;;; $8000..800E: Football data tables ;;;
{
;; $038000: unused values $13-$19 (not referenced).
;; $038007: X speed change indexed by the ground slope, $03800E: Y speed of the next bounce chosen at random.
$03:8000              .db $13,$14,$15,$16,$17,$18,$19 ; Unused: values $13-$19, not referenced anywhere

$03:8007              .db $F0,$F8,$FC,$00,$04,$08,$10 ; Football: X speed change indexed by [$15B8] + 3 (ground slope -3..+3)

$03:800E              .db $A0,$D0,$C0,$D0             ; Football: Y speed after a bounce, indexed by random number & 3

}

;;; $8012: Football sprite main routine (Football) ;;;
{
;; Bouncing football: reverses X speed on walls, zeroes Y speed on ceilings and, each time it lands, flips
;;     horizontally,
;; picks a random bounce height and adds a slope-dependent push to its X speed (clamped to +/-$20).
;; Does nothing while sprites are locked; [$1540] > 1 freezes it, [$1540] = 1 spawns a smoke puff (probably
;;     spin-jump kill).
;; Called by:
;;     $03:A13C: Bank 3 sprite main dispatch (Bnk3CallSprMain)
$03:8012 22 B2 90 01  JSL.L GenericSprGfxRt2          ; Draw sprite (generic graphics routine)
$03:8016 A5 9D        LDA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; \
$03:8018 D0 6C        BNE $8086                       ; / Return if sprites are locked
$03:801A 20 5D B8     JSR.W SubOffscreen0Bnk3         ; Despawn when far off-screen
$03:801D 22 3A 80 01  JSL.L SprSpr+MarioSprRts        ; Sprite-sprite and Mario-sprite interaction
$03:8021 BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; \
$03:8024 F0 07        BEQ $802D                       ; / [$1540] = 0: go move the sprite
$03:8026 3A           DEC A                           ; \
$03:8027 D0 08        BNE $8031                       ; / [$1540] - 1 != 0: skip the smoke and the movement
$03:8029 22 6F AB 01  JSL.L $AB6F                     ; [$1540] = 1: spawn a smoke puff
$03:802D 22 2A 80 01  JSL.L UpdateSpritePos           ; Apply speed to position, check contact with blocks (UpdateSpritePos)
$03:8031 BD 88 15     LDA.W RAM_SprObjStatus,X        ; \
$03:8034 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; |
$03:8036 F0 07        BEQ $803F                       ; / No horizontal wall contact ([$1588] & 3 = 0): skip
$03:8038 B5 B6        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; \
$03:803A 49 FF        EOR.B #$FF                      ; |
$03:803C 1A           INC A                           ; |
$03:803D 95 B6        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; / X speed = -[X speed] (bounce off the wall)
$03:803F BD 88 15     LDA.W RAM_SprObjStatus,X        ; \
$03:8042 29 08        AND.B #$08                      ; |
$03:8044 F0 02        BEQ $8048                       ; / Not touching a ceiling ([$1588] bit 3): skip
$03:8046 74 AA        STZ RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; Touching a ceiling: Y speed = 0
$03:8048 BD 88 15     LDA.W RAM_SprObjStatus,X        ; \
$03:804B 29 04        AND.B #$04                      ; |
$03:804D F0 37        BEQ $8086                       ; / Not on the ground ([$1588] bit 2): return
$03:804F BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; \
$03:8052 D0 32        BNE $8086                       ; / [$1540] non-zero: return
$03:8054 BD F6 15     LDA.W RAM_SpritePal,X           ; \
$03:8057 49 40        EOR.B #$40                      ; |
$03:8059 9D F6 15     STA.W RAM_SpritePal,X           ; / Flip the sprite horizontally: [$15F6] ^= $40
$03:805C 22 F9 AC 01  JSL.L GetRand                   ; \
$03:8060 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; |
$03:8062 A8           TAY                             ; |
$03:8063 B9 0E 80     LDA.W $800E,Y                   ; |
$03:8066 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; / Y speed = $800E[random & 3] (bounce up by a random amount)
$03:8068 BC B8 15     LDY.W $15B8,X                   ; \
$03:806B C8           INY                             ; |
$03:806C C8           INY                             ; |
$03:806D C8           INY                             ; |
$03:806E B9 07 80     LDA.W $8007,Y                   ; |
$03:8071 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:8072 75 B6        ADC RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; / A = [X speed] + $8007[[$15B8] + 3] (slope pushes the ball)
$03:8074 10 08        BPL $807E                       ; Result positive: go clamp at +$20
$03:8076 C9 E0        CMP.B #$E0                      ; \
$03:8078 B0 0A        BCS $8084                       ; / Negative: keep it if >= $E0 (-$20)
$03:807A A9 E0        LDA.B #$E0                      ; Else clamp to $E0
$03:807C 80 06        BRA $8084                       ; Store

$03:807E C9 20        CMP.B #$20                      ; \
$03:8080 90 02        BCC $8084                       ; / Positive: keep it if < $20
$03:8082 A9 20        LDA.B #$20                      ; Else clamp to $20
$03:8084 95 B6        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; Store new X speed
$03:8086 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $8087: Big Boo boss main routine (BigBooBoss) ;;;
{
;; Draws the boss, updates its fade palette and dispatches on state [$C2] through BooBossPtrs.
;; When the sprite slot is freed (status 0) the level ends: sets cutscene flag [$13C6], end timer [$1493] =
;;     $FF and level end music.
;; Called by:
;;     $03:A160: Bank 3 sprite main dispatch (Bnk3CallSprMain)
$03:8087 22 98 83 03  JSL.L $8398                     ; Draw the boss ($8398)
$03:808B 22 39 82 03  JSL.L $8239                     ; Queue the boss's fade palette ($8239)
$03:808F BD C8 14     LDA.W $14C8,X                   ; \
$03:8092 D0 0E        BNE $80A2                       ; / Sprite status non-zero: go to the main code
$03:8094 EE C6 13     INC.W $13C6                     ; Sprite gone: [$13C6]++ (cutscene flag, Mario stops walking at level end)
$03:8097 A9 FF        LDA.B #$FF                      ; \
$03:8099 8D 93 14     STA.W $1493                     ; / [$1493] = $FF: end-of-level timer
$03:809C A9 0B        LDA.B #$0B                      ; \
$03:809E 8D FB 1D     STA.W $1DFB                     ; / [$1DFB] = $0B: request level end music
$03:80A1 60           RTS                             ; Return

$03:80A2 C9 08        CMP.B #$08                      ; \
$03:80A4 D0 2E        BNE $80D4                       ; / Status not 8 (normal): return
$03:80A6 A5 9D        LDA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; \
$03:80A8 D0 2A        BNE $80D4                       ; / Sprites locked: return
$03:80AA B5 C2        LDA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; A = boss state [$C2]
$03:80AC 22 DF 86 00  JSL.L ExecutePtr                ; Run the handler for this state (BooBossPtrs)
; this table holds the location of the coding to use for the various sprite states
}

;;; $80B0: Pointer table: Big Boo boss states (BooBossPtrs) ;;;
{
;; States: 0 hidden wait, 1 fade in, 2 normal movement, 3 hit, 4 fade out, 5 hidden movement, 6 defeated.
;; Also holds the code for state 0 ($80BE, waits $50 frames with graphics frame 3) and state 1
;;     ($80D5,
;; steps the palette index [$190B] up every 8 frames until 7, then state 2).
$03:80B0 BE 80        .dw $80BE                       ; State 0: hidden, wait
$03:80B2 D5 80        .dw $80D5                       ; State 1: fade in
$03:80B4 19 81        .dw $8119                       ; State 2: normal movement
$03:80B6 8B 81        .dw $818B                       ; State 3: hit by a thrown sprite
$03:80B8 BC 81        .dw $81BC                       ; State 4: fade out
$03:80BA 06 81        .dw $8106                       ; State 5: hidden, moving, wait
$03:80BC D3 81        .dw $81D3                       ; State 6: defeated
; sprite state 0
$03:80BE A9 03        LDA.B #$03                      ; \
$03:80C0 9D 02 16     STA.W $1602,X                   ; / Graphics frame [$1602] = 3 (hiding)
$03:80C3 FE 70 15     INC.W $1570,X                   ; [$1570]++: hidden time counter
$03:80C6 BD 70 15     LDA.W $1570,X                   ; \
$03:80C9 C9 90        CMP.B #$90                      ; |
$03:80CB D0 07        BNE $80D4                       ; / [$1570] != $90: return
$03:80CD A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; \
$03:80CF 9D 40 15     STA.W $1540,X                   ; / [$1540] = 8: delay between fade steps
$03:80D2 F6 C2        INC RAM_SpriteState,X           ; State = 1 (fade in)
$03:80D4 60           RTS                             ; Return
; sprite state 1
$03:80D5 BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; \
$03:80D8 D0 1F        BNE $80F9                       ; / Fade step timer [$1540] still running: return
$03:80DA A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; \
$03:80DC 9D 40 15     STA.W $1540,X                   ; / [$1540] = 8
$03:80DF EE 0B 19     INC.W $190B                     ; Fade step: [$190B]++ (palette index)
$03:80E2 AD 0B 19     LDA.W $190B                     ; \
$03:80E5 C9 02        CMP.B #$02                      ; |
$03:80E7 D0 05        BNE $80EE                       ; / [$190B] != 2: skip the sound
$03:80E9 A0 10        LDY.B #$10                      ; \
$03:80EB 8C F9 1D     STY.W $1DF9                     ; / [$1DF9] = $10: sound effect
$03:80EE C9 07        CMP.B #$07                      ; \
$03:80F0 D0 07        BNE $80F9                       ; / [$190B] != 7: return
$03:80F2 F6 C2        INC RAM_SpriteState,X           ; Fully visible: state = 2 (normal)
$03:80F4 A9 40        LDA.B #$40                      ; \
$03:80F6 9D 40 15     STA.W $1540,X                   ; / [$1540] = $40
$03:80F9 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $80FA..8102: Data: Big Boo boss movement tables ;;;
{
;; X/Y acceleration and max speed pairs (reversed when the max is reached) and the turn animation frames.
$03:80FA              .db $FF,$01                     ; X acceleration: +1, -1 (indexed by [$151C] & 1)

$03:80FC              .db $F0,$10                     ; Max X speed: $F0, $10

$03:80FE              .db $0C,$F4                     ; Max Y speed: $0C, $F4

$03:8100              .db $01,$FF                     ; Y acceleration: +1, -1 (indexed by [$1528] & 1)

$03:8102              .db $01,$02,$02,$01             ; Graphics frame while turning, indexed by turn timer / 8
; sprite state 5
}

;;; $8106: Big Boo boss: remaining states and helpers ;;;
{
;; State 5 (hidden and moving, then back to state 0), state 2 (visible: sprite hit check, turn toward Mario,
;;     drift every 8th frame),
;; state 3 (hit: flash, 3rd hit = defeated and KillMostSprites), state 4 (fade out), state 6 (killed, flung
;;     upward).
;; $0381E4: checks sprite slots 0-$0B for a carryable or kicked sprite touching the boss; it is destroyed and
;;     shatters like a block.
;; $038239 (JSL, also called from bank $02): queues a CGRAM upload of 8 colors for fade step [$190B] and sets
;;     [$40] for transparency.
$03:8106 BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; \
$03:8109 D0 07        BNE $8112                       ; / [$1540] still running: skip
$03:810B 74 C2        STZ RAM_SpriteState,X           ; Timer done: state = 0
$03:810D A9 40        LDA.B #$40                      ; \
$03:810F 9D 70 15     STA.W $1570,X                   ; / [$1570] = $40
$03:8112 A9 03        LDA.B #$03                      ; \
$03:8114 9D 02 16     STA.W $1602,X                   ; / Graphics frame [$1602] = 3 (hiding)
$03:8117 80 06        BRA $811F                       ; Go to the movement code ($811F)
; sprite state 2
$03:8119 9E 02 16     STZ.W $1602,X                   ; Graphics frame [$1602] = 0 (normal)
$03:811C 20 E4 81     JSR.W $81E4                     ; Check for thrown sprites hitting the boss ($81E4)
$03:811F BD AC 15     LDA.W $15AC,X                   ; \
$03:8122 D0 0E        BNE $8132                       ; / Turn timer [$15AC] non-zero: already turning, skip
$03:8124 20 17 B8     JSR.W SubHorzPosBnk3            ; \
$03:8127 98           TYA                             ; |
$03:8128 DD 7C 15     CMP.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; |
$03:812B F0 1D        BEQ $814A                       ; / Already facing Mario: skip to the movement code
$03:812D A9 1F        LDA.B #$1F                      ; \
$03:812F 9D AC 15     STA.W $15AC,X                   ; / [$15AC] = $1F: start the turn animation
$03:8132 C9 10        CMP.B #$10                      ; \
$03:8134 D0 0A        BNE $8140                       ; / Turn timer = $10 (halfway)? no: skip the flip
$03:8136 48           PHA                             ; Save the timer
$03:8137 BD 7C 15     LDA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; \
$03:813A 49 01        EOR.B #$01                      ; |
$03:813C 9D 7C 15     STA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; / Flip direction: [$157C] ^= 1
$03:813F 68           PLA                             ; Restore the timer
$03:8140 4A           LSR                             ; \
$03:8141 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:8142 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:8143 A8           TAY                             ; / Y = turn timer / 8
$03:8144 B9 02 81     LDA.W $8102,Y                   ; \
$03:8147 9D 02 16     STA.W $1602,X                   ; / Graphics frame [$1602] = $8102[Y] (turn animation)
$03:814A A5 14        LDA RAM_FrameCounterB           ; \
$03:814C 29 07        AND.B #$07                      ; |
$03:814E D0 16        BNE $8166                       ; / Not every 8th frame ([$14] & 7): skip the X acceleration
$03:8150 BD 1C 15     LDA.W $151C,X                   ; \
$03:8153 29 01        AND.B #$01                      ; |
$03:8155 A8           TAY                             ; |
$03:8156 B5 B6        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; |
$03:8158 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:8159 79 FA 80     ADC.W $80FA,Y                   ; |
$03:815C 95 B6        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; / X speed += $80FA[[$151C] & 1]
$03:815E D9 FC 80     CMP.W $80FC,Y                   ; \
$03:8161 D0 03        BNE $8166                       ; / X speed != max ($80FC)? skip
$03:8163 FE 1C 15     INC.W $151C,X                   ; [$151C]++: reverse the X acceleration
$03:8166 A5 14        LDA RAM_FrameCounterB           ; \
$03:8168 29 07        AND.B #$07                      ; |
$03:816A D0 16        BNE $8182                       ; / Not every 8th frame: skip the Y acceleration
$03:816C BD 28 15     LDA.W $1528,X                   ; \
$03:816F 29 01        AND.B #$01                      ; |
$03:8171 A8           TAY                             ; |
$03:8172 B5 AA        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; |
$03:8174 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:8175 79 00 81     ADC.W $8100,Y                   ; |
$03:8178 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; / Y speed += $8100[[$1528] & 1]
$03:817A D9 FE 80     CMP.W $80FE,Y                   ; \
$03:817D D0 03        BNE $8182                       ; / Y speed != max ($80FE)? skip
$03:817F FE 28 15     INC.W $1528,X                   ; [$1528]++: reverse the Y acceleration
$03:8182 22 22 80 01  JSL.L UpdateXPosNoGrvty         ; Apply X speed (no gravity)
$03:8186 22 1A 80 01  JSL.L UpdateYPosNoGrvty         ; Apply Y speed (no gravity)
$03:818A 60           RTS                             ; Return
; sprite state 3
$03:818B BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; \
$03:818E D0 1E        BNE $81AE                       ; / Hit timer [$1540] still running: go flash
$03:8190 F6 C2        INC RAM_SpriteState,X           ; State = 4 (fade out)
$03:8192 A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; \
$03:8194 9D 40 15     STA.W $1540,X                   ; / [$1540] = 8
$03:8197 22 8B F7 07  JSL.L LoadSpriteTables          ; Reload the sprite tables (LoadSpriteTables)
$03:819B FE 34 15     INC.W $1534,X                   ; Hit counter [$1534]++
$03:819E BD 34 15     LDA.W $1534,X                   ; \
$03:81A1 C9 03        CMP.B #$03                      ; |
$03:81A3 D0 08        BNE $81AD                       ; / Not the 3rd hit: return
$03:81A5 A9 06        LDA.B #$06                      ; \
$03:81A7 95 C2        STA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; / State = 6 (defeated)
$03:81A9 22 C8 A6 03  JSL.L KillMostSprites           ; Kill all other sprites (KillMostSprites)
$03:81AD 60           RTS                             ; Return

$03:81AE 29 0E        AND.B #$0E                      ; \
$03:81B0 5D F6 15     EOR.W RAM_SpritePal,X           ; |
$03:81B3 9D F6 15     STA.W RAM_SpritePal,X           ; / Flash: [$15F6] ^= [$1540] & $0E (palette bits)
$03:81B6 A9 03        LDA.B #$03                      ; \
$03:81B8 9D 02 16     STA.W $1602,X                   ; / Graphics frame [$1602] = 3 (hiding)
$03:81BB 60           RTS                             ; Return
; sprite state 4
$03:81BC BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; \
$03:81BF D0 11        BNE $81D2                       ; / Timer [$1540] still running: return
$03:81C1 A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; \
$03:81C3 9D 40 15     STA.W $1540,X             :/    ; / [$1540] = 8
$03:81C6 CE 0B 19     DEC.W $190B                     ; \
$03:81C9 D0 07        BNE $81D2                       ; / [$190B]--; non-zero: return
$03:81CB F6 C2        INC RAM_SpriteState,X           ; Fully faded out: state = 5
$03:81CD A9 C0        LDA.B #$C0                      ; \
$03:81CF 9D 40 15     STA.W $1540,X                   ; / [$1540] = $C0
$03:81D2 60           RTS                             ; Return
; sprite state 6
$03:81D3 A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; \
$03:81D5 9D C8 14     STA.W $14C8,X                   ; / Status = 2 (killed, falls off screen)
$03:81D8 74 B6        STZ RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; X speed = 0
$03:81DA A9 D0        LDA.B #$D0                      ; \
$03:81DC 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; / Y speed = $D0 (up)
$03:81DE A9 23        LDA.B #$23                      ; \
$03:81E0 8D F9 1D     STA.W $1DF9                     ; / [$1DF9] = $23: sound effect
$03:81E3 60           RTS                             ; Return

$03:81E4 A0 0B        LDY.B #$0B                      ; Y = $0B: start with the last sprite slot
$03:81E6 B9 C8 14     LDA.W $14C8,Y                   ; \
$03:81E9 C9 09        CMP.B #$09                      ; |
$03:81EB F0 08        BEQ $81F5                       ; / Status 9 (carryable): check contact
$03:81ED C9 0A        CMP.B #$0A                      ; \
$03:81EF F0 04        BEQ $81F5                       ; / Status $0A (kicked): check contact
$03:81F1 88           DEY                             ; Next slot: Y--
$03:81F2 10 F2        BPL $81E6                       ; Loop while Y >= 0
$03:81F4 60           RTS                             ; Return

$03:81F5 DA           PHX                             ; Save the boss's sprite index
$03:81F6 BB           TYX                             ; X = other sprite
$03:81F7 22 E5 B6 03  JSL.L GetSpriteClippingB        ; Get clipping box B of the other sprite
$03:81FB FA           PLX                             ; Restore the boss's index
$03:81FC 22 9F B6 03  JSL.L GetSpriteClippingA        ; Get clipping box A of the boss
$03:8200 22 2B B7 03  JSL.L CheckForContact           ; Check overlap (carry set = touching)
$03:8204 90 EB        BCC $81F1                       ; Not touching: next slot
$03:8206 A9 03        LDA.B #$03                      ; \
$03:8208 95 C2        STA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; / State = 3 (hit)
$03:820A A9 40        LDA.B #$40                      ; \
$03:820C 9D 40 15     STA.W $1540,X                   ; / [$1540] = $40
$03:820F DA           PHX                             ; Save the boss's index
$03:8210 BB           TYX                             ; X = the sprite that hit the boss
$03:8211 9E C8 14     STZ.W $14C8,X                   ; Remove that sprite (status 0)
$03:8214 B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; \
$03:8216 85 9A        STA RAM_BlockXLo                ; |
$03:8218 BD E0 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; |
$03:821B 85 9B        STA RAM_BlockXHi                ; |
$03:821D B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; |
$03:821F 85 98        STA RAM_BlockYLo                ; |
$03:8221 BD D4 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; |
$03:8224 85 99        STA RAM_BlockYHi                ; / Block position [$9A],[$9B],[$98],[$99] = that sprite's position
$03:8226 8B           PHB                             ; Save the data bank
$03:8227 A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; \
$03:8229 48           PHA                             ; |
$03:822A AB           PLB                             ; / Data bank = $02
$03:822B A9 FF        LDA.B #$FF                      ; A = $FF
$03:822D 22 63 86 02  JSL.L ShatterBlock              ; Spawn shattering block pieces at the block position (ShatterBlock)
$03:8231 AB           PLB                             ; Restore the data bank
$03:8232 FA           PLX                             ; Restore the boss's index
$03:8233 A9 28        LDA.B #$28                      ; \
$03:8235 8D FC 1D     STA.W $1DFC                     ; / [$1DFC] = $28: sound effect
$03:8238 60           RTS                             ; Return

$03:8239 A0 24        LDY.B #$24                      ; \
$03:823B 84 40        STY $40                         ; / [$40] (CGADSUB mirror) = $24: color math on BG3 and backdrop
$03:823D AD 0B 19     LDA.W $190B                     ; A = [$190B] (fade step)
$03:8240 C9 08        CMP.B #$08                      ; Carry set if step >= 8
$03:8242 3A           DEC A                           ; A = step - 1 (carry unchanged)
$03:8243 B0 05        BCS $824A                       ; Step >= 8: keep $24
$03:8245 A0 34        LDY.B #$34                      ; \
$03:8247 84 40        STY $40                         ; / [$40] = $34: color math also on sprites (transparent boss)
$03:8249 1A           INC A                           ; Undo the DEC: A = step
$03:824A 0A           ASL                             ; \
$03:824B 0A           ASL                             ; |
$03:824C 0A           ASL                             ; |
$03:824D 0A           ASL                             ; |
$03:824E AA           TAX                             ; / X = A * 16: offset into BooBossPals (8 colors per step)
$03:824F 64 00        STZ $00                         ; [$00] = 0: byte counter
$03:8251 AC 81 06     LDY.W $0681                     ; Y = [$0681]: index into the CGRAM upload queue
$03:8254 BF 82 B9 03  LDA.L BooBossPals,X             ; A = next palette byte from BooBossPals[X]
$03:8258 99 84 06     STA.W $0684,Y                   ; Store at $0684 + Y (data part of the new queue record)
$03:825B C8           INY                             ; Y++
$03:825C E8           INX                             ; X++
$03:825D E6 00        INC $00                         ; [$00]++
$03:825F A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$03:8261 C9 10        CMP.B #$10                      ; |
$03:8263 D0 EF        BNE $8254                       ; / Loop for 16 bytes
$03:8265 AE 81 06     LDX.W $0681                     ; X = [$0681]
$03:8268 A9 10        LDA.B #$10                      ; \
$03:826A 9D 82 06     STA.W $0682,X                   ; / Record byte count = $10
$03:826D A9 F0        LDA.B #$F0                      ; \
$03:826F 9D 83 06     STA.W $0683,X                   ; / Record CGRAM address = $F0 (last sprite palette)
$03:8272 9E 94 06     STZ.W $0694,X                   ; Terminate the queue after the record
$03:8275 8A           TXA                             ; \
$03:8276 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:8277 69 12        ADC.B #$12                      ; |
$03:8279 8D 81 06     STA.W $0681                     ; / [$0681] += $12: advance the queue by one record
$03:827C AE E9 15     LDX.W $15E9                     ; Restore the sprite index from [$15E9]
$03:827F 6B           RTL                             ; Return


}

;;; $8348: Big Boo graphics routine, flip table (BigBooGfxProp) ;;;
{
;; Properties table (X/Y flip bits), then the drawing code at $038398 (wrapper, also called from bank $01 for
;;     the Boo block).
;; Sprite $37 only picks a frame (0, 6, or flashing 2/3) and uses the generic routine; others draw 20 16x16
;;     tiles,
;; mirroring the X offsets within a $28 wide area when direction is 0.
;; Parameters: X: sprite index.
$03:8348              .db $00,$00,$40,$00,$00,$80,$80,$00 ; Properties ($40 = X flip, $80 = Y flip): frame 0, tiles 0-7
$03:8350              .db $00,$80,$80,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00 ; Properties ($40 = X flip, $80 = Y flip): frame 0, tiles 8-15
$03:8358              .db $00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$40,$00 ; Properties ($40 = X flip, $80 = Y flip): frame 0 tile 16 to frame 1 tile 3
$03:8360              .db $00,$80,$80,$00,$00,$80,$80,$00 ; Properties ($40 = X flip, $80 = Y flip): frame 1, tiles 4-11
$03:8368              .db $00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00 ; Properties ($40 = X flip, $80 = Y flip): frame 1, tiles 12-19
$03:8370              .db $00,$00,$40,$00,$00,$80,$80,$00 ; Properties ($40 = X flip, $80 = Y flip): frame 2, tiles 0-7
$03:8378              .db $00,$80,$80,$00,$00,$80,$80,$00 ; Properties ($40 = X flip, $80 = Y flip): frame 2, tiles 8-15
$03:8380              .db $00,$80,$80,$00,$00,$40,$00,$00 ; Properties ($40 = X flip, $80 = Y flip): frame 2 tile 16 to frame 3 tile 3
$03:8388              .db $00,$00,$80,$80,$00,$00,$80,$80 ; Properties ($40 = X flip, $80 = Y flip): frame 3, tiles 4-11
$03:8390              .db $00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00 ; Properties ($40 = X flip, $80 = Y flip): frame 3, tiles 12-19

$03:8398 8B           PHB                             ; \
$03:8399 4B           PHK                             ; |
$03:839A AB           PLB                             ; / Data bank = $03
$03:839B 20 A0 83     JSR.W $83A0                     ; Draw ($83A0)
$03:839E AB           PLB                             ; Restore the data bank
$03:839F 6B           RTL                             ; Return

$03:83A0 B5 9E        LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; \
$03:83A2 C9 37        CMP.B #$37                      ; |
$03:83A4 D0 1C        BNE $83C2                       ; / Not sprite $37: go to the Big Boo drawing code
$03:83A6 A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; Frame 0
$03:83A8 B4 C2        LDY RAM_SpriteState,X           ; \
$03:83AA F0 0E        BEQ $83BA                       ; / State 0: use frame 0
$03:83AC A9 06        LDA.B #$06                      ; Frame 6
$03:83AE BC 58 15     LDY.W $1558,X                   ; \
$03:83B1 F0 07        BEQ $83BA                       ; / [$1558] = 0: use frame 6
$03:83B3 98           TYA                             ; \
$03:83B4 29 04        AND.B #$04                      ; |
$03:83B6 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:83B7 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:83B8 69 02        ADC.B #$02                      ; / Frame = 2 + (([$1558] >> 2) & 1): flashing frames 2 and 3
$03:83BA 9D 02 16     STA.W $1602,X                   ; Store the graphics frame [$1602]
$03:83BD 22 B2 90 01  JSL.L GenericSprGfxRt2          ; Draw (generic graphics routine)
$03:83C1 60           RTS                             ; Return

$03:83C2 20 60 B7     JSR.W GetDrawInfoBnk3           ; Get OAM index and screen position (GetDrawInfoBnk3)
$03:83C5 BD 02 16     LDA.W $1602,X                   ; \
$03:83C8 85 06        STA $06                         ; / [$06] = graphics frame [$1602]
$03:83CA 0A           ASL                             ; \
$03:83CB 0A           ASL                             ; |
$03:83CC 85 03        STA $03                         ; |
$03:83CE 0A           ASL                             ; |
$03:83CF 0A           ASL                             ; |
$03:83D0 65 03        ADC $03                         ; |
$03:83D2 85 02        STA $02                         ; / [$02] = frame * 20: index of this frame's first tile in the tables
$03:83D4 BD 7C 15     LDA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; \
$03:83D7 85 04        STA $04                         ; / [$04] = sprite direction [$157C]
$03:83D9 BD F6 15     LDA.W RAM_SpritePal,X           ; \
$03:83DC 85 05        STA $05                         ; / [$05] = sprite properties [$15F6]
$03:83DE A2 00        LDX.B #$00                      ; X = 0: tile loop counter
$03:83E0 DA           PHX                             ; Save the loop counter
$03:83E1 A6 02        LDX $02                         ; X = [$02]: table index of this tile
$03:83E3 BD F8 82     LDA.W BigBooTiles,X             ; \
$03:83E6 99 02 03     STA.W OAM_Tile,Y                ; / OAM tile = BigBooTiles[X]
$03:83E9 A5 04        LDA $04                         ; \
$03:83EB 4A           LSR                             ; / Carry = sprite direction
$03:83EC BD 48 83     LDA.W BigBooGfxProp,X           ; \
$03:83EF 05 05        ORA $05                         ; |
$03:83F1 B0 02        BCS $83F5                       ; / A = BigBooGfxProp[X] | [$05]
$03:83F3 49 40        EOR.B #$40                      ; Direction 0: flip the tile horizontally
$03:83F5 05 64        ORA $64                         ; \
$03:83F7 99 03 03     STA.W OAM_Prop,Y                ; / Add the level's sprite priority [$64] and store as OAM properties
$03:83FA BD 80 82     LDA.W BigBooDispX,X             ; A = BigBooDispX[X]
$03:83FD B0 06        BCS $8405                       ; Direction 1: use the offset as is
$03:83FF 49 FF        EOR.B #$FF                      ; \
$03:8401 1A           INC A                           ; |
$03:8402 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:8403 69 28        ADC.B #$28                      ; / Direction 0: A = $28 - offset (mirror the tile within the boss)
$03:8405 18           CLC                             ; \
$03:8406 65 00        ADC $00                         ; |
$03:8408 99 00 03     STA.W OAM_DispX,Y               ; / OAM X = A + [$00] (sprite screen X)
$03:840B FA           PLX                             ; \
$03:840C DA           PHX                             ; / X = loop counter (also kept on the stack)
$03:840D A5 06        LDA $06                         ; \
$03:840F C9 03        CMP.B #$03                      ; |
$03:8411 90 05        BCC $8418                       ; / Frame < 3: use the first set of Y offsets
$03:8413 8A           TXA                             ; \
$03:8414 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:8415 69 14        ADC.B #$14                      ; |
$03:8417 AA           TAX                             ; / Frame 3 (hiding): X += $14 (second set of Y offsets)
$03:8418 A5 01        LDA $01                         ; \
$03:841A 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:841B 7D D0 82     ADC.W BigBooDispY,X             ; |
$03:841E 99 01 03     STA.W OAM_DispY,Y               ; / OAM Y = [$01] + BigBooDispY[X]
$03:8421 FA           PLX                             ; X = loop counter
$03:8422 C8           INY                             ; \
$03:8423 C8           INY                             ; |
$03:8424 C8           INY                             ; |
$03:8425 C8           INY                             ; / Y += 4: next OAM slot
$03:8426 E6 02        INC $02                         ; Tile index [$02]++
$03:8428 E8           INX                             ; Loop counter++
$03:8429 E0 14        CPX.B #$14                      ; \
$03:842B D0 B3        BNE $83E0                       ; / Loop for all 20 ($14) tiles
$03:842D AE E9 15     LDX.W $15E9                     ; X = sprite index [$15E9]
$03:8430 BD 02 16     LDA.W $1602,X                   ; \
$03:8433 C9 03        CMP.B #$03                      ; |
$03:8435 D0 14        BNE $844B                       ; / Graphics frame != 3 (hiding): finish
$03:8437 BD 58 15     LDA.W $1558,X                   ; \
$03:843A F0 0F        BEQ $844B                       ; / [$1558] = 0 (never set): finish
$03:843C BC EA 15     LDY.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X         ; Unused: Y = OAM index
$03:843F B9 01 03     LDA.W OAM_DispY,Y               ; Unused: A = OAM Y of the first tile
$03:8442 18           CLC                             ; Unused: CLC
$03:8443 69 05        ADC.B #$05                      ; Unused: A += 5
$03:8445 99 01 03     STA.W OAM_DispY,Y               ; Unused: move the first tile down 5 pixels
$03:8448 99 05 03     STA.W OAM_Tile2DispY,Y          ; Unused: move the second tile down as well
$03:844B A9 13        LDA.B #$13                      ; A = $13: 20 tiles written
$03:844D A0 02        LDY.B #$02                      ; Y = 2: the tiles are 16x16
$03:844F 22 B3 B7 01  JSL.L FinishOAMWrite            ; Finish the OAM write (FinishOAMWrite)
$03:8453 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $8454: Grey falling platform main routine (GreyFallingPlat) ;;;
{
;; Platform that falls when Mario stands on it: starts at Y speed 3, waits [$1540] = $18 frames, then
;;     accelerates by 2 up to $40.
;; Called by:
;;     $03:A169: Bank 3 sprite main dispatch (Bnk3CallSprMain)
$03:8454 20 92 84     JSR.W $8492                     ; Draw the platform ($8492)
$03:8457 A5 9D        LDA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; \
$03:8459 D0 2E        BNE $8489                       ; / Sprites locked: return
$03:845B 20 5D B8     JSR.W SubOffscreen0Bnk3         ; Despawn when far off-screen
$03:845E B5 AA        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; \
$03:8460 F0 14        BEQ $8476                       ; / Y speed = 0 (not stepped on yet): skip the movement
$03:8462 BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; \
$03:8465 D0 0B        BNE $8472                       ; / [$1540] non-zero: skip the acceleration
$03:8467 B5 AA        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; \
$03:8469 C9 40        CMP.B #$40                      ; |
$03:846B 10 05        BPL $8472                       ; / Y speed >= $40: skip the acceleration
$03:846D 18           CLC                             ; \
$03:846E 69 02        ADC.B #$02                      ; |
$03:8470 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; / Y speed += 2
$03:8472 22 1A 80 01  JSL.L UpdateYPosNoGrvty         ; Apply Y speed (no gravity)
$03:8476 22 4F B4 01  JSL.L InvisBlkMainRt            ; Make the platform solid (InvisBlkMainRt); carry set if Mario stands on it
$03:847A 90 0D        BCC $8489                       ; Mario not on it: return
$03:847C B5 AA        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; \
$03:847E D0 09        BNE $8489                       ; / Already falling: return
$03:8480 A9 03        LDA.B #$03                      ; \
$03:8482 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; / Y speed = 3: start falling
$03:8484 A9 18        LDA.B #$18                      ; \
$03:8486 9D 40 15     STA.W $1540,X                   ; / [$1540] = $18: delay before accelerating
$03:8489 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $848A: Table: falling platform tile X offsets (FallingPlatDispX) ;;;
{
$03:848A              .db $00,$10,$20,$30             ; Tile X offsets: 0, $10, $20, $30

}

;;; $848E: Falling platform tiles and graphics routine (FallingPlatTiles) ;;;
{
;; Tile table, then $8492 which draws four 16x16 tiles in a row (palette 9, GFX page 2).
$03:848E              .db $60,$61,$61,$62             ; Tiles: $60 (left end), $61, $61, $62 (right end)

$03:8492 20 60 B7     JSR.W GetDrawInfoBnk3           ; Get OAM index and screen position (GetDrawInfoBnk3)
$03:8495 DA           PHX                             ; Save the sprite index
$03:8496 A2 03        LDX.B #$03                      ; X = 3: tile loop counter
$03:8498 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$03:849A 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:849B 7D 8A 84     ADC.W FallingPlatDispX,X        ; |
$03:849E 99 00 03     STA.W OAM_DispX,Y               ; / OAM X = [$00] + FallingPlatDispX[X]
$03:84A1 A5 01        LDA $01                         ; \
$03:84A3 99 01 03     STA.W OAM_DispY,Y               ; / OAM Y = [$01]
$03:84A6 BD 8E 84     LDA.W FallingPlatTiles,X        ; \
$03:84A9 99 02 03     STA.W OAM_Tile,Y                ; / OAM tile = FallingPlatTiles[X]
$03:84AC A9 03        LDA.B #$03                      ; \
$03:84AE 05 64        ORA $64                         ; |
$03:84B0 99 03 03     STA.W OAM_Prop,Y                ; / OAM properties = $03 | [$64]: palette 9, second sprite GFX page
$03:84B3 C8           INY                             ; \
$03:84B4 C8           INY                             ; |
$03:84B5 C8           INY                             ; |
$03:84B6 C8           INY : /                         ; / Y += 4: next OAM slot
$03:84B7 CA           DEX                             ; X--
$03:84B8 10 DE        BPL $8498                       ; Loop for all 4 tiles
$03:84BA FA           PLX                             ; Restore the sprite index
$03:84BB A0 02        LDY.B #$02                      ; Y = 2: the tiles are 16x16
$03:84BD A9 03        LDA.B #$03                      ; A = 3: 4 tiles written
$03:84BF 22 B3 B7 01  JSL.L FinishOAMWrite            ; Finish the OAM write (FinishOAMWrite)
$03:84C3 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $84CA: Blurp main routine (Blurp) ;;;
{
;; Swimming fish. Alternates between tiles $A2 and $EC every 8 frames; dead Blurps are drawn flipped.
;; Every 4th frame Y accelerates up and down within +/-4 (state bit 0 selects the direction); constant X speed
;;     +/-8 by facing.
;; Called by:
;;     $03:A172: Bank 3 sprite main dispatch (Bnk3CallSprMain)
$03:84CA 22 B2 90 01  JSL.L GenericSprGfxRt2          ; Draw sprite (generic graphics routine)
$03:84CE BC EA 15     LDY.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X         ; Y = OAM index
$03:84D1 AD 14 00     LDA.W RAM_FrameCounterB         ; \
$03:84D4 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:84D5 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:84D6 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:84D7 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:84D8 6D E9 15     ADC.W $15E9                     ; |
$03:84DB 4A           LSR                             ; / Carry = bit 0 of ([$14] / 8 + sprite index): swim animation, 8 frames per tile
$03:84DC A9 A2        LDA.B #$A2                      ; A = $A2: first animation tile
$03:84DE 90 02        BCC $84E2                       ; Carry clear: use it
$03:84E0 A9 EC        LDA.B #$EC                      ; A = $EC: second animation tile
$03:84E2 99 02 03     STA.W OAM_Tile,Y                ; Store the tile number
$03:84E5 BD C8 14     LDA.W $14C8,X                   ; \
$03:84E8 C9 08        CMP.B #$08                      ; |
$03:84EA F0 09        BEQ $84F5                       ; / Status 8 (normal): go to the main code
$03:84EC B9 03 03     LDA.W OAM_Prop,Y                ; \
$03:84EF 09 80        ORA.B #$80                : |   ; |
$03:84F1 99 03 03     STA.W OAM_Prop,Y                ; / Dead: flip the sprite vertically
$03:84F4 60           RTS                             ; Return

$03:84F5 A5 9D        LDA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; \
$03:84F7 D0 31        BNE $852A                       ; / Sprites locked: return
$03:84F9 20 5D B8     JSR.W SubOffscreen0Bnk3         ; Despawn when far off-screen
$03:84FC A5 14        LDA RAM_FrameCounterB           ; \
$03:84FE 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; |
$03:8500 D0 14        BNE $8516                       ; / Not every 4th frame: skip the Y acceleration
$03:8502 B5 C2        LDA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; \
$03:8504 29 01        AND.B #$01                      ; |
$03:8506 A8           TAY                             ; / Y = [$C2] & 1: acceleration direction
$03:8507 B5 AA        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; \
$03:8509 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:850A 79 C8 84     ADC.W BlurpAccelY,Y             ; |
$03:850D 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; / Y speed += BlurpAccelY[Y]
$03:850F D9 C4 84     CMP.W BlurpMaxSpeedY,Y          ; \
$03:8512 D0 02        BNE $8516                       ; / Y speed != max for this direction: skip
$03:8514 F6 C2        INC RAM_SpriteState,X           ; Max reached: state++ (reverse direction)
$03:8516 BC 7C 15     LDY.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; \
$03:8519 B9 C6 84     LDA.W BlurpSpeedX,Y             ; |
$03:851C 95 B6        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; / X speed = BlurpSpeedX[direction]
$03:851E 22 22 80 01  JSL.L UpdateXPosNoGrvty         ; Apply X speed (no gravity)
$03:8522 22 1A 80 01  JSL.L UpdateYPosNoGrvty         ; Apply Y speed (no gravity)
$03:8526 22 3A 80 01  JSL.L SprSpr+MarioSprRts        ; Sprite-sprite and Mario-sprite interaction
$03:852A 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

$03:852B              .db $01,$FF                     ; X acceleration by direction: +1 (right), -1 (left)

$03:852D              .db $10,$F0                     ; Max X speed by direction: $10 (right), $F0 (left)

;;; $852F: Porcu-Puffer main routine (PorcuPuffer) ;;;
{
;; Faces Mario and accelerates toward him (+/-1 every 4th frame, max $10). X speed is temporarily boosted by
;;     [$17BD] * 8 for movement.
;; Y speed is 4 (sinks) out of water and $FC (rises) in water.
;; Called by:
;;     $03:A17B: Bank 3 sprite main dispatch (Bnk3CallSprMain)
$03:852F 20 A3 85     JSR.W $85A3                     ; Draw the sprite ($85A3)
$03:8532 A5 9D        LDA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; \
$03:8534 D0 50        BNE $8586                       ; / Sprites locked: return
$03:8536 BD C8 14     LDA.W $14C8,X                   ; \
$03:8539 C9 08        CMP.B #$08                      ; |
$03:853B D0 49        BNE $8586                       ; / Status not 8 (normal): return
$03:853D 20 5D B8     JSR.W SubOffscreen0Bnk3         ; Despawn when far off-screen
$03:8540 22 3A 80 01  JSL.L SprSpr+MarioSprRts        ; Sprite-sprite and Mario-sprite interaction
$03:8544 20 17 B8     JSR.W SubHorzPosBnk3            ; \
$03:8547 98           TYA                             ; |
$03:8548 9D 7C 15     STA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; / Face Mario: [$157C] = 1 if Mario is to the left, else 0
$03:854B A5 14        LDA RAM_FrameCounterB           ; \
$03:854D 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; |
$03:854F D0 0D        BNE $855E                       ; / Not every 4th frame: skip the X acceleration
$03:8551 B5 B6        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; \
$03:8553 D9 2D 85     CMP.W PorcuPuffMaxSpeed,Y       ; |
$03:8556 F0 06        BEQ $855E                       ; / X speed already at the max for this direction: skip
$03:8558 18           CLC                             ; \
$03:8559 79 2B 85     ADC.W PorcuPuffAccel,Y          ; |
$03:855C 95 B6        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; / X speed += PorcuPuffAccel[direction]
$03:855E B5 B6        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; \
$03:8560 48           PHA                             ; / Save the X speed
$03:8561 AD BD 17     LDA.W $17BD                     ; \
$03:8564 0A           ASL                             ; |
$03:8565 0A           ASL                             ; |
$03:8566 0A           ASL                             ; |
$03:8567 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:8568 75 B6        ADC RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; |
$03:856A 95 B6        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; / Temporary X speed += [$17BD] * 8 (probably compensates screen scroll)
$03:856C 22 22 80 01  JSL.L UpdateXPosNoGrvty         ; Apply X speed (no gravity)
$03:8570 68           PLA                             ; \
$03:8571 95 B6        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; / Restore the saved X speed
$03:8573 22 38 91 01  JSL.L $9138                     ; Sprite-block interaction; also sets in-water flag [$164A]
$03:8577 A0 04        LDY.B #$04                      ; Y = 4: Y speed when not in water (sinks)
$03:8579 BD 4A 16     LDA.W $164A,X                   ; \
$03:857C F0 02        BEQ $8580                       ; / Not in water: keep Y = 4
$03:857E A0 FC        LDY.B #$FC                      ; Y = $FC: Y speed in water (rises)
$03:8580 94 AA        STY RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; Store Y speed
$03:8582 22 1A 80 01  JSL.L UpdateYPosNoGrvty         ; Apply Y speed (no gravity)
$03:8586 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

$03:8587              .db $F8,$08,$F8,$08,$08,$F8,$08,$F8 ; X offsets of the 4 tiles: left-facing layout, then mirrored layout
}

;;; $8593: Table: Porcu-Puffer tiles (PocruPufferTiles) ;;;
{
$03:8593              .db $86,$C0,$A6,$C2,$86,$C0,$A6,$8A ; Tiles: animation frame 0 (4 tiles), animation frame 1 (4 tiles)
}

;;; $859B: Porcu-Puffer graphics routine (PocruPufferGfxProp) ;;;
{
;; Property table, then $85A3: draws four 16x16 tiles in a 2x2 layout; tile set swaps every 4 frames,
;;     layout mirrored by direction.
$03:859B              .db $0D,$0D,$0D,$0D,$4D,$4D,$4D,$4D ; OAM properties: $0D (no flip) / $4D (X flip)

$03:85A3 20 60 B7     JSR.W GetDrawInfoBnk3           ; Get OAM index and screen position (GetDrawInfoBnk3)
$03:85A6 A5 14        LDA RAM_FrameCounterB           ; \
$03:85A8 29 04        AND.B #$04                      ; |
$03:85AA 85 03        STA $03                         ; / [$03] = [$14] & 4: animation frame offset (0 or 4), changes every 4 frames
$03:85AC BD 7C 15     LDA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; \
$03:85AF 85 02        STA $02                         ; / [$02] = sprite direction
$03:85B1 DA           PHX                             ; Save the sprite index
$03:85B2 A2 03        LDX.B #$03                      ; X = 3: tile loop counter
$03:85B4 A5 01        LDA $01                         ; \
$03:85B6 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:85B7 7D 8F 85     ADC.W PocruPufferDispY,X        ; |
$03:85BA 99 01 03     STA.W OAM_DispY,Y               ; / OAM Y = [$01] + PocruPufferDispY[X]
$03:85BD DA           PHX                             ; Save the loop counter
$03:85BE A5 02        LDA $02                         ; \
$03:85C0 D0 04        BNE $85C6                       ; / Direction non-zero: use X as is
$03:85C2 8A           TXA                             ; \
$03:85C3 09 04        ORA.B #$04                      ; |
$03:85C5 AA           TAX                             ; / Direction 0: X |= 4 (mirrored half of the tables)
$03:85C6 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$03:85C8 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:85C9 7D 87 85     ADC.W PocruPufferDispX,X        ; |
$03:85CC 99 00 03     STA.W OAM_DispX,Y               ; / OAM X = [$00] + PocruPufferDispX[X]
$03:85CF BD 9B 85     LDA.W PocruPufferGfxProp,X      ; \
$03:85D2 05 64        ORA $64                         ; |
$03:85D4 99 03 03     STA.W OAM_Prop,Y                ; / OAM properties = PocruPufferGfxProp[X] | [$64]
$03:85D7 68           PLA                             ; \
$03:85D8 48           PHA                             ; / X = loop counter (kept on the stack)
$03:85D9 05 03        ORA $03                         ; \
$03:85DB AA           TAX                             ; / X = loop counter | [$03]: tile table index
$03:85DC BD 93 85     LDA.W PocruPufferTiles,X        ; \
$03:85DF 99 02 03     STA.W OAM_Tile,Y                ; / OAM tile = PocruPufferTiles[X]
$03:85E2 FA           PLX                             ; X = loop counter
$03:85E3 C8           INY                             ; \
$03:85E4 C8           INY                             ; |
$03:85E5 C8           INY                             ; |
$03:85E6 C8           INY                             ; / Y += 4: next OAM slot
$03:85E7 CA           DEX                             ; X--
$03:85E8 10 CA        BPL $85B4                       ; Loop for all 4 tiles
$03:85EA FA           PLX                             ; Restore the sprite index
$03:85EB A0 02        LDY.B #$02                      ; Y = 2: the tiles are 16x16
$03:85ED A9 03        LDA.B #$03                      ; A = 3: 4 tiles written
$03:85EF 22 B3 B7 01  JSL.L FinishOAMWrite            ; Finish the OAM write (FinishOAMWrite)
$03:85F3 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

{
$03:85F4              .db $08,$F8                     ; Y speed by direction: +8, -8

;;; $85F6: Flying grey turnblocks main routine (FlyingTurnBlocks) ;;;
{
;; Platform that starts moving right at X speed 8 (flag [$1B9A] = 8) once Mario stands on it, bobbing up and
;;     down;
;; [$1602] is used as the direction switch timer (not a graphics frame). Also starts the first other $C1
;;     sprite found in slots 0-9.
;; Called by:
;;     $03:A184: Bank 3 sprite main dispatch (Bnk3CallSprMain)
$03:85F6 20 A8 86     JSR.W $86A8                     ; Draw the sprite ($86A8)
$03:85F9 A5 9D        LDA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; \
$03:85FB D0 78        BNE $8675                       ; / Sprites locked: return
$03:85FD AD 9A 1B     LDA.W $1B9A                     ; \
$03:8600 F0 27        BEQ $8629                       ; / [$1B9A] = 0 (scroll not started): go to 038629
$03:8602 BD 34 15     LDA.W $1534,X                   ; A = [$1534]
$03:8605 FE 34 15     INC.W $1534,X                   ; [$1534]++
$03:8608 29 01        AND.B #$01                      ; \
$03:860A D0 12        BNE $861E                       ; / Old [$1534] was odd: skip the direction timer
$03:860C DE 02 16     DEC.W $1602,X                   ; [$1602]--: direction switch timer
$03:860F BD 02 16     LDA.W $1602,X                   ; \
$03:8612 C9 FF        CMP.B #$FF                      ; |
$03:8614 D0 08        BNE $861E                       ; / Timer != $FF (not underflowed): skip
$03:8616 A9 FF        LDA.B #$FF                      ; \
$03:8618 9D 02 16     STA.W $1602,X                   ; |
$03:861B FE 7C 15     INC.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; / [$1602] = $FF; [$157C]++: swap the direction
$03:861E BD 7C 15     LDA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; \
$03:8621 29 01        AND.B #$01                      ; |
$03:8623 A8           TAY                             ; / Y = [$157C] & 1
$03:8624 B9 F4 85     LDA.W FlyingBlockSpeedY,Y       ; \
$03:8627 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; / Y speed = FlyingBlockSpeedY[Y]
$03:8629 B5 AA        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; A = Y speed
$03:862B 48           PHA                             ; Save the Y speed
$03:862C BC 1C 15     LDY.W $151C,X                   ; \
$03:862F D0 05        BNE $8636                       ; / [$151C] non-zero: use the speed as is
$03:8631 49 FF        EOR.B #$FF                      ; \
$03:8633 1A           INC A                           ; |
$03:8634 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; / Else Y speed = -[Y speed]
$03:8636 22 1A 80 01  JSL.L UpdateYPosNoGrvty         ; Apply Y speed (no gravity)
$03:863A 68           PLA                             ; \
$03:863B 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; / Restore the saved Y speed
$03:863D AD 9A 1B     LDA.W $1B9A                     ; \
$03:8640 95 B6        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; / X speed = [$1B9A] ($08 once the scroll has started, else 0)
$03:8642 22 22 80 01  JSL.L UpdateXPosNoGrvty         ; Apply X speed (no gravity)
$03:8646 9D 28 15     STA.W $1528,X                   ; Store A in [$1528] (never read by this sprite)
$03:8649 22 4F B4 01  JSL.L InvisBlkMainRt            ; Make the platform solid (InvisBlkMainRt); carry set if Mario stands on it
$03:864D 90 26        BCC $8675                       ; Mario not on it: return
$03:864F AD 9A 1B     LDA.W $1B9A                     ; \
$03:8652 D0 21        BNE $8675                       ; / [$1B9A] already set: return
$03:8654 A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; \
$03:8656 8D 9A 1B     STA.W $1B9A                     ; / [$1B9A] = 8: start the movement
$03:8659 A9 7F        LDA.B #$7F                      ; \
$03:865B 9D 02 16     STA.W $1602,X                   ; / [$1602] = $7F: direction switch timer
$03:865E A0 09        LDY.B #$09                      ; Y = 9: search sprite slots 9 to 0
$03:8660 CC E9 15     CPY.W $15E9                     ; \
$03:8663 F0 07        BEQ $866C                       ; / This sprite itself: skip
$03:8665 B9 9E 00     LDA.W RAM_SpriteNum,Y           ; \
$03:8668 C9 C1        CMP.B #$C1                      ; |
$03:866A F0 04        BEQ $8670                       ; / Sprite number $C1 (flying turnblocks) found: go set its timer
$03:866C 88           DEY                             ; \
$03:866D 10 F1        BPL $8660                       ; / Next slot; loop
$03:866F C8           INY                             ; None found: Y wraps to 0 (so slot 0 is written)
$03:8670 A9 7F        LDA.B #$7F                      ; \
$03:8672 99 02 16     STA.W $1602,Y                   ; / [$1602,Y] = $7F: sync the other block's direction timer
$03:8675 60           RTS                             ; Return


}
