;;; $869E: Flying turn blocks graphics routine (ForestPlatTileSize) ;;;
{
;; Table: OAM size bits for the five tiles (2 = 16x16). Then the draw routine (called from FlyingTurnBlocks):
;;     draws 5 tiles from the
;; ForestPlat* tables; [$14] bit 3 picks the table half (wing animation). Tiles written with varying sizes (Y
;;     = $FF), A = 4 for FinishOAMWrite.
$03:869E              .db $02,$02,$02,$02,$02,$02,$02,$02 ; Tile sizes: $02 (16x16) for tiles 0-7
$03:86A6              .db $00,$00                     ; Tiles 8-9: size 0 (8x8, unused)

$03:86A8 20 60 B7     JSR.W GetDrawInfoBnk3           ; Get sprite draw position ($00 = X, $01 = Y)
$03:86AB BC EA 15     LDY.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X         ; Y = OAM index of this sprite
$03:86AE A5 14        LDA RAM_FrameCounterB           ; \
$03:86B0 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:86B1 29 04        AND.B #$04                      ; |
$03:86B3 F0 01        BEQ $86B6                       ; |
$03:86B5 1A           INC A                           ; |
$03:86B6 85 02        STA $02                         ; / [$02] = 0 or 5: wing frame from [$14] bit 3
$03:86B8 DA           PHX                             ; Save sprite index
$03:86B9 A2 04        LDX.B #$04                      ; \
$03:86BB 86 06        STX $06                         ; / Loop counter [$06] = 4 (five tiles)
$03:86BD 8A           TXA                             ; \
$03:86BE 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:86BF 65 02        ADC $02                         ; |
$03:86C1 AA           TAX                             ; / X = loop counter + [$02]: table index
$03:86C2 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$03:86C4 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:86C5 7D 76 86     ADC.W ForestPlatDispX,X         ; |
$03:86C8 99 00 03     STA.W OAM_DispX,Y               ; / OAM X = sprite X + ForestPlatDispX[X]
$03:86CB A5 01        LDA $01                         ; \
$03:86CD 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:86CE 7D 80 86     ADC.W ForestPlatDispY,X         ; |
$03:86D1 99 01 03     STA.W OAM_DispY,Y               ; / OAM Y = sprite Y + ForestPlatDispY[X]
$03:86D4 BD 8A 86     LDA.W ForestPlatTiles,X         ; \
$03:86D7 99 02 03     STA.W OAM_Tile,Y                ; / OAM tile number from ForestPlatTiles
$03:86DA BD 94 86     LDA.W ForestPlatGfxProp,X       ; \
$03:86DD 99 03 03     STA.W OAM_Prop,Y                ; / OAM properties from ForestPlatGfxProp
$03:86E0 5A           PHY                             ; \
$03:86E1 98           TYA                             ; |
$03:86E2 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:86E3 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:86E4 A8           TAY                             ; / Y = OAM index / 4 (size table index)
$03:86E5 BD 9E 86     LDA.W ForestPlatTileSize,X      ; \
$03:86E8 99 60 04     STA.W OAM_TileSize,Y            ; / OAM size bits from ForestPlatTileSize
$03:86EB 7A           PLY                             ; Restore OAM index
$03:86EC C8           INY                             ; \
$03:86ED C8           INY                             ; |
$03:86EE C8           INY                             ; |
$03:86EF C8           INY                             ; / OAM index += 4
$03:86F0 A6 06        LDX $06                         ; \
$03:86F2 CA           DEX                             ; |
$03:86F3 10 C6        BPL $86BB                       ; / Next tile unless all five are drawn
$03:86F5 FA           PLX                             ; Restore sprite index
$03:86F6 A0 FF        LDY.B #$FF                      ; Sizes are stored individually (no common size)
$03:86F8 A9 04        LDA.B #$04                      ; Tiles drawn - 1 = 4
$03:86FA 22 B3 B7 01  JSL.L FinishOAMWrite            ; Finish OAM write (offscreen culling)
$03:86FE 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $86FF: Gray lava platform main (GrayLavaPlatform) ;;;
{
;; Draws, then handles the platform: Mario can stand on it; standing on it starts a $40-frame sink timer
;;     ($1540) with Y speed 6.
;; When the timer reaches 1 the sprite is removed and its load status reset so it respawns from level data.
;; Called by:
;;     $03:A18D: Bank 3 sprite main dispatch (Bnk3CallSprMain)
$03:86FF 20 3A 87     JSR.W $873A                     ; Draw the platform ($873A)
$03:8702 A5 9D        LDA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; \
$03:8704 D0 2D        BNE $8733                       ; / Return if sprites locked
$03:8706 20 5D B8     JSR.W SubOffscreen0Bnk3         ; Handle offscreen despawn
$03:8709 BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; \
$03:870C 3A           DEC A                           ; |
$03:870D D0 0C        BNE $871B                       ; / Branch unless the sink timer [$1540] equals 1
$03:870F BC 1A 16     LDY.W RAM_SprIndexInLvl,X       ; \
$03:8712 A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; |
$03:8714 99 38 19     STA.W RAM_SprLoadStatus,Y       ; |
$03:8717 9E C8 14     STZ.W $14C8,X                   ; / Clear load status so the platform respawns; remove sprite
$03:871A 60           RTS                             ; Return

$03:871B 22 1A 80 01  JSL.L UpdateYPosNoGrvty         ; Move vertically (no gravity)
$03:871F 22 4F B4 01  JSL.L InvisBlkMainRt            ; Solid on top for Mario (like an invisible block)
$03:8723 90 0E        BCC $8733                       ; Return if Mario is not standing on it
$03:8725 BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; \
$03:8728 D0 09        BNE $8733                       ; / Return if the sink timer is already running
$03:872A A9 06        LDA.B #$06                      ; \
$03:872C 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; / Y speed = 6 (sink)
$03:872E A9 40        LDA.B #$40                      ; \
$03:8730 9D 40 15     STA.W $1540,X                   ; / Sink timer = $40 frames
$03:8733 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $8734: Gray lava platform graphics (LavaPlatTiles) ;;;
{
;; Tables: tile numbers and properties for the three 16x16 tiles, then the draw routine that places them 16
;;     pixels apart.
$03:8734              .db $85,$86,$85                 ; Tiles: $85,$86,$85 (left, middle, right)

$03:8737              .db $43,$03,$03                 ; Properties: $43,$03,$03 (right tile X-flipped)

$03:873A 20 60 B7     JSR.W GetDrawInfoBnk3           ; Get sprite draw position ($00 = X, $01 = Y)
$03:873D DA           PHX                             ; Save sprite index
$03:873E A2 02        LDX.B #$02                      ; Loop counter = 2 (three tiles)
$03:8740 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$03:8742 99 00 03     STA.W OAM_DispX,Y               ; / OAM X = current X
$03:8745 18           CLC                             ; \
$03:8746 69 10        ADC.B #$10                      ; |
$03:8748 85 00        STA $00                         ; / Next tile X += $10
$03:874A A5 01        LDA $01                         ; \
$03:874C 99 01 03     STA.W OAM_DispY,Y               ; / OAM Y = sprite Y
$03:874F BD 34 87     LDA.W LavaPlatTiles,X           ; \
$03:8752 99 02 03     STA.W OAM_Tile,Y                ; / OAM tile number from LavaPlatTiles
$03:8755 BD 37 87     LDA.W $8737,X                   ; \
$03:8758 05 64        ORA $64                         ; |
$03:875A 99 03 03     STA.W OAM_Prop,Y                ; / OAM properties = table | level priority [$64]
$03:875D C8           INY                             ; \
$03:875E C8           INY                             ; |
$03:875F C8           INY                             ; |
$03:8760 C8           INY                             ; / OAM index += 4
$03:8761 CA           DEX                             ; \
$03:8762 10 DC        BPL $8740                       ; / Next tile
$03:8764 FA           PLX                             ; Restore sprite index
$03:8765 A0 02        LDY.B #$02                      ; All 16x16
$03:8767 A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; Three tiles drawn - 1 = 2
$03:8769 22 B3 B7 01  JSL.L FinishOAMWrite            ; Finish OAM write
$03:876D 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $876E: Table: Mega Mole X speed by direction (MegaMoleSpeed) ;;;
{
$03:876E              .db $10,$F0                     ; $10 - walking right, $F0 - walking left

}

;;; $8770: Mega Mole main (MegaMole) ;;;
{
;; Draws, then (if status 8 and sprites not locked) walks left/right at $10/$F0, updates position and sprite
;;     contacts.
;; Remembers whether it was on the ground this frame ($0A frame grace timer in $1540 after leaving the
;;     ground).
;; Called by:
;;     $03:A196: Bank 3 sprite main dispatch (Bnk3CallSprMain)
$03:8770 20 3F 88     JSR.W MegaMoleGfxRt             ; Draw Mega Mole
$03:8773 BD C8 14     LDA.W $14C8,X                   ; \
$03:8776 C9 08        CMP.B #$08                      ; |
$03:8778 D0 B9        BNE $8733                       ; / Return unless status is 8 (normal)
$03:877A 20 4F B8     JSR.W SubOffscreen3Bnk3         ; Handle offscreen despawn
$03:877D BC 7C 15     LDY.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; \
$03:8780 B9 6E 87     LDA.W MegaMoleSpeed,Y           ; |
$03:8783 95 B6        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; / X speed = MegaMoleSpeed[direction]
$03:8785 A5 9D        LDA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; \
$03:8787 D0 AA        BNE $8733                       ; / Return if sprites locked
$03:8789 BD 88 15     LDA.W RAM_SprObjStatus,X        ; \
$03:878C 29 04        AND.B #$04                      ; |
$03:878E 48           PHA                             ; / Save the on-ground flag from last frame
$03:878F 22 2A 80 01  JSL.L UpdateSpritePos           ; Update position from speeds
$03:8793 22 32 80 01  JSL.L SprSprInteract            ; Interact with other sprites
$03:8797 BD 88 15     LDA.W RAM_SprObjStatus,X        ; \
$03:879A 29 04        AND.B #$04                      ; |
$03:879C F0 05        BEQ MegaMoleInAir               ; / Branch if not on ground now
$03:879E 74 AA        STZ RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; On ground: Y speed = 0
$03:87A0 68           PLA                             ; Pop saved flag
$03:87A1 80 0F        BRA MegaMoleOnGround            ; Skip the ledge timer logic

}

;;; $87A3: Mega Mole: airborne this frame (MegaMoleInAir) ;;;
{
;; Pops the saved on-ground bit; if it was on the ground last frame, starts the $0A-frame timer in $1540.
$03:87A3 68           PLA                             ; Pop last frame's on-ground flag
$03:87A4 F0 05        BEQ MegaMoleWasInAir            ; Was on ground last frame: start ledge timer
$03:87A6 A9 0A        LDA.B #$0A                      ; \
$03:87A8 9D 40 15     STA.W $1540,X                   ; / [$1540] = $0A
}

;;; $87AB: Mega Mole: ledge grace timer (MegaMoleWasInAir) ;;;
{
;; While the $1540 timer runs, Y speed is held at 0 so it walks off ledges smoothly.
$03:87AB BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; \
$03:87AE F0 02        BEQ MegaMoleOnGround            ; / While the ledge timer is running...
$03:87B0 74 AA        STZ RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; Keep Y speed 0 (hover briefly off ledges)
}

;;; $87B2: Mega Mole: turn at walls, Mario contact (MegaMoleOnGround) ;;;
{
;; Turns around on wall contact (with a $10-frame turn timer $15AC for the graphics direction $151C).
;; Mario touching it from above (not too high, falling) lets Mario ride on it; touching from the side hurts
;;     Mario.
$03:87B2 BC AC 15     LDY.W $15AC,X                   ; Y = turn timer [$15AC]
$03:87B5 BD 88 15     LDA.W RAM_SprObjStatus,X        ; \
$03:87B8 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; |
$03:87BA F0 11        BEQ $87CD                       ; / Branch if not touching a wall (bits 0-1)
$03:87BC C0 00        CPY.B #$00                      ; \
$03:87BE D0 05        BNE $87C5                       ; / Skip if a turn timer is already running
$03:87C0 A9 10        LDA.B #$10                      ; \
$03:87C2 9D AC 15     STA.W $15AC,X                   ; / Turn timer = $10 frames
$03:87C5 BD 7C 15     LDA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; \
$03:87C8 49 01        EOR.B #$01                      ; |
$03:87CA 9D 7C 15     STA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; / Flip walking direction
$03:87CD C0 00        CPY.B #$00                      ; \
$03:87CF D0 06        BNE $87D7                       ; / Turn timer != 0: keep the old graphics direction
$03:87D1 BD 7C 15     LDA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; \
$03:87D4 9D 1C 15     STA.W $151C,X                   ; / Graphics direction [$151C] = walking direction
$03:87D7 22 DC A7 01  JSL.L MarioSprInteract          ; Check Mario contact
$03:87DB 90 4D        BCC $882A                       ; Return if no contact
$03:87DD 20 29 B8     JSR.W SubVertPosBnk3            ; Mario Y position relative to sprite into [$0E]
$03:87E0 A5 0E        LDA $0E                         ; \
$03:87E2 C9 D8        CMP.B #$D8                      ; |
$03:87E4 10 38        BPL MegaMoleContact             ; / Mario not above the head: side hit
$03:87E6 A5 7D        LDA RAM_MarioSpeedY             ; \
$03:87E8 30 40        BMI $882A                       ; / Return if Mario is moving up
$03:87EA A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; \
$03:87EC 8D 71 14     STA.W $1471                     ; / [$1471] = 1: Mario is standing on a sprite
$03:87EF A9 06        LDA.B #$06                      ; \
$03:87F1 9D 4C 15     STA.W RAM_DisableInter,X        ; / Riding flag [$154C] = 6 (no interaction)
$03:87F4 64 7D        STZ RAM_MarioSpeedY             ; Mario Y speed = 0
$03:87F6 A9 D6        LDA.B #$D6                      ; \
$03:87F8 AC 7A 18     LDY.W RAM_OnYoshi               ; |
$03:87FB F0 02        BEQ MegaMoleNoYoshi             ; |
$03:87FD A9 C6        LDA.B #$C6                      ; / A = $D6, or $C6 if Mario is on Yoshi
}

;;; $87FF: Mega Mole: carry Mario (MegaMoleNoYoshi) ;;;
{
;; Puts Mario on top of the Mega Mole (Y offset differs with Yoshi) and moves him horizontally by [$1491]
;;     (+1/-1).
$03:87FF 18           CLC                             ; \
$03:8800 75 D8        ADC RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; |
$03:8802 85 96        STA RAM_MarioYPos               ; |
$03:8804 BD D4 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; |
$03:8807 69 FF        ADC.B #$FF                      ; |
$03:8809 85 97        STA RAM_MarioYPosHi             ; / Mario Y = sprite Y + A (16-bit)
$03:880B A0 00        LDY.B #$00                      ; \
$03:880D AD 91 14     LDA.W $1491                     ; |
$03:8810 10 01        BPL $8813                       ; |
$03:8812 88           DEY                             ; |
$03:8813 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:8814 65 94        ADC RAM_MarioXPos               ; |
$03:8816 85 94        STA RAM_MarioXPos               ; |
$03:8818 98           TYA                             ; |
$03:8819 65 95        ADC RAM_MarioXPosHi             ; |
$03:881B 85 95        STA RAM_MarioXPosHi             ; / Mario X += [$1491] (+1 or -1, platform movement)
$03:881D 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $881E: Mega Mole: hurt Mario on side contact (MegaMoleContact) ;;;
{
;; Hurts Mario unless he is riding it, or it is being eaten by Yoshi.
$03:881E BD 4C 15     LDA.W RAM_DisableInter,X        ; \
$03:8821 1D D0 15     ORA.W $15D0,X                   ; |
$03:8824 D0 04        BNE $882A                       ; / Return if riding it or it is being eaten
$03:8826 22 B7 F5 00  JSL.L HurtMario                 ; Hurt Mario
$03:882A 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $882B: Table: Mega Mole tile X offsets (MegaMoleTileDispX) ;;;
{
;; 8 entries: 4 tiles for facing left, then 4 for facing right.
$03:882B              .db $00,$10,$00,$10,$10,$00,$10,$00 ; X offsets: left-facing $00,$10,$00,$10; right-facing $10,$00,$10,$00
}

;;; $8833: Table: Mega Mole tile Y offsets (MegaMoleTileDispY) ;;;
{
$03:8833              .db $F0,$F0,$00,$00             ; Y offsets: $F0,$F0,$00,$00 (top row, bottom row)

}

;;; $8837: Table: Mega Mole tile numbers (MegaMoleTiles) ;;;
{
;; Two animation frames of four 16x16 tiles each, per direction.
$03:8837              .db $C6,$C8,$E6,$E8,$CA,$CC,$EA,$EC ; Tiles: $C6,$C8,$E6,$E8 / $CA,$CC,$EA,$EC (two frames)

}

;;; $883F: Mega Mole graphics routine (MegaMoleGfxRt) ;;;
{
;; Draws four 16x16 tiles (2x2). Animation frame from [$14] and the sprite's slot index; flips horizontally
;;     when facing right.
;; Called by:
;;     $03:8770: Mega Mole main (MegaMole)
$03:883F 20 60 B7     JSR.W GetDrawInfoBnk3           ; Get sprite draw position ($00 = X, $01 = Y)
$03:8842 BD 1C 15     LDA.W $151C,X                   ; \
$03:8845 85 02        STA $02                         ; / [$02] = graphics direction
$03:8847 A5 14        LDA RAM_FrameCounterB           ; \
$03:8849 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:884A 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:884B EA           NOP                             ; |
$03:884C 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:884D 6D E9 15     ADC.W $15E9                     ; |
$03:8850 29 01        AND.B #$01                      ; |
$03:8852 0A           ASL                             ; |
$03:8853 0A           ASL                             ; |
$03:8854 85 03        STA $03                         ; } [$03] = 0 or 4: animation frame (changes every 4 frames, per sprite)
$03:8856 DA           PHX                             ; /
$03:8857 A2 03        LDX.B #$03                      ; Loop counter = 3 (four tiles)
}

;;; $8859: Mega Mole: draw tile loop (MegaMoleGfxLoopSt) ;;;
{
$03:8859 DA           PHX                             ; Save loop counter
$03:885A A5 02        LDA $02                         ; \
$03:885C D0 04        BNE MegaMoleFaceLeft            ; / Facing right (dir 0): use the second half of the tables
$03:885E E8           INX                             ; \
$03:885F E8           INX                             ; |
$03:8860 E8           INX                             ; |
$03:8861 E8           INX                             ; / X += 4
}

;;; $8862: Mega Mole: place one tile (MegaMoleFaceLeft) ;;;
{
$03:8862 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$03:8864 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:8865 7D 2B 88     ADC.W MegaMoleTileDispX,X       ; |
$03:8868 99 00 03     STA.W OAM_DispX,Y               ; / OAM X = sprite X + MegaMoleTileDispX[X]
$03:886B FA           PLX                             ; \
$03:886C A5 01        LDA $01                         ; |
$03:886E 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:886F 7D 33 88     ADC.W MegaMoleTileDispY,X       ; |
$03:8872 99 01 03     STA.W OAM_DispY,Y               ; / OAM Y = sprite Y + MegaMoleTileDispY[X]
$03:8875 DA           PHX                             ; Save index
$03:8876 8A           TXA                             ; \
$03:8877 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:8878 65 03        ADC $03                         ; |
$03:887A AA           TAX                             ; / X = tile index + frame offset
$03:887B BD 37 88     LDA.W MegaMoleTiles,X           ; \
$03:887E 99 02 03     STA.W OAM_Tile,Y                ; / OAM tile number from MegaMoleTiles
$03:8881 A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; Properties: palette 0, page 1
$03:8883 A6 02        LDX $02                         ; \
$03:8885 D0 02        BNE MegaMoleGfxNoFlip           ; |
$03:8887 09 40        ORA.B #$40                      ; / X-flip when direction is 0
}

;;; $8889: Mega Mole: tile properties (MegaMoleGfxNoFlip) ;;;
{
$03:8889 05 64        ORA $64                         ; Add level priority [$64]
$03:888B 99 03 03     STA.W OAM_Prop,Y                ; Store OAM properties
$03:888E FA           PLX                             ; Restore loop counter
$03:888F C8           INY                             ; \
$03:8890 C8           INY                             ; |
$03:8891 C8           INY                             ; |
$03:8892 C8           INY                             ; / OAM index += 4
$03:8893 CA           DEX                             ; \
$03:8894 10 C3        BPL MegaMoleGfxLoopSt           ; / Next tile
$03:8896 FA           PLX                             ; Restore sprite index
$03:8897 A0 02        LDY.B #$02                      ; All 16x16
$03:8899 A9 03        LDA.B #$03                      ; Four tiles - 1 = 3
$03:889B 22 B3 B7 01  JSL.L FinishOAMWrite            ; Finish OAM write
$03:889F 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $88A0: Table: Swooper tile numbers (BatTiles) ;;;
{
;; Tile per graphics frame ($1602): 0 = hanging, 1-2 = wings up/down.
$03:88A0              .db $AE,$C0,$E8                 ; Hanging, wings up, wings down

}

;;; $88A3: Swooper bat main (Swooper) ;;;
{
;; Uses GenericSprGfxRt2, replaces the tile by frame. If not status 8 falls to the upside-down death drawing.
;; Otherwise processes sprite interaction, moves, and runs a state machine: 0 = waiting, 1 = swooping down, 2
;;     = flying horizontally.
;; Called by:
;;     $03:A19F: Bank 3 sprite main dispatch (Bnk3CallSprMain)
$03:88A3 22 B2 90 01  JSL.L GenericSprGfxRt2          ; Draw generic sprite
$03:88A7 BC EA 15     LDY.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X         ; Y = OAM index
$03:88AA DA           PHX                             ; \
$03:88AB BD 02 16     LDA.W $1602,X                   ; |
$03:88AE AA           TAX                             ; |
$03:88AF BD A0 88     LDA.W BatTiles,X                ; |
$03:88B2 99 02 03     STA.W OAM_Tile,Y                ; |
$03:88B5 FA           PLX                             ; / OAM tile = BatTiles[graphics frame $1602]
$03:88B6 BD C8 14     LDA.W $14C8,X                   ; \
$03:88B9 C9 08        CMP.B #$08                      ; |
$03:88BB F0 03        BEQ $88C0                       ; / Status 8: run main code
$03:88BD 4C EC 84     JMP.W $84EC                     ; Otherwise: draw as dead (upside down)

$03:88C0 A5 9D        LDA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; \
$03:88C2 D0 1B        BNE $88DF                       ; / Return if sprites locked
$03:88C4 20 5D B8     JSR.W SubOffscreen0Bnk3         ; Handle offscreen despawn
$03:88C7 22 3A 80 01  JSL.L SprSpr+MarioSprRts        ; Sprite and Mario interaction
$03:88CB 22 22 80 01  JSL.L UpdateXPosNoGrvty         ; Update X position
$03:88CF 22 1A 80 01  JSL.L UpdateYPosNoGrvty         ; Update Y position
$03:88D3 B5 C2        LDA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; \
$03:88D5 22 DF 86 00  JSL.L ExecutePtr                ; / Run state routine from SwooperPtrs

}

;;; $88D9: Pointer table: Swooper states (SwooperPtrs) ;;;
{
$03:88D9 E4 88        .dw $88E4                       ; State 0: waiting
$03:88DB 05 89        .dw $8905                       ; State 1: swooping down
$03:88DD 36 89        .dw $8936                       ; State 2: flying horizontally

$03:88DF 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $88E0..88E2: Table: Swooper X speed limits and acceleration ;;;
{
;; Max X speed $10/$F0 and acceleration +1/-1, indexed by direction.
$03:88E0              .db $10,$F0                     ; Max X speed: $10 right, $F0 left

$03:88E2              .db $01,$FF                     ; X acceleration: +1, -1

}

;;; $88E4: Swooper state routines ;;;
{
;; $0388E4: waiting; wakes when Mario is within $50 pixels horizontally.
;; $038905: swooping down; Y speed decays, X accelerates toward Mario's side.
;; $038936: flying horizontally with bobbing Y speed (Blurp tables).
$03:88E4 BD A0 15     LDA.W RAM_OffscreenHorz,X       ; \
$03:88E7 D0 1B        BNE $8904                       ; / Return if offscreen horizontally
$03:88E9 20 17 B8     JSR.W SubHorzPosBnk3            ; Mario horizontal distance in [$0F], Y = side
$03:88EC A5 0F        LDA $0F                         ; \
$03:88EE 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:88EF 69 50        ADC.B #$50                      ; |
$03:88F1 C9 A0        CMP.B #$A0                      ; |
$03:88F3 B0 0F        BCS $8904                       ; / Return if Mario is more than $50 pixels away
$03:88F5 F6 C2        INC RAM_SpriteState,X           ; State = 1 (swooping down)
$03:88F7 98           TYA                             ; \
$03:88F8 9D 7C 15     STA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; / Face Mario
$03:88FB A9 20        LDA.B #$20                      ; \
$03:88FD 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; / Initial Y speed = $20 (down)
$03:88FF A9 26        LDA.B #$26                      ; \
$03:8901 8D FC 1D     STA.W $1DFC                     ; / Play swoop sound effect
$03:8904 60           RTS                             ; Return

$03:8905 A5 13        LDA RAM_FrameCounter            ; \
$03:8907 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; |
$03:8909 D0 0A        BNE $8915                       ; / Skip Y speed decay 3 of 4 frames
$03:890B B5 AA        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; \
$03:890D F0 06        BEQ $8915                       ; / Skip if Y speed is already 0
$03:890F D6 AA        DEC RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; Y speed decays toward 0
$03:8911 D0 02        BNE $8915                       ; Still moving: keep state
$03:8913 F6 C2        INC RAM_SpriteState,X           ; Y speed reached 0: state = 2 (flying horizontally)
$03:8915 A5 13        LDA RAM_FrameCounter            ; \
$03:8917 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; |
$03:8919 D0 10        BNE $892B                       ; / Skip X acceleration 3 of 4 frames
$03:891B BC 7C 15     LDY.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; Y = direction
$03:891E B5 B6        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; A = X speed
$03:8920 D9 E0 88     CMP.W $88E0,Y                   ; \
$03:8923 F0 06        BEQ $892B                       ; / Skip if X speed is at max
$03:8925 18           CLC                             ; \
$03:8926 79 E2 88     ADC.W $88E2,Y                   ; |
$03:8929 95 B6        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; / X speed += $88E2[direction]
$03:892B A5 14        LDA RAM_FrameCounterB           ; \
$03:892D 29 04        AND.B #$04                      ; |
$03:892F 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:8930 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:8931 1A           INC A                           ; |
$03:8932 9D 02 16     STA.W $1602,X                   ; / Graphics frame [$1602] = 1 or 2 (flap animation)
$03:8935 60           RTS                             ; Return

$03:8936 A5 13        LDA RAM_FrameCounter            ; \
$03:8938 29 01        AND.B #$01                      ; |
$03:893A D0 16        BNE $8952                       ; / Only update on even frames
$03:893C BD 1C 15     LDA.W $151C,X                   ; \
$03:893F 29 01        AND.B #$01                      ; |
$03:8941 A8           TAY                             ; / Y = vertical direction bit ($151C)
$03:8942 B5 AA        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; \
$03:8944 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:8945 79 C8 84     ADC.W BlurpAccelY,Y             ; |
$03:8948 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; / Y speed += BlurpAccelY[Y]
$03:894A D9 C4 84     CMP.W BlurpMaxSpeedY,Y          ; \
$03:894D D0 03        BNE $8952                       ; / Branch unless Y speed hit the limit BlurpMaxSpeedY[Y]
$03:894F FE 1C 15     INC.W $151C,X                   ; Reverse vertical direction (bob up and down)
$03:8952 80 C1        BRA $8915                       ; Go to X acceleration and animation ($8915)


}

;;; $8954..8956: Table: Sliding Koopa speed limits and acceleration ;;;
{
;; Max X speed $20/$E0 and acceleration +2/-2, indexed by direction.
$03:8954              .db $20,$E0                     ; Max X speed: $20 right, $E0 left

$03:8956              .db $02,$FE                     ; X acceleration: +2, -2

}

;;; $8958: Sliding Koopa (shell-less blue) main (SlidingKoopa) ;;;
{
;; Faces its movement direction, draws; slides down slopes accelerating, decelerates on flat ground.
;; When it stops, a $20-frame timer ($1558) runs, then it becomes a shell-less blue Koopa (sprite 02). Makes
;;     smoke particles while sliding.
;; $0389FF: spawns a smoke image in a free slot ($17C0-$17C3) every 4th frame while moving.
;; Called by:
;;     $03:A1A8: Bank 3 sprite main dispatch (Bnk3CallSprMain)
$03:8958 A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; \
$03:895A B4 B6        LDY RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; |
$03:895C F0 06        BEQ $8964                       ; |
$03:895E 10 01        BPL $8961                       ; |
$03:8960 1A           INC A                           ; |
$03:8961 9D 7C 15     STA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; / Direction = 1 if X speed > 0, kept if 0, else 0
$03:8964 22 B2 90 01  JSL.L GenericSprGfxRt2          ; Draw generic sprite
$03:8968 BC EA 15     LDY.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X         ; Y = OAM index
$03:896B BD 58 15     LDA.W $1558,X                   ; \
$03:896E C9 01        CMP.B #$01                      ; |
$03:8970 D0 11        BNE $8983                       ; / Branch unless it is time to turn into a Koopa ($1558 = 1)
$03:8972 BD 7C 15     LDA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; \
$03:8975 48           PHA                             ; / Save direction
$03:8976 A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; \
$03:8978 95 9E        STA RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; / Sprite number = $02 (shell-less blue Koopa)
$03:897A 22 D2 F7 07  JSL.L InitSpriteTables          ; Initialise sprite tables for the new sprite
$03:897E 68           PLA                             ; \
$03:897F 9D 7C 15     STA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; / Restore direction
$03:8982 38           SEC                             ; Carry set: select the Koopa tile
$03:8983 A9 86        LDA.B #$86                      ; \
$03:8985 90 02        BCC $8989                       ; / Sliding tile $86 (carry clear)
$03:8987 A9 E0        LDA.B #$E0                      ; Shell-less Koopa tile $E0
$03:8989 99 02 03     STA.W OAM_Tile,Y                ; Store OAM tile
$03:898C BD C8 14     LDA.W $14C8,X                   ; \
$03:898F C9 08        CMP.B #$08                      ; |
$03:8991 D0 6B        BNE $89FE                       ; / Return unless status is 8
$03:8993 20 5D B8     JSR.W SubOffscreen0Bnk3         ; Handle offscreen despawn
$03:8996 22 3A 80 01  JSL.L SprSpr+MarioSprRts        ; Sprite and Mario interaction
$03:899A A5 9D        LDA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; \
$03:899C 1D 40 15     ORA.W $1540,X                   ; |
$03:899F 1D 58 15     ORA.W $1558,X                   ; |
$03:89A2 D0 5A        BNE $89FE                       ; / Return if locked, INIT timer running or turning into Koopa
$03:89A4 22 2A 80 01  JSL.L UpdateSpritePos           ; Update position
$03:89A8 BD 88 15     LDA.W RAM_SprObjStatus,X        ; \
$03:89AB 29 04        AND.B #$04                      ; |
$03:89AD F0 4F        BEQ $89FE                       ; / Return if not on ground
$03:89AF 20 FF 89     JSR.W $89FF                     ; Maybe spawn smoke
$03:89B2 A0 00        LDY.B #$00                      ; Y = 0 (Y speed default)
$03:89B4 B5 B6        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; \
$03:89B6 F0 14        BEQ $89CC                       ; / Y speed 0 if X speed is 0
$03:89B8 10 03        BPL $89BD                       ; Branch if moving right
$03:89BA 49 FF        EOR.B #$FF                      ; \
$03:89BC 1A           INC A                           ; |
$03:89BD 85 00        STA $00                         ; / [$00] = |X speed|
$03:89BF BD B8 15     LDA.W $15B8,X                   ; \
$03:89C2 F0 08        BEQ $89CC                       ; / If not on a slope, Y speed 0
$03:89C4 A4 00        LDY $00                         ; Y = |X speed| (stick to slope)
$03:89C6 55 B6        EOR RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; \
$03:89C8 10 02        BPL $89CC                       ; / If slope direction matches movement, keep it
$03:89CA A0 D0        LDY.B #$D0                      ; Otherwise Y speed = $D0 (up the slope)
$03:89CC 94 AA        STY RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; Set Y speed
$03:89CE A5 13        LDA RAM_FrameCounter            ; \
$03:89D0 29 01        AND.B #$01                      ; |
$03:89D2 D0 2A        BNE $89FE                       ; / Return on odd frames
$03:89D4 BD B8 15     LDA.W $15B8,X                   ; \
$03:89D7 D0 13        BNE $89EC                       ; / On a slope: accelerate ($89EC)
$03:89D9 B5 B6        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; \
$03:89DB D0 06        BNE $89E3                       ; / Moving: decelerate
$03:89DD A9 20        LDA.B #$20                      ; \
$03:89DF 9D 58 15     STA.W $1558,X                   ; / Stopped: start $20-frame timer to become a Koopa
$03:89E2 60           RTS                             ; Return

$03:89E3 10 04        BPL $89E9                       ; \
$03:89E5 F6 B6        INC RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; |
$03:89E7 F6 B6        INC RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; |
$03:89E9 D6 B6        DEC RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; / Move X speed one step toward 0
$03:89EB 60           RTS                             ; Return

$03:89EC 0A           ASL                             ; \
$03:89ED 2A           ROL                             ; |
$03:89EE 29 01        AND.B #$01                      ; |
$03:89F0 A8           TAY                             ; / Y = 1 if X speed is negative, else 0
$03:89F1 B5 B6        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; \
$03:89F3 D9 54 89     CMP.W $8954,Y                   ; |
$03:89F6 F0 06        BEQ $89FE                       ; / Skip if at max X speed
$03:89F8 18           CLC                             ; \
$03:89F9 79 56 89     ADC.W $8956,Y                   ; |
$03:89FC 95 B6        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; / X speed += acceleration
$03:89FE 60           RTS                             ; Return

$03:89FF B5 B6        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; \
$03:8A01 F0 1D        BEQ $8A20                       ; / Return if not moving
$03:8A03 A5 13        LDA RAM_FrameCounter            ; \
$03:8A05 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; |
$03:8A07 D0 17        BNE $8A20                       ; / Only every 4th frame
$03:8A09 A9 04        LDA.B #$04                      ; \
$03:8A0B 85 00        STA $00                         ; |
$03:8A0D A9 0A        LDA.B #$0A                      ; |
$03:8A0F 85 01        STA $01                         ; / Smoke offset: X +4, Y +$0A
$03:8A11 20 FB B8     JSR.W IsSprOffScreenBnk3        ; \
$03:8A14 D0 0A        BNE $8A20                       ; / Return if offscreen
$03:8A16 A0 03        LDY.B #$03                      ; Loop over 4 smoke slots
$03:8A18 B9 C0 17     LDA.W $17C0,Y                   ; \
$03:8A1B F0 04        BEQ $8A21                       ; |
$03:8A1D 88           DEY                             ; |
$03:8A1E 10 F8        BPL $8A18                       ; / Find a free smoke slot
$03:8A20 60           RTS                             ; Return

$03:8A21 A9 03        LDA.B #$03                      ; \
$03:8A23 99 C0 17     STA.W $17C0,Y                   ; / Smoke type 3
$03:8A26 B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; \
$03:8A28 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:8A29 65 00        ADC $00                         ; |
$03:8A2B 99 C8 17     STA.W $17C8,Y                   ; / Smoke X = sprite X + [$00]
$03:8A2E B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$03:8A30 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:8A31 65 01        ADC $01                         ; |
$03:8A33 99 C4 17     STA.W $17C4,Y                   ; / Smoke Y = sprite Y + [$01]
$03:8A36 A9 13        LDA.B #$13                      ; \
$03:8A38 99 CC 17     STA.W $17CC,Y                   ; / Smoke lifetime = $13
$03:8A3B 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $8A3C: Bowser statue main (BowserStatue) ;;;
{
;; Draws, then runs a state routine: 0 sits, 1 and 3 breathe fire, 2 jumps toward Mario. Mario can stand on
;;     it.
;; Called by:
;;     $03:A1B1: Bank 3 sprite main dispatch (Bnk3CallSprMain)
$03:8A3C 20 3D 8B     JSR.W BowserStatueGfx           ; Draw the statue
$03:8A3F A5 9D        LDA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; \
$03:8A41 D0 25        BNE $8A68                       ; / Return if sprites locked
$03:8A43 20 5D B8     JSR.W SubOffscreen0Bnk3         ; Handle offscreen despawn
$03:8A46 B5 C2        LDA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; \
$03:8A48 22 DF 86 00  JSL.L ExecutePtr                ; / Run state routine from BowserStatuePtrs
; list of sprite states
}

;;; $8A4C: Bowser statue states (BowserStatuePtrs) ;;;
{
;; $038A54 spawns fire and falls into $038A57, which handles standing, gravity and landing.
;; $038A69: jumping state with wall bounce and a $30-frame wait between jumps.
$03:8A4C 57 8A        .dw $8A57                       ; State 0: stand still
$03:8A4E 54 8A        .dw $8A54                       ; State 1: breathe fire
$03:8A50 69 8A        .dw $8A69                       ; State 2: jump around
$03:8A52 54 8A        .dw $8A54                       ; State 3: breathe fire

$03:8A54 20 CB 8A     JSR.W $8ACB                     ; Maybe spawn a fireball
$03:8A57 22 4F B4 01  JSL.L InvisBlkMainRt            ; Mario can stand on it
$03:8A5B 22 2A 80 01  JSL.L UpdateSpritePos           ; Update position
$03:8A5F BD 88 15     LDA.W RAM_SprObjStatus,X        ; \
$03:8A62 29 04        AND.B #$04                      ; |
$03:8A64 F0 02        BEQ $8A68                       ; / Return if not on ground
$03:8A66 74 AA        STZ RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; Y speed = 0
$03:8A68 60           RTS                             ; Return

$03:8A69 1E 7A 16     ASL.W RAM_Tweaker167A,X         ; \
$03:8A6C 5E 7A 16     LSR.W RAM_Tweaker167A,X         ; / Clear bit 7 of tweaker $167A (ASL then LSR)
$03:8A6F 22 DC A7 01  JSL.L MarioSprInteract          ; Interact with Mario (hurts)
$03:8A73 9E 02 16     STZ.W $1602,X                   ; Graphics frame = 0
$03:8A76 B5 AA        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; \
$03:8A78 C9 10        CMP.B #$10                      ; |
$03:8A7A 10 03        BPL $8A7F                       ; / Branch unless Y speed < $10 (signed)
$03:8A7C FE 02 16     INC.W $1602,X                   ; Graphics frame = 1 (jumping)
$03:8A7F 22 2A 80 01  JSL.L UpdateSpritePos           ; Update position
$03:8A83 BD 88 15     LDA.W RAM_SprObjStatus,X        ; \
$03:8A86 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; |
$03:8A88 F0 0F        BEQ $8A99                       ; / Branch if no wall contact
$03:8A8A B5 B6        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; \
$03:8A8C 49 FF        EOR.B #$FF                      ; |
$03:8A8E 1A           INC A                           ; |
$03:8A8F 95 B6        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; / X speed = -X speed
$03:8A91 BD 7C 15     LDA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; \
$03:8A94 49 01        EOR.B #$01                      ; |
$03:8A96 9D 7C 15     STA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; / Flip direction
$03:8A99 BD 88 15     LDA.W RAM_SprObjStatus,X        ; \
$03:8A9C 29 04        AND.B #$04                      ; |
$03:8A9E F0 26        BEQ $8AC6                       ; / Return if not on ground
$03:8AA0 A9 10        LDA.B #$10                      ; \
$03:8AA2 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; / Landed: Y speed = $10
$03:8AA4 74 B6        STZ RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; X speed = 0
$03:8AA6 BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; \
$03:8AA9 F0 16        BEQ $8AC1                       ; / Branch if wait timer is 0
$03:8AAB 3A           DEC A                           ; \
$03:8AAC D0 18        BNE $8AC6                       ; / Return unless timer = 1 (time to jump)
$03:8AAE A9 C0        LDA.B #$C0                      ; \
$03:8AB0 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; / Jump Y speed = $C0
$03:8AB2 20 17 B8     JSR.W SubHorzPosBnk3            ; \
$03:8AB5 98           TYA                             ; |
$03:8AB6 9D 7C 15     STA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; |
$03:8AB9 B9 BF 8A     LDA.W BwsrStatueSpeed,Y         ; |
$03:8ABC 95 B6        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; / Face Mario and set X speed from BwsrStatueSpeed
$03:8ABE 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

$03:8AC6 60           RTS                             ; Return

;;; $8AC9: Bowser statue fireball spawner (BwserFireDispXHi) ;;;
{
;; Table of high bytes, then $8ACB: every 128 frames (staggered by slot) spawns sprite B3 (Bowser statue
;;     fireball) in front of the statue.
$03:8AC9              .db $00,$FF                     ; Fire X offset high: $00, $FF

$03:8ACB 8A           TXA                             ; \
$03:8ACC 0A           ASL                             ; |
$03:8ACD 0A           ASL                             ; |
$03:8ACE 65 13        ADC RAM_FrameCounter            ; |
$03:8AD0 29 7F        AND.B #$7F                      ; / Only when ([slot] * 4 + [$13]) mod $80 = 0
$03:8AD2 D0 50        BNE $8B24                       ; Return if not time
$03:8AD4 22 E4 A9 02  JSL.L FindFreeSprSlot           ; Find a free sprite slot
$03:8AD8 30 4A        BMI $8B24                       ; Return if none
$03:8ADA A9 17        LDA.B #$17                      ; \
$03:8ADC 8D FC 1D     STA.W $1DFC                     ; / Play fire sound effect
$03:8ADF A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; \
$03:8AE1 99 C8 14     STA.W $14C8,Y                   ; / New sprite status = 8 (normal)
$03:8AE4 A9 B3        LDA.B #$B3                      ; \
$03:8AE6 99 9E 00     STA.W RAM_SpriteNum,Y           ; / New sprite number = $B3 (Bowser statue fireball)
$03:8AE9 B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; \
$03:8AEB 85 00        STA $00                         ; |
$03:8AED BD E0 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; |
$03:8AF0 85 01        STA $01                         ; |
$03:8AF2 DA           PHX                             ; |
$03:8AF3 BD 7C 15     LDA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; |
$03:8AF6 AA           TAX                             ; |
$03:8AF7 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; |
$03:8AF9 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:8AFA 7D C7 8A     ADC.W BwserFireDispXLo,X        ; |
$03:8AFD 99 E4 00     STA.W RAM_SpriteXLo,Y           ; |
$03:8B00 A5 01        LDA $01                         ; |
$03:8B02 7D C9 8A     ADC.W BwserFireDispXHi,X        ; |
$03:8B05 99 E0 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,Y           ; / New sprite X = statue X +/- $10
$03:8B08 BB           TYX                             ; \
$03:8B09 22 D2 F7 07  JSL.L InitSpriteTables          ; |
$03:8B0D FA           PLX                             ; / Reset the new sprite's tables
$03:8B0E B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$03:8B10 38           SEC                             ; |
$03:8B11 E9 02        SBC.B #$02                      ; |
$03:8B13 99 D8 00     STA.W RAM_SpriteYLo,Y           ; |
$03:8B16 BD D4 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; |
$03:8B19 E9 00        SBC.B #$00                      ; |
$03:8B1B 99 D4 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,Y           ; / New sprite Y = statue Y - 2
$03:8B1E BD 7C 15     LDA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; \
$03:8B21 99 7C 15     STA.W RAM_SpriteDir,Y           ; / New sprite direction = statue direction
$03:8B24 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $8B3D: Bowser statue graphics routine (BowserStatueGfx) ;;;
{
;; Draws three tiles (a small 8x8 and two 16x16) with direction and frame ($1602) selecting the tables;
;;     palette from sprite palette.
;; Called by:
;;     $03:8A3C: Bowser statue main (BowserStatue)
$03:8B3D 20 60 B7     JSR.W GetDrawInfoBnk3           ; Get sprite draw position ($00 = X, $01 = Y)
$03:8B40 BD 02 16     LDA.W $1602,X                   ; \
$03:8B43 85 04        STA $04                         ; / [$04] = graphics frame
$03:8B45 49 01        EOR.B #$01                      ; \
$03:8B47 3A           DEC A                           ; |
$03:8B48 85 03        STA $03                         ; / [$03] = ([$04] EOR 1) - 1: loop end index
$03:8B4A BD F6 15     LDA.W RAM_SpritePal,X           ; \
$03:8B4D 85 05        STA $05                         ; / [$05] = sprite palette
$03:8B4F BD 7C 15     LDA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; \
$03:8B52 85 02        STA $02                         ; / [$02] = direction
$03:8B54 DA           PHX                             ; Save sprite index
$03:8B55 A2 02        LDX.B #$02                      ; Loop: 3 tiles
$03:8B57 DA           PHX                             ; Save loop counter
$03:8B58 A5 02        LDA $02                         ; \
$03:8B5A D0 03        BNE $8B5F                       ; |
$03:8B5C E8           INX                             ; |
$03:8B5D E8           INX                             ; |
$03:8B5E E8           INX                             ; / Direction 0: use the second half of the X/property tables
$03:8B5F A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$03:8B61 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:8B62 7D 25 8B     ADC.W BwsrStatueDispX,X         ; |
$03:8B65 99 00 03     STA.W OAM_DispX,Y               ; / OAM X = sprite X + BwsrStatueDispX[X]
$03:8B68 BD 37 8B     LDA.W BwsrStatueGfxProp,X       ; \
$03:8B6B 05 05        ORA $05                         ; |
$03:8B6D 05 64        ORA $64                         ; |
$03:8B6F 99 03 03     STA.W OAM_Prop,Y                ; / Properties from table, palette and level priority
$03:8B72 FA           PLX                             ; Restore loop counter
$03:8B73 A5 01        LDA $01                         ; \
$03:8B75 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:8B76 7D 2B 8B     ADC.W BwsrStatueDispY,X         ; |
$03:8B79 99 01 03     STA.W OAM_DispY,Y               ; / OAM Y = sprite Y + BwsrStatueDispY[X]
$03:8B7C DA           PHX                             ; Save index
$03:8B7D A5 04        LDA $04                         ; \
$03:8B7F F0 03        BEQ $8B84                       ; |
$03:8B81 E8           INX                             ; |
$03:8B82 E8           INX                             ; |
$03:8B83 E8           INX                             ; / Frame 1: use the second half of the tile table
$03:8B84 BD 2E 8B     LDA.W BwsrStatueTiles,X         ; \
$03:8B87 99 02 03     STA.W OAM_Tile,Y                ; / OAM tile from BwsrStatueTiles
$03:8B8A FA           PLX                             ; Restore index
$03:8B8B 5A           PHY                             ; \
$03:8B8C 98           TYA                             ; |
$03:8B8D 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:8B8E 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:8B8F A8           TAY                             ; / Y = OAM index / 4
$03:8B90 BD 34 8B     LDA.W BwsrStatueTileSize,X      ; \
$03:8B93 99 60 04     STA.W OAM_TileSize,Y            ; / OAM size from BwsrStatueTileSize
$03:8B96 7A           PLY                             ; Restore OAM index
$03:8B97 C8           INY                             ; \
$03:8B98 C8           INY                             ; |
$03:8B99 C8           INY                             ; |
$03:8B9A C8           INY                             ; / OAM index += 4
$03:8B9B CA           DEX                             ; Next tile
$03:8B9C E4 03        CPX $03                         ; \
$03:8B9E D0 B7        BNE $8B57                       ; / Loop until the marker
$03:8BA0 FA           PLX                             ; Restore sprite index
$03:8BA1 A0 FF        LDY.B #$FF                      ; Sizes are individual
$03:8BA3 A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; Three tiles - 1 = 2
$03:8BA5 22 B3 B7 01  JSL.L FinishOAMWrite            ; Finish OAM write
$03:8BA9 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $8C2F: Carrot top lift main routine (CarrotTopLift) ;;;
{
;; Sprites $B7/$B8: slanted platforms that move diagonally in a 4-phase cycle ($80 frames each, speed from
;;     $8C2A, Y speed is -X speed for $B7).
;; Mario can stand on the slope: his X offset from the sprite indexes the surface height table $8BAA,
;;     and he is carried along by [$1491].
;; Parts of the original author's logic are unclear ('can't make sense of the details'), so some comments here
;;     are hedged.
;; Called by:
;;     $03:A1BE: Bank 3 sprite main dispatch (Bnk3CallSprMain)
$03:8C2F 20 24 8D     JSR.W CarrotTopLiftGfx          ; Draw the carrot top lift (CarrotTopLiftGfx)
$03:8C32 A5 9D        LDA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; \
$03:8C34 D0 F8        BNE $8C2E                       ; / Return if sprites are locked
$03:8C36 20 5D B8     JSR.W SubOffscreen0Bnk3         ; Despawn check when off-screen (SubOffscreen)
$03:8C39 BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; \
$03:8C3C D0 07        BNE $8C45                       ; / Phase timer [$1540] still running: skip the phase change
$03:8C3E F6 C2        INC RAM_SpriteState,X           ; Next movement phase: [sprite state]++
$03:8C40 A9 80        LDA.B #$80                      ; \
$03:8C42 9D 40 15     STA.W $1540,X                   ; / Phase timer [$1540] = $80 frames
$03:8C45 B5 C2        LDA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; \
$03:8C47 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; } Y = [sprite state] AND 3 (movement phase)
$03:8C49 A8           TAY                             ; /
$03:8C4A B9 2A 8C     LDA.W $8C2A,Y                   ; A = X speed from $8C2A ($00,$F8,$00,$08) for this phase
$03:8C4D 95 B6        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; Sprite X speed = A
$03:8C4F B5 B6        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; A = sprite X speed
$03:8C51 B4 9E        LDY RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; \
$03:8C53 C0 B8        CPY.B #$B8                      ; } Sprite $B8 keeps Y speed = X speed (skips the negation)
$03:8C55 F0 03        BEQ $8C5A                       ; /
$03:8C57 49 FF        EOR.B #$FF                      ; \
$03:8C59 1A           INC A                           ; / Other lift ($B7): Y speed = -X speed
$03:8C5A 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; Sprite Y speed = A
$03:8C5C 22 1A 80 01  JSL.L UpdateYPosNoGrvty         ; Move vertically (no gravity)
$03:8C60 B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; \
$03:8C62 9D 1C 15     STA.W $151C,X                   ; / [$151C] = sprite X low before moving (reference for Mario's position on the slope)
$03:8C65 22 22 80 01  JSL.L UpdateXPosNoGrvty         ; Move horizontally (no gravity)
$03:8C69 20 E4 8C     JSR.W $8CE4                     ; Build Mario's feet hitbox ($8CE4)
$03:8C6C 22 9F B6 03  JSL.L GetSpriteClippingA        ; Sprite hitbox A (GetSpriteClippingA)
$03:8C70 22 2B B7 03  JSL.L CheckForContact           ; Check hitbox overlap (CheckForContact)
$03:8C74 90 6D        BCC $8CE3                       ; No contact: return
$03:8C76 A5 7D        LDA RAM_MarioSpeedY             ; \
$03:8C78 30 69        BMI $8CE3                       ; / Mario moving upward: return
$03:8C7A A5 94        LDA RAM_MarioXPos               ; \
$03:8C7C 38           SEC                             ; |
$03:8C7D FD 1C 15     SBC.W $151C,X                   ; |
$03:8C80 18           CLC                             ; } A = Mario X - old sprite X + $1C
$03:8C81 69 1C        ADC.B #$1C                      ; /
$03:8C83 B4 9E        LDY RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; \
$03:8C85 C0 B8        CPY.B #$B8                      ; } Sprite $B8 adds $38 more (second half of the slope table)
$03:8C87 D0 03        BNE $8C8C                       ; /
$03:8C89 18           CLC                             ; \
$03:8C8A 69 38        ADC.B #$38                      ; / A += $38
$03:8C8C A8           TAY                             ; Y = index into slope height table $8BAA
$03:8C8D AD 7A 18     LDA.W RAM_OnYoshi               ; \
$03:8C90 C9 01        CMP.B #$01                      ; |
$03:8C92 A9 20        LDA.B #$20                      ; } A = $20, or $30 if riding Yoshi (set at $038C96)
$03:8C94 90 02        BCC $8C98                       ; /
$03:8C96 A9 30        LDA.B #$30                      ; Riding Yoshi: A = $30
$03:8C98 18           CLC                             ; \
$03:8C99 65 96        ADC RAM_MarioYPos               ; } $00 = Mario Y + A (Y of Mario's feet)
$03:8C9B 85 00        STA $00                         ; /
$03:8C9D B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$03:8C9F 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:8CA0 79 AA 8B     ADC.W $8BAA,Y                   ; } A = sprite Y + slope height at Mario's X; compare to feet Y
$03:8CA3 C5 00        CMP $00                         ; /
$03:8CA5 10 3C        BPL $8CE3                       ; Surface at or below the feet: not landed, return
$03:8CA7 AD 7A 18     LDA.W RAM_OnYoshi               ; \
$03:8CAA C9 01        CMP.B #$01                      ; |
$03:8CAC A9 1D        LDA.B #$1D                      ; } A = $1D, or $2D if riding Yoshi (set at $038CB0)
$03:8CAE 90 02        BCC $8CB2                       ; /
$03:8CB0 A9 2D        LDA.B #$2D                      ; Riding Yoshi: A = $2D
$03:8CB2 85 00        STA $00                         ; $00 = height of Mario above the surface
$03:8CB4 B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$03:8CB6 18           CLC                             ; } A = sprite Y + slope height at Mario's X
$03:8CB7 79 AA 8B     ADC.W $8BAA,Y                   ; /
$03:8CBA 08           PHP                             ; Save carry from the 8-bit sum
$03:8CBB 38           SEC                             ; \
$03:8CBC E5 00        SBC $00                         ; } Mario Y low = surface Y - $00 (stand on the slope)
$03:8CBE 85 96        STA RAM_MarioYPos               ; /
$03:8CC0 BD D4 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; \
$03:8CC3 E9 00        SBC.B #$00                      ; |
$03:8CC5 28           PLP                             ; |
$03:8CC6 69 00        ADC.B #$00                      ; } Mario Y high = sprite Y high - borrow + saved carry
$03:8CC8 85 97        STA RAM_MarioYPosHi             ; /
$03:8CCA 64 7D        STZ RAM_MarioSpeedY             ; Mario Y speed = 0
$03:8CCC A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; \
$03:8CCE 8D 71 14     STA.W $1471                     ; / [$1471] = 1: Mario is riding a platform sprite
$03:8CD1 A0 00        LDY.B #$00                      ; \
$03:8CD3 AD 91 14     LDA.W $1491                     ; / Y = 0, A = [$1491] (sprite X movement this frame, probably)
$03:8CD6 10 01        BPL $8CD9                       ; Positive: Y stays 0
$03:8CD8 88           DEY                             ; Negative: Y = $FF (sign extension)
$03:8CD9 18           CLC                             ; \
$03:8CDA 65 94        ADC RAM_MarioXPos               ; } Mario X low += sprite movement
$03:8CDC 85 94        STA RAM_MarioXPos               ; /
$03:8CDE 98           TYA                             ; \
$03:8CDF 65 95        ADC RAM_MarioXPosHi             ; } Mario X high += sign extension and carry
$03:8CE1 85 95        STA RAM_MarioXPosHi             ; /
$03:8CE3 60           RTS                             ; Return

$03:8CE4 A5 94        LDA RAM_MarioXPos               ; \
$03:8CE6 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:8CE7 69 04        ADC.B #$04                      ; } $00 = Mario X + 4 (hitbox X low)
$03:8CE9 85 00        STA $00                         ; /
$03:8CEB A5 95        LDA RAM_MarioXPosHi             ; \
$03:8CED 69 00        ADC.B #$00                      ; } $08 = Mario X high + carry
$03:8CEF 85 08        STA $08                         ; /
$03:8CF1 A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; \
$03:8CF3 85 02        STA $02                         ; } Hitbox width and height ($02, $03) = 8
$03:8CF5 85 03        STA $03                         ; /
$03:8CF7 A9 20        LDA.B #$20                      ; \
$03:8CF9 AC 7A 18     LDY.W RAM_OnYoshi               ; } A = $20, or $30 if riding Yoshi (set at $038CFE)
$03:8CFC F0 02        BEQ $8D00                       ; /
$03:8CFE A9 30        LDA.B #$30                      ; Riding Yoshi: A = $30
$03:8D00 18           CLC                             ; \
$03:8D01 65 96        ADC RAM_MarioYPos               ; } $01 = Mario Y + A (hitbox at Mario's feet)
$03:8D03 85 01        STA $01                         ; /
$03:8D05 A5 97        LDA RAM_MarioYPosHi             ; \
$03:8D07 69 00        ADC.B #$00                      ; } $09 = Mario Y high + carry
$03:8D09 85 09        STA $09                         ; /
$03:8D0B 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $8D24: Carrot top lift graphics (CarrotTopLiftGfx) ;;;
{
;; Draws three 16x16 tiles: entries 2-0 for sprite $B7, entries 5-3 (X-flipped) for sprite $B8.
;; Called by:
;;     $03:8C2F: Carrot top lift main routine (CarrotTopLift)
$03:8D24 20 60 B7     JSR.W GetDrawInfoBnk3           ; Get OAM index and screen position (GetDrawInfoBnk3)
$03:8D27 DA           PHX                             ; Save sprite index
$03:8D28 B5 9E        LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; \
$03:8D2A C9 B8        CMP.B #$B8                      ; / Carry = sprite number >= $B8
$03:8D2C A2 02        LDX.B #$02                      ; \
$03:8D2E 86 02        STX $02                         ; / X = $02 = 2 (three tiles)
$03:8D30 90 02        BCC $8D34                       ; Sprite $B7: use entries 2-0
$03:8D32 A2 05        LDX.B #$05                      ; Sprite $B8: X = 5, use entries 5-3
$03:8D34 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$03:8D36 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:8D37 7D 0C 8D     ADC.W DiagPlatDispX,X           ; } OAM X = sprite X + DiagPlatDispX[X]
$03:8D3A 99 00 03     STA.W OAM_DispX,Y               ; /
$03:8D3D A5 01        LDA $01                         ; \
$03:8D3F 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:8D40 7D 12 8D     ADC.W DiagPlatDispY,X           ; } OAM Y = sprite Y + DiagPlatDispY[X]
$03:8D43 99 01 03     STA.W OAM_DispY,Y               ; /
$03:8D46 BD 18 8D     LDA.W DiagPlatTiles,X           ; \
$03:8D49 99 02 03     STA.W OAM_Tile,Y                ; / OAM tile = DiagPlatTiles[X]
$03:8D4C BD 1E 8D     LDA.W DiagPlatGfxProp,X         ; \
$03:8D4F 05 64        ORA $64                         ; } OAM properties = DiagPlatGfxProp[X] | [$64] (priority)
$03:8D51 99 03 03     STA.W OAM_Prop,Y                ; /
$03:8D54 C8           INY                             ; \
$03:8D55 C8           INY                             ; |
$03:8D56 C8           INY                             ; } OAM index += 4
$03:8D57 C8           INY                             ; /
$03:8D58 CA           DEX                             ; \
$03:8D59 C6 02        DEC $02                         ; } X--, $02--; loop for 3 tiles
$03:8D5B 10 D7        BPL $8D34                       ; /
$03:8D5D FA           PLX                             ; Restore sprite index
$03:8D5E A0 02        LDY.B #$02                      ; \
$03:8D60 98           TYA                             ; / Y = 2 (16x16 tiles), A = 2 (three tiles)
$03:8D61 22 B3 B7 01  JSL.L FinishOAMWrite            ; Finish OAM write
$03:8D65 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $8D6F: Message box main routine (InfoBox) ;;;
{
;; Solid block (InvisBlkMainRt). When hit from below the timer [$1558] counts down; at 1 it plays sound $22
;;     and sets [$1426] to message 1 or 2
;; (chosen by bit 4 of the sprite's X position). While the timer runs the layer 1 Y scroll is shifted
;;     temporarily to fake a bounce; the tile is forced to $C0.
;; Called by:
;;     $03:A1C7: Bank 3 sprite main dispatch (Bnk3CallSprMain)
$03:8D6F 22 4F B4 01  JSL.L InvisBlkMainRt            ; Make Mario able to stand on / hit the block (InvisBlkMainRt)
$03:8D73 20 5D B8     JSR.W SubOffscreen0Bnk3         ; Despawn check when off-screen (SubOffscreen)
$03:8D76 BD 58 15     LDA.W $1558,X                   ; \
$03:8D79 C9 01        CMP.B #$01                      ; } Message timer [$1558] = 1 (about to show message)? Otherwise skip
$03:8D7B D0 16        BNE $8D93                       ; /
$03:8D7D A9 22        LDA.B #$22                      ; \
$03:8D7F 8D FC 1D     STA.W $1DFC                     ; / Play sound effect $22 (port $1DFC)
$03:8D82 9E 58 15     STZ.W $1558,X                   ; Clear the message timer
$03:8D85 74 C2        STZ RAM_SpriteState,X           ; Clear sprite state
$03:8D87 B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; \
$03:8D89 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:8D8A 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:8D8B 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:8D8C 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:8D8D 29 01        AND.B #$01                      ; |
$03:8D8F 1A           INC A                           ; } [$1426] = message number 1 or 2 from bit 4 of sprite X low
$03:8D90 8D 26 14     STA.W $1426                     ; /
$03:8D93 BD 58 15     LDA.W $1558,X                   ; \
$03:8D96 4A           LSR                             ; } Y = [$1558] / 2: index into the bounce table
$03:8D97 A8           TAY                             ; /
$03:8D98 A5 1C        LDA RAM_ScreenBndryYLo          ; \
$03:8D9A 48           PHA                             ; |
$03:8D9B 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:8D9C 79 66 8D     ADC.W $8D66,Y                   ; } Save layer 1 Y low; [$1C] += $8D66[Y] (fake the block bounce)
$03:8D9F 85 1C        STA RAM_ScreenBndryYLo          ; /
$03:8DA1 A5 1D        LDA RAM_ScreenBndryYHi          ; \
$03:8DA3 48           PHA                             ; |
$03:8DA4 69 00        ADC.B #$00                      ; } Save layer 1 Y high; add the carry
$03:8DA6 85 1D        STA RAM_ScreenBndryYHi          ; /
$03:8DA8 22 B2 90 01  JSL.L GenericSprGfxRt2          ; Draw the sprite (GenericSprGfxRt2)
$03:8DAC BC EA 15     LDY.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X         ; Y = OAM index
$03:8DAF A9 C0        LDA.B #$C0                      ; \
$03:8DB1 99 02 03     STA.W OAM_Tile,Y                ; / Force OAM tile to $C0
$03:8DB4 68           PLA                             ; \
$03:8DB5 85 1D        STA RAM_ScreenBndryYHi          ; |
$03:8DB7 68           PLA                             ; } Restore layer 1 Y position (high, then low)
$03:8DB8 85 1C        STA RAM_ScreenBndryYLo          ; /
$03:8DBA 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $8DBB: Timed lift main routine (TimedLift) ;;;
{
;; Platform with a countdown number. Waits for Mario to stand on it, then moves right at speed $10 while the
;;     timer [$1570] counts down,
;; and falls with gravity when it reaches 0. Note: the 'AND #$00' at $038DC7 means the branch after it never
;;     happens.
;; Called by:
;;     $03:A1D0: Bank 3 sprite main dispatch (Bnk3CallSprMain)
$03:8DBB 20 12 8E     JSR.W TimedPlatformGfx          ; Draw the platform with its countdown number (TimedPlatformGfx)
$03:8DBE A5 9D        LDA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; \
$03:8DC0 D0 2D        BNE $8DEF                       ; / Return if sprites are locked
$03:8DC2 20 5D B8     JSR.W SubOffscreen0Bnk3         ; Despawn check when off-screen (SubOffscreen)
$03:8DC5 A5 13        LDA RAM_FrameCounter            ; \
$03:8DC7 29 00        AND.B #$00                      ; } A = frame counter AND 0 = 0: this branch is never taken
$03:8DC9 D0 0C        BNE $8DD7                       ; /
$03:8DCB B5 C2        LDA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; \
$03:8DCD F0 08        BEQ $8DD7                       ; / Not triggered by Mario yet (state = 0): skip the countdown
$03:8DCF BD 70 15     LDA.W $1570,X                   ; \
$03:8DD2 F0 03        BEQ $8DD7                       ; / Timer [$1570] already 0: skip
$03:8DD4 DE 70 15     DEC.W $1570,X                   ; Count down timer [$1570]
$03:8DD7 BD 70 15     LDA.W $1570,X                   ; \
$03:8DDA F0 14        BEQ $8DF0                       ; / Timer ran out: fall ($8DF0)
$03:8DDC 22 22 80 01  JSL.L UpdateXPosNoGrvty         ; Move horizontally (no gravity)
$03:8DE0 9D 28 15     STA.W $1528,X                   ; [$1528] = A (never used)
$03:8DE3 22 4F B4 01  JSL.L InvisBlkMainRt            ; \
$03:8DE7 90 06        BCC $8DEF                       ; / Return unless Mario stands on it (InvisBlkMainRt)
$03:8DE9 A9 10        LDA.B #$10                      ; \
$03:8DEB 95 B6        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; } Mario is on it: X speed = state = $10 (start moving)
$03:8DED 95 C2        STA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; /
$03:8DEF 60           RTS                             ; Return

$03:8DF0 22 2A 80 01  JSL.L UpdateSpritePos           ; Timer expired: move with gravity (UpdateSpritePos)
$03:8DF4 AD 91 14     LDA.W $1491                     ; \
$03:8DF7 9D 28 15     STA.W $1528,X                   ; / [$1528] = [$1491] (never used)
$03:8DFA 22 4F B4 01  JSL.L InvisBlkMainRt            ; Make Mario able to stand on the platform
$03:8DFE 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $8E12: Timed lift graphics (TimedPlatformGfx) ;;;
{
;; Draws two 16x16 platform halves plus an 8x8 countdown digit chosen by [$1570] / 64. The digit is omitted
;;     when the timer is below 8.
;; Sizes are written to the OAM size table by hand, so FinishOAMWrite is called with Y = $FF.
;; Called by:
;;     $03:8DBB: Timed lift main routine (TimedLift)
$03:8E12 20 60 B7     JSR.W GetDrawInfoBnk3           ; Get OAM index and screen position (GetDrawInfoBnk3)
$03:8E15 BD 70 15     LDA.W $1570,X                   ; \
$03:8E18 DA           PHX                             ; |
$03:8E19 48           PHA                             ; |
$03:8E1A 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:8E1B 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:8E1C 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:8E1D 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:8E1E 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:8E1F 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:8E20 AA           TAX                             ; } $02 = number tile from TimedPlatNumTiles[[$1570] / 64]
$03:8E21 BD 0E 8E     LDA.W TimedPlatNumTiles,X       ; /
$03:8E24 85 02        STA $02                         ; Store the number tile in $02
$03:8E26 A2 02        LDX.B #$02                      ; X = 2: three tiles (entry 2 is the number)
$03:8E28 68           PLA                             ; \
$03:8E29 C9 08        CMP.B #$08                      ; |
$03:8E2B B0 01        BCS $8E2E                       ; } Timer < 8: skip the number tile (X = 1)
$03:8E2D CA           DEX                             ; /
$03:8E2E A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$03:8E30 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:8E31 7D FF 8D     ADC.W TimedPlatDispX,X          ; } OAM X = sprite X + TimedPlatDispX[X]
$03:8E34 99 00 03     STA.W OAM_DispX,Y               ; /
$03:8E37 A5 01        LDA $01                         ; \
$03:8E39 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:8E3A 7D 02 8E     ADC.W TimedPlatDispY,X          ; } OAM Y = sprite Y + TimedPlatDispY[X]
$03:8E3D 99 01 03     STA.W OAM_DispY,Y               ; /
$03:8E40 BD 05 8E     LDA.W TimedPlatTiles,X          ; \
$03:8E43 E0 02        CPX.B #$02                      ; |
$03:8E45 D0 02        BNE $8E49                       ; |
$03:8E47 A5 02        LDA $02                         ; } OAM tile = TimedPlatTiles[X], or the number tile in $02 for X = 2
$03:8E49 99 02 03     STA.W OAM_Tile,Y                ; /
$03:8E4C BD 08 8E     LDA.W TimedPlatGfxProp,X        ; \
$03:8E4F 05 64        ORA $64                         ; } OAM properties = TimedPlatGfxProp[X] | [$64]
$03:8E51 99 03 03     STA.W OAM_Prop,Y                ; /
$03:8E54 5A           PHY                             ; \
$03:8E55 98           TYA                             ; |
$03:8E56 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:8E57 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:8E58 A8           TAY                             ; |
$03:8E59 BD 0B 8E     LDA.W TimedPlatTileSize,X       ; } OAM size bits at $0460 + (OAM index / 4) = TimedPlatTileSize[X]
$03:8E5C 99 60 04     STA.W OAM_TileSize,Y            ; /
$03:8E5F 7A           PLY                             ; Restore OAM index
$03:8E60 C8           INY                             ; \
$03:8E61 C8           INY                             ; |
$03:8E62 C8           INY                             ; } OAM index += 4
$03:8E63 C8           INY                             ; /
$03:8E64 CA           DEX                             ; \
$03:8E65 10 C7        BPL $8E2E                       ; / X--; loop while X >= 0
$03:8E67 FA           PLX                             ; Restore sprite index
$03:8E68 A0 FF        LDY.B #$FF                      ; \
$03:8E6A A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; / Y = $FF (sizes already written), A = 2 (three tiles)
$03:8E6C 22 B3 B7 01  JSL.L FinishOAMWrite            ; Finish OAM write
$03:8E70 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $8E79: Grey moving castle block main routine (GreyCastleBlock) ;;;
{
;; Sprite state AND 3 selects a phase: speed 0, left $F0, 0, right $10, for $40 or $50 frames. Solid via
;;     InvisBlkMainRt.
;; Called by:
;;     $03:A1D9: Bank 3 sprite main dispatch (Bnk3CallSprMain)
$03:8E79 20 B4 8E     JSR.W $8EB4                     ; Draw the block ($8EB4)
$03:8E7C A5 9D        LDA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; \
$03:8E7E D0 27        BNE $8EA7                       ; / Return if sprites are locked
$03:8E80 BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; \
$03:8E83 D0 0D        BNE $8E92                       ; / Phase timer [$1540] running: skip the phase change
$03:8E85 F6 C2        INC RAM_SpriteState,X           ; Next phase: state++
$03:8E87 B5 C2        LDA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; \
$03:8E89 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; |
$03:8E8B A8           TAY                             ; |
$03:8E8C B9 75 8E     LDA.W GreyMoveBlkTiming,Y       ; } [$1540] = GreyMoveBlkTiming[state AND 3]
$03:8E8F 9D 40 15     STA.W $1540,X                   ; /
$03:8E92 B5 C2        LDA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; \
$03:8E94 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; |
$03:8E96 A8           TAY                             ; |
$03:8E97 B9 71 8E     LDA.W GreyMoveBlkSpeed,Y        ; } X speed = GreyMoveBlkSpeed[state AND 3]
$03:8E9A 95 B6        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; /
$03:8E9C 22 22 80 01  JSL.L UpdateXPosNoGrvty         ; Move horizontally (no gravity)
$03:8EA0 9D 28 15     STA.W $1528,X                   ; [$1528] = A (never used)
$03:8EA3 22 4F B4 01  JSL.L InvisBlkMainRt            ; Make Mario able to stand on top of the block
$03:8EA7 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

$03:8ED2 A9 03        LDA.B #$03                      ; \

$03:8ED6 99 03 03     STA.W OAM_Prop,Y                ; /
$03:8ED9 C8           INY                             ; \
$03:8EDA C8           INY                             ; |
$03:8EDB C8           INY                             ; } OAM index += 4
$03:8EDC C8           INY                             ; /
$03:8EDD CA           DEX                             ; \

$03:8EE0 FA           PLX                             ; Restore sprite index
$03:8EE1 A0 02        LDY.B #$02                      ; \

$03:8F3F 99 00 03     STA.W OAM_DispX,Y               ; /
$03:8F42 68           PLA                             ; \
$03:8F43 48           PHA                             ; |
$03:8F44 05 03        ORA $03                         ; } X = loop counter | $03 (index into tiles and properties)
$03:8F46 AA           TAX                             ; /
$03:8F47 BD 0B 8F     LDA.W StatueFireTiles,X         ; \
$03:8F4A 99 02 03     STA.W OAM_Tile,Y                ; / OAM tile = StatueFireTiles[X]

$03:8F50 A6 02        LDX $02                         ; \
$03:8F52 D0 02        BNE $8F56                       ; } Direction 0 (right): flip horizontally
$03:8F54 49 40        EOR.B #$40                      ; /
$03:8F56 05 64        ORA $64                         ; \
$03:8F58 99 03 03     STA.W OAM_Prop,Y                ; / OAM properties = A | [$64]

$03:8F5C C8           INY                             ; \
$03:8F5D C8           INY                             ; |
$03:8F5E C8           INY                             ; } OAM index += 4
$03:8F5F C8           INY                             ; /
$03:8F60 CA           DEX                             ; \
$03:8F61 10 CC        BPL $8F2F                       ; / X--; loop while X >= 0
$03:8F63 FA           PLX                             ; Restore sprite index
$03:8F64 A0 00        LDY.B #$00                      ; \
$03:8F66 A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; / Y = 0 (8x8 tiles), A = 1 (two tiles)
$03:8F68 22 B3 B7 01  JSL.L FinishOAMWrite            ; Finish OAM write

;;; $8F7A: Boo stream main routine (BooStream) ;;;
{
;; Sprite $B0 flies diagonally, bouncing off walls and floors (inverting the speed component). Every 8th frame
;;     (staggered per sprite) it spawns a trail tile
;; as extended sprite $0A. Also contains the shared movement code at $8FA4 used by the reflecting
;;     fireball.
;; $038FF2: fireball graphics (tile $AC, palette flickers, flips follow the movement direction). $039020:
;;     spawn the Boo stream extended sprite.

$03:8F7A A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; \
$03:8F7C B4 B6        LDY RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; |
$03:8F7E 10 01        BPL $8F81                       ; |
$03:8F80 1A           INC A                           ; } Direction = 1 if X speed is negative, else 0
$03:8F81 9D 7C 15     STA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; /

$03:8F8B A5 14        LDA RAM_FrameCounterB           ; \
$03:8F8D 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:8F8E 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:8F8F 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:8F90 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:8F91 29 01        AND.B #$01                      ; } $00 = (frame counter / 16) AND 1 (animation bit)
$03:8F93 85 00        STA $00                         ; /
$03:8F95 8A           TXA                             ; \
$03:8F96 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; |
$03:8F98 0A           ASL                             ; } A = ((sprite index AND 3) * 2) | animation bit
$03:8F99 05 00        ORA $00                         ; /
$03:8F9B DA           PHX                             ; Save sprite index
$03:8F9C AA           TAX                             ; X = tile table index
$03:8F9D BD 6D 8F     LDA.W BooStreamFrntTiles,X      ; \
$03:8FA0 99 02 03     STA.W OAM_Tile,Y                ; / OAM tile = BooStreamFrntTiles[X]
$03:8FA3 FA           PLX                             ; Restore sprite index
$03:8FA4 BD C8 14     LDA.W $14C8,X                   ; \
$03:8FA7 C9 08        CMP.B #$08                      ; } Return unless sprite status = 8 (normal)
$03:8FA9 D0 46        BNE $8FF1                       ; /
$03:8FAB A5 9D        LDA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; \
$03:8FAD D0 42        BNE $8FF1                       ; / Return if sprites are locked
$03:8FAF 8A           TXA                             ; \
$03:8FB0 45 14        EOR RAM_FrameCounterB           ; |
$03:8FB2 29 07        AND.B #$07                      ; |
$03:8FB4 1D 6C 18     ORA.W RAM_OffscreenVert,X       ; } Skip unless (sprite index XOR frame counter) AND 7 = 0 and on-screen vertically
$03:8FB7 D0 09        BNE $8FC2                       ; /
$03:8FB9 B5 9E        LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; \
$03:8FBB C9 B0        CMP.B #$B0                      ; } Only sprite $B0 (Boo stream) spawns trail tiles
$03:8FBD D0 03        BNE $8FC2                       ; /
$03:8FBF 20 20 90     JSR.W $9020                     ; Spawn a Boo stream extended sprite ($9020)
$03:8FC2 22 1A 80 01  JSL.L UpdateYPosNoGrvty         ; Move vertically (no gravity)
$03:8FC6 22 22 80 01  JSL.L UpdateXPosNoGrvty         ; Move horizontally (no gravity)
$03:8FCA 22 38 91 01  JSL.L $9138                     ; Interact with objects ($9138)
$03:8FCE BD 88 15     LDA.W RAM_SprObjStatus,X        ; \
$03:8FD1 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; } Touching a wall (object status bits 0-1)? Otherwise skip
$03:8FD3 F0 07        BEQ $8FDC                       ; /
$03:8FD5 B5 B6        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; \
$03:8FD7 49 FF        EOR.B #$FF                      ; |
$03:8FD9 1A           INC A                           ; } X speed = -X speed (bounce)
$03:8FDA 95 B6        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; /
$03:8FDC BD 88 15     LDA.W RAM_SprObjStatus,X        ; \
$03:8FDF 29 0C        AND.B #$0C                      ; } Touching floor or ceiling (bits 2-3)? Otherwise skip
$03:8FE1 F0 07        BEQ $8FEA                       ; /
$03:8FE3 B5 AA        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; \
$03:8FE5 49 FF        EOR.B #$FF                      ; |
$03:8FE7 1A           INC A                           ; } Y speed = -Y speed (bounce)
$03:8FE8 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; /
$03:8FEA 22 DC A7 01  JSL.L MarioSprInteract          ; Interact with Mario (MarioSprInteract)
$03:8FEE 20 5D B8     JSR.W SubOffscreen0Bnk3         ; Despawn check when off-screen (SubOffscreen)
$03:8FF1 60           RTS                             ; Return

$03:8FF2 22 B2 90 01  JSL.L GenericSprGfxRt2          ; Draw the sprite (GenericSprGfxRt2)
$03:8FF6 A5 14        LDA RAM_FrameCounterB           ; \
$03:8FF8 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:8FF9 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:8FFA A9 04        LDA.B #$04                      ; } A = $04 (palette 2) when bit 1 of [$14] is clear, else $08 (palette 4): flickers
$03:8FFC 90 01        BCC $8FFF                       ; /
$03:8FFE 0A           ASL                             ; Bit set: A = $08
$03:8FFF B4 B6        LDY RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; \
$03:9001 10 02        BPL $9005                       ; } Moving left: flip horizontally
$03:9003 49 40        EOR.B #$40                      ; /
$03:9005 B4 AA        LDY RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; \
