$03:9009 49 80        EOR.B #$80                      ; /
$03:900B 85 00        STA $00                         ; $00 = palette and flip bits
$03:900D BC EA 15     LDY.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X         ; Y = OAM index
$03:9010 A9 AC        LDA.B #$AC                      ; \
$03:9012 99 02 03     STA.W OAM_Tile,Y                ; / OAM tile = $AC
$03:9015 B9 03 03     LDA.W OAM_Prop,Y                ; \
$03:9018 29 31        AND.B #$31                      ; |
$03:901A 05 00        ORA $00                         ; } OAM properties = (old properties AND $31) | $00 (keep priority and tile page)
$03:901C 99 03 03     STA.W OAM_Prop,Y                ; /
$03:901F 60           RTS                             ; Return

$03:9020 A0 0B        LDY.B #$0B                      ; Y = $0B: search the 12 extended sprite slots
$03:9022 B9 F0 17     LDA.W $17F0,Y                   ; \
$03:9025 F0 10        BEQ $9037                       ; |
$03:9027 88           DEY                             ; } Find an empty extended sprite slot ($17F0 table)
$03:9028 10 F8        BPL $9022                       ; /
$03:902A CE 5D 18     DEC.W $185D                     ; \
$03:902D 10 05        BPL $9034                       ; |
$03:902F A9 0B        LDA.B #$0B                      ; |
$03:9031 8D 5D 18     STA.W $185D                     ; } No free slot: pick one round-robin from [$185D] (counts 11 to 0)
$03:9034 AC 5D 18     LDY.W $185D                     ; /
$03:9037 A9 0A        LDA.B #$0A                      ; \
$03:9039 99 F0 17     STA.W $17F0,Y                   ; / Extended sprite number = $0A (Boo stream tile)
$03:903C B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; \
$03:903E 99 08 18     STA.W $1808,Y                   ; |
$03:9041 BD E0 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; } Extended sprite X position = sprite X (low, high)
$03:9044 99 EA 18     STA.W $18EA,Y                   ; /
$03:9047 B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$03:9049 99 FC 17     STA.W $17FC,Y                   ; |
$03:904C BD D4 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; } Extended sprite Y position = sprite Y (low, high)
$03:904F 99 14 18     STA.W $1814,Y                   ; /
$03:9052 A9 30        LDA.B #$30                      ; \
$03:9054 99 50 18     STA.W $1850,Y                   ; / Extended sprite timer = $30

;;; $9065: Fishin' Boo main routine (FishinBoo) ;;;
{
;; Boo that dangles a fishing hook. Accelerates horizontally toward Mario (away if [$18BF] is set) and bobs
;;     vertically by flipping the sign of Y acceleration at the max speed.
;; Faces Mario every 64 frames via a turn timer [$15AC]. [$1602] is the animation frame (1 while turning).
;; Called by:
;;     $03:A1F6: Bank 3 sprite main dispatch (Bnk3CallSprMain)
$03:9065 20 80 91     JSR.W FishinBooGfx              ; Draw the sprite (FishinBooGfx)
$03:9068 A5 9D        LDA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; \
$03:906A D0 7E        BNE $90EA                       ; / Return if sprites are locked
$03:906C 22 DC A7 01  JSL.L MarioSprInteract          ; Interact with Mario (MarioSprInteract)
$03:9070 20 17 B8     JSR.W SubHorzPosBnk3            ; Y = 0 if Mario is to the right, 1 if to the left (SubHorzPosBnk3)
$03:9073 9E 02 16     STZ.W $1602,X                   ; [$1602] = 0: normal animation frame
$03:9076 BD AC 15     LDA.W $15AC,X                   ; \
$03:9079 F0 0B        BEQ $9086                       ; / Turn timer [$15AC] = 0? Then skip
$03:907B FE 02 16     INC.W $1602,X                   ; [$1602] = 1: turning animation frame
$03:907E C9 10        CMP.B #$10                      ; \
$03:9080 D0 04        BNE $9086                       ; / Turn timer = $10 (halfway)? Otherwise skip
$03:9082 98           TYA                             ; \
$03:9083 9D 7C 15     STA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; / Face Mario: direction = Y
$03:9086 8A           TXA                             ; \
$03:9087 0A           ASL                             ; |
$03:9088 0A           ASL                             ; |
$03:9089 0A           ASL                             ; |
$03:908A 0A           ASL                             ; |
$03:908B 65 13        ADC RAM_FrameCounter            ; } A = ((sprite index * 16 + [$13]) AND $3F)
$03:908D 29 3F        AND.B #$3F                      ; /
$03:908F 1D AC 15     ORA.W $15AC,X                   ; A |= turn timer [$15AC]
$03:9092 D0 05        BNE $9099                       ; Non-zero: skip
$03:9094 A9 20        LDA.B #$20                      ; \
$03:9096 9D AC 15     STA.W $15AC,X                   ; / Turn timer [$15AC] = $20 (look at Mario again)
$03:9099 AD BF 18     LDA.W $18BF                     ; \
$03:909C F0 04        BEQ $90A2                       ; / [$18BF] = 0? Then chase Mario (flag meaning unclear)
$03:909E 98           TYA                             ; \
$03:909F 49 01        EOR.B #$01                      ; } [$18BF] set: invert Y (move away from Mario)
$03:90A1 A8           TAY                             ; /
$03:90A2 B5 B6        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; \
$03:90A4 D9 5F 90     CMP.W FishinBooMaxSpeedX,Y      ; } Already at max X speed for this direction? Skip
$03:90A7 F0 06        BEQ $90AF                       ; /
$03:90A9 18           CLC                             ; \
$03:90AA 79 5D 90     ADC.W FishinBooAccelX,Y         ; } X speed += FishinBooAccelX[Y]
$03:90AD 95 B6        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; /
$03:90AF A5 13        LDA RAM_FrameCounter            ; \
$03:90B1 29 01        AND.B #$01                      ; } Odd frame: skip the vertical update
$03:90B3 D0 14        BNE $90C9                       ; /
$03:90B5 B5 C2        LDA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; \
$03:90B7 29 01        AND.B #$01                      ; } Y = [sprite state] AND 1 (bob direction)
$03:90B9 A8           TAY                             ; /
$03:90BA B5 AA        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; \
$03:90BC 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:90BD 79 61 90     ADC.W FishinBooAccelY,Y         ; } Y speed += FishinBooAccelY[Y]
$03:90C0 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; /
$03:90C2 D9 63 90     CMP.W FishinBooMaxSpeedY,Y      ; \
$03:90C5 D0 02        BNE $90C9                       ; / Not at max Y speed yet: skip
$03:90C7 F6 C2        INC RAM_SpriteState,X           ; State++: reverse the bobbing direction
$03:90C9 B5 B6        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; \
$03:90CB 48           PHA                             ; / Save the X speed
$03:90CC AC BF 18     LDY.W $18BF                     ; \
$03:90CF D0 0B        BNE $90DC                       ; / [$18BF] set: skip the scroll adjustment
$03:90D1 AD BD 17     LDA.W $17BD                     ; \
$03:90D4 0A           ASL                             ; |
$03:90D5 0A           ASL                             ; |
$03:90D6 0A           ASL                             ; |
$03:90D7 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:90D8 75 B6        ADC RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; } X speed += [$17BD] * 8 (compensates for screen scrolling, probably)
$03:90DA 95 B6        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; /
$03:90DC 22 22 80 01  JSL.L UpdateXPosNoGrvty         ; Move horizontally (no gravity)
$03:90E0 68           PLA                             ; \
$03:90E1 95 B6        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; / Restore the unadjusted X speed
$03:90E3 22 1A 80 01  JSL.L UpdateYPosNoGrvty         ; Move vertically (no gravity)
$03:90E7 20 F3 90     JSR.W $90F3                     ; Check the fishing hook against Mario ($90F3)
$03:90EA 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $90F3: Fishin' Boo hook contact check ;;;
{
;; Builds a 4x4 hitbox $47 pixels below the sprite at the hook's X offset and hurts Mario if it overlaps.
;; Called by:
;;     $03:90E7: Fishin' Boo main routine (FishinBoo)
$03:90F3 BD 7C 15     LDA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; \
$03:90F6 0A           ASL                             ; |
$03:90F7 7D 02 16     ADC.W $1602,X                   ; } Y = direction * 2 + animation frame
$03:90FA A8           TAY                             ; /
$03:90FB B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; \
$03:90FD 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:90FE 79 EB 90     ADC.W $90EB,Y                   ; } $04 = hook hitbox X low = sprite X + $90EB[Y]
$03:9101 85 04        STA $04                         ; /
$03:9103 BD E0 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; \
$03:9106 79 EF 90     ADC.W $90EF,Y                   ; } $0A = hook hitbox X high
$03:9109 85 0A        STA $0A                         ; /
$03:910B A9 04        LDA.B #$04                      ; \
$03:910D 85 06        STA $06                         ; } Hook hitbox width and height ($06, $07) = 4
$03:910F 85 07        STA $07                         ; /
$03:9111 B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$03:9113 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:9114 69 47        ADC.B #$47                      ; } $05 = hook hitbox Y low = sprite Y + $47
$03:9116 85 05        STA $05                         ; /
$03:9118 BD D4 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; \
$03:911B 69 00        ADC.B #$00                      ; } $0B = hook hitbox Y high
$03:911D 85 0B        STA $0B                         ; /
$03:911F 22 64 B6 03  JSL.L GetMarioClipping          ; Mario hitbox B (GetMarioClipping)
$03:9123 22 2B B7 03  JSL.L CheckForContact           ; Check hitbox overlap (CheckForContact)
$03:9127 90 04        BCC $912D                       ; No contact: return
$03:9129 22 B7 F5 00  JSL.L HurtMario                 ; Hurt Mario
$03:912D 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $9180: Fishin' Boo graphics (FishinBooGfx) ;;;
{
;; Draws 10 16x16 tiles: Boo body, rod, three line segments and the animated hook (last tile). The body tiles
;;     then get their flip bits cycled for a wobble.
;; Called by:
;;     $03:9065: Fishin' Boo main routine (FishinBoo)
$03:9180 20 60 B7     JSR.W GetDrawInfoBnk3           ; Get OAM index and screen position (GetDrawInfoBnk3)
$03:9183 BD 02 16     LDA.W $1602,X                   ; \
$03:9186 85 04        STA $04                         ; / $04 = animation frame [$1602]
$03:9188 BD 7C 15     LDA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; \
$03:918B 85 02        STA $02                         ; / $02 = direction
$03:918D DA           PHX                             ; Save sprite index
$03:918E 5A           PHY                             ; Save OAM index
$03:918F A2 09        LDX.B #$09                      ; X = 9: ten tiles
$03:9191 A5 01        LDA $01                         ; \
$03:9193 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:9194 7D 56 91     ADC.W FishinBooDispY,X          ; } OAM Y = sprite Y + FishinBooDispY[X]
$03:9197 99 01 03     STA.W OAM_DispY,Y               ; /
$03:919A 64 03        STZ $03                         ; $03 = 0: no extra flip
$03:919C BD 60 91     LDA.W FishinBooTiles1,X         ; A = FishinBooTiles1[X]
$03:919F E0 09        CPX.B #$09                      ; \
$03:91A1 D0 11        BNE $91B4                       ; / Not tile 9 (the hook): skip the animation
$03:91A3 A5 14        LDA RAM_FrameCounterB           ; \
$03:91A5 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:91A6 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:91A7 DA           PHX                             ; } X = (frame counter / 4) AND 3: hook animation frame
$03:91A8 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; /
$03:91AA AA           TAX 
$03:91AB BD 78 91     LDA.W $9178,X                   ; \
$03:91AE 85 03        STA $03                         ; / $03 = $9178[X] (hook flip bits)
$03:91B0 BD 74 91     LDA.W FishinBooTiles2,X         ; A = FishinBooTiles2[X] (hook tile)
$03:91B3 FA           PLX                             ; Restore loop counter
$03:91B4 99 02 03     STA.W OAM_Tile,Y                ; OAM tile = A
$03:91B7 A5 02        LDA $02                         ; \
$03:91B9 C9 01        CMP.B #$01                      ; / Carry = direction >= 1
$03:91BB BD 6A 91     LDA.W FishinBooGfxProp,X        ; A = FishinBooGfxProp[X]
$03:91BE 45 03        EOR $03                         ; \
$03:91C0 05 64        ORA $64                         ; / Apply hook flip bits and priority [$64]
$03:91C2 B0 02        BCS $91C6                       ; \
$03:91C4 49 40        EOR.B #$40                      ; / Direction 0: flip horizontally
$03:91C6 99 03 03     STA.W OAM_Prop,Y                ; OAM properties = A
$03:91C9 DA           PHX                             ; Save loop counter
$03:91CA A5 04        LDA $04                         ; \
$03:91CC F0 05        BEQ $91D3                       ; |
$03:91CE 8A           TXA                             ; |
$03:91CF 18           CLC                             ; } Frame 1: X += $0A (second set of X offsets)
$03:91D0 69 0A        ADC.B #$0A                      ; /
$03:91D2 AA           TAX                             ; X = adjusted index
$03:91D3 A5 02        LDA $02                         ; \
$03:91D5 D0 05        BNE $91DC                       ; |
$03:91D7 8A           TXA                             ; |
$03:91D8 18           CLC                             ; } Direction 0: X += $14 (mirrored sets)
$03:91D9 69 14        ADC.B #$14                      ; /
$03:91DB AA           TAX                             ; X = adjusted index
$03:91DC A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$03:91DE 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:91DF 7D 2E 91     ADC.W FishinBooDispX,X          ; } OAM X = sprite X + FishinBooDispX[X]
$03:91E2 99 00 03     STA.W OAM_DispX,Y               ; /
$03:91E5 FA           PLX                             ; Restore loop counter
$03:91E6 C8           INY                             ; \
$03:91E7 C8           INY                             ; |
$03:91E8 C8           INY                             ; } OAM index += 4
$03:91E9 C8           INY                             ; /
$03:91EA CA           DEX                             ; \
$03:91EB 10 A4        BPL $9191                       ; / X--; loop while X >= 0
$03:91ED A5 14        LDA RAM_FrameCounterB           ; \
$03:91EF 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:91F0 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:91F1 4A           LSR                             ; } X = (frame counter / 8) AND 3: body wobble index
$03:91F2 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; /
$03:91F4 AA           TAX                             ; X = wobble index
$03:91F5 7A           PLY                             ; Restore OAM index
$03:91F6 BD 7C 91     LDA.W $917C,X                   ; \
$03:91F9 59 13 03     EOR.W $0313,Y                   ; } OAM properties of tile slot 4 (offset +$10) ^= $917C[X]
$03:91FC 99 13 03     STA.W $0313,Y                   ; /
$03:91FF 99 27 03     STA.W $0327,Y                   ; Same value for tile slot 9 (+$24)
$03:9202 49 C0        EOR.B #$C0                      ; \
$03:9204 99 17 03     STA.W $0317,Y                   ; / A ^= $C0; tile slot 5 (+$14) gets it
$03:9207 99 23 03     STA.W $0323,Y                   ; Same value for tile slot 8 (+$20)
$03:920A FA           PLX                             ; Restore sprite index
$03:920B A0 02        LDY.B #$02                      ; \
$03:920D A9 09        LDA.B #$09                      ; / Y = 2 (16x16 tiles), A = 9 (ten tiles)
$03:920F 22 B3 B7 01  JSL.L FinishOAMWrite            ; Finish OAM write
$03:9213 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $9214: Falling spike main routine (FallingSpike) ;;;
{
;; Draws the spike (tile $E0), shakes it horizontally while the timer [$1540] runs, then moves with gravity
;;     and runs a state routine through ExecutePtr (pointer table follows).
;; Called by:
;;     $03:A1ED: Bank 3 sprite main dispatch (Bnk3CallSprMain)
$03:9214 22 B2 90 01  JSL.L GenericSprGfxRt2          ; Draw the sprite (GenericSprGfxRt2)
$03:9218 BC EA 15     LDY.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X         ; Y = OAM index
$03:921B A9 E0        LDA.B #$E0                      ; \
$03:921D 99 02 03     STA.W OAM_Tile,Y                ; / OAM tile = $E0
$03:9220 B9 01 03     LDA.W OAM_DispY,Y               ; \
$03:9223 3A           DEC A                           ; } OAM Y -= 1
$03:9224 99 01 03     STA.W OAM_DispY,Y               ; /
$03:9227 BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; \
$03:922A F0 0B        BEQ $9237                       ; / Timer [$1540] = 0: skip shaking
$03:922C 4A           LSR                             ; \
$03:922D 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:922E 29 01        AND.B #$01                      ; |
$03:9230 18           CLC                             ; } A = ([$1540] / 4) AND 1: shake offset
$03:9231 79 00 03     ADC.W OAM_DispX,Y               ; /
$03:9234 99 00 03     STA.W OAM_DispX,Y               ; OAM X += A
$03:9237 A5 9D        LDA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; \
$03:9239 D0 31        BNE $926C                       ; / Sprites locked: skip to $03926C
$03:923B 20 5D B8     JSR.W SubOffscreen0Bnk3         ; Despawn check when off-screen (SubOffscreen)
$03:923E 22 2A 80 01  JSL.L UpdateSpritePos           ; Move with gravity (UpdateSpritePos)
$03:9242 B5 C2        LDA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; A = sprite state
$03:9244 22 DF 86 00  JSL.L ExecutePtr                ; Run the state routine (ExecutePtr; pointer table follows)

}

;;; $9248: Falling spike: state handlers (FallingSpikePtrs) ;;;
{
;; State 0: stand still until Mario is within $40 pixels horizontally, then state 1 with a $40 frame timer.
;; State 1: shake in place while [$1540] runs, then fall (gravity applied earlier in the main routine) and
;;     hurt Mario on contact.
$03:9248 4C 92        .dw $924C                       ; State 0: wait for Mario to come near
$03:924A 62 92        .dw $9262                       ; State 1: wait, then fall and hurt Mario on contact

$03:924C 74 AA        STZ RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; Sprite Y speed = 0 (hangs in place)
$03:924E 20 17 B8     JSR.W SubHorzPosBnk3            ; $0F = horizontal distance to Mario, Y = side
$03:9251 A5 0F        LDA $0F                         ; \
$03:9253 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:9254 69 40        ADC.B #$40                      ; |
$03:9256 C9 80        CMP.B #$80                      ; } Return unless Mario is within $40 pixels horizontally ([$0F]+$40 < $80)
$03:9258 B0 07        BCS $9261                       ; /
$03:925A F6 C2        INC RAM_SpriteState,X           ; Next state: state 1
$03:925C A9 40        LDA.B #$40                      ; A = $40
$03:925E 9D 40 15     STA.W $1540,X                   ; Shake/stall timer [$1540] = $40 frames
$03:9261 60           RTS                             ; Return

$03:9262 BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; Timer [$1540] still running?
$03:9265 D0 05        BNE $926C                       ; Yes: stay put, Y speed = 0
$03:9267 22 DC A7 01  JSL.L MarioSprInteract          ; Timer done: check Mario contact (hurts Mario)
$03:926B 60           RTS                             ; Return

$03:926C 74 AA        STZ RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; Sprite Y speed = 0 while waiting
$03:926E 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $9284: Creating/eating block main routine (CreateEatBlock) ;;;
{
;; Moving block that follows a fixed path, either laying down blocks (creating) or erasing them (eating)
;;     behind it.
;; Mode in [$151C]: 0 creating, non-zero eating. Path steps come from CrtEatBlkData1 (submap non-zero) or
;;     CrtEatBlkData2 (submap 0).
;; Step byte: high nibble = blocks to travel, low 2 bits = direction, $FF = end of path (sprite removed).
;;     Eating mode follows the existing trail of blocks.
;; Called by:
;;     $03:A211: Bank 3 sprite main dispatch (Bnk3CallSprMain)
$03:9284 22 B2 90 01  JSL.L GenericSprGfxRt2          ; Draw sprite (generic 16x16 gfx)
$03:9288 BC EA 15     LDY.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X         ; Y = index into sprite OAM
$03:928B B9 01 03     LDA.W OAM_DispY,Y               ; \
$03:928E 3A           DEC A                           ; } OAM Y position -= 1
$03:928F 99 01 03     STA.W OAM_DispY,Y               ; /
$03:9292 A9 2E        LDA.B #$2E                      ; A = $2E
$03:9294 99 02 03     STA.W OAM_Tile,Y                ; OAM tile = $2E
$03:9297 B9 03 03     LDA.W OAM_Prop,Y                ; \
$03:929A 29 3F        AND.B #$3F                      ; } OAM properties: clear Y-flip and X-flip bits
$03:929C 99 03 03     STA.W OAM_Prop,Y                ; /
$03:929F A0 02        LDY.B #$02                      ; Y = 2: 16x16 tile size
$03:92A1 A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; A = 0: draw 1 tile
$03:92A3 22 B3 B7 01  JSL.L FinishOAMWrite            ; Finish OAM write (size, offscreen check)
$03:92A7 A0 04        LDY.B #$04                      ; Y = 4: direction 4 = stopped
$03:92A9 AD 09 19     LDA.W $1909                     ; [$1909] = $FF? (probably 'block frozen' flag)
$03:92AC C9 FF        CMP.B #$FF                      ; Compare with $FF
$03:92AE F0 10        BEQ $92C0                       ; Yes: keep Y = 4, no sound
$03:92B0 A5 13        LDA RAM_FrameCounter            ; \
$03:92B2 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; |
$03:92B4 05 9D        ORA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; } Every 4th frame while sprites unlocked: play sound
$03:92B6 D0 05        BNE $92BD                       ; /
$03:92B8 A9 04        LDA.B #$04                      ; Sound effect $04
$03:92BA 8D FA 1D     STA.W $1DFA                     ; Play it via $1DFA
$03:92BD BC 7C 15     LDY.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; Y = sprite direction (0 right, 1 left, 2 down, 3 up)
$03:92C0 A5 9D        LDA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; Sprites locked?
$03:92C2 D0 67        BNE $932B                       ; Yes: return
$03:92C4 B9 6F 92     LDA.W CrtEatBlkSpeedX,Y         ; \
$03:92C7 95 B6        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; / Speed X = CrtEatBlkSpeedX[direction]
$03:92C9 B9 74 92     LDA.W CrtEatBlkSpeedY,Y         ; \
$03:92CC 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; / Speed Y = CrtEatBlkSpeedY[direction]
$03:92CE 22 1A 80 01  JSL.L UpdateYPosNoGrvty         ; Move Y position by speed (no gravity)
$03:92D2 22 22 80 01  JSL.L UpdateXPosNoGrvty         ; Move X position by speed (no gravity)
$03:92D6 9E 28 15     STZ.W $1528,X                   ; Clear [$1528,X] (so Mario is not carried like on a platform)
$03:92D9 22 4F B4 01  JSL.L InvisBlkMainRt            ; Act as a solid invisible block for Mario
$03:92DD AD 09 19     LDA.W $1909                     ; [$1909] = $FF? (frozen)
$03:92E0 C9 FF        CMP.B #$FF                      ; Compare with $FF
$03:92E2 F0 47        BEQ $932B                       ; Yes: return
$03:92E4 B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$03:92E6 15 E4        ORA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; |
$03:92E8 29 0F        AND.B #$0F                      ; } Only act when sprite X and Y are both aligned to a 16 pixel boundary
$03:92EA D0 3F        BNE $932B                       ; /
$03:92EC BD 1C 15     LDA.W $151C,X                   ; [$151C] = mode: 0 creating, non-zero eating
$03:92EF D0 3B        BNE $932C                       ; Eating: go to $03932C
$03:92F1 DE 70 15     DEC.W $1570,X                   ; Creating: decrement step timer [$1570]
$03:92F4 30 02        BMI $92F8                       ; Negative: fetch next step
$03:92F6 D0 27        BNE $931F                       ; Still counting: just make the block
$03:92F8 AC B3 0D     LDY.W $0DB3                     ; Y = current player's submap index [$0DB3]
$03:92FB B9 11 1F     LDA.W $1F11,Y                   ; A = overworld submap [$1F11]
$03:92FE C9 01        CMP.B #$01                      ; Carry set if submap >= 1
$03:9300 BC 34 15     LDY.W $1534,X                   ; Y = path step index [$1534]
$03:9303 FE 34 15     INC.W $1534,X                   ; Next step index
$03:9306 B9 A4 93     LDA.W CrtEatBlkData1,Y          ; A = step from CrtEatBlkData1
$03:9309 B0 03        BCS $930E                       ; Submap non-zero: use data 1
$03:930B B9 EF 93     LDA.W CrtEatBlkData2,Y          ; Submap 0: A = step from CrtEatBlkData2
$03:930E 9D 02 16     STA.W $1602,X                   ; Remember step byte in [$1602] ($FF = end of path)
$03:9311 48           PHA                             ; Save step byte
$03:9312 4A           LSR                             ; \
$03:9313 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:9314 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:9315 4A           LSR                             ; } Blocks left in this step [$1570] = upper nibble of step byte
$03:9316 9D 70 15     STA.W $1570,X                   ; /
$03:9319 68           PLA                             ; Restore step byte
$03:931A 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; \
$03:931C 9D 7C 15     STA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; / Direction = step byte & 3
$03:931F A9 0D        LDA.B #$0D                      ; A = $0D: block to generate
$03:9321 20 8B 93     JSR.W GenTileFromSpr1           ; Generate block at sprite position
$03:9324 BD 02 16     LDA.W $1602,X                   ; A = step byte
$03:9327 C9 FF        CMP.B #$FF                      ; Compare with $FF
$03:9329 F0 5C        BEQ $9387                       ; End of path: remove sprite
$03:932B 60           RTS                             ; Return

$03:932C A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; Eating mode: A = $02, block to generate (empty tile)
$03:932E 20 8B 93     JSR.W GenTileFromSpr1           ; Erase the block under the sprite
$03:9331 A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; \
$03:9333 95 B6        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; } Speed X = Speed Y = 1 (probe down and right)
$03:9335 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; /
$03:9337 22 38 91 01  JSL.L $9138                     ; Sprite-block interaction
$03:933B BD 88 15     LDA.W RAM_SprObjStatus,X        ; A = contact bits from probe
$03:933E 48           PHA                             ; Save them
$03:933F A9 FF        LDA.B #$FF                      ; \
$03:9341 95 B6        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; } Speed X = Speed Y = $FF (probe up and left)
$03:9343 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; /
$03:9345 B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; \
$03:9347 48           PHA                             ; / Save X low
$03:9348 38           SEC                             ; \
$03:9349 E9 01        SBC.B #$01                      ; } X position low -= 1
$03:934B 95 E4        STA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; /
$03:934D BD E0 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; A = X high
$03:9350 48           PHA                             ; Save X high
$03:9351 E9 00        SBC.B #$00                      ; X high -= borrow
$03:9353 9D E0 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; Store X high
$03:9356 B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; A = Y low
$03:9358 48           PHA                             ; Save Y low
$03:9359 38           SEC                             ; \
$03:935A E9 01        SBC.B #$01                      ; } Y position low -= 1
$03:935C 95 D8        STA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; /
$03:935E BD D4 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; A = Y high
$03:9361 48           PHA                             ; Save Y high
$03:9362 E9 00        SBC.B #$00                      ; Y high -= borrow
$03:9364 9D D4 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; Store Y high
$03:9367 22 38 91 01  JSL.L $9138                     ; Sprite-block interaction at the offset position
$03:936B 68           PLA                             ; Restore Y high
$03:936C 9D D4 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; Store Y high
$03:936F 68           PLA                             ; Restore Y low
$03:9370 95 D8        STA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; Store Y low
$03:9372 68           PLA                             ; Restore X high
$03:9373 9D E0 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; Store X high
$03:9376 68           PLA                             ; Restore X low
$03:9377 95 E4        STA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; Store X low
$03:9379 68           PLA                             ; Restore first probe contact bits
$03:937A 1D 88 15     ORA.W RAM_SprObjStatus,X        ; Combine with second probe bits
$03:937D F0 08        BEQ $9387                       ; No block touching: remove sprite
$03:937F A8           TAY                             ; Y = combined contact bits
$03:9380 B9 79 92     LDA.W $9279,Y                   ; A = direction for those bits ($9279)
$03:9383 9D 7C 15     STA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; Set sprite direction
$03:9386 60           RTS                             ; Return

$03:9387 9E C8 14     STZ.W $14C8,X                   ; Sprite status = 0 (erase sprite)
$03:938A 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $938B: Generate block at sprite position (GenTileFromSpr1) ;;;
{
;; Parameters: A: block number to generate. Uses sprite X/Y position.
;; Called by:
;;     $03:9321: Creating/eating block main routine (CreateEatBlock)
;;     $03:932E: Creating/eating block main routine (CreateEatBlock)
$03:938B 85 9C        STA RAM_BlockBlock              ; Block to generate = A
$03:938D B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; \
$03:938F 85 9A        STA RAM_BlockXLo                ; / Block X position low = sprite X low
$03:9391 BD E0 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; \
$03:9394 85 9B        STA RAM_BlockXHi                ; / Block X position high = sprite X high
$03:9396 B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$03:9398 85 98        STA RAM_BlockYLo                ; / Block Y position low = sprite Y low
$03:939A BD D4 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; \
$03:939D 85 99        STA RAM_BlockYHi                ; / Block Y position high = sprite Y high
$03:939F 22 B0 BE 00  JSL.L GenerateTile              ; Generate the block
$03:93A3 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $93A4: Table: creating block path (submap non-zero) (CrtEatBlkData1) ;;;
{
;; Step bytes: high nibble = blocks to travel, low 2 bits = direction (0 right, 1 left, 2 down, 3 up), $FF =
;;     end.
$03:93A4              .db $10,$13,$10,$13,$10,$13,$10,$13 ; Path steps: high nibble = blocks to travel, low 2 bits = direction, $FF = end
$03:93AC              .db $10,$13,$10,$13,$10,$13,$10,$13 ; Path steps: high nibble = blocks to travel, low 2 bits = direction, $FF = end
$03:93B4              .db $F0,$F0,$20,$12,$10,$12,$10,$12 ; Path steps: high nibble = blocks to travel, low 2 bits = direction, $FF = end
$03:93BC              .db $10,$12,$10,$12,$10,$12,$10,$12 ; Path steps: high nibble = blocks to travel, low 2 bits = direction, $FF = end
$03:93C4              .db $D0,$C3,$F1,$21,$22,$F1,$F1,$51 ; Path steps: high nibble = blocks to travel, low 2 bits = direction, $FF = end
$03:93CC              .db $43,$10,$13,$10,$13,$10,$13,$F0 ; Path steps: high nibble = blocks to travel, low 2 bits = direction, $FF = end
$03:93D4              .db $F0,$F0,$60,$32,$60,$32,$71,$32 ; Path steps: high nibble = blocks to travel, low 2 bits = direction, $FF = end
$03:93DC              .db $60,$32,$61,$32,$70,$33,$10,$33 ; Path steps: high nibble = blocks to travel, low 2 bits = direction, $FF = end
$03:93E4              .db $10,$33,$10,$33,$10,$33,$F0,$10 ; Path steps: high nibble = blocks to travel, low 2 bits = direction, $FF = end
$03:93EC              .db $F2,$52,$FF                 ; Path steps: high nibble = blocks to travel, low 2 bits = direction, $FF = end

}

;;; $93EF: Table: creating block path (submap 0) (CrtEatBlkData2) ;;;
{
$03:93EF              .db $80,$13,$10,$13,$10,$13,$10,$13 ; Path steps for submap 0 (same format as CrtEatBlkData1)
$03:93F7              .db $60,$23,$20,$23,$B0,$22,$A1,$22 ; Path steps (same format)
$03:93FF              .db $A0,$22,$A1,$22,$C0,$13,$10,$13 ; Path steps (same format)
$03:9407              .db $10,$13,$10,$13,$10,$13,$10,$13 ; Path steps (same format)
$03:940F              .db $10,$13,$F0,$F0,$F0,$52,$50,$33 ; Path steps (same format)
$03:9417              .db $50,$32,$50,$33,$50,$22,$50,$33 ; Path steps (same format)
$03:941F              .db $F0,$50,$82,$FF             ; Path steps (same format)

;;; $9423: Wooden spike main routine (WoodenSpike) ;;;
{
;; Sprites $AC/$AD. Draws, handles Mario contact, then cycles through 4 states (rise, pause, drop, pause).
;; Called by:
;;     $03:A21E: Bank 3 sprite main dispatch (Bnk3CallSprMain)
$03:9423 20 CF 94     JSR.W WoodSpikeGfx              ; Draw the spike
$03:9426 A5 9D        LDA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; Sprites locked?
$03:9428 D0 16        BNE $9440                       ; Yes: return
$03:942A 20 5D B8     JSR.W SubOffscreen0Bnk3         ; Process only while on screen
$03:942D 20 88 94     JSR.W $9488                     ; Handle Mario contact
$03:9430 B5 C2        LDA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; A = state
$03:9432 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; State & 3 (4 phase cycle)
$03:9434 22 DF 86 00  JSL.L ExecutePtr                ; Run the state routine

}

;;; $9438: Pointer table: wooden spike states (WoodenSpikePtrs) ;;;
{
$03:9438 58 94        .dw $9458                       ; State 0: rise
$03:943A 4E 94        .dw $944E                       ; State 1: pause at top
$03:943C 41 94        .dw $9441                       ; State 2: drop
$03:943E 6B 94        .dw $946B                       ; State 3: pause at bottom

$03:9440 60           RTS                             ; Return

$03:9441 BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; State 2: timer [$1540] running?
$03:9444 F0 04        BEQ $944A                       ; No: go to $03944A
$03:9446 A9 20        LDA.B #$20                      ; A = $20 (fast drop speed)
$03:9448 80 2B        BRA $9475                       ; Move with this speed

$03:944A A9 30        LDA.B #$30                      ; A = $30: pause length
$03:944C 80 17        BRA SetTimerNextState           ; Set timer and go to next state

$03:944E BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; State 1: timer running?
$03:9451 D0 04        BNE $9457                       ; Yes: wait
$03:9453 A9 18        LDA.B #$18                      ; A = $18: length of next phase
$03:9455 80 0E        BRA SetTimerNextState           ; Set timer and go to next state

$03:9457 60           RTS                             ; Return

$03:9458 BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; State 0: timer running?
$03:945B F0 06        BEQ $9463                       ; No: go to $039463
$03:945D A9 F0        LDA.B #$F0                      ; A = $F0 (rise speed)
$03:945F 20 75 94     JSR.W $9475                     ; Move with this speed
$03:9462 60           RTS                             ; Return

$03:9463 A9 30        LDA.B #$30                      ; A = $30: length of next phase
}

;;; $9465: Set timer and go to next state (SetTimerNextState) ;;;
{
;; Parameters: A: value for timer [$1540]. Increments the sprite state.
$03:9465 9D 40 15     STA.W $1540,X                   ; Timer [$1540] = A
$03:9468 F6 C2        INC RAM_SpriteState,X           ; Next state
$03:946A 60           RTS                             ; Return

$03:946B BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; State 3: timer running?
$03:946E D0 04        BNE $9474                       ; Yes: wait
$03:9470 A9 2F        LDA.B #$2F                      ; A = $2F: length of next phase
$03:9472 80 F1        BRA SetTimerNextState           ; Set timer and go to next state (wraps to state 0)

$03:9474 60           RTS                             ; Return

$03:9475 BC 1C 15     LDY.W $151C,X                   ; Y = [$151C] (0 = normal, non-zero = reverse direction)
$03:9478 F0 03        BEQ $947D                       ; Normal: keep speed
$03:947A 49 FF        EOR.B #$FF                      ; \
$03:947C 1A           INC A                           ; / Reverse: negate A
$03:947D 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; Sprite Y speed = A
$03:947F 22 1A 80 01  JSL.L UpdateYPosNoGrvty         ; Move Y position by speed (no gravity)
$03:9483 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $9484..9486: Table: wooden spike push direction ;;;
{
$03:9484              .db $01,$FF                     ; Push Mario X: +1 (Mario on right), -1 (Mario on left)

$03:9486              .db $00,$FF                     ; High byte of that push: $00, $FF

}

;;; $9488: Wooden spike Mario contact ;;;
{
;; Hurts Mario if he touches the center of the spike; otherwise pushes him sideways by 1 pixel and zeroes his
;;     X speed.
;; Called by:
;;     $03:942D: Wooden spike main routine (WoodenSpike)
$03:9488 22 DC A7 01  JSL.L MarioSprInteract          ; Check Mario contact
$03:948C 90 22        BCC $94B0                       ; No contact: return
$03:948E 20 17 B8     JSR.W SubHorzPosBnk3            ; $0F = horizontal distance to Mario, Y = side
$03:9491 A5 0F        LDA $0F                         ; \
$03:9493 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:9494 69 04        ADC.B #$04                      ; |
$03:9496 C9 08        CMP.B #$08                      ; } Mario within 4 pixels of the sprite's center ([$0F]+4 < 8)?
$03:9498 B0 05        BCS $949F                       ; /
$03:949A 22 B7 F5 00  JSL.L HurtMario                 ; Yes: hurt Mario
$03:949E 60           RTS                             ; Return

$03:949F A5 94        LDA RAM_MarioXPos               ; \
$03:94A1 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:94A2 79 84 94     ADC.W $9484,Y                   ; } Mario X position low += $9484[side] (push sideways)
$03:94A5 85 94        STA RAM_MarioXPos               ; /
$03:94A7 A5 95        LDA RAM_MarioXPosHi             ; \
$03:94A9 79 86 94     ADC.W $9486,Y                   ; } Mario X position high += $9486[side]
$03:94AC 85 95        STA RAM_MarioXPosHi             ; /
$03:94AE 64 7B        STZ RAM_MarioSpeedX             ; Mario X speed = 0
$03:94B0 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $94B1: Table: wooden spike tile Y offsets (WoodSpikeDispY) ;;;
{
$03:94B1              .db $00,$10,$20,$30,$40,$40,$30,$20 ; Tile Y offsets, sprite $AC (5 tiles, then sprite $AD)
$03:94B9              .db $10,$00                     ; (sprite $AD, continued)

}

;;; $94BB: Table: wooden spike tile numbers (WoodSpikeTiles) ;;;
{
$03:94BB              .db $6A,$6A,$6A,$6A,$4A,$6A,$6A,$6A ; Tile numbers: $6A, tip $4A
$03:94C3              .db $6A,$4A                     ; (sprite $AD, continued)

}

;;; $94C5: Table: wooden spike tile properties (WoodSpikeGfxProp) ;;;
{
$03:94C5              .db $81,$81,$81,$81,$81,$01,$01,$01 ; Tile properties: $81 flipped vertically, $01 normal
$03:94CD              .db $01,$01                     ; (sprite $AD, continued)

}

;;; $94CF: Wooden spike graphics: setup (WoodSpikeGfx) ;;;
{
;; Sprite $AD uses the second half of the tables.
;; Called by:
;;     $03:9423: Wooden spike main routine (WoodenSpike)
$03:94CF 20 60 B7     JSR.W GetDrawInfoBnk3           ; Y = OAM index, $00 = X, $01 = Y
$03:94D2 64 02        STZ $02                         ; $02 = 0: table offset for first spike type
$03:94D4 B5 9E        LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; \
$03:94D6 C9 AD        CMP.B #$AD                      ; |
$03:94D8 D0 04        BNE $94DE                       ; |
$03:94DA A9 05        LDA.B #$05                      ; } $02 = 5 if sprite number is $AD (second spike type)
$03:94DC 85 02        STA $02                         ; /
$03:94DE DA           PHX                             ; Save sprite index
$03:94DF A2 04        LDX.B #$04                      ; X = 4: draw 5 tiles
}

;;; $94E1: Wooden spike graphics: draw 5 tiles (WoodSpikeGfxLoopSt) ;;;
{
;; Draws 5 16x16 tiles in a column.
$03:94E1 DA           PHX                             ; Save tile counter
$03:94E2 8A           TXA                             ; \
$03:94E3 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:94E4 65 02        ADC $02                         ; } X = tile counter + [$02]: table index
$03:94E6 AA           TAX                             ; /
$03:94E7 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$03:94E9 99 00 03     STA.W OAM_DispX,Y               ; / OAM X = sprite X
$03:94EC A5 01        LDA $01                         ; \
$03:94EE 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:94EF 7D B1 94     ADC.W WoodSpikeDispY,X          ; } OAM Y = sprite Y + WoodSpikeDispY[X]
$03:94F2 99 01 03     STA.W OAM_DispY,Y               ; /
$03:94F5 BD BB 94     LDA.W WoodSpikeTiles,X          ; \
$03:94F8 99 02 03     STA.W OAM_Tile,Y                ; / OAM tile = WoodSpikeTiles[X]
$03:94FB BD C5 94     LDA.W WoodSpikeGfxProp,X        ; \
$03:94FE 99 03 03     STA.W OAM_Prop,Y                ; / OAM properties = WoodSpikeGfxProp[X]
$03:9501 C8           INY                             ; \
$03:9502 C8           INY                             ; |
$03:9503 C8           INY                             ; } Next OAM slot
$03:9504 C8           INY                             ; /
$03:9505 FA           PLX                             ; Restore tile counter
$03:9506 CA           DEX                             ; Next tile
$03:9507 10 D8        BPL WoodSpikeGfxLoopSt          ; Loop for 5 tiles
$03:9509 FA           PLX                             ; Restore sprite index
$03:950A A0 02        LDY.B #$02                      ; Y = 2: 16x16 tiles
$03:950C A9 04        LDA.B #$04                      ; A = 4: 5 tiles
$03:950E 22 B3 B7 01  JSL.L FinishOAMWrite            ; Finish OAM write
$03:9512 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $9513: Table: Rex X speed (RexSpeed) ;;;
{
$03:9513              .db $08,$F8,$10,$F0             ; Rex X speed: $08 right, $F8 left, then $10, $F0 when half squashed

}

;;; $9517: Rex main routine (RexMainRt) ;;;
{
;; Draws Rex. Only runs while status is 8 and sprites are unlocked. Counts down the remains timer when
;;     flattened.
;; Called by:
;;     $03:A227: Bank 3 sprite main dispatch (Bnk3CallSprMain)
$03:9517 20 7E 96     JSR.W RexGfxRt                  ; Draw Rex
$03:951A BD C8 14     LDA.W $14C8,X                   ; A = sprite status
$03:951D C9 08        CMP.B #$08                      ; Normal (8)?
$03:951F D0 12        BNE RexReturn                   ; No (spin kill, star kill, ...): return
$03:9521 A5 9D        LDA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; Sprites locked?
$03:9523 D0 0E        BNE RexReturn                   ; Yes: return
$03:9525 BD 58 15     LDA.W $1558,X                   ; A = timer [$1558] for showing squashed remains
$03:9528 F0 0A        BEQ RexAlive                    ; Zero: Rex alive
$03:952A 9D D0 15     STA.W $15D0,X                   ; Copy timer to [$15D0]
$03:952D 3A           DEC A                           ; Timer - 1
$03:952E D0 03        BNE RexReturn                   ; Remains still showing: return
$03:9530 9E C8 14     STZ.W $14C8,X                   ; Last frame of remains: sprite status = 0 (erase)
}

;;; $9533: Return (RexReturn) ;;;
{
$03:9533 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $9534: Rex: walk and animate (RexAlive) ;;;
{
;; Animates, walks (speed depends on stomp state) and turns at walls, then interacts with sprites and Mario.
$03:9534 20 5D B8     JSR.W SubOffscreen0Bnk3         ; Process only while on screen
$03:9537 FE 70 15     INC.W $1570,X                   ; Frame counter [$1570]++
$03:953A BD 70 15     LDA.W $1570,X                   ; A = [$1570]
$03:953D 4A           LSR                             ; \
$03:953E 4A           LSR                             ; / A = [$1570] / 4
$03:953F B4 C2        LDY RAM_SpriteState,X           ; Y = state (number of stomps)
$03:9541 F0 07        BEQ $954A                       ; Not stomped: go to $03954A
$03:9543 29 01        AND.B #$01                      ; Stomped: A = frame & 1
$03:9545 18           CLC                             ; Clear carry
$03:9546 69 03        ADC.B #$03                      ; +3: squashed walk frames 3 and 4
$03:9548 80 03        BRA $954D                       ; Store frame

$03:954A 4A           LSR                             ; Normal: A = [$1570] / 8
$03:954B 29 01        AND.B #$01                      ; Walk frame 0 or 1
$03:954D 9D 02 16     STA.W $1602,X                   ; Store frame in [$1602]
$03:9550 BD 88 15     LDA.W RAM_SprObjStatus,X        ; A = object contact flags
$03:9553 29 04        AND.B #$04                      ; On ground (bit 2)?
$03:9555 F0 12        BEQ RexInAir                    ; No: go to RexInAir
$03:9557 A9 10        LDA.B #$10                      ; \
$03:9559 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; / Sprite Y speed = $10 (stay on the ground)
$03:955B BC 7C 15     LDY.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; Y = direction
$03:955E B5 C2        LDA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; A = state
$03:9560 F0 02        BEQ RexNoAdjustSpeed            ; Not stomped: normal speed
$03:9562 C8           INY                             ; \
$03:9563 C8           INY                             ; / Y += 2: use squashed speeds
}

;;; $9564: Rex: set X speed (RexNoAdjustSpeed) ;;;
{
$03:9564 B9 13 95     LDA.W RexSpeed,Y                ; A = RexSpeed[Y]
$03:9567 95 B6        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; Sprite X speed = A
}

;;; $9569: Rex: update position (RexInAir) ;;;
{
$03:9569 BD E2 1F     LDA.W $1FE2,X                   ; A = half-squash timer [$1FE2]
$03:956C D0 04        BNE RexHalfSmushed              ; Non-zero: skip movement
$03:956E 22 2A 80 01  JSL.L UpdateSpritePos           ; Update position from speeds (with gravity and block interaction)
}

;;; $9572: Rex: wall turn and Mario contact (RexHalfSmushed) ;;;
{
;; Turns at walls, then handles contact with Mario: star kills, stomp, or hurts Mario.
$03:9572 BD 88 15     LDA.W RAM_SprObjStatus,X        ; A = object contact flags
$03:9575 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; \
$03:9577 F0 08        BEQ $9581                       ; / Touching a wall on left or right?
$03:9579 BD 7C 15     LDA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; \
$03:957C 49 01        EOR.B #$01                      ; } Yes: flip direction
$03:957E 9D 7C 15     STA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; /
$03:9581 22 32 80 01  JSL.L SprSprInteract            ; Interact with other sprites
$03:9585 22 DC A7 01  JSL.L MarioSprInteract          ; Check Mario contact
$03:9589 90 52        BCC NoRexContact                ; No contact: return
$03:958B AD 90 14     LDA.W $1490                     ; A = Mario star timer [$1490]
$03:958E D0 62        BNE RexStarKill                 ; Star active: kill Rex
$03:9590 BD 4C 15     LDA.W RAM_DisableInter,X        ; A = Rex contact disable timer
$03:9593 D0 48        BNE NoRexContact                ; Non-zero: ignore contact
$03:9595 A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; \
$03:9597 9D 4C 15     STA.W RAM_DisableInter,X        ; / Contact disable timer = 8 frames
$03:959A A5 7D        LDA RAM_MarioSpeedY             ; \
$03:959C C9 10        CMP.B #$10                      ; / Mario Y speed < $10 (not falling onto Rex)?
$03:959E 30 2A        BMI RexWins                     ; Yes: Rex hurts Mario
}

;;; $95A0: Mario stomps Rex (MarioBeatsRex) ;;;
{
;; Gives points, bounces Mario. Spin jump or Yoshi kills Rex outright; first stomp half-squashes, second
;;     flattens.
$03:95A0 20 28 96     JSR.W RexPoints                 ; Give points
$03:95A3 22 33 AA 01  JSL.L BoostMarioSpeed           ; Bounce Mario
$03:95A7 22 99 AB 01  JSL.L DisplayContactGfx         ; Show contact star
$03:95AB AD 0D 14     LDA.W RAM_IsSpinJump            ; \
$03:95AE 0D 7A 18     ORA.W RAM_OnYoshi               ; / Mario spin jumping or on Yoshi?
$03:95B1 D0 2B        BNE RexSpinKill                 ; Yes: spin kill
$03:95B3 F6 C2        INC RAM_SpriteState,X           ; Stomp count++
$03:95B5 B5 C2        LDA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; A = stomp count
$03:95B7 C9 02        CMP.B #$02                      ; Second stomp?
$03:95B9 D0 06        BNE SmushRex                    ; No: half squash
$03:95BB A9 20        LDA.B #$20                      ; \
$03:95BD 9D 58 15     STA.W $1558,X                   ; / Timer for showing squashed remains [$1558] = $20
$03:95C0 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $95C1: Half squash Rex (SmushRex) ;;;
{
$03:95C1 A9 0C        LDA.B #$0C                      ; \
$03:95C3 9D E2 1F     STA.W $1FE2,X                   ; / Half-squash timer [$1FE2] = $0C
$03:95C6 9E 62 16     STZ.W RAM_Tweaker1662,X         ; Sprite clipping = 0 (smaller hitbox)
$03:95C9 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $95CA: Rex hurts Mario (RexWins) ;;;
{
$03:95CA AD 97 14     LDA.W $1497                     ; \
$03:95CD 0D 7A 18     ORA.W RAM_OnYoshi               ; } Mario invincible after a hit or on Yoshi: skip
$03:95D0 D0 0B        BNE NoRexContact                ; /
$03:95D2 20 17 B8     JSR.W SubHorzPosBnk3            ; Y = side of Mario
$03:95D5 98           TYA                             ; A = Y
$03:95D6 9D 7C 15     STA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; Rex turns towards Mario
$03:95D9 22 B7 F5 00  JSL.L HurtMario                 ; Hurt Mario
}

;;; $95DD: Return (NoRexContact) ;;;
{
$03:95DD 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $95DE: Rex killed by spin jump (RexSpinKill) ;;;
{
$03:95DE A9 04        LDA.B #$04                      ; \
$03:95E0 9D C8 14     STA.W $14C8,X                   ; / Sprite status = 4 (killed by spin jump)
$03:95E3 A9 1F        LDA.B #$1F                      ; \
$03:95E5 9D 40 15     STA.W $1540,X                   ; / Timer [$1540] = $1F (spin kill animation)
$03:95E8 22 3B FC 07  JSL.L $FC3B                     ; Spawn star particles
$03:95EC A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; \
$03:95EE 8D F9 1D     STA.W $1DF9                     ; / Sound effect $08
$03:95F1 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $95F2: Rex killed by star (RexStarKill) ;;;
{
$03:95F2 A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; \
$03:95F4 9D C8 14     STA.W $14C8,X                   ; / Sprite status = 2 (killed by star)
$03:95F7 A9 D0        LDA.B #$D0                      ; \
$03:95F9 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; / Sprite Y speed = $D0 (jump up)
$03:95FB 20 17 B8     JSR.W SubHorzPosBnk3            ; Y = side of Mario
$03:95FE B9 25 96     LDA.W RexKilledSpeed,Y          ; \
$03:9601 95 B6        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; / Sprite X speed = RexKilledSpeed[Y] (away from Mario)
$03:9603 EE D2 18     INC.W $18D2                     ; Star kill counter [$18D2]++
$03:9606 AD D2 18     LDA.W $18D2                     ; A = counter
$03:9609 C9 08        CMP.B #$08                      ; Compare with 8
$03:960B 90 05        BCC $9612                       ; < 8: keep
$03:960D A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; \
$03:960F 8D D2 18     STA.W $18D2                     ; / Counter = 8 (max)
$03:9612 22 E5 AC 02  JSL.L GivePoints                ; Give points
$03:9616 AC D2 18     LDY.W $18D2                     ; Y = counter
$03:9619 C0 08        CPY.B #$08                      ; Compare with 8
$03:961B B0 06        BCS $9623                       ; 8 or more: no sound
$03:961D B9 FF 7F     LDA.W $7FFF,Y                   ; \
$03:9620 8D F9 1D     STA.W $1DF9                     ; / Sound effect = table at $03:8000 (rising pitch)
$03:9623 60           RTS                             ; Return

$03:9624 60           RTS                             ; Unreferenced return


}

{
$03:9625              .db $F0,$10                     ; X speed when killed by star: $F0 left, $10 right

$03:9627 60           RTS                             ; Unreferenced return

}

;;; $9628: Give points for stomp (RexPoints) ;;;
{
;; Gives points based on the consecutive stomp counter [$1697] and plays the matching sound.
;; Called by:
;;     $03:95A0: Mario stomps Rex (MarioBeatsRex)
$03:9628 5A           PHY                             ; Save Y
$03:9629 AD 97 16     LDA.W $1697                     ; A = stomp counter [$1697]
$03:962C 18           CLC                             ; Clear carry
$03:962D 7D 26 16     ADC.W $1626,X                   ; + sprite's own counter [$1626]
$03:9630 EE 97 16     INC.W $1697                     ; Stomp counter++
$03:9633 A8           TAY                             ; Y = A
$03:9634 C8           INY                             ; Y + 1
$03:9635 C0 08        CPY.B #$08                      ; Compare with 8
$03:9637 B0 06        BCS $963F                       ; 8 or more: no sound
$03:9639 B9 FF 7F     LDA.W $7FFF,Y                   ; \
$03:963C 8D F9 1D     STA.W $1DF9                     ; / Sound effect = table at $03:8000 (rising pitch)
$03:963F 98           TYA                             ; A = Y
$03:9640 C9 08        CMP.B #$08                      ; Compare with 8
$03:9642 90 02        BCC $9646                       ; < 8: keep
$03:9644 A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; A = 8 (max)
$03:9646 22 E5 AC 02  JSL.L GivePoints                ; Give points
$03:964A 7A           PLY                             ; Restore Y
$03:964B 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $967E: Rex graphics routine (RexGfxRt) ;;;
{
;; Chooses frame: 5 when remains timer is set, 2 when half squashed. Draws 2 tiles (second row of tables for
;;     facing right).
;; Called by:
;;     $03:9517: Rex main routine (RexMainRt)
$03:967E BD 58 15     LDA.W $1558,X                   ; A = remains timer [$1558]
$03:9681 F0 05        BEQ RexGfxAlive                 ; Zero: alive
$03:9683 A9 05        LDA.B #$05                      ; Frame = 5 (squashed flat)
$03:9685 9D 02 16     STA.W $1602,X                   ; Store frame
}

;;; $9688: Rex graphics: half squashed frame (RexGfxAlive) ;;;
{
$03:9688 BD E2 1F     LDA.W $1FE2,X                   ; A = half-squash timer [$1FE2]
$03:968B F0 05        BEQ RexNotHalfSmushed           ; Zero: skip
$03:968D A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; Frame = 2 (half squashed)
$03:968F 9D 02 16     STA.W $1602,X                   ; Store frame
}

;;; $9692: Rex graphics: draw tiles (RexNotHalfSmushed) ;;;
{
$03:9692 20 60 B7     JSR.W GetDrawInfoBnk3           ; Get draw position
$03:9695 BD 02 16     LDA.W $1602,X                   ; \
$03:9698 0A           ASL                             ; } $03 = frame * 2 (index of first tile of frame)
$03:9699 85 03        STA $03                         ; /
$03:969B BD 7C 15     LDA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; \
$03:969E 85 02        STA $02                         ; / $02 = direction
$03:96A0 DA           PHX                             ; Save sprite index
$03:96A1 A2 01        LDX.B #$01                      ; X = 1: two tiles per frame
}

;;; $96A3: Rex graphics: tile loop (RexGfxLoopStart) ;;;
{
$03:96A3 DA           PHX                             ; Save tile counter
$03:96A4 8A           TXA                             ; \
$03:96A5 05 03        ORA $03                         ; / A = frame start + tile counter (index of this tile)
$03:96A7 48           PHA                             ; Save it
$03:96A8 A6 02        LDX $02                         ; X = direction
$03:96AA D0 03        BNE RexFaceLeft                 ; Facing left: no offset
$03:96AC 18           CLC                             ; \
$03:96AD 69 0C        ADC.B #$0C                      ; / Facing right: +12 to use the second row of X offsets
}

;;; $96AF: Rex graphics: write tile (RexFaceLeft) ;;;
{
$03:96AF AA           TAX                             ; X = offset index
$03:96B0 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$03:96B2 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:96B3 7D 4C 96     ADC.W RexTileDispX,X            ; } OAM X = sprite X + RexTileDispX[X]
$03:96B6 99 00 03     STA.W OAM_DispX,Y               ; /
$03:96B9 FA           PLX                             ; Restore tile index
$03:96BA A5 01        LDA $01                         ; \
$03:96BC 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:96BD 7D 64 96     ADC.W RexTileDispY,X            ; } OAM Y = sprite Y + RexTileDispY[X]
$03:96C0 99 01 03     STA.W OAM_DispY,Y               ; /
$03:96C3 BD 70 96     LDA.W RexTiles,X                ; \
$03:96C6 99 02 03     STA.W OAM_Tile,Y                ; / OAM tile = RexTiles[X]
$03:96C9 A6 02        LDX $02                         ; \
$03:96CB BD 7C 96     LDA.W RexGfxProp,X              ; |
$03:96CE 05 64        ORA $64                         ; } OAM properties = RexGfxProp[dir] | [$64] (level priority)
$03:96D0 99 03 03     STA.W OAM_Prop,Y                ; /
$03:96D3 98           TYA                             ; \
$03:96D4 4A           LSR                             ; } A = OAM index / 4
$03:96D5 4A           LSR                             ; /
$03:96D6 A6 03        LDX $03                         ; \
$03:96D8 E0 0A        CPX.B #$0A                      ; } X = A; carry set if frame start >= $0A (frames 5 only)
$03:96DA AA           TAX                             ; /
$03:96DB A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; A = 0: 8x8 tile size
$03:96DD B0 02        BCS Rex8x8Tile                  ; Frame 5: use 8x8
$03:96DF A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; A = 2: 16x16 tile size
}

;;; $96E1: Rex graphics: store tile size (Rex8x8Tile) ;;;
{
$03:96E1 9D 60 04     STA.W OAM_TileSize,X            ; Store in OAM size table
$03:96E4 FA           PLX                             ; Restore tile counter
$03:96E5 C8           INY                             ; \
$03:96E6 C8           INY                             ; |
$03:96E7 C8           INY                             ; } Next OAM slot
$03:96E8 C8           INY                             ; /
$03:96E9 CA           DEX                             ; Next tile
$03:96EA 10 B7        BPL RexGfxLoopStart             ; Loop for 2 tiles
$03:96EC FA           PLX                             ; Restore sprite index
$03:96ED A0 FF        LDY.B #$FF                      ; Y = $FF: sizes already written
$03:96EF A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; A = 1: 2 tiles
$03:96F1 22 B3 B7 01  JSL.L FinishOAMWrite            ; Finish OAM write
$03:96F5 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $96F6: Fishbone main routine (Fishbone) ;;;
{
;; Swims horizontally; sometimes opens its mouth. Alternates between accelerating and slowing down.
;; Called by:
;;     $03:A230: Bank 3 sprite main dispatch (Bnk3CallSprMain)
$03:96F6 20 8C 97     JSR.W FishboneGfx               ; Draw Fishbone
$03:96F9 A5 9D        LDA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; Sprites locked?
$03:96FB D0 2D        BNE $972A                       ; Yes: return
$03:96FD 20 5D B8     JSR.W SubOffscreen0Bnk3         ; Process only while on screen
$03:9700 22 DC A7 01  JSL.L MarioSprInteract          ; Check Mario contact
$03:9704 22 22 80 01  JSL.L UpdateXPosNoGrvty         ; Move X position by speed
$03:9708 8A           TXA                             ; \
$03:9709 0A           ASL                             ; |
$03:970A 0A           ASL                             ; |
$03:970B 0A           ASL                             ; } A = sprite index * 16
$03:970C 0A           ASL                             ; /
$03:970D 65 13        ADC RAM_FrameCounter            ; + frame counter
$03:970F 29 7F        AND.B #$7F                      ; Every 128 frames
$03:9711 D0 0D        BNE $9720                       ; Not now: go on
$03:9713 22 F9 AC 01  JSL.L GetRand                   ; Random number
$03:9717 29 01        AND.B #$01                      ; Bit 0
$03:9719 D0 05        BNE $9720                       ; Half the time: skip
$03:971B A9 0C        LDA.B #$0C                      ; A = $0C
$03:971D 9D 58 15     STA.W $1558,X                   ; Mouth open timer [$1558] = $0C
$03:9720 B5 C2        LDA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; A = state
$03:9722 22 DF 86 00  JSL.L ExecutePtr                ; Run state routine

}

;;; $9726: Pointer table: Fishbone states (FishbonePtrs) ;;;
{
$03:9726 2F 97        .dw $972F                       ; State 0: swim and accelerate
$03:9728 5E 97        .dw $975E                       ; State 1: slow down

$03:972A 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $972B: Table: Fishbone max X speed (FishboneMaxSpeed) ;;;

$03:972B              .db $10,$F0                     ; Max X speed: $10 right, $F0 left

}

;;; $972D: Table: Fishbone states and acceleration (FishboneAcceler) ;;;
{
;; State 0 accelerates up to max speed; state 1 slows to a stop. Each lasts $30 frames.
$03:972D              .db $01,$FF                     ; Acceleration: +1 right, -1 left

$03:972F FE 70 15     INC.W $1570,X                   ; Animation counter [$1570]++
$03:9732 BD 70 15     LDA.W $1570,X                   ; A = counter
$03:9735 EA           NOP                             ; No operation
$03:9736 4A           LSR                             ; \
$03:9737 29 01        AND.B #$01                      ; } Animation frame [$1602] = (counter / 2) & 1
$03:9739 9D 02 16     STA.W $1602,X                   ; /
$03:973C BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; A = timer [$1540]
$03:973F F0 15        BEQ $9756                       ; Zero: next state
$03:9741 29 01        AND.B #$01                      ; Odd timer value?
$03:9743 D0 10        BNE $9755                       ; Yes: skip this frame
$03:9745 BC 7C 15     LDY.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; Y = direction
$03:9748 B5 B6        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; A = X speed
$03:974A D9 2B 97     CMP.W FishboneMaxSpeed,Y        ; At max speed for this direction?
$03:974D F0 06        BEQ $9755                       ; Yes: return
$03:974F 18           CLC                             ; \
$03:9750 79 2D 97     ADC.W FishboneAcceler,Y         ; } X speed += FishboneAcceler[direction]
$03:9753 95 B6        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; /
$03:9755 60           RTS                             ; Return

$03:9756 F6 C2        INC RAM_SpriteState,X           ; \
$03:9758 A9 30        LDA.B #$30                      ; } State 1, timer [$1540] = $30
$03:975A 9D 40 15     STA.W $1540,X                   ; /
$03:975D 60           RTS                             ; Return

$03:975E 9E 02 16     STZ.W $1602,X                   ; Animation frame = 0
$03:9761 BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; A = timer
$03:9764 F0 10        BEQ $9776                       ; Zero: back to state 0
$03:9766 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; Timer & 3
$03:9768 D0 0B        BNE $9775                       ; Only every 4th frame
$03:976A B5 B6        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; A = X speed
$03:976C F0 07        BEQ $9775                       ; Zero: done
$03:976E 10 03        BPL $9773                       ; Positive: go to $039773
$03:9770 F6 B6        INC RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; Negative: speed++ (towards 0)
$03:9772 60           RTS                             ; Return

$03:9773 D6 B6        DEC RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; Positive: speed-- (towards 0)
$03:9775 60           RTS                             ; Return

$03:9776 74 C2        STZ RAM_SpriteState,X           ; \
$03:9778 A9 30        LDA.B #$30                      ; } State 0, timer [$1540] = $30
$03:977A 9D 40 15     STA.W $1540,X                   ; /
$03:977D 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;     $03:96F6: Fishbone main routine (Fishbone)

$03:97AE 85 03        STA $03                         ; /

$03:97B3 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:97B4 69 04        ADC.B #$04                      ; } OAM index += 4 (next slot, after head)
$03:97B6 9D EA 15     STA.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X         ; /
$03:97B9 A8           TAY                             ; Y = OAM index
$03:97BA DA           PHX                             ; Save sprite index
$03:97BB A2 01        LDX.B #$01                      ; X = 1: two tail tiles
$03:97BD A5 01        LDA $01                         ; \
$03:97BF 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:97C0 7D 82 97     ADC.W FishboneDispY,X           ; } OAM Y = sprite Y + FishboneDispY[X]
$03:97C3 99 01 03     STA.W OAM_DispY,Y               ; /
$03:97C6 DA           PHX                             ; Save tile counter
$03:97C7 8A           TXA                             ; \
$03:97C8 05 02        ORA $02                         ; } X = tile counter | direction offset
$03:97CA AA           TAX                             ; /
$03:97CB A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$03:97CD 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:97CE 7D 7E 97     ADC.W FishboneDispX,X           ; } OAM X = sprite X + FishboneDispX[X]
$03:97D1 99 00 03     STA.W OAM_DispX,Y               ; /

$03:97D9 99 03 03     STA.W OAM_Prop,Y                ; /
$03:97DC 68           PLA                             ; \
$03:97DD 48           PHA                             ; |
$03:97DE 05 03        ORA $03                         ; } X = tile counter | frame offset
$03:97E0 AA           TAX                             ; /
$03:97E1 BD 88 97     LDA.W FishboneTailTiles,X       ; \
$03:97E4 99 02 03     STA.W OAM_Tile,Y                ; / OAM tile = FishboneTailTiles[X]
$03:97E7 FA           PLX                             ; Restore tile counter
$03:97E8 C8           INY                             ; \
$03:97E9 C8           INY                             ; |
$03:97EA C8           INY                             ; } Next OAM slot
$03:97EB C8           INY                             ; /
$03:97EC CA           DEX                             ; Next tile
$03:97ED 10 CE        BPL $97BD                       ; Loop for 2 tiles
$03:97EF FA           PLX                             ; Restore sprite index
$03:97F0 A0 00        LDY.B #$00                      ; Y = 0: 8x8 tiles
$03:97F2 A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; A = 2: 3 tiles
$03:97F4 22 B3 B7 01  JSL.L FinishOAMWrite            ; Finish OAM write
$03:97F8 60           RTS                             ; Return

$03:97F9 85 01        STA $01                         ; Aim at Mario. A: speed. Save to $01
$03:97FB DA           PHX                             ; Save X
$03:97FC 5A           PHY                             ; Save Y
$03:97FD 20 29 B8     JSR.W SubVertPosBnk3            ; Vertical distance: $0E, Y = side
$03:9800 84 02        STY $02                         ; $02 = vertical side
$03:9802 A5 0E        LDA $0E                         ; A = vertical distance
$03:9804 10 05        BPL $980B                       ; Positive: keep
$03:9806 49 FF        EOR.B #$FF                      ; \

$03:9809 69 01        ADC.B #$01                      ; /
$03:980B 85 0C        STA $0C                         ; $0C = |vertical distance|
$03:980D 20 17 B8     JSR.W SubHorzPosBnk3            ; Horizontal distance: $0F, Y = side
$03:9810 84 03        STY $03                         ; $03 = horizontal side
$03:9812 A5 0F        LDA $0F                         ; A = horizontal distance

$03:981B 85 0D        STA $0D                         ; $0D = |horizontal distance|

$03:981F A5 0D        LDA $0D                         ; A = |horizontal|

$03:9857 A4 02        LDY $02                         ; Y = vertical side
$03:9859 F0 07        BEQ $9862                       ; Zero: keep
$03:985B 49 FF        EOR.B #$FF                      ; \
$03:985D 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:985E 69 01        ADC.B #$01                      ; } Negate $00

;;; $9872: Reznor init (ReznorInit) ;;;
