;;     $01:8789: Init: Reznor (InitReznor)
$03:9872 E0 07        CPX.B #$07                      ; Sprite slot 7?
$03:9874 D0 08        BNE $987E                       ; No: skip
$03:9876 A9 04        LDA.B #$04                      ; A = 4
$03:9878 95 C2        STA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; State = 4 (only slot 7)
$03:987A 22 7D DD 03  JSL.L $DD7D                     ; Set up Reznor room (palette, scrolling, bridge)
$03:987E 22 F9 AC 01  JSL.L GetRand                   ; Random number
$03:9882 9D 70 15     STA.W $1570,X                   ; Rotation counter [$1570] = random
$03:9885 6B           RTL                             ; Return


}

;;; $9886: Table: Reznor start positions low (ReznorStartPosLo) ;;;
{
$03:9886              .db $00,$80,$00,$80             ; Reznor start positions, low byte (4 Reznors)

}

;;; $988A: Table: Reznor start positions high (ReznorStartPosHi) ;;;
{
$03:988A              .db $00,$00,$01,$01             ; Reznor start positions, high byte

}

;;; $988E: Table: Reznor rebound X speed (ReboundSpeedX) ;;;
{
$03:988E              .db $20,$E0                     ; Bounce X speed: $20, $E0

}

;;; $9890: Reznor main routine: start (Reznor) ;;;
{
;; Called by:
;;     $03:A239: Bank 3 sprite main dispatch (Bnk3CallSprMain)
$03:9890 EE 0F 14     INC.W $140F                     ; Reznor frame counter [$140F]++
$03:9893 A5 9D        LDA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; Sprites locked?
$03:9895 F0 03        BEQ ReznorNotLocked             ; No: continue
$03:9897 4C 7B 9A     JMP.W DrawReznor                ; Only draw

}

;;; $989A: Reznor: unlocked, slot 7 setup (ReznorNotLocked) ;;;
{
;; Slot 7 breaks the bridge when necessary.
$03:989A E0 07        CPX.B #$07                      ; Sprite slot 7?
$03:989C D0 72        BNE $9910                       ; No: go to $039910
$03:989E DA           PHX                             ; Save X
$03:989F 22 0C D7 03  JSL.L $D70C                     ; Break bridge when needed
}

;;; $98A3: Reznor ring: sign and level end (ReznorSignCode) ;;;
{
;; Second half of the Reznor main code (entered for every Reznor/platform slot). Only sprite slot 7 runs this
;;     part: it positions the Reznor sign,
;; advances the ring angle [$37,$36] (0-$1FF) by one per frame and, once the level end timer [$163E,X] reaches
;;     1, ends the fight:
;; stops Mario walking, starts the end of level timer [$1493] and plays the clear music ([$1DFB] = $0B).
$03:98A3 A9 80        LDA.B #$80                      ; \
$03:98A5 85 2A        STA $2A                         ; |
$03:98A7 64 2B        STZ $2B                         ; / Circle centre X: [$2A]/[$2B] = $0080 (also the Mode 7 center X)
$03:98A9 A2 00        LDX.B #$00                      ; X = 0: sprite slot 0 gets the sign position
$03:98AB A9 C0        LDA.B #$C0                      ; \
$03:98AD 85 E4        STA RAM_SpriteXLo               ; |
$03:98AF 9C E0 14     STZ.W RAM_SpriteXHi             ; / Slot 0 X position = $00C0 (position of the Reznor sign)
$03:98B2 A9 B2        LDA.B #$B2                      ; \
$03:98B4 85 D8        STA RAM_SpriteYLo               ; |
$03:98B6 9C D4 14     STZ.W RAM_SpriteYHi             ; / Slot 0 Y position = $00B2
$03:98B9 A9 2C        LDA.B #$2C                      ; A = $2C: value for $1BA2 (read by $DF2E, purpose unclear)
$03:98BB 8D A2 1B     STA.W $1BA2                     ; [$1BA2] = $2C
$03:98BE 22 DF DE 03  JSL.L $DEDF                     ; Apply position change to the Reznor sign ($DEDF, Mode 7 related)
$03:98C2 FA           PLX                             ; Restore X = sprite index
$03:98C3 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$03:98C5 A5 36        LDA $36                         ; \
$03:98C7 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:98C8 69 01 00     ADC.W #$0001                    ; } [$36] = ([$36] + 1) & $01FF: advance the Reznor ring angle one step per frame
$03:98CB 29 FF 01     AND.W #$01FF                    ; |
$03:98CE 85 36        STA $36                         ; /
$03:98D0 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$03:98D2 E0 07        CPX.B #$07                      ; Only sprite slot 7 runs the level end logic
$03:98D4 D0 3A        BNE $9910                       ; Other slots: skip to the status check
$03:98D6 BD 3E 16     LDA.W $163E,X                   ; A = level end timer [$163E,X]
$03:98D9 F0 11        BEQ ReznorNoLevelEnd            ; Timer not set: go check whether all Reznors are dead
$03:98DB 3A           DEC A                           ; Timer - 1
$03:98DC D0 32        BNE $9910                       ; Not yet 1: skip
$03:98DE CE C6 13     DEC.W $13C6                     ; [$13C6]--: stop Mario from walking at level end (cutscene state)
$03:98E1 A9 FF        LDA.B #$FF                      ; \
$03:98E3 8D 93 14     STA.W $1493                     ; / End of level timer [$1493] = $FF (time before returning to the overworld)
$03:98E6 A9 0B        LDA.B #$0B                      ; \
$03:98E8 8D FB 1D     STA.W $1DFB                     ; / Music request [$1DFB] = $0B (probably the boss defeated music)
$03:98EB 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $98EC: Reznor: check all Reznors dead (ReznorNoLevelEnd) ;;;
{
;; Adds the four dead flags. When all four Reznors are dead, sets the level end timer [$163E,X] = $90, removes
;;     all other sprites and clears the extended sprites.
;; Then, for every Reznor slot, places the Reznor and its platform on the ring (see ReznorAlive) or skips to
;;     drawing if the status is not 8.
$03:98EC AD 23 15     LDA.W RAM_Reznor4Dead           ; \
$03:98EF 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:98F0 6D 22 15     ADC.W RAM_Reznor3Dead           ; |
$03:98F3 6D 21 15     ADC.W RAM_Reznor2Dead           ; |
$03:98F6 6D 20 15     ADC.W RAM_Reznor1Dead           ; } A = number of dead Reznors (sum of the four dead flags); all four dead?
$03:98F9 C9 04        CMP.B #$04                      ; |
$03:98FB D0 13        BNE $9910                       ; Not all four dead: skip
$03:98FD A9 90        LDA.B #$90                      ; \
$03:98FF 9D 3E 16     STA.W $163E,X                   ; / Level end timer [$163E,X] = $90: set when all Reznors are dead
$03:9902 22 C8 A6 03  JSL.L KillMostSprites           ; Remove all other sprites (KillMostSprites)
$03:9906 A0 07        LDY.B #$07                      ; \
$03:9908 A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; |
$03:990A 99 0B 17     STA.W RAM_ExSpriteNum,Y         ; |
$03:990D 88           DEY                             ; } Clear all 8 extended sprite slots (removes fireballs)
$03:990E 10 FA        BPL $990A                       ; /
$03:9910 BD C8 14     LDA.W $14C8,X                   ; A = sprite status
$03:9913 C9 08        CMP.B #$08                      ; Status 8 (normal)?
$03:9915 F0 03        BEQ $991A                       ; Yes: continue
$03:9917 4C 7B 9A     JMP.W DrawReznor                ; Not normal: just draw

$03:991A 8A           TXA                             ; \
$03:991B 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; } Y = Reznor number (sprite slot AND 3)
$03:991D A8           TAY                             ; /
$03:991E A5 36        LDA $36                         ; \
$03:9920 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:9921 79 86 98     ADC.W ReznorStartPosLo,Y        ; |
$03:9924 85 00        STA $00                         ; |
$03:9926 A5 37        LDA $37                         ; } $01/$00 = ([$36] + start angle [Y]) & $01FF: this Reznor's position on the ring
$03:9928 79 8A 98     ADC.W ReznorStartPosHi,Y        ; |
$03:992B 29 01        AND.B #$01                      ; |
$03:992D 85 01        STA $01                         ; /
$03:992F C2 30        REP #$30                        ; A and index 16-bit
$03:9931 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$03:9933 49 FF 01     EOR.W #$01FF                    ; } $00 = -$00 (mod $200): Reznors turn clockwise
$03:9936 1A           INC A                           ; |
$03:9937 85 00        STA $00                         ; /
$03:9939 18           CLC                             ; \
$03:993A 69 80 00     ADC.W #$0080                    ; } $02 = $00 + $80 (mod $200): angle shifted a quarter turn for the other axis
$03:993D 29 FF 01     AND.W #$01FF                    ; |
$03:9940 85 02        STA $02                         ; /
$03:9942 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$03:9944 29 FF 00     AND.W #$00FF                    ; |
$03:9947 0A           ASL                             ; |
$03:9948 AA           TAX                             ; |
$03:9949 BF DB F7 07  LDA.L CircleCoords,X            ; Read a CircleCoords entry (sine, $0000-$0100)
$03:994D 85 04        STA $04                         ; $04 = sine value for $00
$03:994F A5 02        LDA $02                         ; \
$03:9951 29 FF 00     AND.W #$00FF                    ; |
$03:9954 0A           ASL                             ; |
$03:9955 AA           TAX                             ; / X = ([$02] & $FF) * 2: index into CircleCoords
$03:9956 BF DB F7 07  LDA.L CircleCoords,X            ; Read a CircleCoords entry (cosine, $0000-$0100)
$03:995A 85 06        STA $06                         ; $06 = value for angle $02 (a quarter turn later)
$03:995C E2 30        SEP #$30                        ; A and index 8-bit
$03:995E A5 04        LDA $04                         ; A = low byte of the sine value
$03:9960 8D 02 42     STA.W $4202                     ; Hardware multiply: multiplicand A
$03:9963 A9 38        LDA.B #$38                      ; A = $38: ring radius in pixels
$03:9965 A4 05        LDY $05                         ; Y = high byte of the value ($01 only if value is $100)
$03:9967 D0 0F        BNE $9978                       ; Value = $100: use A = $38 directly
$03:9969 8D 03 42     STA.W $4203                     ; Multiplier B
$03:996C EA           NOP                             ; \
$03:996D EA           NOP                             ; |
$03:996E EA           NOP                             ; |
$03:996F EA           NOP                             ; / Wait for the multiplication result
$03:9970 0E 16 42     ASL.W $4216                     ; Product * 2 (carry gets the top bit of the low byte)
$03:9973 AD 17 42     LDA.W $4217                     ; A = high byte of product
$03:9976 69 00        ADC.B #$00                      ; Round: A = value * $38 / $100 (high byte of the product plus bit 7 of the low byte)
$03:9978 46 01        LSR $01                         ; $01 >>= 1: carry = ring half (bit 8 of the angle)
$03:997A 90 03        BCC $997F                       ; Carry clear: positive offset
$03:997C 49 FF        EOR.B #$FF                      ; \
$03:997E 1A           INC A                           ; / Second half of the ring: negate A
$03:997F 85 04        STA $04                         ; $04 = X offset from the ring centre
$03:9981 A5 06        LDA $06                         ; A = low byte of the second sine value
$03:9983 8D 02 42     STA.W $4202                     ; Hardware multiply: multiplicand A
$03:9986 A9 38        LDA.B #$38                      ; A = $38: ring radius
$03:9988 A4 07        LDY $07                         ; Y = high byte of the value
$03:998A D0 0F        BNE $999B                       ; Value = $100: use A = $38 directly
$03:998C 8D 03 42     STA.W $4203                     ; Multiplier B
$03:998F EA           NOP                             ; \
$03:9990 EA           NOP                             ; |
$03:9991 EA           NOP                             ; |
$03:9992 EA           NOP                             ; / Wait for the multiplication result
$03:9993 0E 16 42     ASL.W $4216                     ; Product * 2
$03:9996 AD 17 42     LDA.W $4217                     ; A = high byte of product
$03:9999 69 00        ADC.B #$00                      ; Add carry (rounding)
$03:999B 46 03        LSR $03                         ; $03 >>= 1: carry = ring half
$03:999D 90 03        BCC $99A2                       ; Carry clear: positive offset
$03:999F 49 FF        EOR.B #$FF                      ; \
$03:99A1 1A           INC A                           ; / Second half of the ring: negate A
$03:99A2 85 06        STA $06                         ; $06 = Y offset from the ring centre
$03:99A4 AE E9 15     LDX.W $15E9                     ; X = sprite index
$03:99A7 B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; A = old X position low
$03:99A9 48           PHA                             ; Save it (for the movement delta)
$03:99AA 64 00        STZ $00                         ; $00 = 0: high byte for sign extension
$03:99AC A5 04        LDA $04                         ; A = X offset
$03:99AE 10 02        BPL $99B2                       ; Positive: keep $00 = 0
$03:99B0 C6 00        DEC $00                         ; Negative: $00 = $FF (sign extend)
$03:99B2 18           CLC                             ; Clear carry
$03:99B3 65 2A        ADC $2A                         ; Add centre X low byte [$2A]
$03:99B5 08           PHP                             ; Save carry
$03:99B6 18           CLC                             ; Clear carry
$03:99B7 69 40        ADC.B #$40                      ; Plus $40: X offset of the ring
$03:99B9 95 E4        STA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; Sprite X position low
$03:99BB A5 2B        LDA $2B                         ; Centre X high byte [$2B]
$03:99BD 69 00        ADC.B #$00                      ; Add carry from the +$40
$03:99BF 28           PLP                             ; Restore carry from the first add
$03:99C0 65 00        ADC $00                         ; Add sign extension
$03:99C2 9D E0 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; Sprite X position high
$03:99C5 68           PLA                             ; \
$03:99C6 38           SEC                             ; |
$03:99C7 F5 E4        SBC RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; |
$03:99C9 49 FF        EOR.B #$FF                      ; } $1528,X = old X - new X, negated: X movement this frame (carries Mario)
$03:99CB 1A           INC A                           ; |
$03:99CC 9D 28 15     STA.W $1528,X                   ; /
$03:99CF 64 01        STZ $01                         ; $01 = 0: high byte for sign extension
$03:99D1 A5 06        LDA $06                         ; A = Y offset
$03:99D3 10 02        BPL $99D7                       ; Positive: keep $01 = 0
$03:99D5 C6 01        DEC $01                         ; Negative: $01 = $FF
$03:99D7 18           CLC                             ; Clear carry
$03:99D8 65 2C        ADC $2C                         ; Add centre Y low byte [$2C]
$03:99DA 08           PHP                             ; Save carry
$03:99DB 69 20        ADC.B #$20                      ; Plus $20: Y offset of the ring on screen
$03:99DD 95 D8        STA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; Sprite Y position low
$03:99DF A5 2D        LDA $2D                         ; Centre Y high byte [$2D]
$03:99E1 69 00        ADC.B #$00                      ; Add carry
$03:99E3 28           PLP                             ; Restore carry from the first add
$03:99E4 65 01        ADC $01                         ; Add sign extension
$03:99E6 9D D4 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; Sprite Y position high
$03:99E9 BD 1C 15     LDA.W $151C,X                   ; \
$03:99EC F0 07        BEQ ReznorAlive                 ; / Reznor already killed ([$151C,X] != 0)? If not, go to ReznorAlive
$03:99EE 22 4F B4 01  JSL.L InvisBlkMainRt            ; Dead: make its platform solid (InvisBlkMainRt)
$03:99F2 4C 7B 9A     JMP.W DrawReznor                ; Draw only the platform

}

;;; $99F5: Reznor: fire timer (ReznorAlive) ;;;
{
;; Reached for a live Reznor. Counts [$1570,X] every frame (unless turning) and every 256 frames sets the
;;     firing timer [$1558,X] = $40.
$03:99F5 A5 13        LDA RAM_FrameCounter            ; A = frame counter
$03:99F7 29 00        AND.B #$00                      ; Mask $00: always 0 (fires on every frame check)
$03:99F9 1D AC 15     ORA.W $15AC,X                   ; OR turning timer [$15AC,X]
$03:99FC D0 12        BNE NoSetRznrFireTime           ; Turning: do not start firing
$03:99FE FE 70 15     INC.W $1570,X                   ; [$1570,X]++: firing counter
$03:9A01 BD 70 15     LDA.W $1570,X                   ; A = firing counter
$03:9A04 C9 00        CMP.B #$00                      ; Counter wrapped to 0 (every 256 frames)?
$03:9A06 D0 08        BNE NoSetRznrFireTime           ; No: skip
$03:9A08 9E 70 15     STZ.W $1570,X                   ; Reset the firing counter
$03:9A0B A9 40        LDA.B #$40                      ; \
$03:9A0D 9D 58 15     STA.W $1558,X                   ; / Firing timer [$1558,X] = $40: show the firing image, fireball at $20
}

;;; $9A10: Reznor: face Mario (NoSetRznrFireTime) ;;;
{
;; Every 64 frames (staggered per slot), if not firing or turning, faces Mario; a direction change starts the
;;     turning timer [$15AC,X] = $0A.
$03:9A10 8A           TXA                             ; \
$03:9A11 0A           ASL                             ; |
$03:9A12 0A           ASL                             ; |
$03:9A13 0A           ASL                             ; |
$03:9A14 0A           ASL                             ; } A = (slot * 16 + [$14]) & $3F: staggers each Reznor, every 64 frames
$03:9A15 65 14        ADC RAM_FrameCounterB           ; |
$03:9A17 29 3F        AND.B #$3F                      ; /
$03:9A19 1D 58 15     ORA.W $1558,X                   ; OR firing timer
$03:9A1C 1D AC 15     ORA.W $15AC,X                   ; OR turning timer
$03:9A1F D0 16        BNE NoSetRenrTurnTime           ; Firing or turning, or not this frame: skip
$03:9A21 BD 7C 15     LDA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; A = old sprite direction
$03:9A24 48           PHA                             ; Save it
$03:9A25 20 17 B8     JSR.W SubHorzPosBnk3            ; Y = side Mario is on (SubHorzPosBnk3)
$03:9A28 98           TYA                             ; A = Y
$03:9A29 9D 7C 15     STA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; Direction = Y: face Mario
$03:9A2C 68           PLA                             ; Pull the old direction
$03:9A2D DD 7C 15     CMP.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; Compare with the new direction
$03:9A30 F0 05        BEQ NoSetRenrTurnTime           ; Unchanged: skip
$03:9A32 A9 0A        LDA.B #$0A                      ; \
$03:9A34 9D AC 15     STA.W $15AC,X                   ; / Turning timer [$15AC,X] = $0A
}

;;; $9A37: Reznor: Mario contact (NoSetRenrTurnTime) ;;;
{
;; Interacts with Mario unless [$154C,X] (disable interaction) is running. Contact sets it to 8 and compares
;;     Mario Y - sprite Y: far above = hurts Mario
;; (HitReznor), at the platform edge or moving down = side bounce, moving up from below = platform bounce that
;;     kills this Reznor.
$03:9A37 BD 4C 15     LDA.W RAM_DisableInter,X        ; A = interaction disabled timer [$154C,X]
$03:9A3A D0 3F        BNE DrawReznor                  ; Running: just draw
$03:9A3C 22 DC A7 01  JSL.L MarioSprInteract          ; Check contact with Mario (MarioSprInteract)
$03:9A40 90 39        BCC DrawReznor                  ; No contact: just draw
$03:9A42 A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; \
$03:9A44 9D 4C 15     STA.W RAM_DisableInter,X        ; / Disable interaction timer [$154C,X] = $08 (after a hit or a bounce)
$03:9A47 A5 96        LDA RAM_MarioYPos               ; \
$03:9A49 38           SEC                             ; |
$03:9A4A F5 D8        SBC RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; |
$03:9A4C C9 ED        CMP.B #$ED                      ; } A = Mario Y - sprite Y; below -19 (Mario well above the platform) = hit Reznor
$03:9A4E 30 27        BMI HitReznor                   ; /
$03:9A50 C9 F2        CMP.B #$F2                      ; Mario Y difference compared with -14
$03:9A52 30 19        BMI HitPlatSide                 ; Between -19 and -15: hit the side of the platform
$03:9A54 A5 7D        LDA RAM_MarioSpeedY             ; A = Mario Y speed
$03:9A56 10 15        BPL HitPlatSide                 ; Mario moving down or still: side hit
}

;;; $9A58: Mario hits platform from below (HitPlatBottom) ;;;
{
;; Starts the platform bounce timer [$1564,X] = $0F, knocks Mario down (Y speed $10) and plays a sound.
;;     KillReznor runs when the timer reaches $0C.
$03:9A58 A9 29        LDA.B #$29                      ; A = $29
$03:9A5A 9D 62 16     STA.W RAM_Tweaker1662,X         ; Tweaker byte [$1662,X] = $29: object clipping, probably so Mario can bump the platform
$03:9A5D A9 0F        LDA.B #$0F                      ; \
$03:9A5F 9D 64 15     STA.W $1564,X                   ; / Platform bounce timer [$1564,X] = $0F
$03:9A62 A9 10        LDA.B #$10                      ; \
$03:9A64 85 7D        STA RAM_MarioSpeedY             ; / Mario Y speed = $10: knocked down off the platform
$03:9A66 A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; \
$03:9A68 8D F9 1D     STA.W $1DF9                     ; / Sound effect $01 (hit head)
$03:9A6B 80 0E        BRA DrawReznor                  ; Draw

}

;;; $9A6D: Mario bounces off platform side (HitPlatSide) ;;;
{
;; Sets Mario X speed from ReboundSpeedX (indexed by the side Mario is on), then draws.
$03:9A6D 20 17 B8     JSR.W SubHorzPosBnk3            ; Y = side of Mario (SubHorzPosBnk3)
$03:9A70 B9 8E 98     LDA.W ReboundSpeedX,Y           ; \
$03:9A73 85 7B        STA RAM_MarioSpeedX             ; / Mario X speed = ReboundSpeedX[Y]: push him away from the platform
$03:9A75 80 04        BRA DrawReznor                  ; Draw

}

;;; $9A77: Hurt Mario, then draw Reznor (HitReznor) ;;;
{
;; Hurts Mario then falls into DrawReznor.
$03:9A77 22 B7 F5 00  JSL.L HurtMario                 ; Hurt Mario (touched the Reznor itself)
}

;;; $9A7B: Reznor: pick frame and draw (DrawReznor) ;;;
{
;; Chooses the frame in [$1602,X]: 0 normal, 1 firing, 2 turning (direction temporarily flipped while the turn
;;     timer >= 5). Fires a fireball when the firing timer = $20, draws via ReznorGfxRt and kills the Reznor when
;;     the platform bounce timer = $0C.
;; Called by:
;;     $03:9897: Reznor main routine: start (Reznor)
;;     $03:9917: Reznor: check all Reznors dead (ReznorNoLevelEnd)
;;     $03:99F2: Reznor: check all Reznors dead (ReznorNoLevelEnd)
$03:9A7B 9E 02 16     STZ.W $1602,X                   ; Frame [$1602,X] = 0: normal image
$03:9A7E BD 7C 15     LDA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; A = sprite direction
$03:9A81 48           PHA                             ; Save the direction
$03:9A82 BC AC 15     LDY.W $15AC,X                   ; Y = turning timer [$15AC,X]
$03:9A85 F0 0E        BEQ ReznorNoTurning             ; Not turning: skip
$03:9A87 C0 05        CPY.B #$05                      ; Turning timer < 5?
$03:9A89 90 05        BCC ReznorTurning               ; Yes: keep the direction
$03:9A8B 49 01        EOR.B #$01                      ; \
$03:9A8D 9D 7C 15     STA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; / Turning timer >= 5: flip the direction for drawing
}

;;; $9A90: Reznor: turning frame (ReznorTurning) ;;;
{
;; Sets frame 2 (turning).
$03:9A90 A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; \
$03:9A92 9D 02 16     STA.W $1602,X                   ; / Frame [$1602,X] = 2: turning image
}

;;; $9A95: Reznor: firing check (ReznorNoTurning) ;;;
{
;; If the firing timer [$1558,X] is non-zero, fires a fireball when it equals $20 and uses frame 1.
$03:9A95 BD 58 15     LDA.W $1558,X                   ; \
$03:9A98 F0 0C        BEQ ReznorNoFiring              ; / A = firing timer [$1558,X]; zero: no firing image
$03:9A9A C9 20        CMP.B #$20                      ; Timer = $20?
$03:9A9C D0 03        BNE ReznorFiring                ; No: just show the firing image
$03:9A9E 20 F8 9A     JSR.W ReznorFireRt              ; Spit a fireball (ReznorFireRt)
}

;;; $9AA1: Reznor: firing frame (ReznorFiring) ;;;
{
;; Sets frame 1 (firing).
$03:9AA1 A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; \
$03:9AA3 9D 02 16     STA.W $1602,X                   ; / Frame [$1602,X] = 1: firing image
}

;;; $9AA6: Reznor: draw and kill check (ReznorNoFiring) ;;;
{
;; Draws, restores the sprite direction, then returns unless sprites are not locked, the Reznor is alive and
;;     the bounce timer = $0C.
$03:9AA6 20 75 9B     JSR.W ReznorGfxRt               ; Draw Reznor and his platform (ReznorGfxRt)
$03:9AA9 68           PLA                             ; Restore the sprite direction
$03:9AAA 9D 7C 15     STA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; Sprite direction = saved value
$03:9AAD A5 9D        LDA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; \
$03:9AAF 1D 1C 15     ORA.W $151C,X                   ; } Return if sprites are locked or this Reznor is already dead
$03:9AB2 D0 43        BNE $9AF7                       ; /
$03:9AB4 BD 64 15     LDA.W $1564,X                   ; \
$03:9AB7 C9 0C        CMP.B #$0C                      ; } Return unless the platform bounce timer = $0C (delays the kill)
$03:9AB9 D0 3C        BNE $9AF7                       ; /
}

;;; $9ABB: Kill Reznor (KillReznor) ;;;
{
;; Plays a sound, records the death in [$151C,X] and spawns a falling dead Reznor (sprite $A9, status 2) at
;;     the same position with Y speed $C0 (bounces up). Returns if no free sprite slot.
$03:9ABB A9 03        LDA.B #$03                      ; \
$03:9ABD 8D F9 1D     STA.W $1DF9                     ; / Sound effect $03 (kick/kill)
$03:9AC0 9E 58 15     STZ.W $1558,X                   ; Firing timer = 0: no more fireballs
$03:9AC3 FE 1C 15     INC.W $151C,X                   ; [$151C,X]++: mark this Reznor as dead
$03:9AC6 22 E4 A9 02  JSL.L FindFreeSprSlot           ; Find a free sprite slot for the falling dead Reznor (Y)
$03:9ACA 30 2B        BMI $9AF7                       ; No free slot: return
$03:9ACC A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; \
$03:9ACE 99 C8 14     STA.W $14C8,Y                   ; / Status = 2 (killed, falling)
$03:9AD1 A9 A9        LDA.B #$A9                      ; \
$03:9AD3 99 9E 00     STA.W RAM_SpriteNum,Y           ; / Sprite number $A9 (dead Reznor)
$03:9AD6 B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; \
$03:9AD8 99 E4 00     STA.W RAM_SpriteXLo,Y           ; |
$03:9ADB BD E0 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; |
$03:9ADE 99 E0 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,Y           ; / Copy X position to the new sprite
$03:9AE1 B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$03:9AE3 99 D8 00     STA.W RAM_SpriteYLo,Y           ; |
$03:9AE6 BD D4 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; |
$03:9AE9 99 D4 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,Y           ; / Copy Y position to the new sprite
$03:9AEC DA           PHX                             ; \
$03:9AED BB           TYX                             ; |
$03:9AEE 22 D2 F7 07  JSL.L InitSpriteTables          ; / Save X; X = new sprite index, then initialize its tables (InitSpriteTables)
$03:9AF2 A9 C0        LDA.B #$C0                      ; \
$03:9AF4 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; / New sprite Y speed = $C0: bounces upward
$03:9AF6 FA           PLX                             ; Restore X = Reznor sprite index
$03:9AF7 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $9AF8: Reznor: find free fireball slot (ReznorFireRt) ;;;
{
;; Finds a free extended sprite slot (7 down to 0) and falls into FoundRznrFireSlot; returns if none.
;; Called by:
;;     $03:9A9E: Reznor: firing check (ReznorNoTurning)
$03:9AF8 A0 07        LDY.B #$07                      ; \
$03:9AFA B9 0B 17     LDA.W RAM_ExSpriteNum,Y         ; |
$03:9AFD F0 04        BEQ FoundRznrFireSlot           ; |
$03:9AFF 88           DEY                             ; } Find a free extended sprite slot (Y = 7..0); return if all are used
$03:9B00 10 F8        BPL $9AFA                       ; /
$03:9B02 60           RTS                             ; Return: no free slot

}

;;; $9B03: Spawn Reznor fireball (FoundRznrFireSlot) ;;;
{
;; Creates extended sprite 2 (Reznor fireball) at Reznor position (-8, -$14), aims it at Mario with speed $10
;;     using $97F9 and stores the speeds.
$03:9B03 A9 10        LDA.B #$10                      ; \
$03:9B05 8D F9 1D     STA.W $1DF9                     ; / Sound effect $10 (Reznor fireball)
$03:9B08 A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; \
$03:9B0A 99 0B 17     STA.W RAM_ExSpriteNum,Y         ; / Extended sprite number = 2 (Reznor fireball)
$03:9B0D B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; A = Reznor X position low
$03:9B0F 48           PHA                             ; Save it
$03:9B10 38           SEC                             ; Carry set for the subtract
$03:9B11 E9 08        SBC.B #$08                      ; Fireball X = Reznor X - 8
$03:9B13 99 1F 17     STA.W RAM_ExSpriteXLo,Y         ; Fireball X low
$03:9B16 95 E4        STA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; Temporarily move the Reznor X too (aim origin)
$03:9B18 BD E0 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; A = Reznor X high
$03:9B1B E9 00        SBC.B #$00                      ; Subtract the borrow
$03:9B1D 99 33 17     STA.W RAM_ExSpriteXHi,Y         ; Fireball X high
$03:9B20 B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; A = Reznor Y low
$03:9B22 48           PHA                             ; Save it
$03:9B23 38           SEC                             ; Carry set for the subtract
$03:9B24 E9 14        SBC.B #$14                      ; Fireball Y = Reznor Y - $14
$03:9B26 95 D8        STA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; Temporarily move Reznor Y
$03:9B28 99 15 17     STA.W RAM_ExSpriteYLo,Y         ; Fireball Y low
$03:9B2B BD D4 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; A = Reznor Y high
$03:9B2E 48           PHA                             ; Save it
$03:9B2F E9 00        SBC.B #$00                      ; Subtract the borrow
$03:9B31 99 29 17     STA.W RAM_ExSpriteYHi,Y         ; Fireball Y high
$03:9B34 9D D4 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; Temporarily move Reznor Y high
$03:9B37 A9 10        LDA.B #$10                      ; A = $10: fireball speed
$03:9B39 20 F9 97     JSR.W $97F9                     ; Aim at Mario: $00 = Y speed, $01 = X speed ($97F9)
$03:9B3C 68           PLA                             ; Pull saved Y high
$03:9B3D 9D D4 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; Restore Reznor Y high
$03:9B40 68           PLA                             ; Pull saved Y low
$03:9B41 95 D8        STA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; Restore Reznor Y low
$03:9B43 68           PLA                             ; Pull saved X low
$03:9B44 95 E4        STA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; Restore Reznor X low
$03:9B46 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; A = aimed Y speed
$03:9B48 99 3D 17     STA.W RAM_ExSprSpeedY,Y         ; Fireball Y speed
$03:9B4B A5 01        LDA $01                         ; A = aimed X speed
$03:9B4D 99 47 17     STA.W RAM_ExSprSpeedX,Y         ; Fireball X speed
$03:9B50 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $9B51: Table: Reznor tile X offsets (ReznorTileDispX) ;;;
{
$03:9B51              .db $00,$F0,$00,$F0,$F0,$00,$F0,$00 ; X offsets per tile, facing right: $00,$F0,$00,$F0; facing left: $F0,$00,$F0,$00
}

;;; $9B59: Table: Reznor tile Y offsets (ReznorTileDispY) ;;;
{
$03:9B59              .db $E0,$E0,$F0,$F0             ; Y offsets per tile: $E0,$E0,$F0,$F0 (2x2 tiles of 16x16)

}

;;; $9B5D: Table: Reznor tile numbers (ReznorTiles) ;;;
{
$03:9B5D              .db $40,$42,$60,$62,$44,$46,$64,$66 ; Tiles for frame 0 (normal) $40,$42,$60,$62 and frame 1 (firing) $44,$46,$64,$66
$03:9B65              .db $28,$28,$48,$48             ; Tiles for frame 2 (turning): $28,$28,$48,$48

}

;;; $9B69: Table: Reznor tile properties (ReznorPal) ;;;
{
$03:9B69              .db $3F,$3F,$3F,$3F,$3F,$3F,$3F,$3F ; Properties for frames 0 and 1: $3F = palette 7, priority 3 (flip added in code)
$03:9B71              .db $7F,$3F,$7F,$3F             ; Properties for frame 2 (turning): $7F,$3F,$7F,$3F

}

;;; $9B75: Draw Reznor (ReznorGfxRt) ;;;
{
;; Draws the four 16x16 tiles of Reznor (frame from [$1602,X], mirrored by direction) and then his platform. A
;;     dead Reznor only draws the platform.
;; Called by:
;;     $03:9AA6: Reznor: draw and kill check (ReznorNoFiring)
$03:9B75 BD 1C 15     LDA.W $151C,X                   ; \
$03:9B78 D0 65        BNE DrawReznorPlats             ; / Reznor dead ([$151C,X] != 0)? Then only draw the platform
$03:9B7A 20 60 B7     JSR.W GetDrawInfoBnk3           ; Get OAM index Y and screen position $00/$01 (GetDrawInfoBnk3)
$03:9B7D BD 02 16     LDA.W $1602,X                   ; \
$03:9B80 0A           ASL                             ; |
$03:9B81 0A           ASL                             ; |
$03:9B82 85 03        STA $03                         ; / $03 = frame [$1602,X] * 4: index of the frame's first tile
$03:9B84 BD 7C 15     LDA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; \
$03:9B87 0A           ASL                             ; |
$03:9B88 0A           ASL                             ; |
$03:9B89 85 02        STA $02                         ; / $02 = direction * 4: index into the facing-dependent X offsets
$03:9B8B DA           PHX                             ; Save sprite index
$03:9B8C A2 03        LDX.B #$03                      ; X = 3: four tiles per frame
}

;;; $9B8E: Reznor draw: tile loop (RznrGfxLoopStart) ;;;
{
;; Loop over the 4 tiles of the frame (X = 3..0): OAM position from the offset tables, tile and properties
;;     from ReznorTiles/ReznorPal.
$03:9B8E DA           PHX                             ; Save the tile counter
$03:9B8F A5 03        LDA $03                         ; A = frame offset
$03:9B91 C9 08        CMP.B #$08                      ; Frame >= 2 (turning image)?
$03:9B93 B0 04        BCS $9B99                       ; Yes: X offsets not direction dependent
$03:9B95 8A           TXA                             ; \
$03:9B96 05 02        ORA $02                         ; } Add the direction offset to the tile index
$03:9B98 AA           TAX                             ; /
$03:9B99 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; A = sprite X on screen
$03:9B9B 18           CLC                             ; Clear carry
$03:9B9C 7D 51 9B     ADC.W ReznorTileDispX,X         ; Plus tile X offset
$03:9B9F 99 00 03     STA.W OAM_DispX,Y               ; OAM X position
$03:9BA2 FA           PLX                             ; Pull tile counter
$03:9BA3 A5 01        LDA $01                         ; A = sprite Y on screen
$03:9BA5 18           CLC                             ; Clear carry
$03:9BA6 7D 59 9B     ADC.W ReznorTileDispY,X         ; Plus tile Y offset
$03:9BA9 99 01 03     STA.W OAM_DispY,Y               ; OAM Y position
$03:9BAC DA           PHX                             ; Save the tile counter again
$03:9BAD 8A           TXA                             ; \
$03:9BAE 05 03        ORA $03                         ; |
$03:9BB0 AA           TAX                             ; / X = frame offset + tile counter: index into the tile and property tables
$03:9BB1 BD 5D 9B     LDA.W ReznorTiles,X             ; Tile number from ReznorTiles
$03:9BB4 99 02 03     STA.W OAM_Tile,Y                ; OAM tile number
$03:9BB7 BD 69 9B     LDA.W ReznorPal,X               ; Properties from ReznorPal
$03:9BBA E0 08        CPX.B #$08                      ; \
$03:9BBC B0 06        BCS NoReznorGfxFlip             ; / Turning image (index >= 8): do not flip
$03:9BBE A6 02        LDX $02                         ; \
$03:9BC0 D0 02        BNE NoReznorGfxFlip             ; } Direction 0: flip tile horizontally
$03:9BC2 49 40        EOR.B #$40                      ; /
}

;;; $9BC4: Reznor draw: finish OAM (NoReznorGfxFlip) ;;;
{
;; Writes properties, advances the OAM index by 4 and finishes with FinishOAMWrite (4 tiles, 16x16).
$03:9BC4 99 03 03     STA.W OAM_Prop,Y                ; OAM properties
$03:9BC7 FA           PLX                             ; Pull tile counter
$03:9BC8 C8           INY                             ; \
$03:9BC9 C8           INY                             ; |
$03:9BCA C8           INY                             ; |
$03:9BCB C8           INY                             ; / OAM index Y += 4: next OAM slot
$03:9BCC CA           DEX                             ; Next tile
$03:9BCD 10 BF        BPL RznrGfxLoopStart            ; Loop for all 4 tiles
$03:9BCF FA           PLX                             ; Restore sprite index X
$03:9BD0 A0 02        LDY.B #$02                      ; Y = 2: all tiles are 16x16
$03:9BD2 A9 03        LDA.B #$03                      ; A = number of tiles - 1
$03:9BD4 22 B3 B7 01  JSL.L FinishOAMWrite            ; Finish OAM write, hide offscreen tiles (FinishOAMWrite)
$03:9BD8 BD C8 14     LDA.W $14C8,X                   ; A = sprite status
$03:9BDB C9 02        CMP.B #$02                      ; Status 2 (killed)?
$03:9BDD F0 03        BEQ $9BE2                       ; Yes: no platform, return
}

;;; $9BDF: Draw Reznor platform (DrawReznorPlats) ;;;
{
;; Calls ReznorPlatGfxRt.
$03:9BDF 20 EB 9B     JSR.W ReznorPlatGfxRt           ; Draw the platform (ReznorPlatGfxRt)
$03:9BE2 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $9BE3: Table: platform bounce Y offsets (ReznorPlatDispY) ;;;
{
$03:9BE3              .db $00,$03,$04,$05,$05,$04,$03,$00 ; Platform bounce Y offsets, indexed by [$1564,X] >> 1: 0,3,4,5,5,4,3,0

}

;;; $9BEB: Draw Reznor platform graphics (ReznorPlatGfxRt) ;;;
{
;; Reserves 4 OAM slots for Reznor, then draws two 16x16 tiles ($4E, the right one X flipped) for the
;;     platform; Y is lowered by the bounce table indexed by [$1564,X] >> 1.
;; Called by:
;;     $03:9BDF: Draw Reznor platform (DrawReznorPlats)
$03:9BEB BD EA 15     LDA.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X         ; \
$03:9BEE 18           CLC                             ; } Skip the 4 OAM slots used by Reznor: OAM index [$15EA,X] += $10
$03:9BEF 69 10        ADC.B #$10                      ; |
$03:9BF1 9D EA 15     STA.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X         ; /
$03:9BF4 20 60 B7     JSR.W GetDrawInfoBnk3           ; Get OAM index Y and screen position $00/$01 (GetDrawInfoBnk3)
$03:9BF7 BD 64 15     LDA.W $1564,X                   ; A = platform bounce timer [$1564,X]
$03:9BFA 4A           LSR                             ; A = timer >> 1: index into the bounce table
$03:9BFB 5A           PHY                             ; Save OAM index Y
$03:9BFC A8           TAY                             ; Y = bounce table index
$03:9BFD B9 E3 9B     LDA.W ReznorPlatDispY,Y         ; A = platform Y offset
$03:9C00 85 02        STA $02                         ; $02 = platform Y offset
$03:9C02 7A           PLY                             ; Restore OAM index Y
$03:9C03 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; A = sprite X on screen
$03:9C05 99 04 03     STA.W OAM_Tile2DispX,Y          ; Right half X position
$03:9C08 38           SEC                             ; Set carry
$03:9C09 E9 10        SBC.B #$10                      ; Left half X = X - $10
$03:9C0B 99 00 03     STA.W OAM_DispX,Y               ; Left half X position
$03:9C0E A5 01        LDA $01                         ; A = sprite Y on screen
$03:9C10 38           SEC                             ; Set carry
$03:9C11 E5 02        SBC $02                         ; Minus the bounce offset
$03:9C13 99 01 03     STA.W OAM_DispY,Y               ; Left half Y position
$03:9C16 99 05 03     STA.W OAM_Tile2DispY,Y          ; Right half Y position
$03:9C19 A9 4E        LDA.B #$4E                      ; \
$03:9C1B 99 02 03     STA.W OAM_Tile,Y                ; } Both tiles = $4E (platform)
$03:9C1E 99 06 03     STA.W OAM_Tile2,Y               ; /
$03:9C21 A9 33        LDA.B #$33                      ; \
$03:9C23 99 03 03     STA.W OAM_Prop,Y                ; / Left tile properties $33 (palette 1, priority 3)
$03:9C26 09 40        ORA.B #$40                      ; \
$03:9C28 99 07 03     STA.W OAM_Tile2Prop,Y           ; / Right tile properties: X flipped
$03:9C2B A0 02        LDY.B #$02                      ; \
$03:9C2D A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; / Y = 2 (16x16 tiles), A = 1: two tiles
$03:9C2F 22 B3 B7 01  JSL.L FinishOAMWrite            ; Finish OAM write, hide offscreen tiles (FinishOAMWrite)
$03:9C33 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $9C34: Dino sprite main entry (and invisible block) (InvisBlk+DinosMain) ;;;
{
;; Entry point shared by sprites $6D (Invisible solid block) , $6E (Dino-Rhino) and $6F (Dino-Torch). Sprite
;;     $6D calls InvisBlkMainRt; the Dinos go to DinoMainRt.
;; Called by:
;;     $01:875E: Invisible solid block, Dino Rhino and Dino Torch (InvisSolid+Dinos)
$03:9C34 B5 9E        LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; \
$03:9C36 C9 6D        CMP.B #$6D                      ; } Sprite $6D (invisible solid block)? Otherwise go to DinoMainRt
$03:9C38 D0 05        BNE DinoMainRt                  ; /
$03:9C3A 22 4F B4 01  JSL.L InvisBlkMainRt            ; Run the invisible solid block routine (InvisBlkMainRt)
$03:9C3E 6B           RTL                             ; Return

}

;;; $9C3F: Dino main wrapper (DinoMainRt) ;;;
{
;; Sets the data bank to the program bank around DinoMainSubRt.
$03:9C3F 8B           PHB                             ; Save data bank
$03:9C40 4B           PHK                             ; \
$03:9C41 AB           PLB                             ; / Data bank = program bank ($03)
$03:9C42 20 47 9C     JSR.W DinoMainSubRt             ; Run the Dino-Rhino/Dino-Torch main code
$03:9C45 AB           PLB                             ; Restore data bank
$03:9C46 6B           RTL                             ; Return

}

;;; $9C47: Dino main code (DinoMainSubRt) ;;;
{
;; Draws, returns if sprites are locked or status is not 8, handles offscreen, Mario contact and movement,
;;     then runs the state: 0 walk, 1/2 breathe fire (Dino-Torch only), 3 jump.
;; Called by:
;;     $03:9C42: Dino main wrapper (DinoMainRt)
$03:9C47 20 49 9E     JSR.W DinoGfxRt                 ; Draw the sprite (DinoGfxRt)
$03:9C4A A5 9D        LDA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; A = sprites locked flag
$03:9C4C D0 55        BNE $9CA3                       ; Locked: return
$03:9C4E BD C8 14     LDA.W $14C8,X                   ; A = sprite status
$03:9C51 C9 08        CMP.B #$08                      ; Status 8 (normal)?
$03:9C53 D0 4E        BNE $9CA3                       ; No: return
$03:9C55 20 5D B8     JSR.W SubOffscreen0Bnk3         ; Handle offscreen despawn (SubOffscreen0Bnk3)
$03:9C58 22 DC A7 01  JSL.L MarioSprInteract          ; Interact with Mario
$03:9C5C 22 2A 80 01  JSL.L UpdateSpritePos           ; Apply speed and gravity, check object collision (UpdateSpritePos)
$03:9C60 B5 C2        LDA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; A = sprite state [$C2,X]
$03:9C62 22 DF 86 00  JSL.L ExecutePtr                ; Run state: 0 walk, 1/2 breathe fire, 3 jump

}

;;; $9C66: Pointer table: Dino states, wall nudge (RhinoStatePtrs) ;;;
{
;; State pointers for Dino-Rhino/Dino-Torch, plus $9C6E/71 (X nudge out of walls) and the state 3 jump
;;     code $9C74.
$03:9C66 A8 9C        .dw $9CA8                       ; State 0: walk ($9CA8)
$03:9C68 41 9D        .dw $9D41                       ; State 1: breathe fire, horizontal flame ($9D41)
$03:9C6A 41 9D        .dw $9D41                       ; State 2: breathe fire, vertical flame ($9D41)
$03:9C6C 74 9C        .dw $9C74                       ; State 3: jump ($9C74)

$03:9C6E              .db $00,$FE,$02                 ; X nudge out of a wall, low byte, by wall flags [$1588]: $00,$FE,$02

$03:9C71              .db $00,$FF,$00                 ; X nudge out of a wall, high byte: $00,$FF,$00

$03:9C74 B5 AA        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; A = Y speed
$03:9C76 30 11        BMI $9C89                       ; Rising: skip
$03:9C78 74 C2        STZ RAM_SpriteState,X           ; Falling: state = 0 (walk)
$03:9C7A BD 88 15     LDA.W RAM_SprObjStatus,X        ; \
$03:9C7D 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; } Not touching a wall: skip the turn
$03:9C7F F0 08        BEQ $9C89                       ; /
$03:9C81 BD 7C 15     LDA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; \
$03:9C84 49 01        EOR.B #$01                      ; } Touching a wall: flip direction
$03:9C86 9D 7C 15     STA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; /
$03:9C89 9E 02 16     STZ.W $1602,X                   ; Frame [$1602,X] = 0
$03:9C8C BD 88 15     LDA.W RAM_SprObjStatus,X        ; A = object contact flags
$03:9C8F 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; Keep side wall bits
$03:9C91 A8           TAY                             ; Y = wall flags: 0 none, 1 right, 2 left
$03:9C92 B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; A = X position low
$03:9C94 18           CLC                             ; Clear carry
$03:9C95 79 6E 9C     ADC.W $9C6E,Y                   ; Add nudge from $9C6E (pushes the sprite out of the wall)
$03:9C98 95 E4        STA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; X position low
$03:9C9A BD E0 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; A = X position high
$03:9C9D 79 71 9C     ADC.W $9C71,Y                   ; Add nudge high byte
$03:9CA0 9D E0 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; X position high
$03:9CA3 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $9CA4: Dino walking states and speeds (DinoSpeed) ;;;
{
;; DinoSpeed table: X speeds for Rhino ($08/$F8) and Torch ($10/$F0). $9CA8 is state 0 (walk): on the
;;     ground, Dino-Torch starts a flame ([$1540,X] = $FF, state 1 or 2) when the timer is 0;
;; every 64 frames it faces Mario; it jumps (Y speed $C0, state 3) when it hits a wall.
$03:9CA4              .db $08,$F8,$10,$F0             ; X speed: Dino-Rhino $08 right, $F8 left; Dino-Torch $10 right, $F0 left

$03:9CA8 BD 88 15     LDA.W RAM_SprObjStatus,X        ; \
$03:9CAB 29 04        AND.B #$04                      ; } Not on the ground? Go to $9C89 (no walking in the air)
$03:9CAD F0 DA        BEQ $9C89                       ; /
$03:9CAF BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; A = fire timer [$1540,X]
$03:9CB2 D0 14        BNE $9CC8                       ; Timer running: skip
$03:9CB4 B5 9E        LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; A = sprite number
$03:9CB6 C9 6E        CMP.B #$6E                      ; Dino-Rhino ($6E)?
$03:9CB8 F0 0E        BEQ $9CC8                       ; Yes: never breathes fire
$03:9CBA A9 FF        LDA.B #$FF                      ; \
$03:9CBC 9D 40 15     STA.W $1540,X                   ; / Fire timer [$1540,X] = $FF
$03:9CBF 22 F9 AC 01  JSL.L GetRand                   ; Random number
$03:9CC3 29 01        AND.B #$01                      ; 0 or 1
$03:9CC5 1A           INC A                           ; 1 or 2
$03:9CC6 95 C2        STA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; State = 1 or 2: pick the flame direction
$03:9CC8 8A           TXA                             ; \
$03:9CC9 0A           ASL                             ; |
$03:9CCA 0A           ASL                             ; |
$03:9CCB 0A           ASL                             ; |
$03:9CCC 0A           ASL                             ; } A = (slot * 16 + [$14]) & $3F: every 64 frames per Dino
$03:9CCD 65 14        ADC RAM_FrameCounterB           ; |
$03:9CCF 29 3F        AND.B #$3F                      ; /
$03:9CD1 D0 07        BNE $9CDA                       ; Not this frame: skip
$03:9CD3 20 17 B8     JSR.W SubHorzPosBnk3            ; \
$03:9CD6 98           TYA                             ; } Face Mario: direction = result of SubHorzPosBnk3
$03:9CD7 9D 7C 15     STA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; /
$03:9CDA A9 10        LDA.B #$10                      ; \
$03:9CDC 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; / Y speed = $10 (keeps it on the ground)
$03:9CDE BC 7C 15     LDY.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; Y = direction
$03:9CE1 B5 9E        LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; A = sprite number
$03:9CE3 C9 6E        CMP.B #$6E                      ; Dino-Rhino?
$03:9CE5 F0 02        BEQ $9CE9                       ; Yes: use the first pair of speeds
$03:9CE7 C8           INY                             ; \
$03:9CE8 C8           INY                             ; / Dino-Torch: Y += 2 for the faster pair
$03:9CE9 B9 A4 9C     LDA.W DinoSpeed,Y               ; A = walking X speed
$03:9CEC 95 B6        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; X speed
$03:9CEE 20 EF 9D     JSR.W DinoSetGfxFrame           ; Update the walking animation frame (DinoSetGfxFrame)
$03:9CF1 BD 88 15     LDA.W RAM_SprObjStatus,X        ; A = object contact flags
$03:9CF4 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; Keep side wall bits
$03:9CF6 F0 08        BEQ $9D00                       ; Not touching a wall: return
$03:9CF8 A9 C0        LDA.B #$C0                      ; \
$03:9CFA 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; / Touching a wall: Y speed = $C0 (jump)
$03:9CFC A9 03        LDA.B #$03                      ; \
$03:9CFE 95 C2        STA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; / State = 3 (jumping)
$03:9D00 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $9D01: Table: Dino-Torch flame animation (DinoFlameTable) ;;;
{
;; 32 entries per flame state (1 = horizontal, 2 = vertical), indexed by [$1540,X] / 8 so played from the end:
;;     high nibble = flame size (0 = full flame that hurts Mario), low nibble = frame for [$1602,X].
$03:9D01              .db $41,$42,$42,$32,$22,$12,$02,$02 ; Flame steps, state 1, 0-7 (timer counts down, so played last): size << 4 | frame
$03:9D09              .db $02,$02,$02,$02,$02,$02,$02,$02 ; Flame steps, state 1, 8-15
$03:9D11              .db $02,$02,$02,$02,$02,$02,$02,$12 ; Flame steps, state 1, 16-23
$03:9D19              .db $22,$32,$42,$42,$42,$42,$41,$41 ; Flame steps, state 1, 24-31 (played first: flame grows)
$03:9D21              .db $41,$43,$43,$33,$23,$13,$03,$03 ; Flame steps, state 2 (vertical flame), 0-7
$03:9D29              .db $03,$03,$03,$03,$03,$03,$03,$03 ; Flame steps, state 2, 8-15
$03:9D31              .db $03,$03,$03,$03,$03,$03,$03,$13 ; Flame steps, state 2, 16-23
$03:9D39              .db $23,$33,$43,$43,$43,$43,$41,$41 ; Flame steps, state 2, 24-31

$03:9D41 74 B6        STZ RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; X speed = 0: stand still while breathing
$03:9D43 BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; A = fire timer [$1540,X]
$03:9D46 D0 09        BNE DinoFlameTimerSet           ; Timer running: continue the flame animation
$03:9D48 74 C2        STZ RAM_SpriteState,X           ; Timer ran out: state = 0 (walk)
$03:9D4A A9 40        LDA.B #$40                      ; \
$03:9D4C 9D 40 15     STA.W $1540,X                   ; / Fire timer [$1540,X] = $40: walk for a while before breathing again
$03:9D4F A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; A = 0 (timer value for the table lookup)
}

;;; $9D51: Dino-Torch breathing flame (state 1/2) (DinoFlameTimerSet) ;;;
{
;; Stands still and runs the flame from timer [$1540,X] ($FF down to 0): sound at $C0, frame and size from
;;     DinoFlameTable. When the flame is full and every 4th frame, checks contact with the flame box and hurts
;;     Mario unless he has a star.
$03:9D51 C9 C0        CMP.B #$C0                      ; Timer = $C0 (just after the flame started)?
$03:9D53 D0 05        BNE $9D5A                       ; No: skip the sound
$03:9D55 A0 17        LDY.B #$17                      ; \
$03:9D57 8C FC 1D     STY.W $1DFC                     ; / Sound effect $17 (fire breath) on [$1DFC]
$03:9D5A 4A           LSR                             ; \
$03:9D5B 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:9D5C 4A           LSR                             ; / A = timer / 8: flame step 0-31
$03:9D5D B4 C2        LDY RAM_SpriteState,X           ; Y = state
$03:9D5F C0 02        CPY.B #$02                      ; State 2?
$03:9D61 D0 03        BNE $9D66                       ; No: first half of the table
$03:9D63 18           CLC                             ; \
$03:9D64 69 20        ADC.B #$20                      ; / State 2: step += $20 (second half of the table)
$03:9D66 A8           TAY                             ; Y = table index
$03:9D67 B9 01 9D     LDA.W DinoFlameTable,Y          ; A = flame animation entry
$03:9D6A 48           PHA                             ; Save it
$03:9D6B 29 0F        AND.B #$0F                      ; Low nibble
$03:9D6D 9D 02 16     STA.W $1602,X                   ; Frame [$1602,X]
$03:9D70 68           PLA                             ; Pull the entry
$03:9D71 4A           LSR                             ; \
$03:9D72 4A           LSR                             ; } High nibble: flame size, 0 = full flame
$03:9D73 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:9D74 4A           LSR                             ; /
$03:9D75 9D 1C 15     STA.W $151C,X                   ; [$151C,X] = flame size
$03:9D78 D0 23        BNE $9D9D                       ; Not full size: no damage, return
$03:9D7A B5 9E        LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; A = sprite number
$03:9D7C C9 6E        CMP.B #$6E                      ; Dino-Rhino?
$03:9D7E F0 1D        BEQ $9D9D                       ; Yes: no flame, return
$03:9D80 8A           TXA                             ; \
$03:9D81 45 13        EOR RAM_FrameCounter            ; |
$03:9D83 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; |
$03:9D85 D0 16        BNE $9D9D                       ; / Only every 4th frame (slot dependent): return otherwise
$03:9D87 20 B6 9D     JSR.W DinoFlameClipping         ; Set up the flame clipping box (DinoFlameClipping)
$03:9D8A 22 64 B6 03  JSL.L GetMarioClipping          ; Get Mario clipping box (GetMarioClipping)
$03:9D8E 22 2B B7 03  JSL.L CheckForContact           ; Check contact with the flame (CheckForContact)
$03:9D92 90 09        BCC $9D9D                       ; No contact: return
$03:9D94 AD 90 14     LDA.W $1490                     ; A = star power timer
$03:9D97 D0 04        BNE $9D9D                       ; Mario has a star: return
$03:9D99 22 B7 F5 00  JSL.L HurtMario                 ; Hurt Mario
$03:9D9D 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

$03:9D9E              .db $DC,$02,$10,$02             ; Flame box X offset low, indexed [frame - 2] (+2 if facing right)

;;; $9DB6: Dino-Torch flame hitbox (DinoFlameClipping) ;;;
{
;; Fills the sprite clipping slot B ($04 X low, $0A X high, $06 width, $05 Y low, $0B Y high, $07 height) from
;;     the DinoFlame tables, indexed by frame - 2 (+2 when the sprite direction is 0).
;; Called by:
;;     $03:9D87: Dino-Torch breathing flame (state 1/2) (DinoFlameTimerSet)
$03:9DB6 BD 02 16     LDA.W $1602,X                   ; A = frame [$1602,X] (2 = horizontal flame, 3 = vertical flame)
$03:9DB9 38           SEC                             ; Set carry
$03:9DBA E9 02        SBC.B #$02                      ; Minus 2
$03:9DBC A8           TAY                             ; Y = 0 or 1
$03:9DBD BD 7C 15     LDA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; A = sprite direction
$03:9DC0 D0 02        BNE $9DC4                       ; Direction 1: keep Y
$03:9DC2 C8           INY                             ; \
$03:9DC3 C8           INY                             ; / Direction 0: Y += 2
$03:9DC4 B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; \
$03:9DC6 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:9DC7 79 9E 9D     ADC.W DinoFlame1,Y              ; |
$03:9DCA 85 04        STA $04                         ; / $04 = X position low + flame X offset
$03:9DCC BD E0 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; \
$03:9DCF 79 A2 9D     ADC.W DinoFlame2,Y              ; |
$03:9DD2 85 0A        STA $0A                         ; / $0A = X position high + offset high
$03:9DD4 B9 A6 9D     LDA.W DinoFlame3,Y              ; A = flame width
$03:9DD7 85 06        STA $06                         ; $06 = width
$03:9DD9 B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$03:9DDB 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:9DDC 79 AA 9D     ADC.W DinoFlame4,Y              ; |
$03:9DDF 85 05        STA $05                         ; / $05 = Y position low + flame Y offset
$03:9DE1 BD D4 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; \
$03:9DE4 79 AE 9D     ADC.W DinoFlame5,Y              ; |
$03:9DE7 85 0B        STA $0B                         ; / $0B = Y position high + offset high
$03:9DE9 B9 B2 9D     LDA.W DinoFlame6,Y              ; A = flame height
$03:9DEC 85 07        STA $07                         ; $07 = height
$03:9DEE 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $9DEF: Dino walk animation frame (DinoSetGfxFrame) ;;;
{
;; Increments the animation counter [$1570,X] and sets the frame [$1602,X] to bit 3 of it (0/1, every 8
;;     frames).
;; Called by:
;;     $03:9CEE: Dino walking states and speeds (DinoSpeed)
$03:9DEF FE 70 15     INC.W $1570,X                   ; [$1570,X]++: animation counter
$03:9DF2 BD 70 15     LDA.W $1570,X                   ; A = animation counter
$03:9DF5 29 08        AND.B #$08                      ; \
$03:9DF7 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:9DF8 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:9DF9 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:9DFA 9D 02 16     STA.W $1602,X                   ; / Frame [$1602,X] = bit 3 of the counter: toggles every 8 frames
$03:9DFD 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

$03:9E41              .db $C8,$CA,$E8,$E2,$CC,$CE,$EC,$EE ; Body tiles per frame: frame 2 $C8,$CA,$E8,$E2; frame 3 $CC,$CE,$EC,$EE
