;;; $9E49: Dino Rhino and Dino Torch graphics (DinoGfxRt) ;;;
{
;; Draws sprite $6E (Dino Rhino): 4 16x16 tiles from DinoRhinoTiles, X-flipped via the mirrored half of the
;;     tables when facing right.
;; Sprite $6F (Dino Torch): head tile plus up to 5 flame segments, flame flickers by flipping every other
;;     frame.
;; Uses [$1602] as animation frame, [$151C] as flame length. Parameters: X = sprite index.
;; Called by:
;;     $03:9C47: Dino main code (DinoMainSubRt)
$03:9E49 20 60 B7     JSR.W GetDrawInfoBnk3           ; Get OAM index [Y] and on-screen position [$00]/[$01] (returns if off-screen)
$03:9E4C BD 7C 15     LDA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; A = sprite direction (0 = right)
$03:9E4F 85 02        STA $02                         ; $02 = direction
$03:9E51 BD 02 16     LDA.W $1602,X                   ; A = animation frame [$1602]
$03:9E54 85 04        STA $04                         ; $04 = frame
$03:9E56 B5 9E        LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; A = sprite number
$03:9E58 C9 6F        CMP.B #$6F                      ; Compare with $6F (Dino Torch)
$03:9E5A F0 4D        BEQ $9EA9                       ; Dino Torch: go draw torch and flame
$03:9E5C DA           PHX                             ; Save sprite index
$03:9E5D A2 03        LDX.B #$03                      ; X = 3: four tiles to draw
$03:9E5F 86 0F        STX $0F                         ; $0F = tile counter
$03:9E61 A5 02        LDA $02                         ; A = direction
$03:9E63 C9 01        CMP.B #$01                      ; Direction >= 1 (left): keep table index
$03:9E65 B0 05        BCS $9E6C                       ; Skip the mirrored-table offset if facing left
$03:9E67 8A           TXA                             ; \
$03:9E68 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:9E69 69 04        ADC.B #$04                      ; } Facing right: X += 4 (use the X-flipped half of the tables)
$03:9E6B AA           TAX                             ; /
$03:9E6C BD 2D 9E     LDA.W DinoRhinoGfxProp,X        ; Tile property from DinoRhinoGfxProp (palette, X-flip when facing right)
$03:9E6F 99 03 03     STA.W OAM_Prop,Y
$03:9E72 BD 25 9E     LDA.W DinoRhinoTileDispX,X      ; \
$03:9E75 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:9E76 65 00        ADC $00                         ; } OAM X = [$00] + DinoRhinoTileDispX[X]
$03:9E78 99 00 03     STA.W OAM_DispX,Y               ; /
$03:9E7B A5 04        LDA $04                         ; \
$03:9E7D C9 01        CMP.B #$01                      ; / Carry = 1 when animation frame >= 1
$03:9E7F A6 0F        LDX $0F                         ; X = tile counter
$03:9E81 BD 35 9E     LDA.W DinoRhinoTileDispY,X      ; \
$03:9E84 65 01        ADC $01                         ; } OAM Y = [$01] + DinoRhinoTileDispY[X] + carry (frames 1+ sit 1 pixel lower)
$03:9E86 99 01 03     STA.W OAM_DispY,Y               ; /
$03:9E89 A5 04        LDA $04                         ; \
$03:9E8B 0A           ASL                             ; |
$03:9E8C 0A           ASL                             ; |
$03:9E8D 65 0F        ADC $0F                         ; } X = frame * 4 + tile counter
$03:9E8F AA           TAX                             ; /
$03:9E90 BD 39 9E     LDA.W DinoRhinoTiles,X          ; \
$03:9E93 99 02 03     STA.W OAM_Tile,Y                ; / OAM tile = DinoRhinoTiles[X]
$03:9E96 C8           INY                             ; \
$03:9E97 C8           INY                             ; |
$03:9E98 C8           INY                             ; } Y += 4: next OAM slot
$03:9E99 C8           INY                             ; /
$03:9E9A A6 0F        LDX $0F                         ; X = tile counter
$03:9E9C CA           DEX                             ; Next tile
$03:9E9D 10 C0        BPL $9E5F                       ; Loop for all 4 tiles
$03:9E9F FA           PLX                             ; Restore sprite index
$03:9EA0 A9 03        LDA.B #$03                      ; A = 3: four tiles
$03:9EA2 A0 02        LDY.B #$02                      ; Y = 2: 16x16 tiles
$03:9EA4 22 B3 B7 01  JSL.L FinishOAMWrite            ; Finish OAM write (size bits, off-screen check)
$03:9EA8 60           RTS                             ; Return

$03:9EA9 BD 1C 15     LDA.W $151C,X                   ; A = [$151C] (flame length index; 0 = longest)
$03:9EAC 85 03        STA $03                         ; $03 = lowest flame segment to draw
$03:9EAE BD 02 16     LDA.W $1602,X                   ; A = animation frame [$1602]
$03:9EB1 85 04        STA $04                         ; $04 = frame
$03:9EB3 DA           PHX                             ; Save sprite index
$03:9EB4 A5 14        LDA RAM_FrameCounterB           ; \
$03:9EB6 29 02        AND.B #$02                      ; |
$03:9EB8 0A           ASL                             ; |
$03:9EB9 0A           ASL                             ; |
$03:9EBA 0A           ASL                             ; |
$03:9EBB 0A           ASL                             ; } A = ([$14] & 2) << 5 = $00 or $40: flame flicker flip bit
$03:9EBC 0A           ASL                             ; /
$03:9EBD A6 04        LDX $04                         ; X = frame
$03:9EBF E0 03        CPX.B #$03                      ; Frame 3?
$03:9EC1 F0 01        BEQ $9EC4                       ; Yes: keep H-flip flicker
$03:9EC3 0A           ASL                             ; Other frames: shift again, flicker flips vertically ($80)
$03:9EC4 85 05        STA $05                         ; $05 = flicker flip bits
$03:9EC6 A2 04        LDX.B #$04                      ; X = 4: start with the head segment
$03:9EC8 86 06        STX $06                         ; $06 = current segment index
$03:9ECA A5 04        LDA $04                         ; A = frame
$03:9ECC C9 03        CMP.B #$03                      ; Frame 3 uses a second set of X offsets
$03:9ECE D0 05        BNE $9ED5
$03:9ED0 8A           TXA                             ; \
$03:9ED1 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:9ED2 69 05        ADC.B #$05                      ; } X = segment + 5 (second row of DinoTorchTileDispX)
$03:9ED4 AA           TAX                             ; /
$03:9ED5 DA           PHX                             ; Save segment index
$03:9ED6 BD FE 9D     LDA.W DinoTorchTileDispX,X      ; A = X offset of this segment
$03:9ED9 A6 02        LDX $02                         ; X = direction
$03:9EDB D0 03        BNE $9EE0                       ; Facing right: keep sign
$03:9EDD 49 FF        EOR.B #$FF                      ; \
$03:9EDF 1A           INC A                           ; / Facing left: negate the X offset
$03:9EE0 FA           PLX                             ; X = segment index
$03:9EE1 18           CLC                             ; \
$03:9EE2 65 00        ADC $00                         ; } OAM X = [$00] + X offset
$03:9EE4 99 00 03     STA.W OAM_DispX,Y               ; /
$03:9EE7 BD 08 9E     LDA.W DinoTorchTileDispY,X      ; \
$03:9EEA 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:9EEB 65 01        ADC $01                         ; } OAM Y = [$01] + DinoTorchTileDispY[X]
$03:9EED 99 01 03     STA.W OAM_DispY,Y               ; /
$03:9EF0 A5 06        LDA $06                         ; A = segment index
$03:9EF2 C9 04        CMP.B #$04                      ; Segment 4 is the head/torch tile
$03:9EF4 D0 07        BNE $9EFD                       ; No: it is a flame tile
$03:9EF6 A6 04        LDX $04                         ; X = frame
$03:9EF8 BD 21 9E     LDA.W DinoTorchTiles,X          ; Head tile = DinoTorchTiles[frame]
$03:9EFB 80 03        BRA $9F00                       ; Skip flame tile lookup

$03:9EFD BD 12 9E     LDA.W DinoFlameTiles,X          ; Flame tile = DinoFlameTiles[X]
$03:9F00 99 02 03     STA.W OAM_Tile,Y                ; Store OAM tile
$03:9F03 A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; A = 0
$03:9F05 A6 02        LDX $02                         ; X = direction
$03:9F07 D0 02        BNE $9F0B                       ; Facing left: no flip
$03:9F09 09 40        ORA.B #$40                      ; Facing right: X-flip
$03:9F0B A6 06        LDX $06                         ; X = segment index
$03:9F0D E0 04        CPX.B #$04                      ; Head segment?
$03:9F0F F0 02        BEQ $9F13                       ; Yes: no flicker
$03:9F11 45 05        EOR $05                         ; Flame segments: apply flicker flip [$05]
$03:9F13 1D 1C 9E     ORA.W DinoTorchGfxProp,X        ; OR palette/page from DinoTorchGfxProp
$03:9F16 05 64        ORA $64                         ; OR priority bits [$64]
$03:9F18 99 03 03     STA.W OAM_Prop,Y                ; Store OAM property
$03:9F1B C8           INY                             ; \
$03:9F1C C8           INY                             ; |
$03:9F1D C8           INY                             ; } Y += 4: next OAM slot
$03:9F1E C8           INY                             ; /
$03:9F1F CA           DEX                             ; Next segment
$03:9F20 E4 03        CPX $03                         ; Compare with lowest segment [$03]
$03:9F22 10 A4        BPL $9EC8                       ; Loop while segment >= [$03]
$03:9F24 FA           PLX                             ; Restore sprite index
$03:9F25 BC 1C 15     LDY.W $151C,X                   ; Y = flame length index
$03:9F28 B9 32 9F     LDA.W DinoTilesWritten,Y        ; A = number of tiles - 1 (DinoTilesWritten)
$03:9F2B A0 02        LDY.B #$02                      ; Y = 2: 16x16 tiles
$03:9F2D 22 B3 B7 01  JSL.L FinishOAMWrite            ; Finish OAM write
$03:9F31 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $9F32: Table: Dino Torch tile counts (DinoTilesWritten) ;;;
{
;; Tiles written minus 1 by [$151C] flame length (4..0). Followed by an unreferenced RTS.
$03:9F32              .db $04,$03,$02,$01,$00         ; Tiles written - 1, indexed by [$151C]

$03:9F37 60           RTS                             ; Unused return

}

;;; $9F38: Blargg main routine (Blargg) ;;;
{
;; Draws, then (unless sprites are locked) does Mario interaction, off-screen despawn and runs one of 5 states
;;     from [$C2].
;; Parameters: X = sprite index.
;; Called by:
;;     $03:A242: Bank 3 sprite main dispatch (Bnk3CallSprMain)
$03:9F38 20 62 A0     JSR.W $A062                     ; Draw Blargg ($A062)
$03:9F3B A5 9D        LDA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; A = sprites locked flag
$03:9F3D D0 17        BNE $9F56                       ; Locked: return
$03:9F3F 22 DC A7 01  JSL.L MarioSprInteract          ; Mario/sprite interaction
$03:9F43 20 5D B8     JSR.W SubOffscreen0Bnk3         ; Despawn when far off-screen
$03:9F46 B5 C2        LDA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; A = Blargg state
$03:9F48 22 DF 86 00  JSL.L ExecutePtr                ; Run state routine

}

;;; $9F4C: Blargg state machine (BlarggPtrs) ;;;
{
;; State 0 waits hidden in lava; 1 eyes rise; 2 eyes look around; 3 sink and leap; 4 leap and fall back.
;; Home position is saved in [$151C]/[$1528]/[$1534]/[$1594] and restored when Blargg falls back into the
;;     lava.
;; Sound $25 on the leap; lava splash via $A045. The pointer table is at the top.
$03:9F4C 57 9F        .dw $9F57                       ; State 0: waiting in lava for Mario
$03:9F4E 8B 9F        .dw $9F8B                       ; State 1: eyes rise out of the lava
$03:9F50 A4 9F        .dw $9FA4                       ; State 2: eyes look around
$03:9F52 C8 9F        .dw $9FC8                       ; State 3: sink, then leap
$03:9F54 EF 9F        .dw $9FEF                       ; State 4: leap out of the lava

$03:9F56 60           RTS                             ; Return

$03:9F57 BD A0 15     LDA.W RAM_OffscreenHorz,X       ; \
$03:9F5A 1D 40 15     ORA.W $1540,X                   ; } Return if off-screen or wait timer [$1540] still running
$03:9F5D D0 2B        BNE $9F8A                       ; /
$03:9F5F 20 17 B8     JSR.W SubHorzPosBnk3            ; $0F = Mario X - Blargg X
$03:9F62 A5 0F        LDA $0F                         ; A = horizontal distance
$03:9F64 18           CLC                             ; Clear carry
$03:9F65 69 70        ADC.B #$70                      ; Add $70
$03:9F67 C9 E0        CMP.B #$E0                      ; Compare with $E0
$03:9F69 B0 1F        BCS $9F8A                       ; Mario more than $70 pixels away: stay hidden
$03:9F6B A9 E3        LDA.B #$E3                      ; \
$03:9F6D 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; / Y speed = $E3 (rise out of the lava)
$03:9F6F BD E0 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; Remember home X high
$03:9F72 9D 1C 15     STA.W $151C,X                   ; [$151C] = X high
$03:9F75 B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; Remember home X low
$03:9F77 9D 28 15     STA.W $1528,X                   ; [$1528] = X low
$03:9F7A BD D4 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; Remember home Y high
$03:9F7D 9D 34 15     STA.W $1534,X                   ; [$1534] = Y high
$03:9F80 B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; Remember home Y low
$03:9F82 9D 94 15     STA.W $1594,X                   ; [$1594] = Y low
$03:9F85 20 C0 9F     JSR.W $9FC0                     ; Face Mario
$03:9F88 F6 C2        INC RAM_SpriteState,X           ; State 1
$03:9F8A 60           RTS                             ; Return

$03:9F8B B5 AA        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; A = Y speed
$03:9F8D C9 10        CMP.B #$10                      ; Compare with $10
$03:9F8F 30 0A        BMI $9F9B                       ; Still slower than $10: keep rising
$03:9F91 A9 50        LDA.B #$50                      ; \
$03:9F93 9D 40 15     STA.W $1540,X                   ; / Wait timer [$1540] = $50
$03:9F96 F6 C2        INC RAM_SpriteState,X           ; State 2
$03:9F98 74 AA        STZ RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; Y speed = 0
$03:9F9A 60           RTS                             ; Return

$03:9F9B 22 1A 80 01  JSL.L UpdateYPosNoGrvty         ; Move vertically, no gravity
$03:9F9F F6 AA        INC RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; \
$03:9FA1 F6 AA        INC RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; / Y speed += 2 (slow the rise)
$03:9FA3 60           RTS                             ; Return

$03:9FA4 BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; A = wait timer
$03:9FA7 D0 08        BNE $9FB1                       ; Still running: go look around
$03:9FA9 F6 C2        INC RAM_SpriteState,X           ; Timer expired: state 3
$03:9FAB A9 0A        LDA.B #$0A                      ; \
$03:9FAD 9D 40 15     STA.W $1540,X                   ; / Timer = $0A: sink for 10 frames
$03:9FB0 60           RTS                             ; Return

$03:9FB1 C9 20        CMP.B #$20                      ; Timer < $20?
$03:9FB3 90 0B        BCC $9FC0                       ; Yes: track Mario ($9FC0)
$03:9FB5 29 1F        AND.B #$1F                      ; Look back and forth: A = timer & $1F
$03:9FB7 D0 0E        BNE $9FC7                       ; Only flip direction when it is 0 ($40 and $20)
$03:9FB9 BD 7C 15     LDA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; A = direction
$03:9FBC 49 01        EOR.B #$01                      ; Flip direction
$03:9FBE 80 04        BRA $9FC4                       ; Store it

$03:9FC0 20 17 B8     JSR.W SubHorzPosBnk3            ; Y = side Mario is on (SubHorzPos)
$03:9FC3 98           TYA                             ; A = side
$03:9FC4 9D 7C 15     STA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; Face Mario
$03:9FC7 60           RTS                             ; Return

$03:9FC8 BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; A = timer
$03:9FCB F0 09        BEQ $9FD6                       ; Timer expired: leap
$03:9FCD A9 20        LDA.B #$20                      ; \
$03:9FCF 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; / Y speed = $20 (sink)
$03:9FD1 22 1A 80 01  JSL.L UpdateYPosNoGrvty         ; Move vertically
$03:9FD5 60           RTS                             ; Return

$03:9FD6 A9 20        LDA.B #$20                      ; \
$03:9FD8 9D 40 15     STA.W $1540,X                   ; / Timer = $20
$03:9FDB BC 7C 15     LDY.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; Y = direction
$03:9FDE B9 ED 9F     LDA.W $9FED,Y                   ; A = X speed by direction
$03:9FE1 95 B6        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; Sprite X speed
$03:9FE3 A9 E2        LDA.B #$E2                      ; A = $E2
$03:9FE5 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; Y speed = $E2 (leap up)
$03:9FE7 20 45 A0     JSR.W $A045                     ; Spawn a lava splash
$03:9FEA F6 C2        INC RAM_SpriteState,X           ; State 4
$03:9FEC 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $9FED..9FED: Table: Blargg leap X speeds ;;;
{
$03:9FED              .db $10,$F0                     ; X speed: $10 when facing right, $F0 when facing left

}

;;; $9FEF: Blargg leap state, splash, graphics ;;;
{
;; State 4: waits [$1540] frames, plays sound $25, moves with gravity, resets to state 0 after falling back
;;     (timer $40).
;; $A038 picks frame 1 (mouth open) at the top of the leap. $A045 spawns a lava splash $0C above
;;     the sprite.
;; $A062 draws: state 0 nothing, states 1-3 an eyes tile with priority bits cleared, state 4 the full
;;     head ($A09D).
$03:9FEF 9E 02 16     STZ.W $1602,X                   ; Frame = 0 (mouth closed)
$03:9FF2 BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; A = timer
$03:9FF5 F0 0B        BEQ $A002                       ; Timer 0: move now
$03:9FF7 3A           DEC A                           ; Timer - 1
$03:9FF8 D0 3E        BNE $A038                       ; Timer was above 1: keep waiting
$03:9FFA A9 25        LDA.B #$25                      ; \
$03:9FFC 8D F9 1D     STA.W $1DF9                     ; / Play sound effect $25 (probably the roar)
$03:9FFF 20 45 A0     JSR.W $A045                     ; Spawn a lava splash
$03:A002 22 22 80 01  JSL.L UpdateXPosNoGrvty         ; Apply X speed
$03:A006 22 1A 80 01  JSL.L UpdateYPosNoGrvty         ; Apply Y speed
$03:A00A A5 13        LDA RAM_FrameCounter            ; A = frame counter
$03:A00C 29 00        AND.B #$00                      ; AND #$00: always 0 (leftover)
$03:A00E D0 02        BNE $A012                       ; Always taken to the gravity step
$03:A010 F6 AA        INC RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; Y speed++ (gravity every frame)
$03:A012 B5 AA        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; A = Y speed
$03:A014 C9 20        CMP.B #$20                      ; Compare with $20
$03:A016 30 20        BMI $A038                       ; Below $20: still airborne
$03:A018 20 45 A0     JSR.W $A045                     ; Back in lava: splash
$03:A01B 74 C2        STZ RAM_SpriteState,X           ; State 0: hide again
$03:A01D BD 1C 15     LDA.W $151C,X                   ; Restore X high from [$151C]
$03:A020 9D E0 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; X high
$03:A023 BD 28 15     LDA.W $1528,X                   ; Restore X low from [$1528]
$03:A026 95 E4        STA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; X low
$03:A028 BD 34 15     LDA.W $1534,X                   ; Restore Y high from [$1534]
$03:A02B 9D D4 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; Y high
$03:A02E BD 94 15     LDA.W $1594,X                   ; Restore Y low from [$1594]
$03:A031 95 D8        STA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; Y low
$03:A033 A9 40        LDA.B #$40                      ; \
$03:A035 9D 40 15     STA.W $1540,X                   ; / Timer = $40 before it can rise again
$03:A038 B5 AA        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; A = Y speed
$03:A03A 18           CLC                             ; Clear carry
$03:A03B 69 06        ADC.B #$06                      ; Add 6
$03:A03D C9 0C        CMP.B #$0C                      ; Compare with $0C
$03:A03F B0 03        BCS $A044                       ; Speed outside -6..+5: keep frame 0
$03:A041 FE 02 16     INC.W $1602,X                   ; Near the top of the leap: frame 1 (mouth open)
$03:A044 60           RTS                             ; Return

$03:A045 B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; A = Y low
$03:A047 48           PHA                             ; Save it
$03:A048 38           SEC                             ; Set carry
$03:A049 E9 0C        SBC.B #$0C                      ; \
$03:A04B 95 D8        STA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; / Y low -= $0C (splash just above the sprite)
$03:A04D BD D4 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; A = Y high
$03:A050 48           PHA                             ; Save it
$03:A051 E9 00        SBC.B #$00                      ; \
$03:A053 9D D4 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; / Y high -= borrow
$03:A056 22 28 85 02  JSL.L $8528                     ; Spawn lava splash extended sprite ($8528)
$03:A05A 68           PLA                             ; Restore Y high
$03:A05B 9D D4 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; Y high
$03:A05E 68           PLA                             ; Restore Y low
$03:A05F 95 D8        STA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; Y low
$03:A061 60           RTS                             ; Return
$03:A062 20 60 B7     JSR.W GetDrawInfoBnk3           ; Get OAM index and position
$03:A065 B5 C2        LDA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; A = state
$03:A067 F0 CF        BEQ $A038                       ; State 0: hidden, skip drawing
$03:A069 C9 04        CMP.B #$04                      ; State 4?
$03:A06B F0 30        BEQ $A09D                       ; Yes: draw the full head
$03:A06D 22 B2 90 01  JSL.L GenericSprGfxRt2          ; States 1-3: draw one 16x16 tile (GenericSprGfxRt2)
$03:A071 BC EA 15     LDY.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X         ; Y = OAM index
$03:A074 A9 A0        LDA.B #$A0                      ; \
$03:A076 99 02 03     STA.W OAM_Tile,Y                ; / Tile = $A0 (eyes)
$03:A079 B9 03 03     LDA.W OAM_Prop,Y                ; \
$03:A07C 29 CF        AND.B #$CF                      ; } Clear priority bits so it is drawn behind the lava layer
$03:A07E 99 03 03     STA.W OAM_Prop,Y                ; /
$03:A081 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $A082..A08A: Table: Blargg tile X offsets ;;;
{
$03:A082              .db $F8,$08,$F8,$08,$18,$08,$F8,$08 ; X offsets: tiles 0-4 (right), 5-9 (left, X += 5)
$03:A08A              .db $F8,$E8                     ; X offsets, mirrored set (end)

}

;;; $A08C..A08C: Table: Blargg tile Y offsets ;;;
{
$03:A08C              .db $F8,$F8,$08,$08,$08         ; Y offsets of the five head tiles

}

;;; $A091: Blargg head draw, Bowser scene init (BlarggTilemap) ;;;
{
;; BlarggTilemap: 5 tiles per frame (2 frames). $A09D draws the 5-tile head, mirrored by direction.
;; $A0F1: init for the Bowser scene sprite (called from InitBowserScene in bank 1): places it at X
;;     $00D0, Y $FF80, state 3.
$03:A091              .db $A2,$A4,$C2,$C4,$A6,$A2,$A4,$E6 ; Head tiles, frame 0 ($A2,$A4,$C2,$C4,$A6), then frame 1
$03:A099              .db $C8,$A6                     ; Frame 1 tiles (end): $C8,$A6

$03:A09B              .db $45,$05                     ; OAM property by direction: $45 (X-flip) / $05

$03:A09D BD 02 16     LDA.W $1602,X                   ; \
$03:A0A0 0A           ASL                             ; |
$03:A0A1 0A           ASL                             ; |
$03:A0A2 7D 02 16     ADC.W $1602,X                   ; } $03 = frame * 5 (index into BlarggTilemap)
$03:A0A5 85 03        STA $03                         ; /
$03:A0A7 BD 7C 15     LDA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; A = direction
$03:A0AA 85 02        STA $02                         ; $02 = direction
$03:A0AC DA           PHX                             ; Save sprite index
$03:A0AD A2 04        LDX.B #$04                      ; X = 4: five tiles
$03:A0AF DA           PHX                             ; Save tile counter
$03:A0B0 DA           PHX                             ; Save it again
$03:A0B1 A5 01        LDA $01                         ; \
$03:A0B3 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:A0B4 7D 8C A0     ADC.W $A08C,X                   ; } OAM Y = [$01] + $A08C[X]
$03:A0B7 99 01 03     STA.W OAM_DispY,Y               ; /
$03:A0BA A5 02        LDA $02                         ; A = direction
$03:A0BC D0 05        BNE $A0C3                       ; Facing right: keep index
$03:A0BE 8A           TXA                             ; \
$03:A0BF 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:A0C0 69 05        ADC.B #$05                      ; } Facing left: X += 5 (mirrored X offsets)
$03:A0C2 AA           TAX                             ; /
$03:A0C3 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$03:A0C5 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:A0C6 7D 82 A0     ADC.W $A082,X                   ; } OAM X = [$00] + $A082[X]
$03:A0C9 99 00 03     STA.W OAM_DispX,Y               ; /
$03:A0CC 68           PLA                             ; \
$03:A0CD 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:A0CE 65 03        ADC $03                         ; |
$03:A0D0 AA           TAX                             ; |
$03:A0D1 BD 91 A0     LDA.W BlarggTilemap,X           ; } OAM tile = BlarggTilemap[tile counter + frame * 5]
$03:A0D4 99 02 03     STA.W OAM_Tile,Y                ; /
$03:A0D7 A6 02        LDX $02                         ; X = direction
$03:A0D9 BD 9B A0     LDA.W $A09B,X                   ; A = property for this direction
$03:A0DC 99 03 03     STA.W OAM_Prop,Y                ; Store OAM property
$03:A0DF FA           PLX                             ; X = tile counter
$03:A0E0 C8           INY                             ; \
$03:A0E1 C8           INY                             ; |
$03:A0E2 C8           INY                             ; } Y += 4: next OAM slot
$03:A0E3 C8           INY                             ; /
$03:A0E4 CA           DEX                             ; Next tile
$03:A0E5 10 C8        BPL $A0AF                       ; Loop for 5 tiles
$03:A0E7 FA           PLX                             ; Restore sprite index
$03:A0E8 A0 02        LDY.B #$02                      ; Y = 2: 16x16 tiles
$03:A0EA A9 04        LDA.B #$04                      ; A = 4: five tiles
$03:A0EC 22 B3 B7 01  JSL.L FinishOAMWrite            ; Finish OAM write
$03:A0F0 60           RTS                             ; Return

$03:A0F1 22 D2 F7 07  JSL.L InitSpriteTables          ; Initialize sprite tables
$03:A0F5 9E A0 15     STZ.W RAM_OffscreenHorz,X       ; Not off-screen horizontally
$03:A0F8 A9 80        LDA.B #$80                      ; \
$03:A0FA 95 D8        STA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; / Y low = $80
$03:A0FC A9 FF        LDA.B #$FF                      ; \
$03:A0FE 9D D4 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; / Y high = $FF (above the screen)
$03:A101 A9 D0        LDA.B #$D0                      ; \
$03:A103 95 E4        STA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; / X low = $D0
$03:A105 A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; \
$03:A107 9D E0 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; / X high = 0
$03:A10A A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; \
$03:A10C 9D 7B 18     STA.W $187B,X                   ; / [$187B] = 2 (hit counter, probably)
$03:A10F A9 03        LDA.B #$03                      ; \
$03:A111 95 C2        STA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; / State = 3
$03:A113 22 7D DD 03  JSL.L $DD7D                     ; Set up the Bowser scene (palette, scroll, Mode 7 state)
$03:A117 6B           RTL                             ; Return

}

;;; $A118: Bank 3 sprite main dispatch (Bnk3CallSprMain) ;;;
{

;;; $A279: Bowser main logic ;;;
{
;; Sets animation values [$1428]/[$1429]/[$1BA2] and Mode 7 center, runs hurt/hit timers ([$14B5], [$14B0],
;;     [$14B1]), Mario interaction, applies speed and runs state [$151C] via BowserFightPtrs.
;; Names of $14Bx timers are inferred, not verified.
;; Called by:
;;     $03:A25D: Bowser fight sprite main (BowserFight)
$03:A279 A5 38        LDA $38                         ; \
$03:A27B 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:A27C 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:A27D 4A           LSR                             ; } Y = [$38] / 8
$03:A27E A8           TAY                             ; /
$03:A27F B9 65 A2     LDA.W $A265,Y                   ; \
$03:A282 8D 29 14     STA.W $1429                     ; / [$1429] = $A265[Y] (Bowser animation frame, probably)
$03:A285 BD 70 15     LDA.W $1570,X                   ; \
$03:A288 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:A289 69 1E        ADC.B #$1E                      ; |
$03:A28B 1D 7C 15     ORA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; } [$1BA2] = [$1570] + $1E, OR direction (Bowser image index, probably)
$03:A28E 8D A2 1B     STA.W $1BA2                     ; /
$03:A291 A5 14        LDA RAM_FrameCounterB           ; \
$03:A293 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:A294 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; } [$1428] = ([$14] >> 1) & 3: four-step animation counter
$03:A296 8D 28 14     STA.W $1428                     ; /
$03:A299 A9 90        LDA.B #$90                      ; \
$03:A29B 85 2A        STA $2A                         ; / Mode 7 center X = $90
$03:A29D A9 C8        LDA.B #$C8                      ; \
$03:A29F 85 2C        STA $2C                         ; / Mode 7 center Y = $C8
$03:A2A1 22 DF DE 03  JSL.L $DEDF                     ; Update Bowser Mode 7 position from sprite X/Y ($DEDF)
$03:A2A5 AD B5 14     LDA.W $14B5                     ; A = [$14B5] (Bowser hurt timer, probably)
$03:A2A8 F0 03        BEQ $A2AD                       ; Zero: skip
$03:A2AA 20 59 AF     JSR.W $AF59                     ; Draw circling stars ($AF59)
$03:A2AD BD 64 15     LDA.W $1564,X                   ; A = [$1564,X]
$03:A2B0 F0 03        BEQ $A2B5                       ; Zero: skip
$03:A2B2 20 E2 A3     JSR.W $A3E2                     ; Draw expanding particle burst ($A3E2)
$03:A2B5 BD 94 15     LDA.W $1594,X                   ; A = [$1594,X]
$03:A2B8 F0 14        BEQ $A2CE                       ; Zero: skip
$03:A2BA 3A           DEC A                           ; \
$03:A2BB 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:A2BC 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:A2BD 48           PHA                             ; |
$03:A2BE 4A           LSR                             ; } Y = ([$1594] - 1) / 8; keep ([$1594] - 1) / 4 on the stack
$03:A2BF A8           TAY                             ; /
$03:A2C0 B9 BE A8     LDA.W $A8BE,Y                   ; A = $A8BE[Y]
$03:A2C3 85 02        STA $02                         ; $02 = offset
$03:A2C5 68           PLA                             ; \
$03:A2C6 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; } $03 = ([$1594] - 1) / 4 & 3
$03:A2C8 85 03        STA $03                         ; /
$03:A2CA 20 6E AA     JSR.W $AA6E                     ; Draw the effect ($AA6E)
$03:A2CD EA           NOP                             ; NOP
$03:A2CE A5 9D        LDA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; A = sprites locked flag
$03:A2D0 D0 6E        BNE $A340                       ; Locked: return
$03:A2D2 9E 94 15     STZ.W $1594,X                   ; Clear [$1594]
$03:A2D5 A9 30        LDA.B #$30                      ; \
$03:A2D7 85 64        STA $64                         ; / Sprite priority [$64] = $30
$03:A2D9 A5 38        LDA $38                         ; A = [$38]
$03:A2DB C9 20        CMP.B #$20                      ; Compare with $20
$03:A2DD B0 02        BCS $A2E1                       ; >= $20: keep priority
$03:A2DF 64 64        STZ $64                         ; Below $20: priority = 0
$03:A2E1 20 61 A6     JSR.W $A661                     ; Handle the hurt timer [$14B5] ($A661)
$03:A2E4 AD B0 14     LDA.W $14B0                     ; A = [$14B0]
$03:A2E7 F0 09        BEQ $A2F2                       ; Zero: skip
$03:A2E9 A5 13        LDA RAM_FrameCounter            ; A = frame counter
$03:A2EB 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; Every 4th frame
$03:A2ED D0 03        BNE $A2F2                       ; Not this frame
$03:A2EF CE B0 14     DEC.W $14B0                     ; [$14B0]--
$03:A2F2 A5 13        LDA RAM_FrameCounter            ; A = frame counter
$03:A2F4 29 7F        AND.B #$7F                      ; Every 128 frames
$03:A2F6 D0 0D        BNE $A305                       ; Not this frame
$03:A2F8 22 F9 AC 01  JSL.L GetRand                   ; A = random
$03:A2FC 29 01        AND.B #$01                      ; 50 percent chance
$03:A2FE D0 05        BNE $A305                       ; Skip
$03:A300 A9 0C        LDA.B #$0C                      ; \
$03:A302 9D 58 15     STA.W $1558,X                   ; / [$1558] = $0C (blink/mouth timer, probably)
$03:A305 20 78 B0     JSR.W $B078                     ; Mario interaction with Bowser ($B078)
$03:A308 BD 1C 15     LDA.W $151C,X                   ; A = Bowser state [$151C]
$03:A30B C9 09        CMP.B #$09                      ; State 9?
$03:A30D F0 0B        BEQ $A31A                       ; Yes: skip
$03:A30F 9C 27 14     STZ.W $1427                     ; [$1427] = 0
$03:A312 BD 58 15     LDA.W $1558,X                   ; A = [$1558]
$03:A315 F0 03        BEQ $A31A                       ; Zero: skip
$03:A317 EE 27 14     INC.W $1427                     ; [$1427] = 1 while the timer runs
$03:A31A 20 AD A5     JSR.W $A5AD                     ; Handle timer [$14B1] ($A5AD)
$03:A31D 22 22 80 01  JSL.L UpdateXPosNoGrvty         ; Apply X speed
$03:A321 22 1A 80 01  JSL.L UpdateYPosNoGrvty         ; Apply Y speed
$03:A325 BD 1C 15     LDA.W $151C,X                   ; A = Bowser state
$03:A328 22 DF 86 00  JSL.L ExecutePtr                ; Run state routine

}

;;; $A3E2: Draw expanding particle burst ;;;
{
;; Draws 8 particles using OAM slots from $70, phase from [$1564]; they move outward as the timer counts down.
;; Called by:
;;     $03:A2B2: Bowser main logic
$03:A3E2 20 60 B7     JSR.W GetDrawInfoBnk3           ; Get OAM index and position
$03:A3E5 BD 64 15     LDA.W $1564,X                   ; A = [$1564]
$03:A3E8 3A           DEC A                           ; \
$03:A3E9 4A           LSR                             ; } $03 = phase = ([$1564] - 1) / 2
$03:A3EA 85 03        STA $03                         ; /
$03:A3EC 0A           ASL                             ; \
$03:A3ED 0A           ASL                             ; |
$03:A3EE 0A           ASL                             ; } $02 = phase * 8 (row offset into the tables)
$03:A3EF 85 02        STA $02                         ; /
$03:A3F1 A9 70        LDA.B #$70                      ; \
$03:A3F3 9D EA 15     STA.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X         ; / Use OAM slots starting at $70
$03:A3F6 A8           TAY                             ; Y = OAM index
$03:A3F7 DA           PHX                             ; Save sprite index
$03:A3F8 A2 07        LDX.B #$07                      ; X = 7: eight particles
$03:A3FA DA           PHX                             ; Save particle counter
$03:A3FB 8A           TXA                             ; \
$03:A3FC 05 02        ORA $02                         ; } X = phase row | particle
$03:A3FE AA           TAX                             ; /
$03:A3FF A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$03:A401 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:A402 7D 41 A3     ADC.W $A341,X                   ; |
$03:A405 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:A406 69 08        ADC.B #$08                      ; } OAM X = [$00] + $A341[X] + 8
$03:A408 99 00 03     STA.W OAM_DispX,Y               ; /
$03:A40B A5 01        LDA $01                         ; \
$03:A40D 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:A40E 7D 89 A3     ADC.W $A389,X                   ; |
$03:A411 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:A412 69 30        ADC.B #$30                      ; } OAM Y = [$01] + $A389[X] + $30
$03:A414 99 01 03     STA.W OAM_DispY,Y               ; /
$03:A417 A6 03        LDX $03                         ; \
$03:A419 BD D9 A3     LDA.W $A3D9,X                   ; } OAM tile = $A3D9[phase]
$03:A41C 99 02 03     STA.W OAM_Tile,Y                ; /
$03:A41F FA           PLX                             ; X = particle counter
$03:A420 BD D1 A3     LDA.W $A3D1,X                   ; \
$03:A423 99 03 03     STA.W OAM_Prop,Y                ; / OAM property = $A3D1[X]
$03:A426 C8           INY                             ; \
$03:A427 C8           INY                             ; |
$03:A428 C8           INY                             ; } Y += 4: next OAM slot
$03:A429 C8           INY                             ; /
$03:A42A CA           DEX                             ; Next particle
$03:A42B 10 CD        BPL $A3FA                       ; Loop for 8 particles
$03:A42D FA           PLX                             ; Restore sprite index
$03:A42E A0 02        LDY.B #$02                      ; Y = 2: 16x16 tiles
$03:A430 A9 07        LDA.B #$07                      ; A = 7: eight tiles
$03:A432 22 B3 B7 01  JSL.L FinishOAMWrite            ; Finish OAM write
$03:A436 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $A441: Bowser state 0: enter and start fight ;;;
{
;; Bowser main routine state 0 ([$151C] = 0). Bowser descends from the top of the screen to line $10, pauses
;;     for [$1540] frames animating his face,
;; then sets [$154C] and switches to state 7 with the attack timer [$14B0] = $78. Ending at $03A482 is the
;;     state change itself.
;; Quirk: [$154C] is used here as a delay timer, not only for interaction.
$03:A441 BD 4C 15     LDA.W RAM_DisableInter,X        ; Interaction disable timer [$154C] non-zero: go wait for it to expire
$03:A444 D0 3C        BNE $A482
$03:A446 BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; Descent timer [$1540] = 0: still entering
$03:A449 D0 1A        BNE $A465
$03:A44B A9 0E        LDA.B #$0E                      ; Bowser face frame = $0E (mouth open, entering)
$03:A44D 9D 70 15     STA.W $1570,X
$03:A450 A9 04        LDA.B #$04                      ; Y speed = +4 (descend)
$03:A452 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X
$03:A454 74 B6        STZ RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; X speed = 0
$03:A456 B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$03:A458 38           SEC                             ; |
$03:A459 E5 1C        SBC RAM_ScreenBndryYLo          ; } Bowser Y position on screen = [Y low] - [layer 1 Y low]; compare with $10
$03:A45B C9 10        CMP.B #$10                      ; /
$03:A45D D0 05        BNE $A464                       ; Not at screen line $10 yet: keep descending
$03:A45F A9 A4        LDA.B #$A4                      ; Reached it: stop timer [$1540] = $A4
$03:A461 9D 40 15     STA.W $1540,X
$03:A464 60           RTS                             ; Return

$03:A465 74 AA        STZ RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; Y speed = 0
$03:A467 74 B6        STZ RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; X speed = 0
$03:A469 C9 01        CMP.B #$01                      ; Timer = 1 (about to expire)?
$03:A46B F0 0F        BEQ $A47C                       ; Yes: start the fight
$03:A46D C9 40        CMP.B #$40                      ; Timer >= $40: keep the current face
$03:A46F B0 0A        BCS $A47B
$03:A471 4A           LSR                             ; \
$03:A472 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:A473 4A           LSR                             ; } Y = timer / 8: face animation index
$03:A474 A8           TAY                             ; /
$03:A475 B9 37 A4     LDA.W $A437,Y                   ; Face frame from $A437 (mouth closes as the timer runs out)
$03:A478 9D 70 15     STA.W $1570,X                   ; Bowser face frame [$1570]
$03:A47B 60           RTS                             ; Return

$03:A47C A9 24        LDA.B #$24                      ; Interaction disable timer [$154C] = $24 (delay before the first state change)
$03:A47E 9D 4C 15     STA.W RAM_DisableInter,X
$03:A481 60           RTS                             ; Return

$03:A482 3A           DEC A                           ; Timer [$154C] counted down to 1?
$03:A483 D0 0A        BNE $A48F                       ; No: wait
$03:A485 A9 07        LDA.B #$07                      ; Bowser state = 7 (hover and move)
$03:A487 9D 1C 15     STA.W $151C,X
$03:A48A A9 78        LDA.B #$78                      ; Phase timer [$14B0] = $78 before the first attack
$03:A48C 8D B0 14     STA.W $14B0
$03:A48F 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $A490..A498: Table: Bowser hover speeds ;;;
{
$03:A490              .db $FF,$01                     ; X acceleration for state 7: +1 / -1 per frame, indexed by [$1528] bit 0

$03:A492              .db $C8,$38                     ; X speed limits for state 7: -$38 / +$38

$03:A494              .db $01,$FF                     ; Y acceleration for state 7: +1 / -1 per frame, indexed by [$1534] bit 0

$03:A496              .db $1C,$E4                     ; Y speed limits for state 7: +$1C / -$1C

$03:A498              .db $00,$02,$04,$02             ; Face frame cycle for idle animation: 0, 2, 4, 2

}

;;; $A49C: Bowser state 7: hover and face Mario ;;;
{
;; State 7 ([$151C] = 7): Bowser floats in a loop. X speed ramps between -$38 and +$38 and Y speed between
;;     -$1C and +$1C,
;; reversing direction each time the limit is reached. Also runs the face animation and attack scheduler.
;; $03A4D2: face animation. Frame counter bits 3-4 pick $A498 for 32 frames out of every 256, else face
;;     0.
$03:A49C 20 D2 A4     JSR.W $A4D2                     ; Animate the face ($A4D2)
$03:A49F 20 FD A4     JSR.W $A4FD                     ; Run the attack scheduler ($A4FD)
$03:A4A2 20 ED A4     JSR.W $A4ED                     ; Turn to face Mario every 32 frames ($A4ED)
$03:A4A5 BD 28 15     LDA.W $1528,X                   ; \
$03:A4A8 29 01        AND.B #$01                      ; } Y = [$1528] AND 1: X direction of acceleration
$03:A4AA A8           TAY                             ; /
$03:A4AB B5 B6        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; \
$03:A4AD 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:A4AE 79 90 A4     ADC.W $A490,Y                   ; } X speed += $A490[Y] (+1 or -1)
$03:A4B1 95 B6        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; /
$03:A4B3 D9 92 A4     CMP.W $A492,Y                   ; Reached the X speed limit?
$03:A4B6 D0 03        BNE $A4BB
$03:A4B8 FE 28 15     INC.W $1528,X                   ; Yes: reverse the X acceleration direction ([$1528]++)
$03:A4BB BD 34 15     LDA.W $1534,X                   ; \
$03:A4BE 29 01        AND.B #$01                      ; } Y = [$1534] AND 1: Y direction of acceleration
$03:A4C0 A8           TAY                             ; /
$03:A4C1 B5 AA        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; \
$03:A4C3 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:A4C4 79 94 A4     ADC.W $A494,Y                   ; } Y speed += $A494[Y] (+1 or -1)
$03:A4C7 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; /
$03:A4C9 D9 96 A4     CMP.W $A496,Y                   ; Reached the Y speed limit?
$03:A4CC D0 03        BNE $A4D1
$03:A4CE FE 34 15     INC.W $1534,X                   ; Yes: reverse the Y acceleration direction ([$1534]++)
$03:A4D1 60           RTS                             ; Return

$03:A4D2 A0 00        LDY.B #$00                      ; Y = 0: default face
$03:A4D4 A5 13        LDA RAM_FrameCounter            ; Frame counter AND $E0: only animate during the first 32 of every 256 frames
$03:A4D6 29 E0        AND.B #$E0
$03:A4D8 D0 0C        BNE $A4E6                       ; Not in that window: use face 0
$03:A4DA A5 13        LDA RAM_FrameCounter
$03:A4DC 29 18        AND.B #$18                      ; \
$03:A4DE 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:A4DF 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:A4E0 4A           LSR                             ; } Y = ([frame counter] AND $18) / 8: animation step
$03:A4E1 A8           TAY                             ; /
$03:A4E2 B9 98 A4     LDA.W $A498,Y                   ; Face frame from $A498
$03:A4E5 A8           TAY 
$03:A4E6 98           TYA                             ; A = face frame
$03:A4E7 9D 70 15     STA.W $1570,X                   ; Bowser face frame [$1570]
$03:A4EA 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $A4EB..A4EB: Table: sprite direction toward Mario ;;;

$03:A4EB              .db $80,$00                     ; Sprite direction [$157C] values: $80 / $00 (indexed by side Mario is on)

;;; $A4ED: Bowser: face Mario and attack scheduler ;;;
{
;; $03A4ED: every 32 frames, sets Bowser's direction [$157C] so he looks at Mario.
;; $03A4FD: attack scheduler, run when the phase timer [$14B0] is 0. In state 8 it starts a Bowser Ball throw
;;     ([$14B6] = $FF) the first two times
;; (counted in [$14B8]) and then falls to the Mechakoopa drop: [$14B1] = $FF, only if sprite slot 0 or 1 is
;;     free.
;; Called by:
;;     $03:A4A2: Bowser state 7: hover and face Mario
;;     $03:AB27: Bowser state 8: chase Mario
;;     $03:AB6F: Bowser phase 9: bounce on the floor
$03:A4ED A5 13        LDA RAM_FrameCounter            ; Frame counter AND $1F: every 32 frames
$03:A4EF 29 1F        AND.B #$1F
$03:A4F1 D0 09        BNE $A4FC                       ; Other frames: return
$03:A4F3 20 17 B8     JSR.W SubHorzPosBnk3            ; Y = side of Mario (0 = right, 1 = left)
$03:A4F6 B9 EB A4     LDA.W $A4EB,Y                   ; Face direction from table
$03:A4F9 9D 7C 15     STA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; Sprite direction [$157C] (turn toward Mario)
$03:A4FC 60           RTS                             ; Return

$03:A4FD AD B0 14     LDA.W $14B0                     ; Phase timer [$14B0] non-zero: no attack yet
$03:A500 D0 2A        BNE $A52C
$03:A502 BD 1C 15     LDA.W $151C,X                   ; Bowser state
$03:A505 C9 08        CMP.B #$08                      ; State 8 (chase Mario)?
$03:A507 D0 11        BNE $A51A                       ; No: drop Mechakoopas instead
$03:A509 EE B8 14     INC.W $14B8                     ; Ball counter [$14B8]++
$03:A50C AD B8 14     LDA.W $14B8
$03:A50F C9 03        CMP.B #$03                      ; Third time: reset and drop Mechakoopas
$03:A511 F0 07        BEQ $A51A
$03:A513 A9 FF        LDA.B #$FF                      ; Start the Bowser Ball throw: ball timer [$14B6] = $FF
$03:A515 8D B6 14     STA.W $14B6
$03:A518 80 12        BRA $A52C                       ; Done

$03:A51A 9C B8 14     STZ.W $14B8                     ; Ball counter [$14B8] = 0
$03:A51D AD C8 14     LDA.W $14C8                     ; Sprite slot 0 status
$03:A520 F0 05        BEQ $A527                       ; Slot 0 free: can spawn
$03:A522 AD C9 14     LDA.W $14C9                     ; Sprite slot 1 status
$03:A525 D0 05        BNE $A52C                       ; Slot 1 also in use: skip
$03:A527 A9 FF        LDA.B #$FF                      ; Start the Mechakoopa drop: timer [$14B1] = $FF
$03:A529 8D B1 14     STA.W $14B1
$03:A52C 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $A5AD: Bowser: Mechakoopa drop and ball throw ;;;
{
;; Called every frame from the main routine. If the Mechakoopa timer [$14B1] runs, animates the face and
;;     spawns a Mechakoopa (sprite $A2, $B019)
;; when it hits $80, then skips the rest of the main routine (PLA, PLA). Else if the ball timer [$14B6] runs,
;;     does the same and spawns a
;; Bowser Ball (sprite $A1) at timer $80. When a timer finishes it sets the next phase timer [$14B0].
;; $03A61D: spawn the Bowser Ball in slot 8 at Bowser X + 8, Y + $40.
;; Called by:
;;     $03:A31A: Bowser main logic
$03:A5AD AD B1 14     LDA.W $14B1                     ; Mechakoopa drop timer [$14B1]
$03:A5B0 F0 26        BEQ $A5D8                       ; Zero: check the ball throw instead
$03:A5B2 CE B1 14     DEC.W $14B1                     ; Timer--
$03:A5B5 D0 06        BNE $A5BD                       ; Not finished: animate
$03:A5B7 A9 54        LDA.B #$54                      ; Finished: phase timer [$14B0] = $54
$03:A5B9 8D B0 14     STA.W $14B0
$03:A5BC 60           RTS                             ; Return

$03:A5BD 4A           LSR                             ; \
$03:A5BE 4A           LSR                             ; } Y = timer / 4
$03:A5BF A8           TAY                             ; /
$03:A5C0 B9 2D A5     LDA.W $A52D,Y                   ; Face frame from $A52D
$03:A5C3 9D 70 15     STA.W $1570,X                   ; Bowser face frame [$1570]
$03:A5C6 AD B1 14     LDA.W $14B1                     ; Timer at $80?
$03:A5C9 C9 80        CMP.B #$80
$03:A5CB D0 08        BNE $A5D5                       ; No
$03:A5CD 20 19 B0     JSR.W $B019                     ; Spawn a Mechakoopa (sprite $A2) from Bowser ($B019)
$03:A5D0 A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; \
$03:A5D2 8D FC 1D     STA.W $1DFC                     ; / Play sound effect $08
$03:A5D5 68           PLA                             ; \
$03:A5D6 68           PLA                             ; / Discard return address: skip the rest of Bowser main routine this frame
$03:A5D7 60           RTS                             ; Return

$03:A5D8 AD B6 14     LDA.W $14B6                     ; Ball throw timer [$14B6]
$03:A5DB F0 30        BEQ $A60D                       ; Zero: nothing to do
$03:A5DD CE B6 14     DEC.W $14B6                     ; Timer--
$03:A5E0 F0 2C        BEQ $A60E                       ; Reached 0: set the next phase timer
$03:A5E2 4A           LSR                             ; \
$03:A5E3 4A           LSR                             ; } Y = timer / 4
$03:A5E4 A8           TAY                             ; /
$03:A5E5 B9 2D A5     LDA.W $A52D,Y                   ; Face frame from $A52D
$03:A5E8 9D 70 15     STA.W $1570,X                   ; Bowser face frame [$1570]
$03:A5EB B9 6D A5     LDA.W $A56D,Y                   ; Tilt value from $A56D
$03:A5EE 85 36        STA $36                         ; [$36] = tilt low
$03:A5F0 64 37        STZ $37                         ; [$37] = 0
$03:A5F2 C9 FF        CMP.B #$FF                      ; Tilt = $FF (maximum)?
$03:A5F4 D0 06        BNE $A5FC
$03:A5F6 64 36        STZ $36                         ; Yes: [$36] = 0 and [$37] = 1 (tilt $0100)
$03:A5F8 E6 37        INC $37
$03:A5FA 64 64        STZ $64                         ; [$64] = 0 (sprite priority)
$03:A5FC AD B6 14     LDA.W $14B6                     ; Timer at $80?
$03:A5FF C9 80        CMP.B #$80
$03:A601 D0 08        BNE $A60B                       ; No
$03:A603 A9 09        LDA.B #$09                      ; \
$03:A605 8D FC 1D     STA.W $1DFC                     ; / Play sound effect $09
$03:A608 20 1D A6     JSR.W $A61D                     ; Spawn the Bowser Ball ($A61D)
$03:A60B 68           PLA                             ; \
$03:A60C 68           PLA                             ; / Discard return address: skip the rest of Bowser main routine this frame
$03:A60D 60           RTS                             ; Return

$03:A60E A9 60        LDA.B #$60                      ; Phase timer = $60 after the third ball
$03:A610 AC B8 14     LDY.W $14B8                     ; [$14B8]
$03:A613 C0 02        CPY.B #$02                      ; Third ball?
$03:A615 F0 02        BEQ $A619
$03:A617 A9 20        LDA.B #$20                      ; Otherwise phase timer = $20
$03:A619 8D B0 14     STA.W $14B0                     ; Phase timer [$14B0]
$03:A61C 60           RTS                             ; Return

$03:A61D A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; Status of slot 8 = 8 (normal)
$03:A61F 8D D0 14     STA.W $14D0
$03:A622 A9 A1        LDA.B #$A1                      ; Sprite number of slot 8 = $A1 (Bowser Ball)
$03:A624 85 A6        STA $A6
$03:A626 B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; \
$03:A628 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:A629 69 08        ADC.B #$08                      ; } Ball X low = Bowser X + 8
$03:A62B 85 EC        STA $EC                         ; /
$03:A62D BD E0 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; \
$03:A630 69 00        ADC.B #$00                      ; } Ball X high (carry)
$03:A632 8D E8 14     STA.W $14E8                     ; /
$03:A635 B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$03:A637 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:A638 69 40        ADC.B #$40                      ; } Ball Y low = Bowser Y + $40
$03:A63A 85 E0        STA $E0                         ; /
$03:A63C BD D4 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; \
$03:A63F 69 00        ADC.B #$00                      ; } Ball Y high (carry)
$03:A641 8D DC 14     STA.W $14DC                     ; /
$03:A644 DA           PHX                             ; Save Bowser index
$03:A645 A2 08        LDX.B #$08                      ; X = 8: the ball slot
$03:A647 22 D2 F7 07  JSL.L InitSpriteTables          ; Initialize sprite tables for the ball
$03:A64B FA           PLX                             ; Restore Bowser index
$03:A64C 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

$03:A64D              .db $00,$00,$00,$00,$FC,$F8,$F4,$F0 ; Mode 7 shake [$36] when Bowser is hit, by [$14B5] / 4 (signed)

;;; $A661: Bowser: hurt reaction ;;;
{
;; Called every frame. While the hurt timer [$14B5] runs, cancels attacks, shakes Bowser and flickers his
;;     face, then skips the rest of the main routine.
;; When it ends, decrements the hits-left counter [$187B]. At 0 Bowser goes to state 1 (retreat), or to state
;;     4 if he was in state 9 (probably the defeat).
;; Called by:
;;     $03:A2E1: Bowser main logic
$03:A661 AD B5 14     LDA.W $14B5                     ; Hurt timer [$14B5]
$03:A664 F0 59        BEQ $A6BF                       ; Zero: not hurt, return
$03:A666 9C B1 14     STZ.W $14B1                     ; Cancel the Mechakoopa drop
$03:A669 9C B6 14     STZ.W $14B6                     ; Cancel the ball throw
$03:A66C CE B5 14     DEC.W $14B5                     ; Hurt timer--
$03:A66F D0 20        BNE $A691                       ; Still hurt: animate
$03:A671 A9 50        LDA.B #$50                      ; Hurt finished: phase timer [$14B0] = $50
$03:A673 8D B0 14     STA.W $14B0
$03:A676 DE 7B 18     DEC.W $187B,X                   ; Hits-left counter [$187B]--
$03:A679 D0 16        BNE $A691                       ; Hits left: keep going
$03:A67B BD 1C 15     LDA.W $151C,X                   ; Bowser state
$03:A67E C9 09        CMP.B #$09                      ; State 9?
$03:A680 F0 3E        BEQ $A6C0                       ; Yes: go to the defeat state
$03:A682 A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; Hits-left counter [$187B] = 2
$03:A684 9D 7B 18     STA.W $187B,X
$03:A687 A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; Bowser state = 1 (retreat)
$03:A689 9D 1C 15     STA.W $151C,X
$03:A68C A9 80        LDA.B #$80                      ; Timer [$1540] = $80
$03:A68E 9D 40 15     STA.W $1540,X
$03:A691 7A           PLY                             ; \
$03:A692 7A           PLY                             ; / Discard return address: skip the rest of Bowser main routine this frame
$03:A693 48           PHA                             ; Save A
$03:A694 AD B5 14     LDA.W $14B5                     ; Hurt timer
$03:A697 4A           LSR                             ; \
$03:A698 4A           LSR                             ; } Y = timer / 4
$03:A699 A8           TAY                             ; /
$03:A69A B9 4D A6     LDA.W $A64D,Y                   ; Shake value from $A64D
$03:A69D 85 36        STA $36                         ; [$36] = shake low (signed)
$03:A69F 64 37        STZ $37                         ; [$37] = 0
$03:A6A1 10 02        BPL $A6A5                       ; Positive: keep
$03:A6A3 E6 37        INC $37                         ; Negative: [$37] = 1
$03:A6A5 68           PLA                             ; Restore A
$03:A6A6 A0 0C        LDY.B #$0C                      ; Y = $0C: hurt face frame
$03:A6A8 C9 40        CMP.B #$40                      ; A >= $40?
$03:A6AA B0 0A        BCS $A6B6                       ; Yes: keep hurt face
$03:A6AC A5 13        LDA RAM_FrameCounter            ; Frame counter
$03:A6AE A0 10        LDY.B #$10                      ; Y = $10
$03:A6B0 29 04        AND.B #$04                      ; Bit 2 of the frame counter
$03:A6B2 F0 02        BEQ $A6B6                       ; Clear: face $10
$03:A6B4 A0 12        LDY.B #$12                      ; Set: face $12 (flicker)
$03:A6B6 98           TYA 
$03:A6B7 9D 70 15     STA.W $1570,X                   ; Bowser face frame [$1570]
$03:A6BA A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; [$1427] = 2 (probably Bowser animation / palette flag)
$03:A6BC 8D 27 14     STA.W $1427
$03:A6BF 60           RTS                             ; Return

$03:A6C0 A9 04        LDA.B #$04                      ; Bowser state = 4 (defeated)
$03:A6C2 9D 1C 15     STA.W $151C,X
$03:A6C5 74 B6        STZ RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; X speed = 0
$03:A6C7 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $A6C8: Kill all sprites except bosses (KillMostSprites) ;;;
{
;; Sets every sprite in slots 0-9 to status 4 (killed by spin jump) with a smoke timer of $1F, except Reznor
;;     ($A9), Koopa Kid ($29), Bowser ($A0)
;; and Big Boo Boss ($C5). Long call (RTL).
;; Called by:
;;     $01:FB6A: Iggy/Larry: tilting-platform Koopaling (PlatformKoopaKids)
;;     $03:81A9: Big Boo boss: remaining states and helpers
;;     $03:9902: Reznor: check all Reznors dead (ReznorNoLevelEnd)
;;     $03:B13D: Bowser Mario and Mecha-Koopa contact
;;     $03:CED7: Koopa Kid states 5-6 and Mario contact
$03:A6C8 A0 09        LDY.B #$09                      ; Y = 9: sprite slot counter
$03:A6CA B9 C8 14     LDA.W $14C8,Y                   ; Sprite status
$03:A6CD F0 1D        BEQ $A6EC                       ; Empty: next slot
$03:A6CF B9 9E 00     LDA.W RAM_SpriteNum,Y           ; Sprite number
$03:A6D2 C9 A9        CMP.B #$A9                      ; $A9 (Reznor)?
$03:A6D4 F0 16        BEQ $A6EC                       ; Keep it
$03:A6D6 C9 29        CMP.B #$29                      ; $29 (Koopa Kid)?
$03:A6D8 F0 12        BEQ $A6EC                       ; Keep it
$03:A6DA C9 A0        CMP.B #$A0                      ; $A0 (Bowser)?
$03:A6DC F0 0E        BEQ $A6EC                       ; Keep it
$03:A6DE C9 C5        CMP.B #$C5                      ; $C5 (Big Boo Boss)?
$03:A6E0 F0 0A        BEQ $A6EC                       ; Keep it
$03:A6E2 A9 04        LDA.B #$04                      ; \
$03:A6E4 99 C8 14     STA.W $14C8,Y                   ; / Sprite status = 4 (killed by spin jump)
$03:A6E7 A9 1F        LDA.B #$1F                      ; \
$03:A6E9 99 40 15     STA.W $1540,Y                   ; / Smoke cloud timer = $1F
$03:A6EC 88           DEY                             ; \
$03:A6ED 10 DB        BPL $A6CA                       ; / Next slot, loop for slots 9 to 0
$03:A6EF 6B           RTL                             ; Return long


}

;;; $A6F8: Bowser state 1: shake then retreat ;;;
{
;; State 1: while [$1540] counts down Bowser sits still with his face animated (music $17 when it reaches 1),
;;     then moves via $A731.
$03:A6F8 BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; Timer [$1540]
$03:A6FB F0 34        BEQ $A731                       ; Zero: drift away
$03:A6FD C9 01        CMP.B #$01                      ; Timer = 1?
$03:A6FF D0 05        BNE $A706
$03:A701 A0 17        LDY.B #$17                      ; \
$03:A703 8C FB 1D     STY.W $1DFB                     ; / Change music to $17
$03:A706 4A           LSR                             ; \
$03:A707 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:A708 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:A709 4A           LSR                             ; } Y = timer / 16
$03:A70A A8           TAY                             ; /
$03:A70B B9 F0 A6     LDA.W $A6F0,Y                   ; Face frame from $A6F0
$03:A70E 9D 70 15     STA.W $1570,X                   ; Bowser face frame [$1570]
$03:A711 74 B6        STZ RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; X speed = 0
$03:A713 74 AA        STZ RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; Y speed = 0
$03:A715 9E 28 15     STZ.W $1528,X                   ; X accel stage [$1528] = 0
$03:A718 9E 34 15     STZ.W $1534,X                   ; Y accel stage [$1534] = 0
$03:A71B 9C B2 14     STZ.W $14B2                     ; Scale stage [$14B2] = 0
$03:A71E 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $A71F..A72F: Table: Bowser retreat accelerations ;;;
{
;; Pairs for the X, Y and scale stages of the retreat: steps, limits and frame masks.
$03:A71F              .db $01,$FF                     ; X accel step per stage: +1, -1

$03:A721              .db $10,$80                     ; X speed limits: +$10, -$80

$03:A723              .db $07,$03                     ; X accel mask on frame counter: $07, $03

$03:A725              .db $FF,$01                     ; Y accel step per stage: -1, +1

$03:A727              .db $F0,$08                     ; Y speed limits: -$10, +$08

$03:A729              .db $01,$FF                     ; Scale [$38] step per stage: +1, -1

$03:A72B              .db $03,$03                     ; Y accel mask on frame counter: $03, $03

$03:A72D              .db $60,$02                     ; Scale [$38] limits: $60, $02

$03:A72F              .db $01,$01                     ; Scale accel mask on frame counter: $01, $01

}

;;; $A731: Bowser state 1: retreat off-screen ;;;
{
;; Ramps X speed, Y speed and the scale [$38]/[$39] in two stages each. Once scale stage [$14B2] is 2, or
;;     Bowser's X high is $FE,
;; goes to state 3 with timer [$14B0] = $80, picks a random start for the falling objects and starts music
;;     $1D.
$03:A731 BC 28 15     LDY.W $1528,X                   ; Y = X accel stage [$1528]
$03:A734 C0 02        CPY.B #$02                      ; Stage >= 2: done with X
$03:A736 B0 17        BCS $A74F
$03:A738 A5 13        LDA RAM_FrameCounter            ; \
$03:A73A 39 23 A7     AND.W $A723,Y                   ; } Only accelerate on frames matching the mask in $A723
$03:A73D D0 10        BNE $A74F                       ; /
$03:A73F B5 B6        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; \
$03:A741 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:A742 79 1F A7     ADC.W $A71F,Y                   ; } X speed += $A71F[Y]
$03:A745 95 B6        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; /
$03:A747 D9 21 A7     CMP.W $A721,Y                   ; Reached the limit?
$03:A74A D0 03        BNE $A74F
$03:A74C FE 28 15     INC.W $1528,X                   ; Yes: next stage
$03:A74F BC 34 15     LDY.W $1534,X                   ; Y = Y accel stage [$1534]
$03:A752 C0 02        CPY.B #$02                      ; Stage >= 2: done with Y
$03:A754 B0 17        BCS $A76D
$03:A756 A5 13        LDA RAM_FrameCounter            ; \
$03:A758 39 2B A7     AND.W $A72B,Y                   ; } Only accelerate on frames matching the mask in $A72B
$03:A75B D0 10        BNE $A76D                       ; /
$03:A75D B5 AA        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; \
$03:A75F 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:A760 79 25 A7     ADC.W $A725,Y                   ; } Y speed += $A725[Y]
$03:A763 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; /
$03:A765 D9 27 A7     CMP.W $A727,Y                   ; Reached the limit?
$03:A768 D0 03        BNE $A76D
$03:A76A FE 34 15     INC.W $1534,X                   ; Yes: next stage
$03:A76D AC B2 14     LDY.W $14B2                     ; Y = scale stage [$14B2]
$03:A770 C0 02        CPY.B #$02                      ; Stage 2: finished
$03:A772 F0 20        BEQ $A794
$03:A774 A5 13        LDA RAM_FrameCounter            ; \
$03:A776 39 2F A7     AND.W $A72F,Y                   ; } Only change scale on frames matching the mask in $A72F
$03:A779 D0 12        BNE $A78D                       ; /
$03:A77B A5 38        LDA $38                         ; \
$03:A77D 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:A77E 79 29 A7     ADC.W $A729,Y                   ; } [$38] += $A729[Y] (Mode 7 scale, probably)
$03:A781 85 38        STA $38                         ; /
$03:A783 85 39        STA $39                         ; Also store in [$39]
$03:A785 D9 2D A7     CMP.W $A72D,Y                   ; Reached the limit?
$03:A788 D0 03        BNE $A78D
$03:A78A EE B2 14     INC.W $14B2                     ; Yes: next stage
$03:A78D BD E0 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; Bowser X high byte
$03:A790 C9 FE        CMP.B #$FE                      ; Off-screen at $FE?
$03:A792 D0 18        BNE $A7AC                       ; No: keep moving
$03:A794 A9 03        LDA.B #$03                      ; Bowser state = 3 (waiting off-screen)
$03:A796 9D 1C 15     STA.W $151C,X
$03:A799 A9 80        LDA.B #$80                      ; Phase timer [$14B0] = $80
$03:A79B 8D B0 14     STA.W $14B0
$03:A79E 22 F9 AC 01  JSL.L GetRand                   ; Random number
$03:A7A2 29 F0        AND.B #$F0                      ; Keep the high nibble
$03:A7A4 8D B7 14     STA.W $14B7                     ; Falling object X start [$14B7] = random multiple of $10
$03:A7A7 A9 1D        LDA.B #$1D
$03:A7A9 8D FB 1D     STA.W $1DFB                     ; Change music to $1D
$03:A7AC 60           RTS                             ; Return

$03:A7AD A9 60        LDA.B #$60                      ; Scale [$38] = $60
$03:A7AF 85 38        STA $38
$03:A7B1 85 39        STA $39                         ; Scale [$39] = $60
$03:A7B3 A9 FF        LDA.B #$FF                      ; Bowser X high = $FF
$03:A7B5 9D E0 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X
$03:A7B8 A9 60        LDA.B #$60                      ; Bowser X low = $60 (off-screen to the left)
$03:A7BA 95 E4        STA RAM_SpriteXLo,X
$03:A7BC AD B0 14     LDA.W $14B0                     ; Phase timer [$14B0]
$03:A7BF D0 1E        BNE $A7DF                       ; Non-zero: spawn objects while it runs
$03:A7C1 A9 18        LDA.B #$18                      ; Music $18
$03:A7C3 8D FB 1D     STA.W $1DFB                     ; / Change music
$03:A7C6 A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; Bowser state = 2 (return)
$03:A7C8 9D 1C 15     STA.W $151C,X
$03:A7CB A9 18        LDA.B #$18                      ; Bowser Y low = $18
$03:A7CD 95 D8        STA RAM_SpriteYLo,X
$03:A7CF A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; Bowser Y high = 0
$03:A7D1 9D D4 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X
$03:A7D4 A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; Scale [$38] = 8
$03:A7D6 85 38        STA $38
$03:A7D8 85 39        STA $39                         ; Scale [$39] = 8
$03:A7DA A9 64        LDA.B #$64                      ; X speed = $64
$03:A7DC 95 B6        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X
$03:A7DE 60           RTS                             ; Return

$03:A7DF C9 60        CMP.B #$60                      ; Timer >= $60: wait
$03:A7E1 B0 5D        BCS $A840
$03:A7E3 A5 13        LDA RAM_FrameCounter            ; Every 32 frames only
$03:A7E5 29 1F        AND.B #$1F
$03:A7E7 D0 57        BNE $A840
$03:A7E9 A0 07        LDY.B #$07                      ; Y = 7: look for a free slot from 7 down to 2
$03:A7EB B9 C8 14     LDA.W $14C8,Y                   ; Slot status
$03:A7EE F0 06        BEQ $A7F6                       ; Free: use it
$03:A7F0 88           DEY                             ; Next slot
$03:A7F1 C0 01        CPY.B #$01
$03:A7F3 D0 F6        BNE $A7EB
$03:A7F5 60           RTS                             ; No free slot: return

$03:A7F6 A9 17        LDA.B #$17                      ; \
$03:A7F8 8D FC 1D     STA.W $1DFC                     ; / Play sound effect $17
$03:A7FB A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; \
$03:A7FD 99 C8 14     STA.W $14C8,Y                   ; / Sprite status = 8 (normal)
$03:A800 A9 33        LDA.B #$33                      ; Sprite number $33
$03:A802 99 9E 00     STA.W RAM_SpriteNum,Y
$03:A805 AD B7 14     LDA.W $14B7                     ; Falling object X position [$14B7]
$03:A808 48           PHA                             ; Save it
$03:A809 99 E4 00     STA.W RAM_SpriteXLo,Y           ; Sprite X low
$03:A80C 18           CLC                             ; Next object is $20 further along
$03:A80D 69 20        ADC.B #$20
$03:A80F 8D B7 14     STA.W $14B7
$03:A812 A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; X high = 0
$03:A814 99 E0 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,Y
$03:A817 A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; Y low = 0 (top of the screen)
$03:A819 99 D8 00     STA.W RAM_SpriteYLo,Y
$03:A81C 99 D4 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,Y           ; Y high = 0
$03:A81F DA           PHX                             ; Save Bowser index
$03:A820 BB           TYX                             ; X = new sprite
$03:A821 22 D2 F7 07  JSL.L InitSpriteTables          ; Initialize sprite tables
$03:A825 F6 C2        INC RAM_SpriteState,X           ; Sprite state [$00C2]++
$03:A827 1E 86 16     ASL.W RAM_Tweaker1686,X         ; Clear bit 7 of tweaker [$1686]
$03:A82A 5E 86 16     LSR.W RAM_Tweaker1686,X
$03:A82D A9 39        LDA.B #$39                      ; Tweaker [$1662] = $39 (sprite clipping)
$03:A82F 9D 62 16     STA.W RAM_Tweaker1662,X
$03:A832 FA           PLX                             ; Restore Bowser index
$03:A833 68           PLA                             ; Saved X position
$03:A834 4A           LSR                             ; \
$03:A835 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:A836 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:A837 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:A838 4A           LSR                             ; } Y = X position / 32: column 0-7
$03:A839 A8           TAY                             ; /
$03:A83A B9 41 A8     LDA.W BowserSound,Y             ; Sound from BowserSound[Y] (a note per column)
$03:A83D 8D FC 1D     STA.W $1DFC                     ; Play it ($1DFC)
$03:A840 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $A841: Table: Bowser sound effect (first entry) (BowserSound) ;;;
{
;; Sound effect values for $1DFC indexed by column / 32; it continues in the next label.
$03:A841              .db $2D                         ; Sound effect $2D (start of a note table of 8 sounds)

}

;;; $A842: Bowser state 2 and music table (BowserSoundMusic) ;;;
{
;; $03A842: table of values indexed by [$14B4], written to $1DFB (music) at timer $3F; the first 8 bytes also
;;     serve as sound effects for BowserSound.
;; State 2 ($03A84B): Bowser slows, scales up to $20, drops a Super Mushroom at timer $A0, plays sound $2A at
;;     $E8 and at timer 1 switches to state [$14B4] + 1.
$03:A842              .db $2E,$2F,$30,$31,$32,$33,$34,$19 ; Values indexed by [$14B4]: $2E-$34, $19, $1A; also the rest of BowserSound
$03:A84A              .db $1A

$03:A84B 74 AA        STZ RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; Y speed = 0
$03:A84D BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; Timer [$1540]
$03:A850 D0 1C        BNE $A86E                       ; Running: go handle it
$03:A852 B5 B6        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; X speed
$03:A854 F0 02        BEQ $A858                       ; Zero: skip
$03:A856 D6 B6        DEC RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; Slow down: X speed--
$03:A858 A5 13        LDA RAM_FrameCounter            ; Frame counter AND 3
$03:A85A 29 03        AND.B #$03
$03:A85C D0 0F        BNE $A86D                       ; Only every 4th frame
$03:A85E E6 38        INC $38                         ; Scale [$38]++
$03:A860 E6 39        INC $39                         ; Scale [$39]++
$03:A862 A5 38        LDA $38                         ; Scale reached $20?
$03:A864 C9 20        CMP.B #$20
$03:A866 D0 05        BNE $A86D                       ; No: wait
$03:A868 A9 FF        LDA.B #$FF                      ; Timer [$1540] = $FF
$03:A86A 9D 40 15     STA.W $1540,X
$03:A86D 60           RTS                             ; Return

$03:A86E C9 A0        CMP.B #$A0                      ; Timer = $A0?
$03:A870 D0 05        BNE $A877
$03:A872 48           PHA                             ; Save timer
$03:A873 20 D6 A8     JSR.W $A8D6                     ; Spawn a Super Mushroom ($A8D6)
$03:A876 68           PLA                             ; Restore timer
$03:A877 74 B6        STZ RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; X speed = 0
$03:A879 74 AA        STZ RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; Y speed = 0
$03:A87B C9 01        CMP.B #$01                      ; Timer = 1?
$03:A87D F0 1E        BEQ $A89D                       ; Yes: go to the next state
$03:A87F C9 40        CMP.B #$40                      ; Timer >= $40?
$03:A881 B0 2B        BCS $A8AE                       ; Yes: flash
$03:A883 C9 3F        CMP.B #$3F                      ; Timer = $3F?
$03:A885 D0 0B        BNE $A892
$03:A887 48           PHA                             ; Save timer
$03:A888 AC B4 14     LDY.W $14B4                     ; Phase counter [$14B4] (probably)
$03:A88B B9 42 A8     LDA.W BowserSoundMusic,Y        ; Value from BowserSoundMusic[Y]
$03:A88E 8D FB 1D     STA.W $1DFB                     ; Change music
$03:A891 68           PLA                             ; Restore timer
$03:A892 4A           LSR                             ; \
$03:A893 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:A894 4A           LSR                             ; } Y = timer / 8
$03:A895 A8           TAY                             ; /
$03:A896 B9 37 A4     LDA.W $A437,Y                   ; Face frame from $A437
$03:A899 9D 70 15     STA.W $1570,X                   ; Bowser face frame [$1570]
$03:A89C 60           RTS                             ; Return

$03:A89D AD B4 14     LDA.W $14B4                     ; Next state = [$14B4] + 1
$03:A8A0 1A           INC A
$03:A8A1 9D 1C 15     STA.W $151C,X                   ; Bowser state
$03:A8A4 74 B6        STZ RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; X speed = 0
$03:A8A6 74 AA        STZ RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; Y speed = 0
$03:A8A8 A9 80        LDA.B #$80                      ; Phase timer [$14B0] = $80
$03:A8AA 8D B0 14     STA.W $14B0
$03:A8AD 60           RTS                             ; Return

$03:A8AE C9 E8        CMP.B #$E8                      ; Timer = $E8?
$03:A8B0 D0 05        BNE $A8B7
$03:A8B2 A0 2A        LDY.B #$2A                      ; \
$03:A8B4 8C F9 1D     STY.W $1DF9                     ; / Play sound effect $2A on $1DF9
$03:A8B7 38           SEC                             ; Peach animation counter [$1594] = timer - $3F (probably)
$03:A8B8 E9 3F        SBC.B #$3F
$03:A8BA 9D 94 15     STA.W $1594,X
$03:A8BD 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

$03:A8BE              .db $00,$00,$00,$08,$10,$14,$14,$16 ; Vertical offset by [$1594] / 8: the rising and falling motion of the drawn object
$03:A8C6              .db $16,$18,$18,$17,$16,$16,$17,$18
$03:A8CE              .db $18,$17,$14,$10,$0C,$08,$04,$00

;;; $A8D6: Spawn Super Mushroom from Bowser ;;;
{
;; Finds a free sprite slot (7 down to 2), makes it a Super Mushroom (sprite $74) at Bowser X + 4, Y + $18,
;;     thrown upward ($C0) and sideways toward the screen center.
;; Called by:
;;     $03:A873: Bowser state 2 and music table (BowserSoundMusic)
$03:A8D6 A0 07        LDY.B #$07                      ; Y = 7: look for a free slot from 7 down to 2
$03:A8D8 B9 C8 14     LDA.W $14C8,Y                   ; Slot status
$03:A8DB F0 06        BEQ $A8E3                       ; Free: use it
$03:A8DD 88           DEY                             ; Next slot
$03:A8DE C0 01        CPY.B #$01
$03:A8E0 D0 F6        BNE $A8D8
$03:A8E2 60           RTS                             ; No free slot: return

$03:A8E3 A9 10        LDA.B #$10                      ; \
$03:A8E5 8D F9 1D     STA.W $1DF9                     ; / Play sound effect $10 on $1DF9
$03:A8E8 A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; \
$03:A8EA 99 C8 14     STA.W $14C8,Y                   ; / Sprite status = 8 (normal)
$03:A8ED A9 74        LDA.B #$74                      ; Sprite number $74 (Super Mushroom)
$03:A8EF 99 9E 00     STA.W RAM_SpriteNum,Y
$03:A8F2 B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; \
$03:A8F4 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:A8F5 69 04        ADC.B #$04                      ; } Mushroom X low = Bowser X + 4
$03:A8F7 99 E4 00     STA.W RAM_SpriteXLo,Y           ; /
$03:A8FA BD E0 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; \
$03:A8FD 69 00        ADC.B #$00                      ; } Mushroom X high (carry)
$03:A8FF 99 E0 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,Y           ; /
$03:A902 B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$03:A904 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:A905 69 18        ADC.B #$18                      ; } Mushroom Y low = Bowser Y + $18
$03:A907 99 D8 00     STA.W RAM_SpriteYLo,Y           ; /
$03:A90A BD D4 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; \
$03:A90D 69 00        ADC.B #$00                      ; } Mushroom Y high (carry)
$03:A90F 99 D4 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,Y           ; /
$03:A912 DA           PHX                             ; Save Bowser index
$03:A913 BB           TYX                             ; X = mushroom
$03:A914 22 D2 F7 07  JSL.L InitSpriteTables          ; Initialize sprite tables
$03:A918 A9 C0        LDA.B #$C0                      ; Y speed = $C0 (thrown upward)
$03:A91A 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X
$03:A91C 9E 7C 15     STZ.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; Direction = 0
$03:A91F A0 0C        LDY.B #$0C                      ; Y = $0C: X speed to the right
$03:A921 B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; Mushroom X low
$03:A923 10 05        BPL $A92A                       ; Left half of the screen: keep
$03:A925 A0 F4        LDY.B #$F4                      ; Y = $F4: X speed to the left
$03:A927 FE 7C 15     INC.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; Direction = 1
$03:A92A 94 B6        STY RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; X speed
$03:A92C FA           PLX                             ; Restore Bowser index
$03:A92D 60           RTS                             ; Return


}
