$03:AA66              .db $40,$40,$40,$40,$40,$40,$40,$40

}

;;; $AA6E: Draw Bowser overlay (probably Peach) ;;;
{
;; Draws a 2x2 group of 16x16 tiles at OAM $70 using the four tables above, indexed by [$03] * 4. Frames 8-15
;;     of the animation also draw two extra
;; sprites at OAM $02A0/$02A4. Identification of the drawn object as Peach is a guess based on the tile data
;;     and the mushroom drop.
;; Parameters: Y: animation step, [$02]: vertical offset, [$03]: frame row.
;; Called by:
;;     $03:A2CA: Bowser main logic
$03:AA6E B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; \
$03:AA70 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:AA71 69 04        ADC.B #$04                      ; |
$03:AA73 38           SEC                             ; |
$03:AA74 E5 1A        SBC RAM_ScreenBndryXLo          ; } $00 = Bowser X + 4 - [layer 1 X low] (screen X)
$03:AA76 85 00        STA $00                         ; /
$03:AA78 B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$03:AA7A 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:AA7B 69 20        ADC.B #$20                      ; |
$03:AA7D 38           SEC                             ; |
$03:AA7E E5 02        SBC $02                         ; |
$03:AA80 38           SEC                             ; |
$03:AA81 E5 1C        SBC RAM_ScreenBndryYLo          ; } $01 = Bowser Y + $20 - [$02] - [layer 1 Y low] (screen Y)
$03:AA83 85 01        STA $01                         ; /
$03:AA85 C0 08        CPY.B #$08                      ; Y (animation index) < 8?
$03:AA87 90 3D        BCC $AAC6                       ; Yes: skip the extra sprites
$03:AA89 C0 10        CPY.B #$10                      ; Y >= $10?
$03:AA8B B0 39        BCS $AAC6                       ; Yes: skip the extra sprites
$03:AA8D A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$03:AA8F 38           SEC                             ; |
$03:AA90 E9 04        SBC.B #$04                      ; } OAM $02A0 X = [$00] - 4
$03:AA92 8D A0 02     STA.W $02A0                     ; /
$03:AA95 18           CLC                             ; \
$03:AA96 69 10        ADC.B #$10                      ; } OAM $02A4 X = [$00] + $0C
$03:AA98 8D A4 02     STA.W $02A4                     ; /
$03:AA9B A5 01        LDA $01                         ; \
$03:AA9D 38           SEC                             ; |
$03:AA9E E9 18        SBC.B #$18                      ; |
$03:AAA0 8D A1 02     STA.W $02A1                     ; } OAM $02A1 and $02A5 Y = [$01] - $18
$03:AAA3 8D A5 02     STA.W $02A5                     ; /
$03:AAA6 A9 20        LDA.B #$20                      ; Tile $20
$03:AAA8 8D A2 02     STA.W $02A2                     ; OAM $02A2 tile
$03:AAAB A9 22        LDA.B #$22                      ; Tile $22
$03:AAAD 8D A6 02     STA.W $02A6                     ; OAM $02A6 tile
$03:AAB0 A5 14        LDA RAM_FrameCounterB           ; \
$03:AAB2 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:AAB3 29 06        AND.B #$06                      ; |
$03:AAB5 1A           INC A                           ; |
$03:AAB6 1A           INC A                           ; } Properties: palette from the frame counter, 3 + 2 * ([frame counter B] / 2 AND 3)
$03:AAB7 1A           INC A                           ; /
$03:AAB8 8D A3 02     STA.W $02A3                     ; OAM $02A3 properties
$03:AABB 8D A7 02     STA.W $02A7                     ; OAM $02A7 properties
$03:AABE A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; Size bits = 2 (16x16)
$03:AAC0 8D 48 04     STA.W $0448                     ; OAM $0448 size
$03:AAC3 8D 49 04     STA.W $0449                     ; OAM $0449 size
$03:AAC6 A0 70        LDY.B #$70                      ; Y = $70: OAM index of the 4 main tiles
$03:AAC8 A5 03        LDA $03                         ; \
$03:AACA 0A           ASL                             ; |
$03:AACB 0A           ASL                             ; } $04 = [$03] * 4: row offset into the tile tables
$03:AACC 85 04        STA $04                         ; /
$03:AACE DA           PHX                             ; Save sprite index
$03:AACF A2 03        LDX.B #$03                      ; X = 3: tile counter
$03:AAD1 DA           PHX                             ; Save counter
$03:AAD2 8A           TXA                             ; \
$03:AAD3 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:AAD4 65 04        ADC $04                         ; } X = counter + [$04]: table index
$03:AAD6 AA           TAX                             ; /
$03:AAD7 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$03:AAD9 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:AADA 7D 2E A9     ADC.W $A92E,X                   ; } OAM X = [$00] + $A92E[X]
$03:AADD 99 00 03     STA.W OAM_DispX,Y               ; /
$03:AAE0 A5 01        LDA $01                         ; \
$03:AAE2 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:AAE3 7D 7E A9     ADC.W $A97E,X                   ; } OAM Y = [$01] + $A97E[X]
$03:AAE6 99 01 03     STA.W OAM_DispY,Y               ; /
$03:AAE9 BD CE A9     LDA.W $A9CE,X                   ; Tile from $A9CE
$03:AAEC 99 02 03     STA.W OAM_Tile,Y                ; OAM tile
$03:AAEF BD 1E AA     LDA.W $AA1E,X                   ; Properties from $AA1E
$03:AAF2 DA           PHX                             ; Save table index
$03:AAF3 AE E9 15     LDX.W $15E9                     ; X = current sprite index
$03:AAF6 E0 09        CPX.B #$09                      ; Sprite slot 9?
$03:AAF8 F0 02        BEQ $AAFC                       ; Yes: keep properties
$03:AAFA 09 30        ORA.B #$30                      ; Otherwise add priority bits $30
$03:AAFC 99 03 03     STA.W OAM_Prop,Y                ; OAM properties
$03:AAFF FA           PLX                             ; Restore table index
$03:AB00 5A           PHY                             ; Save OAM index
$03:AB01 98           TYA                             ; \
$03:AB02 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:AB03 4A           LSR                             ; } Y = OAM index / 4
$03:AB04 A8           TAY                             ; /
$03:AB05 A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; Size = 2 (16x16)
$03:AB07 99 60 04     STA.W OAM_TileSize,Y            ; OAM size table
$03:AB0A 7A           PLY                             ; Restore OAM index
$03:AB0B C8           INY                             ; \
$03:AB0C C8           INY                             ; |
$03:AB0D C8           INY                             ; } Next OAM slot
$03:AB0E C8           INY                             ; /
$03:AB0F FA           PLX                             ; Restore counter
$03:AB10 CA           DEX                             ; Counter--
$03:AB11 10 BE        BPL $AAD1                       ; Loop for 4 tiles
$03:AB13 FA           PLX                             ; Restore sprite index
$03:AB14 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $AB15..AB1B: Table: Bowser chase accelerations ;;;
{
;; X and Y acceleration and speed limits for state 8. The last 4 bytes belong to another routine.
$03:AB15              .db $01,$FF                     ; X acceleration toward Mario: +1, -1

$03:AB17              .db $20,$E0                     ; X speed limits: +$20, -$20

$03:AB19              .db $02,$FE                     ; Y acceleration: +2, -2

$03:AB1B              .db $20,$E0,$01,$FF,$10,$F0     ; Y speed limits: +$20, -$20 (remaining bytes belong to later code)

}

;;; $AB21: Bowser state 8: chase Mario ;;;
{
;; State 8: runs the attack scheduler and face routines. Every frame, accelerates X toward Mario up to +/-$20,
;;     and Y toward screen line $10 at +/-$20.
$03:AB21 20 FD A4     JSR.W $A4FD                     ; Run the attack scheduler ($A4FD)
$03:AB24 20 D2 A4     JSR.W $A4D2                     ; Animate the face ($A4D2)
$03:AB27 20 ED A4     JSR.W $A4ED                     ; Turn to face Mario every 32 frames ($A4ED)
$03:AB2A A5 13        LDA RAM_FrameCounter            ; Frame counter AND 0: always zero, so this runs every frame
$03:AB2C 29 00        AND.B #$00
$03:AB2E D0 1B        BNE $AB4B
$03:AB30 A0 00        LDY.B #$00                      ; Y = 0
$03:AB32 B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; \
$03:AB34 C5 94        CMP RAM_MarioXPos               ; |
$03:AB36 BD E0 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; } Compare Bowser X to Mario X (16-bit)
$03:AB39 E5 95        SBC RAM_MarioXPosHi             ; /
$03:AB3B 30 01        BMI $AB3E                       ; Bowser left of Mario: keep Y = 0
$03:AB3D C8           INY                             ; Bowser right of Mario: Y = 1
$03:AB3E B5 B6        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; X speed
$03:AB40 D9 17 AB     CMP.W $AB17,Y                   ; At the limit already?
$03:AB43 F0 06        BEQ $AB4B                       ; Yes: skip
$03:AB45 18           CLC 
$03:AB46 79 15 AB     ADC.W $AB15,Y                   ; Accelerate toward Mario
$03:AB49 95 B6        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; X speed
$03:AB4B A0 00        LDY.B #$00                      ; Y = 0
$03:AB4D B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; Bowser Y low
$03:AB4F C9 10        CMP.B #$10                      ; Compare with $10
$03:AB51 30 01        BMI $AB54                       ; Above: keep Y = 0
$03:AB53 C8           INY                             ; Below: Y = 1
$03:AB54 B5 AA        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; Y speed
$03:AB56 D9 1B AB     CMP.W $AB1B,Y                   ; At the limit already?
$03:AB59 F0 06        BEQ $AB61                       ; Yes: return
$03:AB5B 18           CLC 
$03:AB5C 79 19 AB     ADC.W $AB19,Y                   ; Accelerate toward Y = $10
$03:AB5F 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; Y speed
$03:AB61 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $AB62..AB62: Table: Bowser hop X speed ;;;
{
;; X speed $10/-$10 by side of Mario (used by the next state).
$03:AB62              .db $10,$F0                     ; X speeds for landing: $10 (Mario on right), $F0

}

;;; $AB64: Bowser phase 9: bounce on the floor ;;;
{
;; Last Bowser phase ([$151C] = 9). Bowser falls with gravity (Y speed += 3) and bounces when he hits Y = $64:
;;     Y speed = $A0,
;; X speed = +/-$10 away from or toward Mario, sound effect and a $20-frame ground shake.
;; Phase 4 ($AB9F): Bowser rises off the top of the screen. Phase 5 ($ABBE): holds still while
;;     [$36]/[$37] counts up,
;; then moves on to phase 6 and starts a music change. Phase 6 ($AC03): spawns Princess Peach, flies off
;;     to the upper left, changes music to $1C.
;; $AC63 (called from phase 6): creates Peach in sprite slot 8 at Bowser X + 8, Y + $47.
$03:AB64 A9 03        LDA.B #$03                      ; \
$03:AB66 8D 27 14     STA.W $1427                     ; / Bowser animation/drawing mode [$1427] = 3
$03:AB69 20 FD A4     JSR.W $A4FD                     ; Handle Bowser's hit timer and Mario contact ($A4FD)
$03:AB6C 20 D2 A4     JSR.W $A4D2                     ; Pick clown car face frame ($A4D2)
$03:AB6F 20 ED A4     JSR.W $A4ED                     ; Every 32 frames turn to face Mario ($A4ED)
$03:AB72 B5 AA        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; \
$03:AB74 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:AB75 69 03        ADC.B #$03                      ; |
$03:AB77 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; / Bowser Y speed += 3 (gravity)
$03:AB79 B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$03:AB7B C9 64        CMP.B #$64                      ; / Bowser Y < $64: still in the air, return
$03:AB7D 90 1F        BCC $AB9E                       ; Return if Y position is above the floor
$03:AB7F BD D4 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; \
$03:AB82 30 1A        BMI $AB9E                       ; / Y high byte negative: above the screen, return
$03:AB84 A9 64        LDA.B #$64                      ; \
$03:AB86 95 D8        STA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; / Bowser Y = $64 (land on the floor)
$03:AB88 A9 A0        LDA.B #$A0                      ; \
$03:AB8A 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; / Y speed = $A0 (bounce up)
$03:AB8C A9 09        LDA.B #$09                      ; \
$03:AB8E 8D FC 1D     STA.W $1DFC                     ; / Sound effect: ground pound / thump
$03:AB91 20 17 B8     JSR.W SubHorzPosBnk3            ; Y = side Mario is on
$03:AB94 B9 62 AB     LDA.W $AB62,Y                   ; \
$03:AB97 95 B6        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; / X speed = $10 or $F0 (away from or toward Mario)
$03:AB99 A9 20        LDA.B #$20                      ; \
$03:AB9B 8D 87 18     STA.W RAM_ShakeGrndTimer        ; / Shake the ground for $20 frames
$03:AB9E 60           RTS                             ; Return

$03:AB9F 20 AC A6     JSR.W $A6AC                     ; Animate the clown car propeller ($A6AC)
$03:ABA2 BD D4 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; \
$03:ABA5 30 08        BMI $ABAF                       ; / Y high byte: above the screen ($FF) goes to the end branch
$03:ABA7 D0 10        BNE $ABB9                       ; Y high non-zero (below top): skip to the rising code
$03:ABA9 B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$03:ABAB C9 10        CMP.B #$10                      ; |
$03:ABAD B0 0A        BCS $ABB9                       ; / Y position >= $10: keep rising
$03:ABAF A9 05        LDA.B #$05                      ; \
$03:ABB1 9D 1C 15     STA.W $151C,X                   ; / Bowser phase [$151C] = 5 (hold in place)
$03:ABB4 A9 60        LDA.B #$60                      ; \
$03:ABB6 9D 40 15     STA.W $1540,X                   ; / Phase timer [$1540] = $60
$03:ABB9 A9 F8        LDA.B #$F8                      ; \
$03:ABBB 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; / Y speed = -8 (fly upward)
$03:ABBD 60           RTS                             ; Return

$03:ABBE 20 AC A6     JSR.W $A6AC                     ; Animate the clown car propeller ($A6AC)
$03:ABC1 74 B6        STZ RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; X speed = 0
$03:ABC3 74 AA        STZ RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; Y speed = 0
$03:ABC5 BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; \
$03:ABC8 D0 21        BNE $ABEB                       ; / Phase timer [$1540] non-zero: go to the countdown handling
$03:ABCA A5 36        LDA $36                         ; \
$03:ABCC 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:ABCD 69 0A        ADC.B #$0A                      ; |
$03:ABCF 85 36        STA $36                         ; } [$36]/[$37] += $0A (16-bit)
$03:ABD1 A5 37        LDA $37                         ; |
$03:ABD3 69 00        ADC.B #$00                      ; |
$03:ABD5 85 37        STA $37                         ; |
$03:ABD7 F0 11        BEQ $ABEA                       ; / Carry into [$37] clear: return
$03:ABD9 64 36        STZ $36                         ; [$36] = 0
$03:ABDB A9 20        LDA.B #$20                      ; \
$03:ABDD 9D 4C 15     STA.W RAM_DisableInter,X        ; / Disable sprite interaction for $20 frames
$03:ABE0 A9 60        LDA.B #$60                      ; \
$03:ABE2 9D 40 15     STA.W $1540,X                   ; / Phase timer [$1540] = $60
$03:ABE5 A9 06        LDA.B #$06                      ; \
$03:ABE7 9D 1C 15     STA.W $151C,X                   ; / Bowser phase [$151C] = 6
$03:ABEA 60           RTS                             ; Return

$03:ABEB C9 40        CMP.B #$40                      ; \
$03:ABED 90 13        BCC $AC02                       ; / Timer < $40: return
$03:ABEF C9 5E        CMP.B #$5E                      ; \
$03:ABF1 D0 05        BNE $ABF8                       ; / Timer = $5E? No: skip
$03:ABF3 A0 1B        LDY.B #$1B                      ; \
$03:ABF5 8C FB 1D     STY.W $1DFB                     ; / Change music to $1B
$03:ABF8 BD 64 15     LDA.W $1564,X                   ; \
$03:ABFB D0 05        BNE $AC02                       ; / Animation timer [$1564] already running: return
$03:ABFD A9 12        LDA.B #$12                      ; \
$03:ABFF 9D 64 15     STA.W $1564,X                   ; / Start the $1564 animation timer at $12
$03:AC02 60           RTS                             ; Return

$03:AC03 20 AC A6     JSR.W $A6AC                     ; Animate the clown car propeller ($A6AC)
$03:AC06 BD 4C 15     LDA.W RAM_DisableInter,X        ; \
$03:AC09 C9 01        CMP.B #$01                      ; / Interaction-disable timer = 1 (about to expire)?
$03:AC0B D0 15        BNE $AC22                       ; Not yet: skip the Peach spawn
$03:AC0D A9 0B        LDA.B #$0B                      ; \
$03:AC0F 85 71        STA RAM_MarioAnimation          ; / Mario animation [$71] = $0B (disappear/freeze, ending pose)
$03:AC11 EE 0D 19     INC.W $190D                     ; [$190D]++ (probably flags the Peach-appears event)
$03:AC14 9C 01 07     STZ.W $0701                     ; Clear $0701 (background color low)
$03:AC17 9C 02 07     STZ.W $0702                     ; Clear $0702 (background color high)
$03:AC1A A9 03        LDA.B #$03                      ; \
$03:AC1C 8D F9 13     STA.W RAM_IsBehindScenery       ; / Mario is behind scenery [$13F9] = 3
$03:AC1F 20 63 AC     JSR.W $AC63                     ; Spawn Princess Peach ($AC63)
$03:AC22 BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; \
$03:AC25 D0 25        BNE $AC4C                       ; / Timer [$1540] non-zero: return
$03:AC27 A9 FA        LDA.B #$FA                      ; \
$03:AC29 95 B6        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; / X speed = $FA (fly left)
$03:AC2B A9 FC        LDA.B #$FC                      ; \
$03:AC2D 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; / Y speed = $FC (fly up)
$03:AC2F A5 36        LDA $36                         ; \
$03:AC31 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:AC32 69 05        ADC.B #$05                      ; |
$03:AC34 85 36        STA $36                         ; } [$36]/[$37] += $05 (16-bit)
$03:AC36 A5 37        LDA $37                         ; |
$03:AC38 69 00        ADC.B #$00                      ; |
$03:AC3A 85 37        STA $37                         ; /
$03:AC3C A5 13        LDA RAM_FrameCounter            ; \
$03:AC3E 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; |
$03:AC40 D0 0A        BNE $AC4C                       ; / Every 4th frame only
$03:AC42 A5 38        LDA $38                         ; \
$03:AC44 C9 80        CMP.B #$80                      ; / [$38] >= $80: finished, go to AC4D
$03:AC46 B0 05        BCS $AC4D                       ; [$38]++
$03:AC48 E6 38        INC $38                         ; [$39]++
$03:AC4A E6 39        INC $39
$03:AC4C 60           RTS                             ; Return

$03:AC4D BD 4A 16     LDA.W $164A,X                   ; \
$03:AC50 D0 08        BNE $AC5A                       ; / Already switched music? [$164A] non-zero: skip
$03:AC52 A9 1C        LDA.B #$1C                      ; \
$03:AC54 8D FB 1D     STA.W $1DFB                     ; / Change music to $1C
$03:AC57 FE 4A 16     INC.W $164A,X                   ; Mark the music as changed
$03:AC5A A9 FE        LDA.B #$FE                      ; \
$03:AC5C 9D E0 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; |
$03:AC5F 9D D4 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; / Set X and Y high bytes to $FE: move the clown car far off-screen
$03:AC62 60           RTS                             ; Return

$03:AC63 A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; \
$03:AC65 8D D0 14     STA.W $14D0                     ; / Slot 8 sprite status [$14D0] = 8 (normal)
$03:AC68 A9 7C        LDA.B #$7C                      ; \
$03:AC6A 85 A6        STA $A6                         ; / Slot 8 sprite number [$A6] = $7C: Princess Peach
$03:AC6C B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; \
$03:AC6E 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:AC6F 69 08        ADC.B #$08                      ; |
$03:AC71 85 EC        STA $EC                         ; |
$03:AC73 BD E0 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; |
$03:AC76 69 00        ADC.B #$00                      ; } Peach X = Bowser X + $08 (slot 8: low [$EC], high [$14E8])
$03:AC78 8D E8 14     STA.W $14E8                     ; /
$03:AC7B B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$03:AC7D 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:AC7E 69 47        ADC.B #$47                      ; |
$03:AC80 85 E0        STA $E0                         ; |
$03:AC82 BD D4 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; |
$03:AC85 69 00        ADC.B #$00                      ; } Peach Y = Bowser Y + $47 (slot 8: low [$E0], high [$14DC])
$03:AC87 8D DC 14     STA.W $14DC                     ; /
$03:AC8A DA           PHX                             ; Save X
$03:AC8B A2 08        LDX.B #$08                      ; X = 8: Peach's sprite slot
$03:AC8D 22 D2 F7 07  JSL.L InitSpriteTables          ; Initialize slot 8's sprite tables (InitSpriteTables)
$03:AC91 FA           PLX                             ; Restore X
$03:AC92 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $AC93: Data: heart Y offsets for Peach scene (BlushTileDispY) ;;;
{
$03:AC93              .db $01,$11                     ; Heart Y offsets: $01 for big Mario (X=0), $11 for small Mario (X=1)

;;; $AC95: Data: heart tiles for Peach scene (BlushTiles) ;;;
{
$03:AC95              .db $6E,$88                     ; Heart tiles: $6E for big Mario, $88 for small Mario

;;; $AC97: Princess Peach main routine (PrincessPeach) ;;;
{
;; Sprite $7C. Draws Peach (two 16x16 tiles via $AAC8), blinks at random (1 in 8 every 128 frames) and,
;;     while [$1558] is
;; running, draws a small heart/blush tile next to Mario. Freezes both Peach and Mario X speed, then runs the
;;     state routine in PeachPtrs.
;; Called by:
;;     $03:A157: Bank 3 sprite main dispatch (Bnk3CallSprMain)
$03:AC97 B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; \
$03:AC99 38           SEC                             ; |
$03:AC9A E5 1A        SBC RAM_ScreenBndryXLo          ; |
$03:AC9C 85 00        STA $00                         ; / [$00] = Peach screen X position
$03:AC9E B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$03:ACA0 38           SEC                             ; |
$03:ACA1 E5 1C        SBC RAM_ScreenBndryYLo          ; |
$03:ACA3 85 01        STA $01                         ; / [$01] = Peach screen Y position
$03:ACA5 A5 13        LDA RAM_FrameCounter            ; \
$03:ACA7 29 7F        AND.B #$7F                      ; / Every 128 frames
$03:ACA9 D0 0D        BNE $ACB8                       ; Not yet: skip
$03:ACAB 22 F9 AC 01  JSL.L GetRand                   ; Get a random number
$03:ACAF 29 07        AND.B #$07                      ; \
$03:ACB1 D0 05        BNE $ACB8                       ; / 1 in 8 chance
$03:ACB3 A9 0C        LDA.B #$0C                      ; \
$03:ACB5 9D 4C 15     STA.W RAM_DisableInter,X        ; / Blink timer [$154C] = $0C
$03:ACB8 BC 02 16     LDY.W $1602,X                   ; Y = Peach pose frame [$1602]
$03:ACBB BD 4C 15     LDA.W RAM_DisableInter,X        ; \
$03:ACBE F0 01        BEQ $ACC1                       ; / Blink timer running?
$03:ACC0 C8           INY                             ; Y++ (blinking frame)
$03:ACC1 BD 7C 15     LDA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; \
$03:ACC4 D0 05        BNE $ACCB                       ; / Facing left? (direction 0) go on, else skip
$03:ACC6 98           TYA                             ; \
$03:ACC7 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:ACC8 69 08        ADC.B #$08                      ; |
$03:ACCA A8           TAY                             ; / Facing direction 0: add 8 to the frame number
$03:ACCB 84 03        STY $03                         ; [$03] = frame number
$03:ACCD A9 D0        LDA.B #$D0                      ; \
$03:ACCF 9D EA 15     STA.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X         ; / OAM index = $D0
$03:ACD2 A8           TAY                             ; Y = $D0
$03:ACD3 20 C8 AA     JSR.W $AAC8                     ; Draw Peach's tiles ($AAC8)
$03:ACD6 A0 02        LDY.B #$02                      ; Y = 2: 16x16 tiles
$03:ACD8 A9 03        LDA.B #$03                      ; A = 3: draw 4 tiles
$03:ACDA 22 B3 B7 01  JSL.L FinishOAMWrite            ; Finish OAM write (FinishOAMWrite)
$03:ACDE BD 58 15     LDA.W $1558,X                   ; \
$03:ACE1 F0 35        BEQ $AD18                       ; / Blush/heart timer [$1558] = 0: skip the extra sprite
$03:ACE3 DA           PHX                             ; Save X
$03:ACE4 A2 00        LDX.B #$00                      ; X = 0
$03:ACE6 A5 19        LDA RAM_MarioPowerUp            ; \
$03:ACE8 D0 01        BNE $ACEB                       ; / X = 0 for powered-up Mario, X = 1 for small Mario (index into heart tables)
$03:ACEA E8           INX                             ; |
$03:ACEB A0 4C        LDY.B #$4C                      ; Y = $4C: OAM slot for the extra tile
$03:ACED A5 7E        LDA $7E                         ; \
$03:ACEF 99 00 03     STA.W OAM_DispX,Y               ; / OAM X = Mario screen X [$7E]
$03:ACF2 A5 80        LDA $80                         ; \
$03:ACF4 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:ACF5 7D 93 AC     ADC.W BlushTileDispY,X          ; |
$03:ACF8 99 01 03     STA.W OAM_DispY,Y               ; / OAM Y = Mario screen Y [$80] + heart Y offset
$03:ACFB BD 95 AC     LDA.W BlushTiles,X              ; \
$03:ACFE 99 02 03     STA.W OAM_Tile,Y                ; / OAM tile = heart tile
$03:AD01 FA           PLX                             ; Restore X
$03:AD02 A5 76        LDA RAM_MarioDirection          ; \
$03:AD04 C9 01        CMP.B #$01                      ; |
$03:AD06 A9 31        LDA.B #$31                      ; |
$03:AD08 90 02        BCC $AD0C                       ; |
$03:AD0A 09 40        ORA.B #$40                      ; |
$03:AD0C 99 03 03     STA.W OAM_Prop,Y                ; / OAM property = $31, flip X if Mario faces right
$03:AD0F 98           TYA                             ; \
$03:AD10 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:AD11 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:AD12 A8           TAY                             ; / Y = OAM index / 4
$03:AD13 A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; \
$03:AD15 99 60 04     STA.W OAM_TileSize,Y            ; / OAM size = 16x16 for this tile
$03:AD18 74 B6        STZ RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; X speed = 0
$03:AD1A 64 7B        STZ RAM_MarioSpeedX             ; Mario X speed = 0 (Mario cannot walk away)
$03:AD1C A9 04        LDA.B #$04                      ; \
$03:AD1E 9D 02 16     STA.W $1602,X                   ; / Peach pose frame [$1602] = 4
$03:AD21 B5 C2        LDA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; A = Peach state [$C2]
$03:AD23 22 DF 86 00  JSL.L ExecutePtr                ; Run the state routine below

}

;;; $AD27: Pointer table: Peach states, state 0-1 (PeachPtrs) ;;;
{
;; 8 states in [$C2]: 0 fall to ground (sparkles), 1 wait and face Mario, 2 walk together, 3 wait, 4 wait and
;;     blink, 5 ending picture, 6 fade, 7 start credits ($C796).
;; State 0: falls to Y = $A0 and spawns sparkles every 8 frames. State 1: waits for [$1540], faces Mario.
;;     $ADCC: contact check between Peach and Mario (carry set if touching).
$03:AD27 37 AD        .dw $AD37                       ; State 0: Peach falls to the ground
$03:AD29 B3 AD        .dw $ADB3                       ; State 1: wait, then face Mario
$03:AD2B DD AD        .dw $ADDD                       ; State 2: Peach and Mario approach each other
$03:AD2D 25 AE        .dw $AE25                       ; State 3: wait
$03:AD2F 32 AE        .dw $AE32                       ; State 4: wait, then fade the screen
$03:AD31 AF AE        .dw $AEAF                       ; State 5: show the ending picture step by step
$03:AD33 E8 AE        .dw $AEE8                       ; State 6: fade out
$03:AD35 96 C7        .dw $C796                       ; State 7: start the credits ($C796)

$03:AD37 A9 06        LDA.B #$06                      ; \
$03:AD39 9D 02 16     STA.W $1602,X                   ; / Peach pose [$1602] = 6 (falling)
$03:AD3C 22 1A 80 01  JSL.L UpdateYPosNoGrvty         ; Update Y position with no gravity
$03:AD40 B5 AA        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; \
$03:AD42 C9 08        CMP.B #$08                      ; |
$03:AD44 B0 05        BCS $AD4B                       ; / Y speed >= 8: stop accelerating
$03:AD46 18           CLC                             ; \
$03:AD47 69 01        ADC.B #$01                      ; |
$03:AD49 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; / Y speed++ (gravity)
$03:AD4B BD D4 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; \
$03:AD4E 30 13        BMI $AD63                       ; / Y high byte negative: skip the landing check
$03:AD50 B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$03:AD52 C9 A0        CMP.B #$A0                      ; |
$03:AD54 90 0D        BCC $AD63                       ; / Y < $A0: still falling
$03:AD56 A9 A0        LDA.B #$A0                      ; \
$03:AD58 95 D8        STA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; / Peach Y = $A0 (ground)
$03:AD5A 74 AA        STZ RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; Y speed = 0
$03:AD5C A9 A0        LDA.B #$A0                      ; \
$03:AD5E 9D 40 15     STA.W $1540,X                   ; / Timer [$1540] = $A0
$03:AD61 F6 C2        INC RAM_SpriteState,X           ; Peach state++
$03:AD63 A5 13        LDA RAM_FrameCounter            ; \
$03:AD65 29 07        AND.B #$07                      ; / Every 8 frames spawn a sparkle
$03:AD67 D0 0A        BNE $AD73                       ; Else return
$03:AD69 A0 0B        LDY.B #$0B                      ; Y = $0B: search extended sprite slots
$03:AD6B B9 F0 17     LDA.W $17F0,Y                   ; \
$03:AD6E F0 04        BEQ $AD74                       ; / Slot Y free? Use it
$03:AD70 88           DEY                             ; \
$03:AD71 10 F8        BPL $AD6B                       ; / Next slot
$03:AD73 60           RTS                             ; Return

$03:AD74 A9 05        LDA.B #$05                      ; \
$03:AD76 99 F0 17     STA.W $17F0,Y                   ; / Minor extended sprite slot Y = type 5 (sparkle)
$03:AD79 22 F9 AC 01  JSL.L GetRand                   ; Get a random number (GetRand)
$03:AD7D 64 00        STZ $00                         ; \
$03:AD7F 29 1F        AND.B #$1F                      ; |
$03:AD81 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:AD82 69 F8        ADC.B #$F8                      ; |
$03:AD84 10 02        BPL $AD88                       ; |
$03:AD86 C6 00        DEC $00                         ; |
$03:AD88 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:AD89 75 E4        ADC RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; |
$03:AD8B 99 08 18     STA.W $1808,Y                   ; } Sparkle X = Peach X + random -8..+23 (high byte via [$00])
$03:AD8E BD E0 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; |
$03:AD91 65 00        ADC $00                         ; |
$03:AD93 99 EA 18     STA.W $18EA,Y                   ; /
$03:AD96 AD 8E 14     LDA.W RAM_RandomByte2           ; \
$03:AD99 29 1F        AND.B #$1F                      ; |
$03:AD9B 75 D8        ADC RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; |
$03:AD9D 99 FC 17     STA.W $17FC,Y                   ; } Sparkle Y = Peach Y + random 0..$1F
$03:ADA0 BD D4 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; |
$03:ADA3 69 00        ADC.B #$00                      ; |
$03:ADA5 99 14 18     STA.W $1814,Y                   ; /
$03:ADA8 A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; \
$03:ADAA 99 20 18     STA.W $1820,Y                   ; / Sparkle sprite table $1820 = 0
$03:ADAD A9 17        LDA.B #$17                      ; \
$03:ADAF 99 50 18     STA.W $1850,Y                   ; / Sparkle lifetime = $17
$03:ADB2 60           RTS                             ; Return

$03:ADB3 BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; \
$03:ADB6 D0 0A        BNE $ADC2                       ; / Timer [$1540] non-zero: skip ahead to face Mario
$03:ADB8 F6 C2        INC RAM_SpriteState,X           ; Peach state++
$03:ADBA 20 CC AD     JSR.W $ADCC                     ; Check contact with Mario ($ADCC)
$03:ADBD 90 03        BCC $ADC2                       ; No contact: skip
$03:ADBF FE 1C 15     INC.W $151C,X                   ; Unused. Sets the flag [$151C] when Peach already touches Mario.
$03:ADC2 20 17 B8     JSR.W SubHorzPosBnk3            ; Y = side Mario is on
$03:ADC5 98           TYA                             ; \
$03:ADC6 9D 7C 15     STA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; / Peach faces Mario
$03:ADC9 85 76        STA RAM_MarioDirection          ; Mario faces Peach
$03:ADCB 60           RTS                             ; Return

$03:ADCC 22 9F B6 03  JSL.L GetSpriteClippingA        ; Get Peach's clipping box (GetSpriteClippingA)
$03:ADD0 22 64 B6 03  JSL.L GetMarioClipping          ; Get Mario's clipping box (GetMarioClipping)
$03:ADD4 22 2B B7 03  JSL.L CheckForContact           ; Check for contact; carry set if touching
$03:ADD8 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $ADD9..ADD9: Data: Peach walk X speeds ;;;
{
$03:ADD9              .db $08,$F8,$F8,$08             ; Walk speeds toward each other: $08, $F8, $F8, $08

}

;;; $ADDD: Peach states 2-4: walk to Mario, wait ;;;
{
;; State 2: Peach and Mario walk toward each other until they touch, then both face each other and [$1540] =
;;     $60. State 3 waits, State 4 blinks and starts the blush timer.
$03:ADDD A5 14        LDA RAM_FrameCounterB           ; \
$03:ADDF 29 08        AND.B #$08                      ; |
$03:ADE1 D0 05        BNE $ADE8                       ; |
$03:ADE3 A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; |
$03:ADE5 9D 02 16     STA.W $1602,X                   ; / Every 16 frames toggle pose [$1602] = 8
$03:ADE8 20 CC AD     JSR.W $ADCC                     ; Check contact with Mario ($ADCC)
$03:ADEB 08           PHP                             ; Save the contact flag
$03:ADEC 20 17 B8     JSR.W SubHorzPosBnk3            ; Y = side Mario is on
$03:ADEF 28           PLP                             ; Restore the contact flag
$03:ADF0 BD 1C 15     LDA.W $151C,X                   ; \
$03:ADF3 D0 04        BNE $ADF9                       ; / [$151C] set? Use the unused branch
$03:ADF5 B0 1D        BCS $AE14                       ; Contact: go to AE14
$03:ADF7 80 06        BRA $ADFF                       ; Else walk toward Mario

$03:ADF9 90 19        BCC $AE14                       ; Unused branch for [$151C] non-zero, no contact
$03:ADFB 98           TYA                             ; \
$03:ADFC 49 01        EOR.B #$01                      ; |
$03:ADFE A8           TAY                             ; / Y ^= 1 (reverse direction)
$03:ADFF B9 D9 AD     LDA.W $ADD9,Y                   ; \
$03:AE02 95 B6        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; / Peach X speed = $ADD9[Y]
$03:AE04 49 FF        EOR.B #$FF                      ; \
$03:AE06 1A           INC A                           ; |
$03:AE07 85 7B        STA RAM_MarioSpeedX             ; / Mario X speed = -(Peach X speed)
$03:AE09 98           TYA                             ; \
$03:AE0A 9D 7C 15     STA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; |
$03:AE0D 85 76        STA RAM_MarioDirection          ; / Peach and Mario face direction Y
$03:AE0F 22 22 80 01  JSL.L UpdateXPosNoGrvty         ; Move Peach horizontally
$03:AE13 60           RTS                             ; Return

$03:AE14 20 17 B8     JSR.W SubHorzPosBnk3            ; Y = side Mario is on
$03:AE17 98           TYA                             ; \
$03:AE18 9D 7C 15     STA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; |
$03:AE1B 85 76        STA RAM_MarioDirection          ; / Peach and Mario face each other
$03:AE1D F6 C2        INC RAM_SpriteState,X           ; Peach state++
$03:AE1F A9 60        LDA.B #$60                      ; \
$03:AE21 9D 40 15     STA.W $1540,X                   ; / Timer [$1540] = $60
$03:AE24 60           RTS                             ; Return

$03:AE25 BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; \
$03:AE28 D0 07        BNE $AE31                       ; / Timer [$1540] non-zero: return
$03:AE2A F6 C2        INC RAM_SpriteState,X           ; Peach state++
$03:AE2C A9 A0        LDA.B #$A0                      ; \
$03:AE2E 9D 40 15     STA.W $1540,X                   ; / Timer [$1540] = $A0
$03:AE31 60           RTS                             ; Return

$03:AE32 BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; \
$03:AE35 D0 08        BNE $AE3F                       ; / Timer [$1540] non-zero: skip
$03:AE37 F6 C2        INC RAM_SpriteState,X           ; Peach state++
$03:AE39 9C 8A 18     STZ.W $188A                     ; Clear $188A (probably ending-picture counter)
$03:AE3C 9C 8B 18     STZ.W $188B                     ; Clear $188B
$03:AE3F C9 50        CMP.B #$50                      ; \
$03:AE41 90 17        BCC $AE5A                       ; / Timer < $50: return
$03:AE43 48           PHA                             ; Save the timer
$03:AE44 D0 05        BNE $AE4B                       ; Timer = $50 exactly? Else skip
$03:AE46 A9 14        LDA.B #$14                      ; \
$03:AE48 9D 4C 15     STA.W RAM_DisableInter,X        ; / Blink timer [$154C] = $14
$03:AE4B A9 0A        LDA.B #$0A                      ; \
$03:AE4D 9D 02 16     STA.W $1602,X                   ; / Peach pose [$1602] = $0A
$03:AE50 68           PLA                             ; Restore the timer
$03:AE51 C9 68        CMP.B #$68                      ; \
$03:AE53 D0 05        BNE $AE5A                       ; / Timer = $68? Else return
$03:AE55 A9 80        LDA.B #$80                      ; \
$03:AE57 9D 58 15     STA.W $1558,X                   ; / Start blush timer [$1558] = $80
$03:AE5A 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $AE5B..AEAB: Data: ending picture step delays ;;;
{
;; $55 bytes: frame delay per step of the ending picture, indexed by [$1921].
$03:AE5B              .db $08,$08,$08,$08,$08,$08,$18,$08 ; Ending picture delays: timers in frames for each step (index = [$1921])
$03:AE63              .db $08,$08,$08,$08,$08,$08,$08,$08 ; Delay table row
$03:AE6B              .db $08,$08,$08,$08,$08,$08,$20,$08 ; Delay table row
$03:AE73              .db $08,$08,$08,$08,$20,$08,$08,$10 ; Delay table row
$03:AE7B              .db $08,$08,$08,$08,$08,$08,$08,$08 ; Delay table row
$03:AE83              .db $20,$08,$08,$08,$08,$08,$20,$08 ; Delay table row
$03:AE8B              .db $04,$20,$08,$08,$08,$08,$08,$08 ; Delay table row
$03:AE93              .db $08,$08,$08,$08,$08,$08,$10,$08 ; Delay table row
$03:AE9B              .db $08,$08,$08,$08,$08,$08,$08,$08 ; Delay table row
$03:AEA3              .db $08,$08,$10,$08,$08,$08,$08,$08 ; Delay table row
$03:AEAB              .db $08,$08,$08,$40             ; Delay table row (last delay $40)

}

;;; $AEAF: Peach state 5: ending picture steps ;;;
{
;; Draws the ending picture ($D674) and advances one step ([$1921]) each time [$1540] expires, using
;;     $AE5B delays. After step $54 moves to state 6. $AED0: state++, [$1FEB] = $80.
$03:AEAF 20 74 D6     JSR.W $D674                     ; Draw the ending picture so far ($D674)
$03:AEB2 BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; \
$03:AEB5 D0 10        BNE $AEC7                       ; / Timer [$1540] non-zero: return
$03:AEB7 AC 21 19     LDY.W $1921                     ; Y = ending picture step [$1921]
$03:AEBA C0 54        CPY.B #$54                      ; \
$03:AEBC F0 0A        BEQ $AEC8                       ; / Step $54: the last one, go to AEC8
$03:AEBE EE 21 19     INC.W $1921                     ; Step++
$03:AEC1 B9 5B AE     LDA.W $AE5B,Y                   ; \
$03:AEC4 9D 40 15     STA.W $1540,X                   ; / Timer = delay for this step
$03:AEC7 60           RTS                             ; Return

$03:AEC8 F6 C2        INC RAM_SpriteState,X           ; Peach state++
$03:AECA A9 40        LDA.B #$40                      ; \
$03:AECC 9D 40 15     STA.W $1540,X                   ; / Timer [$1540] = $40
$03:AECF 60           RTS                             ; Return

$03:AED0 F6 C2        INC RAM_SpriteState,X           ; Peach state++
$03:AED2 A9 80        LDA.B #$80                      ; \
$03:AED4 8D EB 1F     STA.W $1FEB                     ; / [$1FEB] = $80 (probably starts the credits)
$03:AED7 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $AED8..AEE0: Unused. Data, purpose unclear ;;;
{
$03:AED8              .db $00,$00,$94,$18,$18,$9C,$9C,$FF ; Unused. Palette-like data, purpose unclear.
$03:AEE0              .db $00,$00,$52,$63,$63,$73,$73,$7F

}

;;; $AEE8: Peach state 6: fade ending color ;;;
{
;; Writes a grey CGRAM color $F1 (value = timer/2 replicated into R, G, B) to the palette buffer each frame so
;;     the ending picture fades; redraws the picture. When [$1540] reaches 0, goes to $AED0.
$03:AEE8 BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; \
$03:AEEB F0 E3        BEQ $AED0                       ; / Timer [$1540] = 0: go to AED0
$03:AEED 4A           LSR                             ; \
$03:AEEE 85 00        STA $00                         ; |
$03:AEF0 64 01        STZ $01                         ; / [$00] = timer / 2
$03:AEF2 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$03:AEF4 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$03:AEF6 0A           ASL                             ; |
$03:AEF7 0A           ASL                             ; |
$03:AEF8 0A           ASL                             ; |
$03:AEF9 0A           ASL                             ; |
$03:AEFA 0A           ASL                             ; |
$03:AEFB 05 00        ORA $00                         ; |
$03:AEFD 85 00        STA $00                         ; / [$00] = v | v<<5
$03:AEFF 0A           ASL                             ; \
$03:AF00 0A           ASL                             ; |
$03:AF01 0A           ASL                             ; |
$03:AF02 0A           ASL                             ; |
$03:AF03 0A           ASL                             ; |
$03:AF04 05 00        ORA $00                         ; |
$03:AF06 85 00        STA $00                         ; / [$00] = v | v<<5 | v<<10 (grey color value v)
$03:AF08 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$03:AF0A DA           PHX                             ; Save X
$03:AF0B AA           TAX                             ; X = A
$03:AF0C AC 81 06     LDY.W $0681                     ; Y = palette write buffer index [$0681]
$03:AF0F A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; \
$03:AF11 99 82 06     STA.W $0682,Y                   ; / Palette buffer: size 2
$03:AF14 A9 F1        LDA.B #$F1                      ; \
$03:AF16 99 83 06     STA.W $0683,Y                   ; / Palette buffer: CGRAM color $F1
$03:AF19 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$03:AF1B 99 84 06     STA.W $0684,Y                   ; / Color low byte
$03:AF1E A5 01        LDA $01                         ; \
$03:AF20 99 85 06     STA.W $0685,Y                   ; / Color high byte
$03:AF23 A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; \
$03:AF25 99 86 06     STA.W $0686,Y                   ; / Terminator $00
$03:AF28 98           TYA                             ; \
$03:AF29 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:AF2A 69 04        ADC.B #$04                      ; |
$03:AF2C 8D 81 06     STA.W $0681                     ; / Buffer index += 4
$03:AF2F FA           PLX                             ; Restore X
$03:AF30 20 74 D6     JSR.W $D674                     ; Draw the ending picture ($D674)
$03:AF33 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $AF34..AF54: Data: Bowser hit star offsets and tiles ;;;

$03:AF54              .db $38,$3A,$3E,$46,$54

;;; $AF59: Draw hit stars and puffs around Bowser ;;;
{
;; Called while [$14B5] (hit flash timer) is non-zero. Draws 4 stars (tile $59) circling Bowser and, for the
;;     first $68 frames of [$14B3], a trail of smoke puffs (tile $49); then copies the 5 OAM entries into the
;;     extended OAM area.
;; Called by:
;;     $03:A2AA: Bowser main logic
$03:AF59 20 60 B7     JSR.W GetDrawInfoBnk3           ; Get OAM draw info for Bowser (GetDrawInfoBnk3)
$03:AF5C BD 7C 15     LDA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; \
$03:AF5F 85 04        STA $04                         ; / [$04] = Bowser direction
$03:AF61 A5 14        LDA RAM_FrameCounterB           ; \
$03:AF63 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:AF64 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:AF65 29 07        AND.B #$07                      ; |
$03:AF67 85 02        STA $02                         ; / [$02] = ([$14] >> 2) AND 7: rotation phase
$03:AF69 A9 EC        LDA.B #$EC                      ; \
$03:AF6B 9D EA 15     STA.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X         ; / OAM index = $EC
$03:AF6E A8           TAY                             ; Y = $EC
$03:AF6F DA           PHX                             ; Save X
$03:AF70 A2 03        LDX.B #$03                      ; X = 3: draw 4 sparkles
$03:AF72 DA           PHX                             ; Save X
$03:AF73 8A           TXA                             ; \
$03:AF74 0A           ASL                             ; |
$03:AF75 0A           ASL                             ; |
$03:AF76 65 02        ADC $02                         ; |
$03:AF78 29 07        AND.B #$07                      ; |
$03:AF7A AA           TAX                             ; / X = (X * 4 + [$02]) AND 7: position on the circle
$03:AF7B A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$03:AF7D 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:AF7E 7D 34 AF     ADC.W $AF34,X                   ; |
$03:AF81 99 00 03     STA.W OAM_DispX,Y               ; / OAM X = [$00] + sparkle X offset
$03:AF84 A5 01        LDA $01                         ; \
$03:AF86 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:AF87 7D 3C AF     ADC.W $AF3C,X                   ; |
$03:AF8A 99 01 03     STA.W OAM_DispY,Y               ; / OAM Y = [$01] + sparkle Y offset
$03:AF8D A9 59        LDA.B #$59                      ; \
$03:AF8F 99 02 03     STA.W OAM_Tile,Y                ; / Tile $59 (star)
$03:AF92 BD 44 AF     LDA.W $AF44,X                   ; \
$03:AF95 05 64        ORA $64                         ; |
$03:AF97 99 03 03     STA.W OAM_Prop,Y                ; / Property from $AF44 ORed with [$64] (priority)
$03:AF9A FA           PLX                             ; Restore X
$03:AF9B C8           INY                             ; \
$03:AF9C C8           INY                             ; |
$03:AF9D C8           INY                             ; |
$03:AF9E C8           INY                             ; / Next OAM slot (Y += 4)
$03:AF9F CA           DEX                             ; X--
$03:AFA0 10 D0        BPL $AF72                       ; Loop for all 4
$03:AFA2 AD B3 14     LDA.W $14B3                     ; \
$03:AFA5 EE B3 14     INC.W $14B3                     ; / A = [$14B3]; then [$14B3]++ (Bowser-hit effect timer)
$03:AFA8 4A           LSR                             ; \
$03:AFA9 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:AFAA 4A           LSR                             ; / Divide by 8
$03:AFAB C9 0D        CMP.B #$0D                      ; \
$03:AFAD B0 28        BCS $AFD7                       ; / >= $0D: effect finished, skip
$03:AFAF AA           TAX                             ; X = frame of the effect
$03:AFB0 A0 FC        LDY.B #$FC                      ; Y = $FC: last OAM slot of the extra tile
$03:AFB2 A5 04        LDA $04                         ; \
$03:AFB4 0A           ASL                             ; |
$03:AFB5 2A           ROL                             ; |
$03:AFB6 0A           ASL                             ; |
$03:AFB7 0A           ASL                             ; |
$03:AFB8 0A           ASL                             ; |
$03:AFB9 65 00        ADC $00                         ; / Add [$00] plus $15 with direction-based offset
$03:AFBB 18           CLC                             ; \
$03:AFBC 69 15        ADC.B #$15                      ; / X offset +$15
$03:AFBE 99 00 03     STA.W OAM_DispX,Y               ; OAM X = result
$03:AFC1 A5 01        LDA $01                         ; \
$03:AFC3 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:AFC4 7F 4C AF 03  ADC.L $AF4C,X                   ; / OAM Y = [$01] + $AF4C[X]
$03:AFC8 99 01 03     STA.W OAM_DispY,Y               ; Store OAM Y
$03:AFCB A9 49        LDA.B #$49                      ; \
$03:AFCD 99 02 03     STA.W OAM_Tile,Y                ; / Tile $49 (smoke puff)
$03:AFD0 A9 07        LDA.B #$07                      ; \
$03:AFD2 05 64        ORA $64                         ; |
$03:AFD4 99 03 03     STA.W OAM_Prop,Y                ; / Property $07 ORed with [$64]
$03:AFD7 FA           PLX                             ; Restore X
$03:AFD8 A0 00        LDY.B #$00                      ; Y = 0: 8x8 tiles
$03:AFDA A9 04        LDA.B #$04                      ; A = 4: draw 5 tiles
$03:AFDC 22 B3 B7 01  JSL.L FinishOAMWrite            ; Finish OAM write (FinishOAMWrite)
$03:AFE0 BC EA 15     LDY.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X         ; Y = OAM index
$03:AFE3 DA           PHX                             ; Save X
$03:AFE4 A2 04        LDX.B #$04                      ; X = 4: copy 5 tiles
$03:AFE6 B9 00 03     LDA.W OAM_DispX,Y               ; \
$03:AFE9 99 00 02     STA.W OAM_ExtendedDispX,Y       ; / Copy OAM X to extended OAM area
$03:AFEC B9 01 03     LDA.W OAM_DispY,Y               ; \
$03:AFEF 99 01 02     STA.W OAM_ExtendedDispY,Y       ; / Copy OAM Y
$03:AFF2 B9 02 03     LDA.W OAM_Tile,Y                ; \
$03:AFF5 99 02 02     STA.W OAM_ExtendedTile,Y        ; / Copy tile
$03:AFF8 B9 03 03     LDA.W OAM_Prop,Y                ; \
$03:AFFB 99 03 02     STA.W OAM_ExtendedProp,Y        ; / Copy property
$03:AFFE 5A           PHY                             ; Save Y
$03:AFFF 98           TYA                             ; \
$03:B000 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:B001 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:B002 A8           TAY                             ; / Y = OAM index / 4
$03:B003 B9 60 04     LDA.W OAM_TileSize,Y            ; \
$03:B006 99 20 04     STA.W $0420,Y                   ; / Copy tile size to the $0420 table
$03:B009 7A           PLY                             ; Restore Y
$03:B00A C8           INY                             ; \
$03:B00B C8           INY                             ; |
$03:B00C C8           INY                             ; |
$03:B00D C8           INY                             ; / Next slot (Y += 4)
$03:B00E CA           DEX                             ; X--
$03:B00F 10 D5        BPL $AFE6                       ; Loop for all 5
$03:B011 FA           PLX                             ; Restore X
$03:B012 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $B019: Bowser drops two Mecha-Koopas ;;;
{
;; Finds a free sprite slot (0 or 1) twice and spawns Mecha-Koopa ($A2, status 8) at Bowser X + 0 / + $10, Y +
;;     $10, with X speed $F8 / $08 and Y speed $C0. Parameters: [$02] = side (0 left, 1 right).
;; Called by:
;;     $03:A5CD: Bowser: Mechakoopa drop and ball throw
$03:B019 64 02        STZ $02                         ; \
$03:B01B 20 20 B0     JSR.W $B020                     ; / Clear [$02]; spawn the left Mecha-Koopa
$03:B01E E6 02        INC $02                         ; [$02] = 1: spawn the right one
$03:B020 A0 01        LDY.B #$01                      ; Y = 1: search sprite slots 1 and 0
$03:B022 B9 C8 14     LDA.W $14C8,Y                   ; \
$03:B025 F0 04        BEQ $B02B                       ; / Slot Y empty (status 0)? Use it
$03:B027 88           DEY                             ; \
$03:B028 10 F8        BPL $B022                       ; / Next slot; none free: return
$03:B02A 60           RTS                             ; Return

$03:B02B A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; \
$03:B02D 99 C8 14     STA.W $14C8,Y                   ; / Status = 8 (normal)
$03:B030 A9 A2        LDA.B #$A2                      ; \
$03:B032 99 9E 00     STA.W RAM_SpriteNum,Y           ; / Sprite number $A2: Mecha-Koopa
$03:B035 B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$03:B037 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:B038 69 10        ADC.B #$10                      ; |
$03:B03A 99 D8 00     STA.W RAM_SpriteYLo,Y           ; / Y position = Bowser Y + $10
$03:B03D BD D4 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; \
$03:B040 69 00        ADC.B #$00                      ; |
$03:B042 99 D4 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,Y           ; / Y high byte
$03:B045 B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; \
$03:B047 85 00        STA $00                         ; / [$00] = Bowser X low
$03:B049 BD E0 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; \
$03:B04C 85 01        STA $01                         ; / [$01] = Bowser X high
$03:B04E DA           PHX                             ; Save X
$03:B04F A6 02        LDX $02                         ; X = [$02]: which side
$03:B051 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$03:B053 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:B054 7D 13 B0     ADC.W $B013,X                   ; |
$03:B057 99 E4 00     STA.W RAM_SpriteXLo,Y           ; / X low = Bowser X + $B013[X]
$03:B05A A5 01        LDA $01                         ; \
$03:B05C 7D 15 B0     ADC.W $B015,X                   ; |
$03:B05F 99 E0 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,Y           ; / X high = Bowser X high + $B015[X] (carry)
$03:B062 BB           TYX                             ; X = new sprite slot
$03:B063 22 D2 F7 07  JSL.L InitSpriteTables          ; Initialize the new sprite's tables
$03:B067 A4 02        LDY $02                         ; Y = [$02]
$03:B069 B9 17 B0     LDA.W $B017,Y                   ; \
$03:B06C 95 B6        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; / X speed = $B017[Y]
$03:B06E A9 C0        LDA.B #$C0                      ; \
$03:B070 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; / Y speed = $C0 (toss upward)
$03:B072 FA           PLX                             ; Restore X
$03:B073 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $B078: Bowser Mario and Mecha-Koopa contact ;;;
{
;; Runs when Bowser is in phase 7 or later and [$38] = $20. Checks carried Mecha-Koopas against Bowser
;;     ($B0DC/03B0F3), then three Bowser hitboxes against Mario via MarioSprInteract (Tweaker $24-$26):
;; first two shove Mario away; the last hurts him. Mecha-Koopa hit starts the hit flash [$14B5] = $4C and
;;     kills the sprite.
;; Called by:
;;     $03:A305: Bowser main logic
$03:B078 A5 38        LDA $38                         ; \
$03:B07A C9 20        CMP.B #$20                      ; |
$03:B07C D0 5D        BNE $B0DB                       ; / Return unless [$38] = $20
$03:B07E BD 1C 15     LDA.W $151C,X                   ; \
$03:B081 C9 07        CMP.B #$07                      ; |
$03:B083 90 6D        BCC $B0F2                       ; / Bowser phase [$151C] < 7: return
$03:B085 A5 36        LDA $36                         ; \
$03:B087 05 37        ORA $37                         ; |
$03:B089 D0 67        BNE $B0F2                       ; / Return while [$36]/[$37] is non-zero
$03:B08B 20 DC B0     JSR.W $B0DC                     ; Check carried Mecha-Koopas hitting Bowser ($B0DC)
$03:B08E BD 4C 15     LDA.W RAM_DisableInter,X        ; \
$03:B091 D0 48        BNE $B0DB                       ; / Interaction disabled: return
$03:B093 A9 24        LDA.B #$24                      ; \
$03:B095 9D 62 16     STA.W RAM_Tweaker1662,X         ; / Tweaker $24: first body hitbox
$03:B098 22 DC A7 01  JSL.L MarioSprInteract          ; Check Mario/Bowser contact
$03:B09C 90 1F        BCC $B0BD                       ; No contact: next hitbox
$03:B09E 20 D6 B0     JSR.W $B0D6                     ; Bounce: disable interaction ($B0D6)
$03:B0A1 64 7D        STZ RAM_MarioSpeedY             ; Mario Y speed = 0
$03:B0A3 20 17 B8     JSR.W SubHorzPosBnk3            ; Y = side Mario is on
$03:B0A6 AD B1 14     LDA.W $14B1                     ; \
$03:B0A9 0D B6 14     ORA.W $14B6                     ; |
$03:B0AC F0 05        BEQ $B0B3                       ; / [$14B1] or [$14B6] both zero? (purpose unclear)
$03:B0AE B9 76 B0     LDA.W $B076,Y                   ; Unused. Weaker shove X speed
$03:B0B1 80 03        BRA $B0B6                       ; Skip

$03:B0B3 B9 74 B0     LDA.W $B074,Y                   ; Mario X speed from the strong table
$03:B0B6 85 7B        STA RAM_MarioSpeedX             ; Mario X speed = shove
$03:B0B8 A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; \
$03:B0BA 8D F9 1D     STA.W $1DF9                     ; / Sound effect: contact
$03:B0BD FE 62 16     INC.W RAM_Tweaker1662,X         ; Next hitbox: Tweaker++
$03:B0C0 22 DC A7 01  JSL.L MarioSprInteract          ; Check contact again
$03:B0C4 90 03        BCC $B0C9                       ; No contact: next
$03:B0C6 20 D2 B0     JSR.W $B0D2                     ; Unused. Hurt Mario ($B0D2).
$03:B0C9 FE 62 16     INC.W RAM_Tweaker1662,X         ; Next hitbox: Tweaker++
$03:B0CC 22 DC A7 01  JSL.L MarioSprInteract          ; Check contact
$03:B0D0 90 09        BCC $B0DB                       ; No contact: return
$03:B0D2 22 B7 F5 00  JSL.L HurtMario                 ; Hurt Mario
$03:B0D6 A9 20        LDA.B #$20                      ; \
$03:B0D8 9D 4C 15     STA.W RAM_DisableInter,X        ; / Disable interaction for $20 frames
$03:B0DB 60           RTS                             ; Return

$03:B0DC A0 01        LDY.B #$01                      ; Y = 1: check sprites 1 and 0
$03:B0DE 5A           PHY                             ; Save Y
$03:B0DF B9 C8 14     LDA.W $14C8,Y                   ; \
$03:B0E2 C9 09        CMP.B #$09                      ; / Status $09 (carried/stunned)?
$03:B0E4 D0 08        BNE $B0EE                       ; No: next
$03:B0E6 B9 A0 15     LDA.W RAM_OffscreenHorz,Y       ; \
$03:B0E9 D0 03        BNE $B0EE                       ; / Skip sprites that are off-screen horizontally
$03:B0EB 20 F3 B0     JSR.W $B0F3                     ; Test hit against Bowser ($B0F3)
$03:B0EE 7A           PLY                             ; Restore Y
$03:B0EF 88           DEY                             ; Y--
$03:B0F0 10 EC        BPL $B0DE                       ; Loop
$03:B0F2 60           RTS                             ; Return

$03:B0F3 DA           PHX                             ; Save X
$03:B0F4 BB           TYX                             ; X = sprite slot Y
$03:B0F5 22 E5 B6 03  JSL.L GetSpriteClippingB        ; Get that sprite's clipping box (GetSpriteClippingB)
$03:B0F9 FA           PLX                             ; Restore X
$03:B0FA A9 24        LDA.B #$24                      ; \
$03:B0FC 9D 62 16     STA.W RAM_Tweaker1662,X         ; / Bowser Tweaker $24
$03:B0FF 22 9F B6 03  JSL.L GetSpriteClippingA        ; Get Bowser's clipping box
$03:B103 22 2B B7 03  JSL.L CheckForContact           ; Check for contact
$03:B107 B0 39        BCS $B142                       ; Contact: go to B142
$03:B109 FE 62 16     INC.W RAM_Tweaker1662,X         ; Tweaker++ (second hitbox)
$03:B10C 22 9F B6 03  JSL.L GetSpriteClippingA        ; Get clipping box
$03:B110 22 2B B7 03  JSL.L CheckForContact           ; Check contact
$03:B114 90 4A        BCC $B160                       ; No contact: return
$03:B116 AD B5 14     LDA.W $14B5                     ; \
$03:B119 D0 45        BNE $B160                       ; / Hit flash timer [$14B5] running: return
$03:B11B A9 4C        LDA.B #$4C                      ; \
$03:B11D 8D B5 14     STA.W $14B5                     ; / Bowser hit flash timer [$14B5] = $4C
$03:B120 9C B3 14     STZ.W $14B3                     ; Reset effect timer [$14B3] = 0
$03:B123 BD 1C 15     LDA.W $151C,X                   ; \
$03:B126 8D B4 14     STA.W $14B4                     ; / [$14B4] = Bowser phase
$03:B129 A9 28        LDA.B #$28                      ; \
$03:B12B 8D FC 1D     STA.W $1DFC                     ; / Sound effect: Bowser hit
$03:B12E BD 1C 15     LDA.W $151C,X                   ; \
$03:B131 C9 09        CMP.B #$09                      ; / Phase = 9?
$03:B133 D0 0D        BNE $B142                       ; No: skip
$03:B135 BD 7B 18     LDA.W $187B,X                   ; \
$03:B138 C9 01        CMP.B #$01                      ; / [$187B] (hit counter) = 1?
$03:B13A D0 06        BNE $B142                       ; No: skip
$03:B13C 5A           PHY                             ; Save Y
$03:B13D 22 C8 A6 03  JSL.L KillMostSprites           ; Kill all sprites except Bowser (KillMostSprites)
$03:B141 7A           PLY                             ; Restore Y
$03:B142 A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; \
$03:B144 99 B6 00     STA.W RAM_SpriteSpeedX,Y        ; / Thrown sprite X speed = 0
$03:B147 DA           PHX                             ; Save X
$03:B148 A2 10        LDX.B #$10                      ; X = $10
$03:B14A B9 AA 00     LDA.W RAM_SpriteSpeedY,Y        ; \
$03:B14D 30 02        BMI $B151                       ; / Thrown sprite moving up? Keep $10
$03:B14F A2 D0        LDX.B #$D0                      ; X = $D0
$03:B151 8A           TXA                             ; \
$03:B152 99 AA 00     STA.W RAM_SpriteSpeedY,Y        ; / Y speed = $10 or $D0
$03:B155 A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; \
$03:B157 99 C8 14     STA.W $14C8,Y                   ; / Status 2: killed
$03:B15A BB           TYX                             ; X = slot
$03:B15B 22 6F AB 01  JSL.L $AB6F                     ; Give points / spawn effect ($AB6F)
$03:B15F FA           PLX                             ; Restore X
$03:B160 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $B163: Bowser bowling ball main (BowserBowlingBall) ;;;
{
;; Main routine of the bowling ball Bowser throws (sprite $A1): draws it, applies gravity (+3 per frame, max
;;     $40),
;; lands on the floor line Y = $B0, plays a thud and shakes the ground on hard landings, bounces via
;;     $B7F8,
;; and starts rolling toward Mario after the first landing. [$1570] is the rotation counter, stepped by roll
;;     direction.
;; Called by:
;;     $03:A24B: Bank 3 sprite main dispatch (Bnk3CallSprMain)
$03:B163 20 21 B2     JSR.W BowserBallGfx             ; Draw the bowling ball
$03:B166 A5 9D        LDA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; \
$03:B168 D0 6A        BNE $B1D4                       ; / Return if sprites are locked
$03:B16A 20 5D B8     JSR.W SubOffscreen0Bnk3         ; Despawn if far offscreen
$03:B16D 22 DC A7 01  JSL.L MarioSprInteract          ; Check contact with Mario
$03:B171 22 22 80 01  JSL.L UpdateXPosNoGrvty         ; Update X position (no gravity)
$03:B175 22 1A 80 01  JSL.L UpdateYPosNoGrvty         ; Update Y position (no gravity)
$03:B179 B5 AA        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; \
$03:B17B C9 40        CMP.B #$40                      ; } If Y speed < $40 (signed)...
$03:B17D 10 07        BPL $B186                       ; /
$03:B17F 18           CLC                             ; \
$03:B180 69 03        ADC.B #$03                      ; } ... Y speed += 3 (gravity)
$03:B182 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; /
$03:B184 80 04        BRA $B18A                       ; Skip the clamp

$03:B186 A9 40        LDA.B #$40                      ; \
$03:B188 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; / Clamp Y speed to $40 (terminal velocity)
$03:B18A B5 AA        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; \
$03:B18C 30 37        BMI $B1C5                       ; / Moving up: skip the floor check
$03:B18E BD D4 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; \
$03:B191 30 32        BMI $B1C5                       ; / Y position high byte negative (above level): skip the floor check
$03:B193 B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$03:B195 C9 B0        CMP.B #$B0                      ; } Above floor line Y = $B0: skip
$03:B197 90 2C        BCC $B1C5                       ; /
$03:B199 A9 B0        LDA.B #$B0                      ; \
$03:B19B 95 D8        STA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; / Land on the floor: Y position = $B0
$03:B19D B5 AA        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; \
$03:B19F C9 3E        CMP.B #$3E                      ; } Fall speed >= $3E (hard landing)?
$03:B1A1 90 0A        BCC $B1AD                       ; /
$03:B1A3 A0 25        LDY.B #$25                      ; \
$03:B1A5 8C FC 1D     STY.W $1DFC                     ; / Play sound effect $25 (heavy impact)
$03:B1A8 A0 20        LDY.B #$20                      ; \
$03:B1AA 8C 87 18     STY.W RAM_ShakeGrndTimer        ; / Shake the ground for $20 frames
$03:B1AD C9 08        CMP.B #$08                      ; \
$03:B1AF 90 05        BCC $B1B6                       ; / Fall speed < 8: no bounce sound
$03:B1B1 A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; \
$03:B1B3 8D F9 1D     STA.W $1DF9                     ; / Play sound effect 1 (bounce)
$03:B1B6 20 F8 B7     JSR.W $B7F8                     ; Set bounce Y speed from table by impact speed
$03:B1B9 B5 B6        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; \
$03:B1BB D0 08        BNE $B1C5                       ; / Already rolling horizontally: skip
$03:B1BD 20 17 B8     JSR.W SubHorzPosBnk3            ; Y = side of Mario relative to the ball
$03:B1C0 B9 61 B1     LDA.W BowserBallSpeed,Y         ; \
$03:B1C3 95 B6        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; / Start rolling toward Mario (X speed from BowserBallSpeed)
$03:B1C5 B5 B6        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; \
$03:B1C7 F0 0B        BEQ $B1D4                       ; / No X speed: return
$03:B1C9 30 06        BMI $B1D1                       ; Moving left (negative): skip to the single increment
$03:B1CB DE 70 15     DEC.W $1570,X                   ; Moving right: [$1570] -= 2 ...
$03:B1CE DE 70 15     DEC.W $1570,X                   ; (second decrement)
$03:B1D1 FE 70 15     INC.W $1570,X                   ; ... then += 1: net -1 right, +1 left (spin direction follows roll)
$03:B1D4 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $B221: Bowling ball graphics routine (BowserBallGfx) ;;;
{
;; Draws 12 tiles (a 3x3 body plus 3 extra pieces) into OAM at index $70, then moves tiles 2 and 3 (the bright
;;     pieces)
;; around a circle using the 8-step offset tables, stepped by [$1570] >> 3, to fake rotation.
;; Called by:
;;     $03:B163: Bowser bowling ball main (BowserBowlingBall)
$03:B221 A9 70        LDA.B #$70                      ; OAM index = $70
$03:B223 9D EA 15     STA.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X         ; Store sprite OAM index
$03:B226 20 60 B7     JSR.W GetDrawInfoBnk3           ; Get draw info: $00/$01 = screen X/Y
$03:B229 DA           PHX                             ; Save sprite index
$03:B22A A2 0B        LDX.B #$0B                      ; X = 11: 12 tiles
$03:B22C A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$03:B22E 18           CLC                             ; } Tile X = sprite X + X offset
$03:B22F 7D D5 B1     ADC.W BowserBallDispX,X         ; /
$03:B232 99 00 03     STA.W OAM_DispX,Y               ; Store OAM X
$03:B235 A5 01        LDA $01                         ; \
$03:B237 18           CLC                             ; } Tile Y = sprite Y + Y offset
$03:B238 7D E1 B1     ADC.W BowserBallDispY,X         ; /
$03:B23B 99 01 03     STA.W OAM_DispY,Y               ; Store OAM Y
$03:B23E BD ED B1     LDA.W BowserBallTiles,X         ; Tile number from table
$03:B241 99 02 03     STA.W OAM_Tile,Y                ; Store OAM tile
$03:B244 BD F9 B1     LDA.W BowserBallGfxProp,X       ; \
$03:B247 05 64        ORA $64                         ; / Properties from table | sprite priority bits [$64]
$03:B249 99 03 03     STA.W OAM_Prop,Y                ; Store OAM properties
$03:B24C 5A           PHY                             ; Save OAM index
$03:B24D 98           TYA                             ; \
$03:B24E 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:B24F 4A           LSR                             ; } Y = OAM index / 4: index into the size table
$03:B250 A8           TAY                             ; /
$03:B251 BD 05 B2     LDA.W BowserBallTileSize,X      ; Tile size from table
$03:B254 99 60 04     STA.W OAM_TileSize,Y            ; Store OAM size/high X bit
$03:B257 7A           PLY                             ; Restore OAM index
$03:B258 C8           INY                             ; \
$03:B259 C8           INY                             ; |
$03:B25A C8           INY                             ; } OAM index += 4
$03:B25B C8           INY                             ; /
$03:B25C CA           DEX                             ; Next tile
$03:B25D 10 CD        BPL $B22C                       ; Loop for all 12 tiles
$03:B25F FA           PLX                             ; Restore sprite index
$03:B260 DA           PHX                             ; Save it again
$03:B261 BC EA 15     LDY.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X         ; Y = OAM index of the sprite
$03:B264 BD 70 15     LDA.W $1570,X                   ; \
$03:B267 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:B268 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:B269 4A           LSR                             ; } Frame = ([$1570] >> 3) & 7: rotation step 0-7
$03:B26A 29 07        AND.B #$07                      ; /
$03:B26C 48           PHA                             ; Save step
$03:B26D AA           TAX                             ; X = step
$03:B26E B9 04 03     LDA.W OAM_Tile2DispX,Y          ; \
$03:B271 18           CLC                             ; } Spinning tile 2: X += circle X offset [step]
$03:B272 7D 11 B2     ADC.W BowserBallDispX2,X        ; /
$03:B275 99 04 03     STA.W OAM_Tile2DispX,Y          ; Store OAM X
$03:B278 B9 05 03     LDA.W OAM_Tile2DispY,Y          ; \
$03:B27B 18           CLC                             ; } Spinning tile 2: Y += circle Y offset [step]
$03:B27C 7D 19 B2     ADC.W BowserBallDispY2,X        ; /
$03:B27F 99 05 03     STA.W OAM_Tile2DispY,Y          ; Store OAM Y
$03:B282 68           PLA                             ; \
$03:B283 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:B284 69 02        ADC.B #$02                      ; } Step + 2 (quarter turn), wrapped to 0-7
$03:B286 29 07        AND.B #$07                      ; /
$03:B288 AA           TAX                             ; X = step + 2
$03:B289 B9 08 03     LDA.W OAM_Tile3DispX,Y          ; \
$03:B28C 18           CLC                             ; } Spinning tile 3: X += circle X offset
$03:B28D 7D 11 B2     ADC.W BowserBallDispX2,X        ; /
$03:B290 99 08 03     STA.W OAM_Tile3DispX,Y          ; Store OAM X
$03:B293 B9 09 03     LDA.W OAM_Tile3DispY,Y          ; \
$03:B296 18           CLC                             ; } Spinning tile 3: Y += circle Y offset
$03:B297 7D 19 B2     ADC.W BowserBallDispY2,X        ; /
$03:B29A 99 09 03     STA.W OAM_Tile3DispY,Y          ; Store OAM Y
$03:B29D FA           PLX                             ; Restore sprite index
$03:B29E A9 0B        LDA.B #$0B                      ; A = 11: 12 tiles
$03:B2A0 A0 FF        LDY.B #$FF                      ; Y = $FF: tile sizes already set
$03:B2A2 22 B3 B7 01  JSL.L FinishOAMWrite            ; Finish OAM write
$03:B2A6 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $B2A7: Table: Mechakoopa walk speed (MechakoopaSpeed) ;;;
{
$03:B2A7              .db $08,$F8                     ; X speed on the ground, by direction: right $08, left $F8

}

;;; $B2A9: Mechakoopa main (MechaKoopa) ;;;
{
;; Draws itself, then (status 8, sprites unlocked) walks at +/-8 X speed, turns toward Mario every 64 frames
;; while on the ground, reverses at walls, and advances the walk animation frame in [$1602] (0-3).
;; Stunned handling is elsewhere; here [$1540] only drives the stun graphics.
;; Called by:
;;     $03:A254: Bank 3 sprite main dispatch (Bnk3CallSprMain)
$03:B2A9 22 07 B3 03  JSL.L $B307                     ; Draw the Mechakoopa (via wrapper)
$03:B2AD BD C8 14     LDA.W $14C8,X                   ; \
$03:B2B0 C9 08        CMP.B #$08                      ; } Return unless sprite status = 8 (normal)
$03:B2B2 D0 52        BNE $B306                       ; /
$03:B2B4 A5 9D        LDA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; \
$03:B2B6 D0 4E        BNE $B306                       ; / Return if sprites are locked
$03:B2B8 20 5D B8     JSR.W SubOffscreen0Bnk3         ; Despawn if far offscreen
$03:B2BB 22 3A 80 01  JSL.L SprSpr+MarioSprRts        ; Check contact with Mario and other sprites
$03:B2BF 22 2A 80 01  JSL.L UpdateSpritePos           ; Update position with gravity and object collision
$03:B2C3 BD 88 15     LDA.W RAM_SprObjStatus,X        ; \
$03:B2C6 29 04        AND.B #$04                      ; } Not on the ground: skip to wall check
$03:B2C8 F0 19        BEQ $B2E3                       ; /
$03:B2CA 74 AA        STZ RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; Y speed = 0
$03:B2CC BC 7C 15     LDY.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; Y = facing direction
$03:B2CF B9 A7 B2     LDA.W MechakoopaSpeed,Y         ; \
$03:B2D2 95 B6        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; / X speed = walk speed for the direction
$03:B2D4 B5 C2        LDA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; \
$03:B2D6 F6 C2        INC RAM_SpriteState,X           ; |
$03:B2D8 29 3F        AND.B #$3F                      ; } Every 64 frames ([state] & $3F = 0), turn toward Mario
$03:B2DA D0 07        BNE $B2E3                       ; /
$03:B2DC 20 17 B8     JSR.W SubHorzPosBnk3            ; \
$03:B2DF 98           TYA                             ; } Face Mario
$03:B2E0 9D 7C 15     STA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; /
$03:B2E3 BD 88 15     LDA.W RAM_SprObjStatus,X        ; \
$03:B2E6 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; } Not touching a wall: skip
$03:B2E8 F0 0F        BEQ $B2F9                       ; /
$03:B2EA B5 B6        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; \
$03:B2EC 49 FF        EOR.B #$FF                      ; |
$03:B2EE 1A           INC A                           ; } Hit a wall: X speed = -X speed
$03:B2EF 95 B6        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; /
$03:B2F1 BD 7C 15     LDA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; \
$03:B2F4 49 01        EOR.B #$01                      ; } Flip facing direction
$03:B2F6 9D 7C 15     STA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; /
$03:B2F9 FE 70 15     INC.W $1570,X                   ; Walk animation counter [$1570]++
$03:B2FC BD 70 15     LDA.W $1570,X                   ; \
$03:B2FF 29 0C        AND.B #$0C                      ; |
$03:B301 4A           LSR                             ; } Frame = ([$1570] & $0C) >> 2: walk frames 0-3
$03:B302 4A           LSR                             ; /
$03:B303 9D 02 16     STA.W $1602,X                   ; Store animation frame
$03:B306 60           RTS                             ; Return

$03:B307 8B           PHB                             ; \
$03:B308 4B           PHK                             ; } Wrapper: data bank = program bank
$03:B309 AB           PLB                             ; /
$03:B30A 20 55 B3     JSR.W MechaKoopaGfx             ; Draw the Mechakoopa
$03:B30D AB           PLB                             ; Restore data bank
$03:B30E 6B           RTL                             ; Return long


}
