;;; $B355: Mechakoopa graphics routine (MechaKoopaGfx) ;;;
{
;; Draws the 4-tile Mechakoopa body (frame [$1602], mirrored by direction) and then its wind-up key. While
;;     [$1540] is non-zero
;; it shows the stunned frames 4/5 and, for the last $30 frames, flashes the palette between $0B and $05.
;; Called by:
;;     $03:B30A: Mechakoopa main (MechaKoopa)
$03:B355 A9 0B        LDA.B #$0B                      ; A = $0B: default palette
$03:B357 9D F6 15     STA.W RAM_SpritePal,X           ; Set sprite palette
$03:B35A BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; \
$03:B35D F0 20        BEQ $B37F                       ; / Stun timer [$1540] = 0: draw normally
$03:B35F A0 05        LDY.B #$05                      ; Y = frame 5 (stunned)
$03:B361 C9 05        CMP.B #$05                      ; \
$03:B363 90 04        BCC $B369                       ; / Timer < 5: use frame 4
$03:B365 C9 FA        CMP.B #$FA                      ; \
$03:B367 90 02        BCC $B36B                       ; / Timer < $FA: keep frame 5
$03:B369 A0 04        LDY.B #$04                      ; Y = frame 4
$03:B36B 98           TYA                             ; \
$03:B36C 9D 02 16     STA.W $1602,X                   ; / Stunned frame = Y
$03:B36F BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; \
$03:B372 C9 30        CMP.B #$30                      ; } Timer >= $30: no flashing
$03:B374 B0 09        BCS $B37F                       ; /
$03:B376 29 01        AND.B #$01                      ; \
$03:B378 A8           TAY                             ; |
$03:B379 B9 53 B3     LDA.W MechakoopaPalette,Y       ; } Last 48 frames: flash palette (alternates $0B/$05)
$03:B37C 9D F6 15     STA.W RAM_SpritePal,X           ; /
$03:B37F 20 60 B7     JSR.W GetDrawInfoBnk3           ; Get draw info: $00/$01 = screen X/Y
$03:B382 BD F6 15     LDA.W RAM_SpritePal,X           ; \
$03:B385 85 04        STA $04                         ; / $04 = palette bits
$03:B387 98           TYA                             ; \
$03:B388 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:B389 69 0C        ADC.B #$0C                      ; } OAM index += $0C: draw the 4 tiles from the last slot
$03:B38B A8           TAY                             ; /
$03:B38C BD 02 16     LDA.W $1602,X                   ; \
$03:B38F 0A           ASL                             ; |
$03:B390 0A           ASL                             ; } $03 = frame * 4: offset into tile tables
$03:B391 85 03        STA $03                         ; /
$03:B393 BD 7C 15     LDA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; \
$03:B396 0A           ASL                             ; |
$03:B397 0A           ASL                             ; |
$03:B398 49 04        EOR.B #$04                      ; } $02 = (direction * 4) EOR 4: offset into the X/flip tables
$03:B39A 85 02        STA $02                         ; /
$03:B39C DA           PHX                             ; Save sprite index
$03:B39D A2 03        LDX.B #$03                      ; X = 3: 4 tiles
$03:B39F DA           PHX                             ; Save tile index
$03:B3A0 5A           PHY                             ; Save OAM index
$03:B3A1 98           TYA                             ; \
$03:B3A2 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:B3A3 4A           LSR                             ; } Y = OAM index / 4
$03:B3A4 A8           TAY                             ; /
$03:B3A5 BD 4F B3     LDA.W MechakoopaTileSize,X      ; Tile size from table
$03:B3A8 99 60 04     STA.W OAM_TileSize,Y            ; Store OAM size
$03:B3AB 7A           PLY                             ; Restore OAM index
$03:B3AC 68           PLA                             ; A = tile index
$03:B3AD 48           PHA                             ; Keep it on the stack
$03:B3AE 18           CLC                             ; \
$03:B3AF 65 02        ADC $02                         ; } X = tile index + direction offset
$03:B3B1 AA           TAX                             ; /
$03:B3B2 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$03:B3B4 18           CLC                             ; } Tile X = sprite X + X offset
$03:B3B5 7D 0F B3     ADC.W MechakoopaDispX,X         ; /
$03:B3B8 99 00 03     STA.W OAM_DispX,Y               ; Store OAM X
$03:B3BB BD 47 B3     LDA.W MechakoopaGfxProp,X       ; \
$03:B3BE 05 04        ORA $04                         ; } Properties | palette | priority bits [$64]
$03:B3C0 05 64        ORA $64                         ; /
$03:B3C2 99 03 03     STA.W OAM_Prop,Y                ; Store OAM properties
$03:B3C5 68           PLA                             ; A = tile index
$03:B3C6 48           PHA                             ; Keep it
$03:B3C7 18           CLC                             ; \
$03:B3C8 65 03        ADC $03                         ; } X = tile index + frame offset
$03:B3CA AA           TAX                             ; /
$03:B3CB BD 2F B3     LDA.W MechakoopaTiles,X         ; Tile number from table
$03:B3CE 99 02 03     STA.W OAM_Tile,Y                ; Store OAM tile
$03:B3D1 A5 01        LDA $01                         ; \
$03:B3D3 18           CLC                             ; } Tile Y = sprite Y + Y offset
$03:B3D4 7D 17 B3     ADC.W MechakoopaDispY,X         ; /
$03:B3D7 99 01 03     STA.W OAM_DispY,Y               ; Store OAM Y
$03:B3DA FA           PLX                             ; Restore tile index
$03:B3DB 88           DEY                             ; \
$03:B3DC 88           DEY                             ; |
$03:B3DD 88           DEY                             ; } OAM index -= 4
$03:B3DE 88           DEY                             ; /
$03:B3DF CA           DEX                             ; Next tile
$03:B3E0 10 BD        BPL $B39F                       ; Loop for all 4 tiles
$03:B3E2 FA           PLX                             ; Restore sprite index
$03:B3E3 A0 FF        LDY.B #$FF                      ; Y = $FF: tile sizes already set
$03:B3E5 A9 03        LDA.B #$03                      ; A = 3: 4 tiles
$03:B3E7 22 B3 B7 01  JSL.L FinishOAMWrite            ; Finish OAM write
$03:B3EB 20 F7 B3     JSR.W MechaKoopaKeyGfx          ; Draw the wind-up key on its back
$03:B3EE 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $B3F7: Mechakoopa key graphics (MechaKoopaKeyGfx) ;;;
{
;; Draws the rotating wind-up key on its back as one 8x8 tile in the OAM slot after the body.
;; Called by:
;;     $03:B3EB: Mechakoopa graphics routine (MechaKoopaGfx)
$03:B3F7 BD EA 15     LDA.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X         ; \
$03:B3FA 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:B3FB 69 10        ADC.B #$10                      ; } OAM index += $10: key uses the next slot
$03:B3FD 9D EA 15     STA.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X         ; /
$03:B400 20 60 B7     JSR.W GetDrawInfoBnk3           ; Get draw info
$03:B403 DA           PHX                             ; Save sprite index
$03:B404 BD 70 15     LDA.W $1570,X                   ; \
$03:B407 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:B408 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:B409 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; } $02 = ([$1570] >> 2) & 3: key rotation frame
$03:B40B 85 02        STA $02                         ; /
$03:B40D BD 7C 15     LDA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; A = facing direction
$03:B410 AA           TAX                             ; X = direction
$03:B411 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$03:B413 18           CLC                             ; } Key X = sprite X + offset
$03:B414 7D EF B3     ADC.W MechaKeyDispX,X           ; /
$03:B417 99 00 03     STA.W OAM_DispX,Y               ; Store OAM X
$03:B41A A5 01        LDA $01                         ; \
$03:B41C 38           SEC                             ; } Key Y = sprite Y (no offset)
$03:B41D E9 00        SBC.B #$00                      ; /
$03:B41F 99 01 03     STA.W OAM_DispY,Y               ; Store OAM Y
$03:B422 BD F1 B3     LDA.W MechaKeyGfxProp,X         ; \
$03:B425 05 64        ORA $64                         ; / Properties | priority bits [$64]
$03:B427 99 03 03     STA.W OAM_Prop,Y                ; Store OAM properties
$03:B42A A6 02        LDX $02                         ; X = key frame
$03:B42C BD F3 B3     LDA.W MechaKeyTiles,X           ; Key tile from table
$03:B42F 99 02 03     STA.W OAM_Tile,Y                ; Store OAM tile
$03:B432 FA           PLX                             ; Restore sprite index
$03:B433 A0 00        LDY.B #$00                      ; Y = 0: 8x8 tile
$03:B435 A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; A = 0: one tile
$03:B437 22 B3 B7 01  JSL.L FinishOAMWrite            ; Finish OAM write
$03:B43B 60           RTS                             ; Return

$03:B43C 20 4F B4     JSR.W BowserItemBoxGfx          ; Draw the Bowser scene: item box
$03:B43F 20 AC B4     JSR.W BowserSceneGfx            ; Draw the Bowser scene: background pieces
$03:B442 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $B44F: Bowser scene: draw item box (BowserItemBoxGfx) ;;;
{
;; Draws the reserve item box at the top of the screen as four 16x16 corner tiles ($43, flipped). Hidden when
;;     [$190D] is non-zero
;; (it also clears [$0DC2], the reserve item).
;; $B43C (just above) calls this and BowserSceneGfx.
;; Called by:
;;     $03:B43C: Mechakoopa key graphics (MechaKoopaKeyGfx)
$03:B44F AD 0D 19     LDA.W $190D                     ; \
$03:B452 F0 03        BEQ $B457                       ; / Bowser fight stage [$190D] = 0?
$03:B454 9C C2 0D     STZ.W $0DC2                     ; Stage non-zero: hide the item box ($0DC2 = 0)
$03:B457 AD C2 0D     LDA.W $0DC2                     ; \
$03:B45A F0 2F        BEQ $B48B                       ; / No reserve item: return
$03:B45C DA           PHX                             ; Save sprite index
$03:B45D A2 03        LDX.B #$03                      ; X = 3: 4 corners
$03:B45F A0 04        LDY.B #$04                      ; Y = $04: OAM index (extended slot)
$03:B461 BD 43 B4     LDA.W BowserItemBoxPosX,X       ; \
$03:B464 99 00 02     STA.W OAM_ExtendedDispX,Y       ; / OAM X = corner X
$03:B467 BD 47 B4     LDA.W BowserItemBoxPosY,X       ; \
$03:B46A 99 01 02     STA.W OAM_ExtendedDispY,Y       ; / OAM Y = corner Y
$03:B46D A9 43        LDA.B #$43                      ; \
$03:B46F 99 02 02     STA.W OAM_ExtendedTile,Y        ; / OAM tile = $43 (item box corner)
$03:B472 BD 4B B4     LDA.W BowserItemBoxProp,X       ; \
$03:B475 99 03 02     STA.W OAM_ExtendedProp,Y        ; / OAM properties from table
$03:B478 5A           PHY                             ; Save OAM index
$03:B479 98           TYA                             ; \
$03:B47A 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:B47B 4A           LSR                             ; } Y = OAM index / 4
$03:B47C A8           TAY                             ; /
$03:B47D A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; \
$03:B47F 99 20 04     STA.W $0420,Y                   ; / Size = 16x16 (written to $0420 table)
$03:B482 7A           PLY                             ; Restore OAM index
$03:B483 C8           INY                             ; \
$03:B484 C8           INY                             ; |
$03:B485 C8           INY                             ; } OAM index += 4
$03:B486 C8           INY                             ; /
$03:B487 CA           DEX                             ; Next corner
$03:B488 10 D7        BPL $B461                       ; Loop for all 4 corners
$03:B48A FA           PLX                             ; Restore sprite index
$03:B48B 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $B4AC: Bowser scene: draw floor and roof (BowserSceneGfx) ;;;
{
;; Draws the Bowser fight room backdrop with sprites: a row of floor tiles at Y = $C0 and 16 roof/battlement
;;     tiles from the tables,
;; positioned relative to the screen scroll. [$190D] (fight phase) selects which OAM area is used (stage 0:
;;     $BC/$14, otherwise $90/$50).
;; Called by:
;;     $03:B43F: Mechakoopa key graphics (MechaKoopaKeyGfx)
$03:B4AC DA           PHX                             ; Save sprite index
$03:B4AD A0 BC        LDY.B #$BC                      ; Y = $BC: OAM index of the first piece (stage 0)
$03:B4AF 64 01        STZ $01                         ; $01 = 0: running X
$03:B4B1 AD 0D 19     LDA.W $190D                     ; \

$03:B4B6 C9 01        CMP.B #$01                      ; \

$03:B4C7 A5 01        LDA $01                         ; \

$03:B4E0 5A           PHY                             ; Save OAM index
$03:B4E1 98           TYA                             ; \
$03:B4E2 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:B4E3 4A           LSR                             ; } Y = OAM index / 4
$03:B4E4 A8           TAY                             ; /

;;; $B664: Get Mario hitbox (GetMarioClipping) ;;;
{
;; Builds Mario's hitbox in the "B" slot used by CheckForContact: X = Mario X + 2, width $0C, Y = Mario Y +
;;     offset, height by
;; form (big, small/ducking, on Yoshi). Returns: $00/$08 X, $01/$09 Y (low/high), $02 width, $03 height.
;; Called by:
;;     $01:A824: Test Mario against sprite (ProcessInteract)
;;     $01:B933: Finish OAM write and solid-sprite helpers (FinishOAMWriteRt)
;;     $01:CAC2: Platform: Mario interaction and geometry helpers
;;     $01:D2BD: Koopa Kid boss: landing, stomp, fireballs
;;     $01:E1ED: Keyhole main (Keyhole)
;;     $01:ED2E: Yoshi physics, mounting and dismount
;;     $02:8CEC: Minor extended sprite 0A: Boo stream (BooStreamTiles)
;;     $02:A3FE: Extended sprite: smoke puff, contact with Mario (SmokePuff)
;;     $02:F9E6: Sumo Bro flame: contact with Mario
;;     $03:911F: Fishin' Boo hook contact check
;;     $03:9D8A: Dino-Torch breathing flame (state 1/2) (DinoFlameTimerSet)
;;     $03:ADD0: Pointer table: Peach states, state 0-1 (PeachPtrs)
$03:B664 DA           PHX                             ; Save sprite index
$03:B665 A5 94        LDA RAM_MarioXPos               ; \
$03:B667 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:B668 69 02        ADC.B #$02                      ; } $00 = Mario X + 2 (low byte): hitbox X
$03:B66A 85 00        STA $00                         ; /
$03:B66C A5 95        LDA RAM_MarioXPosHi             ; \
$03:B66E 69 00        ADC.B #$00                      ; } $08 = Mario X high byte (+ carry)
$03:B670 85 08        STA $08                         ; /
$03:B672 A9 0C        LDA.B #$0C                      ; \
$03:B674 85 02        STA $02                         ; / $02 = hitbox width $0C
$03:B676 A2 00        LDX.B #$00                      ; X = 0: big Mario
$03:B678 A5 73        LDA RAM_IsDucking               ; \
$03:B67A D0 04        BNE $B680                       ; / Ducking: X = 1
$03:B67C A5 19        LDA RAM_MarioPowerUp            ; \
$03:B67E D0 01        BNE $B681                       ; / Powerup non-zero (not small): keep X = 0
$03:B680 E8           INX                             ; Small or ducking: X = 1
$03:B681 AD 7A 18     LDA.W RAM_OnYoshi               ; \
$03:B684 F0 02        BEQ $B688                       ; / Not on Yoshi: skip
$03:B686 E8           INX                             ; \
$03:B687 E8           INX                             ; / On Yoshi: X += 2
$03:B688 BF 60 B6 03  LDA.L MarioClippingHeight,X     ; \
$03:B68C 85 03        STA $03                         ; / $03 = hitbox height from table
$03:B68E A5 96        LDA RAM_MarioYPos               ; \
$03:B690 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:B691 7F 5C B6 03  ADC.L MairoClipDispY,X          ; } $01 = Mario Y + Y offset (low byte)
$03:B695 85 01        STA $01                         ; /
$03:B697 A5 97        LDA RAM_MarioYPosHi             ; \
$03:B699 69 00        ADC.B #$00                      ; } $09 = Mario Y high byte (+ carry)
$03:B69B 85 09        STA $09                         ; /
$03:B69D FA           PLX                             ; Restore sprite index
$03:B69E 6B           RTL                             ; Return long

}

;;; $B69F: Get sprite hitbox into slot A (GetSpriteClippingA) ;;;
{
;; Builds the hitbox of sprite X from the clipping tables ([$1662] & $3F) with sign-extended offsets.
;; Parameters: X = sprite index. Returns: $04/$0A X, $05/$0B Y (low/high), $06 width, $07 height. X and Y
;;     preserved.
;; Called by:
;;     $01:88CD: Check shell proximity and jump (HandleJumpOver)
;;     $01:8AB8: Shelless Koopa logic, part 2 (NOTE)
;;     $01:A828: Test Mario against sprite (ProcessInteract)
;;     $01:BAFD: Climbing net door main (ClimbingDoor)
;;     $01:E201: Keyhole main (Keyhole)
;;     $01:F590: Check tongue contact with sprite (TryEatSprite)
;;     $01:F66F: Yoshi vs. other sprites contact
;;     $02:8157: Explosion: kill sprite on contact (ExplodeKillSpr)
;;     $02:93DE: Bounce block and cape hit sprites
;;     $02:A0D4: Fireball vs. sprite loop (FireRtLoopStart)
;;     $02:B7C7: Pokey: behaviour and drawing (PokeyAlive)
;;     $02:E61F: Moving ledge (hole) sprite main (MovingLedgeMain)
;;     ... and 6 more
$03:B69F 5A           PHY                             ; Save Y
$03:B6A0 DA           PHX                             ; Save X
$03:B6A1 9B           TXY                             ; Y = sprite index
$03:B6A2 BD 62 16     LDA.W RAM_Tweaker1662,X         ; \
$03:B6A5 29 3F        AND.B #$3F                      ; } X = clipping index [$1662] & $3F
$03:B6A7 AA           TAX                             ; /
$03:B6A8 64 0F        STZ $0F                         ; $0F = 0 (X displacement high byte)
$03:B6AA BF 6C B5 03  LDA.L SprClippingDispX,X        ; Load X displacement
$03:B6AE 10 02        BPL $B6B2                       ; Positive: skip sign extension
$03:B6B0 C6 0F        DEC $0F                         ; Negative: $0F = $FF (sign extend)
$03:B6B2 18           CLC                             ; \
$03:B6B3 79 E4 00     ADC.W RAM_SpriteXLo,Y           ; } $04 = sprite X + displacement (low byte)
$03:B6B6 85 04        STA $04                         ; /
$03:B6B8 B9 E0 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,Y           ; \
$03:B6BB 65 0F        ADC $0F                         ; } $0A = sprite X high byte + sign extension
$03:B6BD 85 0A        STA $0A                         ; /
$03:B6BF BF A8 B5 03  LDA.L SprClippingWidth,X        ; \
$03:B6C3 85 06        STA $06                         ; / $06 = hitbox width
$03:B6C5 64 0F        STZ $0F                         ; $0F = 0 (Y displacement high byte)
$03:B6C7 BF E4 B5 03  LDA.L SprClippingDispY,X        ; Load Y displacement
$03:B6CB 10 02        BPL $B6CF                       ; Positive: skip sign extension
$03:B6CD C6 0F        DEC $0F                         ; Negative: $0F = $FF (sign extend)
$03:B6CF 18           CLC                             ; \
$03:B6D0 79 D8 00     ADC.W RAM_SpriteYLo,Y           ; } $05 = sprite Y + displacement (low byte)
$03:B6D3 85 05        STA $05                         ; /
$03:B6D5 B9 D4 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,Y           ; \
$03:B6D8 65 0F        ADC $0F                         ; } $0B = sprite Y high byte + sign extension
$03:B6DA 85 0B        STA $0B                         ; /
$03:B6DC BF 20 B6 03  LDA.L SprClippingHeight,X       ; \
$03:B6E0 85 07        STA $07                         ; / $07 = hitbox height
$03:B6E2 FA           PLX                             ; Restore sprite index
$03:B6E3 7A           PLY                             ; Restore Y
$03:B6E4 6B           RTL                             ; Return long

}

$03:B6FE B9 E0 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,Y           ; \
$03:B701 65 0F        ADC $0F                         ; } $08 = sprite X high byte + sign extension
$03:B703 85 08        STA $08                         ; /
$03:B705 BF A8 B5 03  LDA.L SprClippingWidth,X        ; \

$03:B70D BF E4 B5 03  LDA.L SprClippingDispY,X        ; Load Y displacement
$03:B711 10 02        BPL $B715                       ; Positive: skip sign extension
$03:B713 C6 0F        DEC $0F                         ; Negative: $0F = $FF (sign extend)
$03:B715 18           CLC                             ; \
$03:B716 79 D8 00     ADC.W RAM_SpriteYLo,Y           ; } $01 = sprite Y + displacement (low byte)
$03:B719 85 01        STA $01                         ; /
$03:B71B B9 D4 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,Y           ; \
$03:B71E 65 0F        ADC $0F                         ; } $09 = sprite Y high byte + sign extension
$03:B720 85 09        STA $09                         ; /
$03:B722 BF 20 B6 03  LDA.L SprClippingHeight,X       ; \

$03:B728 FA           PLX                             ; Restore sprite index

$03:B72A 6B           RTL                             ; Return long

;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;
;This subroutine checks if the two hitboxes of A and B to see if they are in contact.
;Carry is set if true, else false.
;Syntax:
; $00 = X low byte position/displacement B
; $01 = Y low byte position/displacement B
; $02 = Hitbox width (8-bit) B
; $03 = Hitbox height (8-bit) B
; $04 = X low byte position/displacement A
; $05 = Y low byte position/displacement A
; $06 = Hitbox width (8-bit) A
; $07 = Hitbox height (8-bit) A
; $08 = X high byte position/displacement B
; $09 = Y high byte position/displacement B
; $0A = X high byte position/displacement A
; $0B = Y high byte position/displacement A
;Destroyed values:
; $0C = used as part of the high byte to check if they are too far
; $0F = used as the furthest distance to check if the hitboxes are at least edge
;       to edge on contact.
;-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
;Functionality explanation:
;(1) The first thing it does is that it handles the high byte position of the
;    hitboxes. It checks if the distance is too far (high byte would increment during
;    calculation if it was too far at $03B740).
;
;(2) The second thing while within the #$0100 range is checking the distance between
;    two edges of each boxes. During calculation at $03B746, it subtracts to find the
;    distance between two boxes' top/lefts:
;
;    If the subtraction result was negative (B is right/down of A), it adds by A's
;    size (width/height) to get the "negative distance" of the gap space itself
;    (distance of both boxes' size excluded).
;
;    Otherwise (positive; B is left/up of A), it would get the total distance of both
;    sizes, and also includes the gap in between as well.
;
;(3) The third calculates the farthest distance possible while remainding in contact
;    (assuming if two boxes are edge-to-edge touching, no gaps, no overlaps), then
;    compares the results with 2 using BCC (if the max distance is < distance of 2
;    boxes, carry clear + end of routine. This is unsigned, by the way, so negative
;    numbers also don't set the carry). 
;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;
}

;;; $B72B: Check two hitboxes for contact (CheckForContact) ;;;
{
;; Tests whether hitbox A ($04-$07, $0A-$0B) and hitbox B ($00-$03, $08-$09) overlap, on Y then X.
;; Returns: carry set if in contact, clear otherwise. Trashes $0C and $0F.
;; Called by:
;;     $01:88D1: Check shell proximity and jump (HandleJumpOver)
;;     $01:8AC3: Shelless Koopa logic, part 2 (NOTE)
;;     $01:A82C: Test Mario against sprite (ProcessInteract)
;;     $01:B937: Finish OAM write and solid-sprite helpers (FinishOAMWriteRt)
;;     $01:BB04: Climbing net door main (ClimbingDoor)
;;     $01:CAC6: Platform: Mario interaction and geometry helpers
;;     $01:D2C4: Koopa Kid boss: landing, stomp, fireballs
;;     $01:D3E3: Koopa Kid boss: landing, stomp, fireballs
;;     $01:E205: Keyhole main (Keyhole)
;;     $01:ED32: Yoshi physics, mounting and dismount
;;     $01:F595: Check tongue contact with sprite (TryEatSprite)
;;     $01:F673: Yoshi vs. other sprites contact
;;     ... and 19 more
$03:B72B DA           PHX                             ; Save sprite index
$03:B72C A2 01        LDX.B #$01                      ; X = 1: check Y axis first, then X axis
$03:B72E B5 00        LDA $00,X                       ; \
$03:B730 38           SEC                             ; |
$03:B731 F5 04        SBC $04,X                       ; } Low byte of distance between hitbox origins (B - A); save it
$03:B733 48           PHA                             ; /
$03:B734 B5 08        LDA $08,X                       ; \
$03:B736 F5 0A        SBC $0A,X                       ; } High byte of that distance -> $0C
$03:B738 85 0C        STA $0C                         ; /
$03:B73A 68           PLA                             ; \
$03:B73B 18           CLC                             ; } Low byte + $80: rounds to nearest $100
$03:B73C 69 80        ADC.B #$80                      ; /
$03:B73E A5 0C        LDA $0C                         ; \
$03:B740 69 00        ADC.B #$00                      ; / Distance high byte + carry: non-zero if boxes are $100 or more apart
$03:B742 D0 16        BNE $B75A                       ; Too far apart: no contact
$03:B744 B5 04        LDA $04,X                       ; \
$03:B746 38           SEC                             ; } A - B origin distance
$03:B747 F5 00        SBC $00,X                       ; /
$03:B749 18           CLC                             ; \
$03:B74A 75 06        ADC $06,X                       ; } $0F = A - B + size of A (0 if A's far edge touches B's origin)
$03:B74C 85 0F        STA $0F                         ; /
$03:B74E B5 02        LDA $02,X                       ; \
$03:B750 18           CLC                             ; } A = sum of both sizes: the largest distance that still overlaps
$03:B751 75 06        ADC $06,X                       ; /
$03:B753 C5 0F        CMP $0F                         ; Compare against distance
$03:B755 90 03        BCC $B75A                       ; Gap too large: exit with carry clear
$03:B757 CA           DEX                             ; Next axis (Y, then X)
$03:B758 10 D4        BPL $B72E                       ; Loop for both axes (carry set = contact)
$03:B75A FA           PLX                             ; Restore sprite index
$03:B75B 6B           RTL                             ; Return long


}

;;; $B75C..B75E: Table: offscreen margins and flags ;;;
{
$03:B75C              .db $0C,$1C                     ; Vertical offscreen margins: $0C normal, $1C for smushed sprites

$03:B75E              .db $01,$02                     ; Offscreen flag bits: 1 and 2

}

;;; $B760: Get sprite draw info (bank 3) (GetDrawInfoBnk3) ;;;
{
;; Common graphics prologue. Sets [RAM_OffscreenHorz]/[RAM_OffscreenVert], sets [$15C4] if far offscreen, and
;;     gives screen-relative position.
;; Returns: $00/$01 = sprite X/Y relative to the screen, Y = sprite OAM index. If far offscreen it pops its
;;     own return address
;; so the calling graphics routine returns without drawing.
;; Called by:
;;     $03:83C2: Big Boo graphics routine, flip table (BigBooGfxProp)
;;     $03:8492: Falling platform tiles and graphics routine (FallingPlatTiles)
;;     $03:85A3: Porcu-Puffer graphics routine (PocruPufferGfxProp)
;;     $03:86A8: Flying turn blocks graphics routine (ForestPlatTileSize)
;;     $03:873A: Gray lava platform graphics (LavaPlatTiles)
;;     $03:883F: Mega Mole graphics routine (MegaMoleGfxRt)
;;     $03:8B3D: Bowser statue graphics routine (BowserStatueGfx)
;;     $03:8D24: Carrot top lift graphics (CarrotTopLiftGfx)
;;     $03:8E12: Timed lift graphics (TimedPlatformGfx)
;;     $03:8EB4: Grey castle block graphics (GreyMoveBlkTiles)
;;     $03:8F1B: Statue fireball graphics (StatueFireballGfx)
;;     $03:9180: Fishin' Boo graphics (FishinBooGfx)
;;     ... and 17 more
$03:B760 9E 6C 18     STZ.W RAM_OffscreenVert,X       ; Clear vertical offscreen flag
$03:B763 9E A0 15     STZ.W RAM_OffscreenHorz,X       ; Clear horizontal offscreen flag
$03:B766 B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; \
$03:B768 C5 1A        CMP RAM_ScreenBndryXLo          ; |
$03:B76A BD E0 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; |
$03:B76D E5 1B        SBC RAM_ScreenBndryXHi          ; } Sprite X - screen X (16-bit): offscreen horizontally?
$03:B76F F0 03        BEQ $B774                       ; /
$03:B771 FE A0 15     INC.W RAM_OffscreenHorz,X       ; Set horizontal offscreen flag
$03:B774 BD E0 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; \
$03:B777 EB           XBA                             ; } A = sprite X (16 bit, high byte in B)
$03:B778 B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; /
$03:B77A C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$03:B77C 38           SEC                             ; \
$03:B77D E5 1A        SBC RAM_ScreenBndryXLo          ; |
$03:B77F 18           CLC                             ; } A = sprite X - screen X + $40
$03:B780 69 40 00     ADC.W #$0040                    ; /
$03:B783 C9 80 01     CMP.W #$0180                    ; Compare with $0180 (on screen with a margin)
$03:B786 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$03:B788 2A           ROL                             ; \
$03:B789 29 01        AND.B #$01                      ; } Carry -> [$15C4] = 1 if far offscreen
$03:B78B 9D C4 15     STA.W $15C4,X                   ; /
$03:B78E D0 3F        BNE $B7CF                       ; Far offscreen: return from the caller too
$03:B790 A0 00        LDY.B #$00                      ; Y = 0: check two vertical margins
$03:B792 BD 62 16     LDA.W RAM_Tweaker1662,X         ; \
$03:B795 29 20        AND.B #$20                      ; } Sprite smushed ([$1662] bit 5)?
$03:B797 F0 01        BEQ $B79A                       ; /
$03:B799 C8           INY                             ; Smushed: check only the second margin
$03:B79A B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$03:B79C 18           CLC                             ; } A = sprite Y + margin
$03:B79D 79 5C B7     ADC.W $B75C,Y                   ; /
$03:B7A0 08           PHP                             ; Save carry
$03:B7A1 C5 1C        CMP RAM_ScreenBndryYLo          ; Compare with screen Y
$03:B7A3 26 00        ROL $00                         ; Keep the carry in $00
$03:B7A5 28           PLP                             ; Restore carry
$03:B7A6 BD D4 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; \
$03:B7A9 69 00        ADC.B #$00                      ; / Sprite Y high byte + carry
$03:B7AB 46 00        LSR $00                         ; \
$03:B7AD E5 1D        SBC RAM_ScreenBndryYHi          ; / Minus screen Y high byte and borrow
$03:B7AF F0 09        BEQ $B7BA                       ; On screen: skip
$03:B7B1 BD 6C 18     LDA.W RAM_OffscreenVert,X       ; \
$03:B7B4 19 5E B7     ORA.W $B75E,Y                   ; } Set the vertical offscreen flag bit
$03:B7B7 9D 6C 18     STA.W RAM_OffscreenVert,X       ; /
$03:B7BA 88           DEY                             ; Next margin
$03:B7BB 10 DD        BPL $B79A                       ; Loop
$03:B7BD BC EA 15     LDY.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X         ; Y = sprite OAM index
$03:B7C0 B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; \
$03:B7C2 38           SEC                             ; |
$03:B7C3 E5 1A        SBC RAM_ScreenBndryXLo          ; } $00 = sprite X - screen X
$03:B7C5 85 00        STA $00                         ; /
$03:B7C7 B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$03:B7C9 38           SEC                             ; |
$03:B7CA E5 1C        SBC RAM_ScreenBndryYLo          ; } $01 = sprite Y - screen Y
$03:B7CC 85 01        STA $01                         ; /
$03:B7CE 60           RTS                             ; Return

$03:B7CF 68           PLA                             ; Far offscreen: discard the return address ...
$03:B7D0 68           PLA                             ; ... so the caller returns too
$03:B7D1 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

$03:B7EA              .db $FC,$F8,$EC,$EC,$EC,$E8,$E4,$E0
$03:B7F2              .db $DC,$D8,$D4,$D0,$CC,$C8

;;; $B7F8: Set bounce Y speed ;;;
{
;; Replaces Y speed by a bounce speed from $B7D2 indexed by old speed / 4 (+$13 for sprite $A1, the
;;     bowling ball).
;; Table entries are negative (upward); skipped if [$1588] is negative. Called by the bowling ball on landing.
;; Called by:
;;     $03:B1B6: Bowser bowling ball main (BowserBowlingBall)
$03:B7F8 B5 AA        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; Save current Y speed
$03:B7FA 48           PHA                             ; \
$03:B7FB 74 AA        STZ RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; } Y speed = 0
$03:B7FD 68           PLA                             ; /
$03:B7FE 4A           LSR                             ; \
$03:B7FF 4A           LSR                             ; } Y = old speed / 4: table index
$03:B800 A8           TAY                             ; /
$03:B801 B5 9E        LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; \
$03:B803 C9 A1        CMP.B #$A1                      ; } Sprite $A1 (Bowser bowling ball)?
$03:B805 D0 05        BNE $B80C                       ; /
$03:B807 98           TYA                             ; \
$03:B808 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:B809 69 13        ADC.B #$13                      ; } Yes: index += $13 (second half of the table)
$03:B80B A8           TAY                             ; /
$03:B80C B9 D2 B7     LDA.W $B7D2,Y                   ; A = bounce speed
$03:B80F BC 88 15     LDY.W RAM_SprObjStatus,X        ; \
$03:B812 30 02        BMI $B816                       ; / Skip if [$1588] is negative
$03:B814 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; Y speed = bounce speed
$03:B816 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $B817: Sprite to Mario horizontal distance (SubHorzPosBnk3) ;;;
{
;; Bank 3 copy of SubHorzPos.
;; Returns: Y = 0 if Mario is at or right of the sprite, 1 if left; [$0F] = low byte of Mario X - sprite X.
;; Called by:
;;     $03:8124: Big Boo boss: remaining states and helpers
;;     $03:8544: Porcu-Puffer main routine (PorcuPuffer)
;;     $03:88E9: Swooper state routines
;;     $03:8AB2: Bowser statue states (BowserStatuePtrs)
;;     $03:9070: Fishin' Boo main routine (FishinBoo)
;;     $03:924E: Falling spike: state handlers (FallingSpikePtrs)
;;     $03:948E: Wooden spike Mario contact
;;     $03:95D2: Rex hurts Mario (RexWins)
;;     $03:95FB: Rex killed by star (RexStarKill)
;;     $03:980D: Fishbone graphics, and aim at Mario routine (FishboneGfx)
;;     $03:9A25: Reznor: face Mario (NoSetRznrFireTime)
;;     $03:9A6D: Mario bounces off platform side (HitPlatSide)
;;     ... and 12 more
$03:B817 A0 00        LDY.B #$00                      ; Y = 0: assume Mario is at or to the right of the sprite
$03:B819 A5 94        LDA RAM_MarioXPos               ; \
$03:B81B 38           SEC                             ; |
$03:B81C F5 E4        SBC RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; |
$03:B81E 85 0F        STA $0F                         ; / [$0F] = Mario X position low - sprite X position low
$03:B820 A5 95        LDA RAM_MarioXPosHi             ; \
$03:B822 FD E0 14     SBC.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; / 16-bit borrow: sign of the high byte tells which side Mario is on
$03:B825 10 01        BPL $B828                       ; Mario right of (or at) the sprite: keep Y = 0
$03:B827 C8           INY                             ; Mario left of the sprite: Y = 1
$03:B828 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $B829: Sprite to Mario vertical distance (SubVertPosBnk3) ;;;
{
;; Bank 3 copy of SubVertPos.
;; Returns: Y = 0 if Mario is at or below the sprite, 1 if above; [$0F] = low byte of Mario Y - sprite Y.
;; Called by:
;;     $03:87DD: Mega Mole: turn at walls, Mario contact (MegaMoleOnGround)
;;     $03:97FD: Fishbone graphics, and aim at Mario routine (FishboneGfx)
$03:B829 A0 00        LDY.B #$00                      ; Y = 0: assume Mario is at or below the sprite
$03:B82B A5 96        LDA RAM_MarioYPos               ; \
$03:B82D 38           SEC                             ; |
$03:B82E F5 D8        SBC RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; |
$03:B830 85 0F        STA $0F                         ; / [$0F] = Mario Y position low - sprite Y position low
$03:B832 A5 97        LDA RAM_MarioYPosHi             ; \
$03:B834 FD D4 14     SBC.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; / 16-bit borrow: sign of the high byte tells which side Mario is on
$03:B837 10 01        BPL $B83A                       ; Mario below (or at) the sprite: keep Y = 0
$03:B839 C8           INY                             ; Mario above the sprite: Y = 1
$03:B83A 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $B83B..B847: Table: off-screen despawn limits ;;;
{
;; Vertical (2 entries) and horizontal (4 pairs) limits used by the SubOffscreen routines, as 16-bit offsets
;;     from the screen boundary, low and high bytes in separate tables.
$03:B83B              .db $40,$B0                     ; Vertical limits, low bytes: $40 (below screen), $B0 (above screen)

$03:B83D              .db $01,$FF                     ; Vertical limits, high bytes: $01, $FF (so +$0140 and -$0050)

$03:B83F              .db $30,$C0,$A0,$80,$A0,$40,$60,$B0 ; Horizontal limits, low bytes: pairs (right, left) for margin sets 0, 1, 2, 3
$03:B847              .db $01,$FF,$01,$FF,$01,$00,$01,$FF ; Horizontal limits, high bytes: $0130/$FFC0, $01A0/$FF80, $01A0/$0040, $0160/$FFB0

}

;; Called by:

$03:B84F A9 06        LDA.B #$06                      ; [$03] = 6: margin set 3
$03:B851 80 06        BRA $B859                       ; Go to the shared code

}

$03:B853 A9 04        LDA.B #$04                      ; [$03] = 4: margin set 2
$03:B855 80 02        BRA $B859                       ; Go to the shared code

}

;;; $B857: Despawn off-screen sprite, margin set 1 (SubOffscreen1Bnk3) ;;;

;; Entry point that sets [$03] = 2 and joins the shared code.
$03:B857 A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; [$03] = 2: margin set 1
$03:B859 85 03        STA $03                         ; Store the margin set number
$03:B85B 80 02        BRA $B85F                       ; Skip the STZ below

}

;;; $B85D: Despawn off-screen sprite (horizontal) (SubOffscreen0Bnk3) ;;;
{
;; Bank 3 copy of SubOffscreen. Called by sprites every frame to remove themselves when too far from the
;;     screen.
;; Does nothing while the sprite is on screen or has the process-off-screen tweaker bit set (except falling
;;     below the level).
;; Otherwise alternates frames between the right and the left limit and erases the sprite once beyond it.
;; Parameters: X = sprite index; entry point picks the margin set in [$03] (0, 2, 4, 6). Vertical levels use
;;     VerticalLevelBnk3.
;; Called by:
;;     $03:801A: Football sprite main routine (Football)
;;     $03:845B: Grey falling platform main routine (GreyFallingPlat)
;;     $03:84F9: Blurp main routine (Blurp)
;;     $03:853D: Porcu-Puffer main routine (PorcuPuffer)
;;     $03:8706: Gray lava platform main (GrayLavaPlatform)
;;     $03:88C4: Swooper bat main (Swooper)
;;     $03:8993: Sliding Koopa (shell-less blue) main (SlidingKoopa)
;;     $03:8A43: Bowser statue main (BowserStatue)
;;     $03:8C36: Carrot top lift main routine (CarrotTopLift)
;;     $03:8D73: Message box main routine (InfoBox)
;;     $03:8DC2: Timed lift main routine (TimedLift)
;;     $03:8EF3: Bowser statue fireball main routine (StatueFireball)
;;     ... and 11 more
$03:B85D 64 03        STZ $03                         ; [$03] = 0: margin set 0 (default)
$03:B85F 20 FB B8     JSR.W IsSprOffScreenBnk3        ; A = non-zero if the sprite is off-screen (IsSprOffScreenBnk3)
$03:B862 F0 5E        BEQ $B8C2                       ; On screen: return
$03:B864 A5 5B        LDA RAM_IsVerticalLvl           ; \
$03:B866 29 01        AND.B #$01                      ; |
$03:B868 D0 59        BNE VerticalLevelBnk3           ; / Vertical level: use VerticalLevelBnk3 instead
$03:B86A B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$03:B86C 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:B86D 69 50        ADC.B #$50                      ; |
$03:B86F BD D4 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; |
$03:B872 69 00        ADC.B #$00                      ; |
$03:B874 C9 02        CMP.B #$02                      ; |
$03:B876 10 34        BPL OffScrEraseSprBnk3          ; / Sprite Y + $50 reaches high byte >= 2 (fell below the level): erase it
$03:B878 BD 7A 16     LDA.W RAM_Tweaker167A,X         ; \
$03:B87B 29 04        AND.B #$04                      ; |
$03:B87D D0 43        BNE $B8C2                       ; / Tweaker [$167A] bit 2 = process off-screen: never despawn, return
$03:B87F A5 13        LDA RAM_FrameCounter            ; \
$03:B881 29 01        AND.B #$01                      ; |
$03:B883 05 03        ORA $03                         ; |
$03:B885 85 01        STA $01                         ; / [$01] = (frame counter & 1) | [$03]: picks right edge or left edge, per margin set
$03:B887 A8           TAY                             ; Y = index into the horizontal limit tables
$03:B888 A5 1A        LDA RAM_ScreenBndryXLo          ; A = screen boundary X low
$03:B88A 18           CLC                             ; \
$03:B88B 79 3F B8     ADC.W $B83F,Y                   ; / + limit low byte $B83F[Y]
$03:B88E 26 00        ROL $00                         ; Save the carry out in [$00] bit 0
$03:B890 D5 E4        CMP RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; Compare with sprite X low
$03:B892 08           PHP                             ; Save the compare result
$03:B893 A5 1B        LDA RAM_ScreenBndryXHi          ; A = screen boundary X high
$03:B895 46 00        LSR $00                         ; Restore the carry from the limit addition
$03:B897 79 47 B8     ADC.W $B847,Y                   ; + limit high byte $B847[Y]
$03:B89A 28           PLP                             ; Restore the compare result
$03:B89B FD E0 14     SBC.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; A = (screen X + limit) - sprite X, high byte (16-bit subtract)
$03:B89E 85 00        STA $00                         ; [$00] = that high byte
$03:B8A0 46 01        LSR $01                         ; Carry = 1 on odd frames (left edge check)
$03:B8A2 90 04        BCC $B8A8                       ; Even frame (right edge): keep the sign
$03:B8A4 49 80        EOR.B #$80                      ; \
$03:B8A6 85 00        STA $00                         ; / Odd frame (left edge): flip the sign
$03:B8A8 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; A = [$00]
$03:B8AA 10 16        BPL $B8C2                       ; Sprite inside the limit: return, otherwise fall into the erase code
}

;;; $B8AC: Erase sprite, allow level reload (OffScrEraseSprBnk3) ;;;
{
;; Clears the sprite status. If the sprite came from the level's sprite list (and was alive, status >= 8) its
;;     load status is cleared too, so it respawns when its position scrolls back.
$03:B8AC BD C8 14     LDA.W $14C8,X                   ; A = sprite status
$03:B8AF C9 08        CMP.B #$08                      ; \
$03:B8B1 90 0C        BCC OffScrKillSprBnk3           ; / Status < 8 (already dying): just clear the status below
$03:B8B3 BC 1A 16     LDY.W RAM_SprIndexInLvl,X       ; Y = index of this sprite in the level's sprite list
$03:B8B6 C0 FF        CPY.B #$FF                      ; \
$03:B8B8 F0 05        BEQ OffScrKillSprBnk3           ; / $FF = not from level data (spawned): do not mark for reload
$03:B8BA A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; \
$03:B8BC 99 38 19     STA.W RAM_SprLoadStatus,Y       ; / Clear its load status so the level loader can respawn it later
}

;;; $B8BF: Erase sprite (OffScrKillSprBnk3) ;;;
{
;; Sets sprite status to 0 and returns.
$03:B8BF 9E C8 14     STZ.W $14C8,X                   ; Sprite status = 0 (erase sprite)
$03:B8C2 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $B8C3: Despawn off-screen sprite (vertical level) (VerticalLevelBnk3) ;;;
{
;; Vertical level version of the off-screen check: runs every other frame, alternates between the bottom and
;;     the top limit, and jumps to OffScrEraseSprBnk3 when beyond it.
$03:B8C3 BD 7A 16     LDA.W RAM_Tweaker167A,X         ; \
$03:B8C6 29 04        AND.B #$04                      ; |
$03:B8C8 D0 F8        BNE $B8C2                       ; / Tweaker [$167A] bit 2 = process off-screen: return
$03:B8CA A5 13        LDA RAM_FrameCounter            ; \
$03:B8CC 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:B8CD B0 F3        BCS $B8C2                       ; / Return on odd frames (carry = frame counter bit 0)
$03:B8CF 29 01        AND.B #$01                      ; \
$03:B8D1 85 01        STA $01                         ; / [$01] = frame counter bit 1: picks bottom edge or top edge
$03:B8D3 A8           TAY                             ; Y = index into the vertical limit tables
$03:B8D4 A5 1C        LDA RAM_ScreenBndryYLo          ; A = screen boundary Y low
$03:B8D6 18           CLC                             ; \
$03:B8D7 79 3B B8     ADC.W $B83B,Y                   ; / + limit low byte $B83B[Y]
$03:B8DA 26 00        ROL $00                         ; Save the carry out in [$00] bit 0
$03:B8DC D5 D8        CMP RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; Compare with sprite Y low
$03:B8DE 08           PHP                             ; Save the compare result
$03:B8DF AD 1D 00     LDA.W RAM_ScreenBndryYHi        ; A = screen boundary Y high
$03:B8E2 46 00        LSR $00                         ; Restore the carry from the limit addition
$03:B8E4 79 3D B8     ADC.W $B83D,Y                   ; + limit high byte $B83D[Y]
$03:B8E7 28           PLP                             ; Restore the compare result
$03:B8E8 FD D4 14     SBC.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; A = (screen Y + limit) - sprite Y, high byte (16-bit subtract)
$03:B8EB 85 00        STA $00                         ; [$00] = that high byte
$03:B8ED A4 01        LDY $01                         ; Y = [$01]
$03:B8EF F0 04        BEQ $B8F5                       ; Bottom edge check: keep the sign
$03:B8F1 49 80        EOR.B #$80                      ; \
$03:B8F3 85 00        STA $00                         ; / Top edge check: flip the sign
$03:B8F5 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; A = [$00]
$03:B8F7 10 C9        BPL $B8C2                       ; Sprite inside the limit: return
$03:B8F9 30 B1        BMI OffScrEraseSprBnk3          ; Outside: erase the sprite (always taken)
}

;;; $B8FB: Is sprite off-screen (IsSprOffScreenBnk3) ;;;
{
;; Returns: A = 0 if on screen, non-zero if off-screen horizontally or vertically.
;; Called by:
;;     $03:8A11: Sliding Koopa (shell-less blue) main (SlidingKoopa)

;;; $C000: Generate block at sprite position (GenTileFromSpr2) ;;;
{
;; Creates a block (map16 tile) at the sprite's position (X - 8, Y + 8) using GenerateTile.
;; Parameters: A = block number; X = sprite index.
;; $03C023 (separate routine): long-call wrapper that sets the data bank and runs the Baby Yoshi swallow code
;;     at $03C02F; called from bank 2.
;; Called by:
;;     $01:BADE: Climbing net door main (ClimbingDoor)
;;     $01:BB22: Climbing net door main (ClimbingDoor)
$03:C000 85 9C        STA RAM_BlockBlock              ; [$9C] = block number to generate
$03:C002 B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; \
$03:C004 38           SEC                             ; |
$03:C005 E9 08        SBC.B #$08                      ; |
$03:C007 85 9A        STA RAM_BlockXLo                ; |
$03:C009 BD E0 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; |
$03:C00C E9 00        SBC.B #$00                      ; |
$03:C00E 85 9B        STA RAM_BlockXHi                ; / Block X position = sprite X position - 8 (16-bit)
$03:C010 B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$03:C012 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:C013 69 08        ADC.B #$08                      ; |
$03:C015 85 98        STA RAM_BlockYLo                ; |
$03:C017 BD D4 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; |
$03:C01A 69 00        ADC.B #$00                      ; |
$03:C01C 85 99        STA RAM_BlockYHi                ; / Block Y position = sprite Y position + 8 (16-bit)
$03:C01E 22 B0 BE 00  JSL.L GenerateTile              ; Generate the tile (GenerateTile)
$03:C022 6B           RTL                             ; Return

$03:C023 8B           PHB                             ; \
$03:C024 4B           PHK                             ; |
$03:C025 AB           PLB                             ; / Data bank = program bank ($03), old bank saved
$03:C026 20 2F C0     JSR.W $C02F                     ; Run the Baby Yoshi swallow routine ($C02F)
$03:C029 AB           PLB                             ; Restore the data bank
$03:C02A 6B           RTL                             ; Return long


}

;;; $C02B..C02B: Table: cycling power-up sprite numbers ;;;
{
;; Sprite numbers $74 (mushroom), $75 (fire flower), $77 (feather), $76 (star).
$03:C02B              .db $74,$75,$77,$76             ; $74 mushroom, $75 fire flower, $77 feather, $76 star

}

;;; $C02F: Baby Yoshi swallows caught sprite ;;;
{
;; Probably the Baby Yoshi eating code (called through the $03C023 wrapper). Erases the sprite caught by the
;;     tongue ([$160E,X]) and plays a sound.
;; If the eaten sprite is a power-up ($74-$77), or it is the fifth sprite eaten ([$1570]), the sprite becomes
;;     a full Yoshi (sprite $35).
;; Otherwise gives points. Sprite $81 is replaced by a power-up from a table cycled by the frame counter
;;     (purpose partly unclear).
;; Parameters: X = Baby Yoshi sprite index.
;; Called by:
;;     $03:C026: Generate block at sprite position (GenTileFromSpr2)
$03:C02F BC 0E 16     LDY.W $160E,X                   ; Y = sprite slot of the sprite caught by Baby Yoshi's tongue
$03:C032 A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; \
$03:C034 99 C8 14     STA.W $14C8,Y                   ; / Erase the caught sprite (status 0)
$03:C037 A9 06        LDA.B #$06                      ; \
$03:C039 8D F9 1D     STA.W $1DF9                     ; / Play sound effect $06
$03:C03C B9 0E 16     LDA.W $160E,Y                   ; A = [$160E] of the caught sprite
$03:C03F D0 5A        BNE $C09B                       ; Non-zero: skip the power-up check (purpose unclear), go to the eat counter
$03:C041 B9 9E 00     LDA.W RAM_SpriteNum,Y           ; A = caught sprite number
$03:C044 C9 81        CMP.B #$81                      ; Is it sprite $81?
$03:C046 D0 0C        BNE $C054                       ; No: use the sprite number as it is
$03:C048 A5 14        LDA RAM_FrameCounterB           ; \
$03:C04A 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:C04B 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:C04C 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:C04D 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:C04E 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; / Y = (frame counter >> 4) & 3
$03:C050 A8           TAY                             ; Y = index
$03:C051 B9 2B C0     LDA.W $C02B,Y                   ; Sprite $81: take a power-up from the cycling table
$03:C054 C9 74        CMP.B #$74                      ; Sprite number >= $74?
$03:C056 90 43        BCC $C09B                       ; No: not a power-up, go to the eat counter
$03:C058 C9 78        CMP.B #$78                      ; Sprite number < $78?
$03:C05A B0 3F        BCS $C09B                       ; No: not a power-up, go to the eat counter
$03:C05C 9C AC 18     STZ.W $18AC                     ; Clear [$18AC] (Yoshi swallow/tongue timer)
$03:C05F 9C 1E 14     STZ.W RAM_YoshiHasWings         ; Yoshi has no wings
$03:C062 A9 35        LDA.B #$35                      ; \
$03:C064 9D 9E 00     STA.W RAM_SpriteNum,X           ; / Sprite number = $35 (Yoshi): Baby Yoshi grows up
$03:C067 A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; \
$03:C069 9D C8 14     STA.W $14C8,X                   ; / Sprite status = 8 (normal)
$03:C06C A9 1F        LDA.B #$1F                      ; \
$03:C06E 8D FC 1D     STA.W $1DFC                     ; / Play sound effect $1F
$03:C071 B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$03:C073 E9 10        SBC.B #$10                      ; |
$03:C075 95 D8        STA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; |
$03:C077 BD D4 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; |
$03:C07A E9 00        SBC.B #$00                      ; |
$03:C07C 9D D4 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; / Sprite Y position -= $10 (taller sprite)
$03:C07F BD F6 15     LDA.W RAM_SpritePal,X           ; \
$03:C082 48           PHA                             ; / Save the sprite palette
$03:C083 22 D2 F7 07  JSL.L InitSpriteTables          ; Reset all sprite tables for the new sprite type (InitSpriteTables)
$03:C087 68           PLA                             ; \
$03:C088 29 FE        AND.B #$FE                      ; |
$03:C08A 9D F6 15     STA.W RAM_SpritePal,X           ; / Restore the palette with the low bit cleared
$03:C08D A9 0C        LDA.B #$0C                      ; \
$03:C08F 9D 02 16     STA.W $1602,X                   ; / [$1602] = $0C (animation frame)
$03:C092 DE 0E 16     DEC.W $160E,X                   ; [$160E] -= 1 (no caught sprite: $00 becomes $FF)
$03:C095 A9 40        LDA.B #$40                      ; \
$03:C097 8D E8 18     STA.W $18E8                     ; / [$18E8] = $40 (timer that blocks further tongue contact)
$03:C09A 60           RTS                             ; Return

$03:C09B FE 70 15     INC.W $1570,X                   ; Count this eaten sprite: [$1570] += 1
$03:C09E BD 70 15     LDA.W $1570,X                   ; A = eaten sprite count
$03:C0A1 C9 05        CMP.B #$05                      ; Fifth eaten sprite?
$03:C0A3 D0 02        BNE $C0A7                       ; No: just react to the meal
$03:C0A5 80 B5        BRA $C05C                       ; Yes: grow up too (go to $03C05C)

$03:C0A7 22 4A B3 05  JSL.L $B34A                     ; Eat reaction ($B34A, probably the Baby Yoshi gulp animation)
$03:C0AB A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; \
$03:C0AD 22 E5 AC 02  JSL.L GivePoints                ; / Give points (index 1) to this sprite (GivePoints)
$03:C0B1 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $C0B2..C0BE: Table: animated tiles and phase offsets ;;;
{
;; Tile numbers $68, $6A, $6C, $6E and 16 per-tile animation phase offsets, for the row drawn by $C0C6.
$03:C0B2              .db $68,$6A,$6C,$6E             ; Tile numbers $68, $6A, $6C, $6E (animation frames)

$03:C0B6              .db $00,$03,$01,$02,$04,$02,$00,$01 ; Animation phase offsets per tile (index 0-15; the tile loop also reads 4 bytes past the table)
$03:C0BE              .db $00,$04,$00,$02,$00,$03,$04,$01

}

;;; $C0C6: Iggy/Larry room: draw row and tilt platform ;;;
{
;; Called from bank 0 (non-Mode 7 boss room path). Updates the tilting platform unless sprites are locked,
;;     then draws 20 16x16 tiles across the screen at Y = $C4 (probably the lava), OAM slots $6C-$7F, animated
;;     from the frame counter.
;; Quirk: the phase offset loop reads 4 bytes past $C0B6 (into code), only the low two bits are used.
;; Called by:
;;     $00:988C: Mode 7 boss room: per-frame update
$03:C0C6 A5 9D        LDA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; \
$03:C0C8 D0 03        BNE $C0CD                       ; / Sprites not locked: tilt the platform ($C11E)
$03:C0CA 20 1E C1     JSR.W $C11E                     ; Update the Iggy/Larry platform tilt
$03:C0CD 64 00        STZ $00                         ; [$00] = 0: X position of the first tile
$03:C0CF A2 13        LDX.B #$13                      ; X = $13: 20 tiles
$03:C0D1 A0 B0        LDY.B #$B0                      ; Y = $B0: first OAM slot ($0300 + $B0 = OAM sprite $6C)
$03:C0D3 86 02        STX $02                         ; [$02] = tile counter
$03:C0D5 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; A = tile X position
$03:C0D7 99 00 03     STA.W OAM_DispX,Y               ; OAM X position
$03:C0DA 18           CLC                             ; \
$03:C0DB 69 10        ADC.B #$10                      ; |
$03:C0DD 85 00        STA $00                         ; / Next tile X position += $10
$03:C0DF A9 C4        LDA.B #$C4                      ; \
$03:C0E1 99 01 03     STA.W OAM_DispY,Y               ; / OAM Y position = $C4 (bottom of the screen)
$03:C0E4 A5 64        LDA $64                         ; \
$03:C0E6 09 09        ORA.B #$09                      ; |
$03:C0E8 99 03 03     STA.W OAM_Prop,Y                ; / OAM properties = [$64] (priority bits) | $09 (palette 4, second tile page)
$03:C0EB DA           PHX                             ; Save the tile counter
$03:C0EC A5 14        LDA RAM_FrameCounterB           ; \
$03:C0EE 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:C0EF 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:C0F0 4A           LSR                             ; / A = frame counter B >> 3
$03:C0F1 18           CLC                             ; \
$03:C0F2 7F B6 C0 03  ADC.L $C0B6,X                   ; / + animation offset $C0B6[counter]
$03:C0F6 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; A &= 3
$03:C0F8 AA           TAX                             ; X = frame index
$03:C0F9 BF B2 C0 03  LDA.L $C0B2,X                   ; A = tile number from $C0B2[X]
$03:C0FD 99 02 03     STA.W OAM_Tile,Y                ; OAM tile number
$03:C100 98           TYA                             ; \
$03:C101 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:C102 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:C103 AA           TAX                             ; / X = OAM index / 4
$03:C104 A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; \
$03:C106 9D 60 04     STA.W OAM_TileSize,X            ; / Tile size = 16x16 (X high bit 0)
$03:C109 FA           PLX                             ; Restore the tile counter
$03:C10A C8           INY                             ; \
$03:C10B C8           INY                             ; |
$03:C10C C8           INY                             ; |
$03:C10D C8           INY                             ; / Y += 4: next OAM slot
$03:C10E CA           DEX                             ; Next tile
$03:C10F 10 C2        BPL $C0D3                       ; Loop for all 20 tiles
$03:C111 6B           RTL                             ; Return long


}

;;; $C112: Table: platform tilt speed (IggyPlatSpeed) ;;;
{
;; Low byte (-1, +1, -1, +1) and sign-extension byte of the tilt change per step, indexed by the tilt
;;     direction (+2 for steep phases).
$03:C112              .db $FF,$01,$FF,$01             ; Low byte of tilt speed: -1, +1, -1, +1 (second pair for steep tilts)

$03:C116              .db $FF,$00,$FF,$00             ; High byte of tilt speed: $FF, $00, $FF, $00 (sign extension)

}

;;; $C11A: Iggy/Larry platform tilt update (IggyPlatBounds) ;;;
{
;; Tilts the platform one step every other frame by adding a speed to [$36]/[$37] until it hits the maximum,
;;     then holds still for $40 frames and advances the phase.
;; [$1905] = number of tilts made, [$1906] = hold timer, [$1907] = phase 0-5 (phases 4 and 5 tilt further).
;; Data at $03C11A: maximum tilt values. Code at $03C11E returns at once if sprites are locked or the battle
;;     is over ([$1493]).
$03:C11A              .db $E7,$18,$D7,$28             ; Maximum tilt values: -$19, +$18 (normal), -$29, +$28 (steep)

$03:C11E A5 9D        LDA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; \
$03:C120 0D 93 14     ORA.W $1493                     ; |
$03:C123 D0 50        BNE $C175                       ; / Sprites locked or battle over ([$1493] non-zero): return
$03:C125 AD 06 19     LDA.W $1906                     ; \
$03:C128 F0 03        BEQ $C12D                       ; / [$1906] = stationary timer at maximum tilt: 0 means moving
$03:C12A CE 06 19     DEC.W $1906                     ; Count the stationary timer down
$03:C12D A5 13        LDA RAM_FrameCounter            ; \
$03:C12F 29 01        AND.B #$01                      ; |
$03:C131 0D 06 19     ORA.W $1906                     ; |
$03:C134 D0 3F        BNE $C175                       ; / Move only every other frame, and only if the timer is 0
$03:C136 AD 05 19     LDA.W $1905                     ; A = [$1905], total number of tilts made so far
$03:C139 29 01        AND.B #$01                      ; \
$03:C13B AA           TAX                             ; / X = tilt direction (bit 0 of the tilt count)
$03:C13C AD 07 19     LDA.W $1907                     ; A = [$1907], current phase (0-5)
$03:C13F C9 04        CMP.B #$04                      ; \
$03:C141 90 02        BCC $C145                       ; / Phase < 4: normal tilt
$03:C143 E8           INX                             ; \
$03:C144 E8           INX                             ; / Phase 4 or 5: X += 2 for a steep tilt
$03:C145 A5 36        LDA $36                         ; A = [$36], platform tilt (low byte)
$03:C147 18           CLC                             ; \
$03:C148 7F 12 C1 03  ADC.L IggyPlatSpeed,X           ; / + speed from IggyPlatSpeed[X]
$03:C14C 85 36        STA $36                         ; [$36] = new tilt
$03:C14E 48           PHA                             ; Save the new tilt
$03:C14F A5 37        LDA $37                         ; A = [$37], platform tilt high byte
$03:C151 7F 16 C1 03  ADC.L $C116,X                   ; + sign extension from $C116[X]
$03:C155 29 01        AND.B #$01                      ; \
$03:C157 85 37        STA $37                         ; / [$37] = bit 0 only (which way the platform leans)
$03:C159 68           PLA                             ; A = new tilt
$03:C15A DF 1A C1 03  CMP.L IggyPlatBounds,X          ; \
$03:C15E D0 15        BNE $C175                       ; / Not at the maximum tilt yet: return
$03:C160 EE 05 19     INC.W $1905                     ; Count one more tilt: [$1905] += 1
$03:C163 A9 40        LDA.B #$40                      ; \
$03:C165 8D 06 19     STA.W $1906                     ; / [$1906] = $40: hold the platform still for 64 frames
$03:C168 EE 07 19     INC.W $1907                     ; Next phase: [$1907] += 1
$03:C16B AD 07 19     LDA.W $1907                     ; \
$03:C16E C9 06        CMP.B #$06                      ; |
$03:C170 D0 03        BNE $C175                       ; / Phase 6: wrap back to 0
$03:C172 9C 07 19     STZ.W $1907                     ; Phase = 0
$03:C175 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

{

;;     used by the Yoshi graphics code in bank 1.
$03:C176              .db $0C,$0C,$0C,$0C,$0C,$0C,$0D,$0D ; Yoshi tongue tip X offsets (index in [$02], 40 entries)
$03:C17E              .db $0D,$0D,$FC,$FC,$FC,$FC,$FC,$FC
$03:C186              .db $FB,$FB,$FB,$FB,$0C,$0C,$0C,$0C
$03:C18E              .db $0C,$0C,$0D,$0D,$0D,$0D,$FC,$FC
$03:C196              .db $FC,$FC,$FC,$FC,$FB,$FB,$FB,$FB
}
