$03:C1A6              .db $0B,$0B,$0E,$0E,$0E,$0D,$0D,$0D
$03:C1AE              .db $0C,$0C,$0B,$0B,$12,$12,$12,$11
$03:C1B6              .db $11,$11,$10,$10,$0F,$0F,$12,$12
$03:C1BE              .db $12,$11,$11,$11,$10,$10,$0F,$0F
}

;;; $C1C6..C1C8: Table: slope nudge for sprites ;;;
{
;; X low bytes +2/-2 and X high bytes $00/$FF, indexed by slope direction.
$03:C1C6              .db $02,$FE                     ; Slope nudge X low: +2, -2

$03:C1C8              .db $00,$FF                     ; Slope nudge X high: $00, $FF

}

;;; $C1CA: Move sprite along a slope ;;;
{
;; Long-call routine from bank 1 (sprites on slopes such as the Diggin' Chuck rock and the football). Nudges
;;     the sprite X by +2 or -2 depending on the slope sign in [$15B8,X] and sets Y speed to $18 so it stays on
;;     the slope.
;; Parameters: X = sprite index.
;; Called by:
;;     $01:9380: Sprite vertical check and map16 lookup
$03:C1CA 8B           PHB                             ; \
$03:C1CB 4B           PHK                             ; |
$03:C1CC AB           PLB                             ; / Data bank = program bank ($03)
$03:C1CD A0 00        LDY.B #$00                      ; Y = 0
$03:C1CF BD B8 15     LDA.W $15B8,X                   ; A = [$15B8] (slope under the sprite)
$03:C1D2 10 01        BPL $C1D5                       ; Positive or flat: keep Y = 0
$03:C1D4 C8           INY                             ; Negative slope: Y = 1
$03:C1D5 B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; \
$03:C1D7 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:C1D8 79 C6 C1     ADC.W $C1C6,Y                   ; / Sprite X low += $C1C6[Y]
$03:C1DB 95 E4        STA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; Store it
$03:C1DD BD E0 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; \
$03:C1E0 79 C8 C1     ADC.W $C1C8,Y                   ; / Sprite X high += $C1C8[Y]
$03:C1E3 9D E0 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; Store it
$03:C1E6 A9 18        LDA.B #$18                      ; \
$03:C1E8 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; / Sprite Y speed = $18 (push it down onto the slope)
$03:C1EA AB           PLB                             ; Restore the data bank
$03:C1EB 6B           RTL                             ; Return long


}

;;; $C1EC..C1F4: Table: light switch Y shake ;;;
{
;; Screen Y offsets applied while the switch is drawn, indexed by hit timer / 2.
$03:C1EC              .db $00,$04,$07,$08,$08,$07,$04,$00 ; Screen Y shake offsets by hit timer / 2 (0,4,7,8,8,7,4,0,0)
$03:C1F4              .db $00

}

;;; $C1F5: Light switch sprite main (LightSwitch) ;;;
{
;; Sprite $C8. Behaves as a solid block (InvisBlkMainRt) and despawns off-screen. When the hit timer [$1558]
;;     reaches 5 it toggles bit 0 of the state of every normal Dark Room (sprite $C6) in the 10 first slots.
;; Graphics: draws generic sprite tile $2A, temporarily shifting the screen Y by a table value for a press
;;     animation.
;; Parameters: X = sprite index.
;; Called by:
;;     $03:A121: Bank 3 sprite main dispatch (Bnk3CallSprMain)
$03:C1F5 A5 9D        LDA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; \
$03:C1F7 D0 32        BNE $C22B                       ; / Sprites locked: skip to the graphics
$03:C1F9 22 4F B4 01  JSL.L InvisBlkMainRt            ; Act as a solid block hit from below (InvisBlkMainRt)
$03:C1FD 20 5D B8     JSR.W SubOffscreen0Bnk3         ; Despawn when off-screen (SubOffscreen0Bnk3)
$03:C200 BD 58 15     LDA.W $1558,X                   ; A = hit timer [$1558]
$03:C203 C9 05        CMP.B #$05                      ; \
$03:C205 D0 24        BNE $C22B                       ; / Not yet 5 (the frame the switch fires): skip to the graphics
$03:C207 74 C2        STZ RAM_SpriteState,X           ; Sprite state = 0
$03:C209 A0 0B        LDY.B #$0B                      ; \
$03:C20B 8C F9 1D     STY.W $1DF9                     ; / Play sound effect $0B
$03:C20E 48           PHA                             ; Save the hit timer
$03:C20F A0 09        LDY.B #$09                      ; Y = 9: loop over sprite slots 9 to 0
$03:C211 B9 C8 14     LDA.W $14C8,Y                   ; A = sprite status
$03:C214 C9 08        CMP.B #$08                      ; \
$03:C216 D0 0F        BNE $C227                       ; / Not normal (8): next slot
$03:C218 B9 9E 00     LDA.W RAM_SpriteNum,Y           ; A = sprite number
$03:C21B C9 C6        CMP.B #$C6                      ; \
$03:C21D D0 08        BNE $C227                       ; / Not sprite $C6 (dark room with spotlight): next slot
$03:C21F B9 C2 00     LDA.W RAM_SpriteState,Y         ; A = its sprite state
$03:C222 49 01        EOR.B #$01                      ; Toggle bit 0 (room lit or dark)
$03:C224 99 C2 00     STA.W RAM_SpriteState,Y         ; Store it
$03:C227 88           DEY                             ; Next slot
$03:C228 10 E7        BPL $C211                       ; Loop until Y < 0
$03:C22A 68           PLA                             ; Restore the hit timer
$03:C22B BD 58 15     LDA.W $1558,X                   ; \
$03:C22E 4A           LSR                             ; / A = [$1558] >> 1
$03:C22F A8           TAY                             ; Y = index into the shake table
$03:C230 A5 1C        LDA RAM_ScreenBndryYLo          ; \
$03:C232 48           PHA                             ; / Save screen Y low
$03:C233 18           CLC                             ; \
$03:C234 79 EC C1     ADC.W $C1EC,Y                   ; / + $C1EC[Y]
$03:C237 85 1C        STA RAM_ScreenBndryYLo          ; Shift the screen so the switch appears to move
$03:C239 A5 1D        LDA RAM_ScreenBndryYHi          ; \
$03:C23B 48           PHA                             ; / Save screen Y high
$03:C23C 69 00        ADC.B #$00                      ; \
$03:C23E 85 1D        STA RAM_ScreenBndryYHi          ; / Add the carry
$03:C240 22 B2 90 01  JSL.L GenericSprGfxRt2          ; Draw a generic sprite (GenericSprGfxRt2)
$03:C244 BC EA 15     LDY.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X         ; Y = OAM index of this sprite
$03:C247 A9 2A        LDA.B #$2A                      ; \
$03:C249 99 02 03     STA.W OAM_Tile,Y                ; / OAM tile = $2A
$03:C24C B9 03 03     LDA.W OAM_Prop,Y                ; \
$03:C24F 29 BF        AND.B #$BF                      ; |
$03:C251 99 03 03     STA.W OAM_Prop,Y                ; / Clear the X flip bit of the properties
$03:C254 68           PLA                             ; \
$03:C255 85 1D        STA RAM_ScreenBndryYHi          ; / Restore screen Y high
$03:C257 68           PLA                             ; \
$03:C258 85 1C        STA RAM_ScreenBndryYLo          ; / Restore screen Y low
$03:C25A 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $C25B: Table: chainsaw tiles and setup (ChainsawMotorTiles) ;;;
{
;; Motor animation tiles, per-sprite blade segment Y spacing ($65 and $66) and blade properties. Code at
;;     $03C263 is a long-call wrapper (data bank = $03) around ChainsawGfx, called from bank 1.
$03:C25B              .db $E0,$C2,$C0,$C2             ; Motor tiles: $E0, $C2, $C0, $C2 (animation frames)

$03:C25F              .db $F2,$0E                     ; Blade segment Y spacing: $F2 (-14, sprite $65), $0E (+14, sprite $66)

$03:C261              .db $33,$B3                     ; Blade tile properties: $33, $B3 (Y flipped for the second sprite)

$03:C263 8B           PHB                             ; \
$03:C264 4B           PHK                             ; |
$03:C265 AB           PLB                             ; / Data bank = program bank ($03)
$03:C266 20 6B C2     JSR.W ChainsawGfx               ; Draw the chainsaw (ChainsawGfx)
$03:C269 AB           PLB                             ; Restore the data bank
$03:C26A 6B           RTL                             ; Return long

}

;;; $C26B: Draw chainsaw (ChainsawGfx) ;;;
{
;; Draws three 16x16 tiles: an animated motor and two blade tiles that jitter every other frame. Sprite $65
;;     draws the blade above, $66 below (Y flipped).
;; Parameters: X = sprite index.
;; Called by:
;;     $03:C266: Table: chainsaw tiles and setup (ChainsawMotorTiles)
$03:C26B 20 60 B7     JSR.W GetDrawInfoBnk3           ; Get on-screen position: [$00] = X, [$01] = Y, Y = OAM index (GetDrawInfoBnk3)
$03:C26E DA           PHX                             ; Save the sprite index
$03:C26F B5 9E        LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; \
$03:C271 38           SEC                             ; |
$03:C272 E9 65        SBC.B #$65                      ; / A = sprite number - $65
$03:C274 AA           TAX                             ; X = 0 or 1
$03:C275 BD 5F C2     LDA.W $C25F,X                   ; \
$03:C278 85 03        STA $03                         ; / [$03] = blade segment Y spacing
$03:C27A BD 61 C2     LDA.W $C261,X                   ; \
$03:C27D 85 04        STA $04                         ; / [$04] = blade tile properties
$03:C27F FA           PLX                             ; Restore the sprite index
$03:C280 A5 14        LDA RAM_FrameCounterB           ; \
$03:C282 29 02        AND.B #$02                      ; / [$02] = frame counter B & 2: blade jitter
$03:C284 85 02        STA $02                         ; A = on-screen X
$03:C286 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$03:C288 38           SEC                             ; / - 8
$03:C289 E9 08        SBC.B #$08
$03:C28B 99 00 03     STA.W OAM_DispX,Y               ; OAM X of the motor tile
$03:C28E 99 04 03     STA.W OAM_Tile2DispX,Y          ; OAM X of the first blade tile
$03:C291 99 08 03     STA.W OAM_Tile3DispX,Y          ; OAM X of the second blade tile
$03:C294 A5 01        LDA $01                         ; A = on-screen Y
$03:C296 38           SEC                             ; \
$03:C297 E9 08        SBC.B #$08                      ; / - 8
$03:C299 99 01 03     STA.W OAM_DispY,Y               ; OAM Y of the motor tile
$03:C29C 18           CLC                             ; \
$03:C29D 65 03        ADC $03                         ; / + spacing
$03:C29F 18           CLC                             ; \
$03:C2A0 65 02        ADC $02                         ; / + jitter
$03:C2A2 99 05 03     STA.W OAM_Tile2DispY,Y          ; OAM Y of the first blade tile
$03:C2A5 18           CLC                             ; \
$03:C2A6 65 03        ADC $03                         ; / + spacing
$03:C2A8 99 09 03     STA.W OAM_Tile3DispY,Y          ; OAM Y of the second blade tile
$03:C2AB A5 14        LDA RAM_FrameCounterB           ; \
$03:C2AD 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:C2AE 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:C2AF 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; / A = (frame counter B >> 2) & 3
$03:C2B1 DA           PHX                             ; Save the sprite index
$03:C2B2 AA           TAX                             ; X = motor animation frame
$03:C2B3 BD 5B C2     LDA.W ChainsawMotorTiles,X      ; A = motor tile from ChainsawMotorTiles[X]
$03:C2B6 99 02 03     STA.W OAM_Tile,Y                ; OAM tile of the motor
$03:C2B9 FA           PLX                             ; Restore the sprite index
$03:C2BA A9 AE        LDA.B #$AE                      ; \
$03:C2BC 99 06 03     STA.W OAM_Tile2,Y               ; / First blade tile = $AE
$03:C2BF A9 8E        LDA.B #$8E                      ; \
$03:C2C1 99 0A 03     STA.W OAM_Tile3,Y               ; / Second blade tile = $8E
$03:C2C4 A9 37        LDA.B #$37                      ; \
$03:C2C6 99 03 03     STA.W OAM_Prop,Y                ; / Motor properties = $37
$03:C2C9 A5 04        LDA $04                         ; \
$03:C2CB 99 07 03     STA.W OAM_Tile2Prop,Y           ; / First blade tile properties = [$04]
$03:C2CE 99 0B 03     STA.W OAM_Tile3Prop,Y           ; Second blade tile properties = [$04]
$03:C2D1 A0 02        LDY.B #$02                      ; Y = 2: 16x16 tiles
$03:C2D3 98           TYA                             ; A = 2: three tiles
$03:C2D4 22 B3 B7 01  JSL.L FinishOAMWrite            ; Finish the OAM write (FinishOAMWrite)
$03:C2D8 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $C2D9: Spawn 1-Up if a sprite slot is free (TriggerInivis1Up) ;;;
{
;; Long routine called from bank 0 when the hidden 1-Up counter ([$1421]) reaches 4. Searches slots $0B-$00
;;     for a free one; if found, continues into Generate1Up.
;; Called by:
;;     $00:F2B1: Block interaction: hurt tiles, bounce blocks, coins
$03:C2D9 DA           PHX                             ; Save the sprite index
$03:C2DA A2 0B        LDX.B #$0B                      ; X = $0B: search sprite slots 11 down to 0
$03:C2DC BD C8 14     LDA.W $14C8,X                   ; \
$03:C2DF F0 05        BEQ Generate1Up                 ; / Free slot (status 0): create the 1-Up there
$03:C2E1 CA           DEX                             ; Next slot
$03:C2E2 10 F8        BPL $C2DC                       ; Loop
$03:C2E4 FA           PLX                             ; No free slot: restore X
$03:C2E5 6B           RTL                             ; Return long

}

;;; $C2E6: Create 1-Up mushroom at Mario (Generate1Up) ;;;
{
;; Makes sprite X a normal 1-Up mushroom ($78) at Mario's position, initializes it, sets the interaction
;;     disable timer and pops it out (PopupMushroom). Returns long.
$03:C2E6 A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; \
$03:C2E8 9D C8 14     STA.W $14C8,X                   ; / Sprite status = 8 (normal)
$03:C2EB A9 78        LDA.B #$78                      ; \
$03:C2ED 95 9E        STA RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; / Sprite number = $78 (1-Up mushroom)
$03:C2EF A5 94        LDA RAM_MarioXPos               ; \
$03:C2F1 95 E4        STA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; |
$03:C2F3 A5 95        LDA RAM_MarioXPosHi             ; |
$03:C2F5 9D E0 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; / Sprite X position = Mario X position
$03:C2F8 A5 96        LDA RAM_MarioYPos               ; \
$03:C2FA 95 D8        STA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; |
$03:C2FC A5 97        LDA RAM_MarioYPosHi             ; |
$03:C2FE 9D D4 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; / Sprite Y position = Mario Y position
$03:C301 22 D2 F7 07  JSL.L InitSpriteTables          ; Initialize the sprite tables (InitSpriteTables)
$03:C305 A9 10        LDA.B #$10                      ; \
$03:C307 9D 4C 15     STA.W RAM_DisableInter,X        ; / Interaction disable timer = $10
$03:C30A 20 34 C3     JSR.W PopupMushroom             ; Set direction, upward speed and sound (PopupMushroom)
$03:C30D FA           PLX                             ; Restore the sprite index
$03:C30E 6B           RTL                             ; Return long

}

;;; $C30F: Invisible mushroom sprite main (InvisMushroom) ;;;
{
;; Sprite $C7. When Mario touches it, becomes a mushroom ($74) a bit higher and falls into PopupMushroom.
;; Called by:
;;     $03:A12A: Bank 3 sprite main dispatch (Bnk3CallSprMain)
$03:C30F 20 60 B7     JSR.W GetDrawInfoBnk3           ; Get on-screen position (GetDrawInfoBnk3)
$03:C312 22 DC A7 01  JSL.L MarioSprInteract          ; Mario touching the sprite? (MarioSprInteract)
$03:C316 90 2F        BCC $C347                       ; No: return
$03:C318 A9 74        LDA.B #$74                      ; \
$03:C31A 95 9E        STA RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; / Sprite number = $74 (mushroom)
$03:C31C 22 D2 F7 07  JSL.L InitSpriteTables          ; Reset the sprite tables (InitSpriteTables)
$03:C320 A9 20        LDA.B #$20                      ; \
$03:C322 9D 4C 15     STA.W RAM_DisableInter,X        ; / Interaction disable timer = $20
$03:C325 B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$03:C327 38           SEC                             ; |
$03:C328 E9 0F        SBC.B #$0F                      ; |
$03:C32A 95 D8        STA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; |
$03:C32C BD D4 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; |
$03:C32F E9 00        SBC.B #$00                      ; |
$03:C331 9D D4 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; / Sprite Y position -= $0F (16-bit)
}

;;; $C334: Pop item upward (PopupMushroom) ;;;
{
;; Sets the sprite direction from Mario's X speed (left = 1), Y speed $C0 (up) and plays sound $02. Used when
;;     a mushroom or 1-Up appears.
;; Called by:
;;     $03:C30A: Create 1-Up mushroom at Mario (Generate1Up)
$03:C334 A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; A = 0: facing right
$03:C336 A4 7B        LDY RAM_MarioSpeedX             ; Y = Mario X speed
$03:C338 10 01        BPL $C33B                       ; Mario not moving left: keep A = 0
$03:C33A 1A           INC A                           ; Mario moving left: A = 1
$03:C33B 9D 7C 15     STA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; Sprite direction = A (same as Mario's horizontal direction)
$03:C33E A9 C0        LDA.B #$C0                      ; \
$03:C340 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; / Sprite Y speed = $C0 (pops upward)
$03:C342 A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; \
$03:C344 8D FC 1D     STA.W $1DFC                     ; / Play sound effect $02
$03:C347 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $C348: Table: Ninji jump Y speeds (NinjiSpeedY) ;;;
{
$03:C348              .db $D0,$C0,$B0,$D0             ; Ninji jump Y speeds: $D0, $C0, $B0, $D0

}

;;; $C34C: Ninji main; Dry Bones graphics wrapper (Ninji) ;;;
{
;; Sprite $51 Ninji: faces Mario and hops every $60 frames on the ground, cycling through four hop speeds
;;     (NinjiSpeedY).
;; $03C390 (JSL from bank 01): draws Dry Bones / Bony Beetle with the direction temporarily flipped while
;;     turning.
;; $03C3AE: Bony Beetle ($31) uses the generic sprite drawing routine instead.
;; Called by:
;;     $03:A133: Bank 3 sprite main dispatch (Bnk3CallSprMain)
$03:C34C 22 B2 90 01  JSL.L GenericSprGfxRt2          ; Draw Ninji (generic sprite graphics routine)
$03:C350 A5 9D        LDA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; \
$03:C352 D0 3B        BNE $C38F                       ; / Return if sprites are locked
$03:C354 20 17 B8     JSR.W SubHorzPosBnk3            ; \
$03:C357 98           TYA                             ; } Face Mario: sprite direction = side Mario is on
$03:C358 9D 7C 15     STA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; /
$03:C35B 20 5D B8     JSR.W SubOffscreen0Bnk3         ; Only process while on-screen (SubOffscreen0)
$03:C35E 22 3A 80 01  JSL.L SprSpr+MarioSprRts        ; Interact with Mario
$03:C362 22 2A 80 01  JSL.L UpdateSpritePos           ; Update position from speed, with gravity and object collision
$03:C366 BD 88 15     LDA.W RAM_SprObjStatus,X        ; \
$03:C369 29 04        AND.B #$04                      ; } Skip the landing code if not on the ground ([$1588] bit 2)
$03:C36B F0 18        BEQ $C385                       ; /
$03:C36D 74 AA        STZ RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; Landed: Y speed = 0
$03:C36F BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; \
$03:C372 D0 11        BNE $C385                       ; / Skip if the hop timer [$1540] is still running
$03:C374 A9 60        LDA.B #$60                      ; \
$03:C376 9D 40 15     STA.W $1540,X                   ; / Hop timer [$1540] = $60 frames
$03:C379 F6 C2        INC RAM_SpriteState,X           ; Hop counter [$C2]++
$03:C37B B5 C2        LDA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; \
$03:C37D 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; } Y = [$C2] & 3: which of the four hop heights
$03:C37F A8           TAY                             ; /
$03:C380 B9 48 C3     LDA.W NinjiSpeedY,Y             ; \
$03:C383 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; / Y speed = NinjiSpeedY[Y] (jump up)
$03:C385 A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; \
$03:C387 B4 AA        LDY RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; |
$03:C389 30 01        BMI $C38C                       ; |
$03:C38B 1A           INC A                           ; } Animation frame [$1602] = 0 while moving up, 1 when Y speed >= 0
$03:C38C 9D 02 16     STA.W $1602,X                   ; /
$03:C38F 60           RTS                             ; Return

$03:C390 8B           PHB                             ; Save data bank
$03:C391 4B           PHK                             ; \
$03:C392 AB           PLB                             ; / Data bank = program bank ($03)
$03:C393 BD 7C 15     LDA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; Save sprite direction on the stack
$03:C396 48           PHA                             ; Push it
$03:C397 BC AC 15     LDY.W $15AC,X                   ; \
$03:C39A F0 09        BEQ $C3A5                       ; / Y = turn timer [$15AC]; skip if not turning
$03:C39C C0 05        CPY.B #$05                      ; \
$03:C39E 90 05        BCC $C3A5                       ; / Skip if timer < 5 (turn nearly finished)
$03:C3A0 49 01        EOR.B #$01                      ; \
$03:C3A2 9D 7C 15     STA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; / Turning: draw with the direction flipped
$03:C3A5 20 DA C3     JSR.W $C3DA                     ; Draw Dry Bones / Bony Beetle ($C3DA)
$03:C3A8 68           PLA                             ; \
$03:C3A9 9D 7C 15     STA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; / Restore the real sprite direction
$03:C3AC AB           PLB                             ; Restore data bank
$03:C3AD 6B           RTL                             ; Return long (JSL from bank 01)

$03:C3AE 22 B2 90 01  JSL.L GenericSprGfxRt2          ; Sprite $31 (Bony Beetle): draw with the generic routine instead
$03:C3B2 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $C3B3: Table: Dry Bones tile X offsets (DryBonesTileDispX) ;;;
{
;; Index = direction * 3 + tile (bone, head, body); +6 while turning.
$03:C3B3              .db $00,$08,$00,$00,$F8,$00,$00,$04 ; Tile X offsets, 3 tiles (bone, head, body) x direction: normal right, normal left, turning right (part)
$03:C3BB              .db $00,$00,$FC,$00             ; Turning left; head is only 4 pixels forward while turning

}

;;; $C3BF: Table: Dry Bones tile properties (DryBonesGfxProp) ;;;
{
$03:C3BF              .db $43,$43,$43,$03,$03,$03     ; Tile properties: $43 (X flip) for direction 0, $03 for direction 1

}

;;; $C3C5: Table: Dry Bones tile Y offsets (DryBonesTileDispY) ;;;
{
;; Index = frame * 3 + tile (bone, head, body).
$03:C3C5              .db $F4,$F0,$00,$F4,$F1,$00,$F4,$F0 ; Tile Y offsets (bone, head, body): frame 0, frame 1, start of frame 2
$03:C3CD              .db $00                         ; Frame 2 body offset

}

;;; $C3CE: Dry Bones tiles, drawing, bone spawn (DryBonesTiles) ;;;
{
;; Tile table (frame * 3 + tile), then $C3DA: draws Dry Bones with up to three 16x16 tiles (bone in hand
;;     drawn only in frame 2).
;; Parameters: X: sprite index. Returns via FinishOAMWrite.
;; $03C44E (JSL from bank 01): throws a Bone extended sprite ($06) from above the sprite if it is on-screen,
;;     toward the facing direction (X speed $18 or $E8).
$03:C3CE              .db $00,$64,$66,$00,$64,$68,$82,$64 ; Tile numbers: frame 0, frame 1 (no bone tile), start of frame 2
$03:C3D6              .db $E6                         ; Frame 2 body tile $E6 (frame 2 = $82 held bone, $64 head)

$03:C3D7              .db $00,$00,$FF                 ; Last tile index to skip, per frame: $00 = skip tile 0 (bone), $FF = draw all three

$03:C3DA B5 9E        LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; \
$03:C3DC C9 31        CMP.B #$31                      ; } Sprite $31 (Bony Beetle): use the generic drawing routine
$03:C3DE F0 CE        BEQ $C3AE                       ; /
$03:C3E0 20 60 B7     JSR.W GetDrawInfoBnk3           ; Get on-screen position: [$00] = X, [$01] = Y, Y = OAM index
$03:C3E3 BD AC 15     LDA.W $15AC,X                   ; \
$03:C3E6 85 05        STA $05                         ; / [$05] = turn timer [$15AC]
$03:C3E8 BD 7C 15     LDA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; \
$03:C3EB 0A           ASL                             ; |
$03:C3EC 7D 7C 15     ADC.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; } [$02] = direction * 3 (index into the X offset tables)
$03:C3EF 85 02        STA $02                         ; /
$03:C3F1 DA           PHX                             ; Save sprite index
$03:C3F2 BD 02 16     LDA.W $1602,X                   ; A = animation frame [$1602]
$03:C3F5 48           PHA                             ; Save frame
$03:C3F6 0A           ASL                             ; \
$03:C3F7 7D 02 16     ADC.W $1602,X                   ; } [$03] = frame * 3 (index into the Y offset and tile tables)
$03:C3FA 85 03        STA $03                         ; /
$03:C3FC FA           PLX                             ; X = frame
$03:C3FD BD D7 C3     LDA.W $C3D7,X                   ; \
$03:C400 85 04        STA $04                         ; / [$04] = loop end marker for this frame
$03:C402 A2 02        LDX.B #$02                      ; Start with tile 2 (body)
$03:C404 DA           PHX                             ; Save tile index
$03:C405 8A           TXA                             ; \
$03:C406 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:C407 65 02        ADC $02                         ; } X = direction * 3 + tile index
$03:C409 AA           TAX                             ; /
$03:C40A DA           PHX                             ; Save it
$03:C40B A5 05        LDA $05                         ; \
$03:C40D F0 05        BEQ $C414                       ; / Not turning: use X as is
$03:C40F 8A           TXA                             ; \
$03:C410 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:C411 69 06        ADC.B #$06                      ; } Turning: use the second half of the X offset table (+6)
$03:C413 AA           TAX                             ; /
$03:C414 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$03:C416 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:C417 7D B3 C3     ADC.W DryBonesTileDispX,X       ; } OAM X = on-screen X + X offset
$03:C41A 99 00 03     STA.W OAM_DispX,Y               ; /
$03:C41D FA           PLX                             ; Restore X = direction * 3 + tile index
$03:C41E BD BF C3     LDA.W DryBonesGfxProp,X         ; \
$03:C421 05 64        ORA $64                         ; } OAM properties = flip bits for the direction | sprite palette/priority [$64]
$03:C423 99 03 03     STA.W OAM_Prop,Y                ; /
$03:C426 68           PLA                             ; Pull tile index
$03:C427 48           PHA                             ; Push it back
$03:C428 18           CLC                             ; \
$03:C429 65 03        ADC $03                         ; } X = frame * 3 + tile index
$03:C42B AA           TAX                             ; /
$03:C42C A5 01        LDA $01                         ; \
$03:C42E 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:C42F 7D C5 C3     ADC.W DryBonesTileDispY,X       ; } OAM Y = on-screen Y + Y offset
$03:C432 99 01 03     STA.W OAM_DispY,Y               ; /
$03:C435 BD CE C3     LDA.W DryBonesTiles,X           ; \
$03:C438 99 02 03     STA.W OAM_Tile,Y                ; / OAM tile = DryBonesTiles[X]
$03:C43B FA           PLX                             ; Restore the tile index
$03:C43C C8           INY                             ; \
$03:C43D C8           INY                             ; |
$03:C43E C8           INY                             ; } Next OAM slot (Y += 4)
$03:C43F C8           INY                             ; /
$03:C440 CA           DEX                             ; \
$03:C441 E4 04        CPX $04                         ; } Next tile; loop until the end marker
$03:C443 D0 BF        BNE $C404                       ; /
$03:C445 FA           PLX                             ; Restore sprite index
$03:C446 A0 02        LDY.B #$02                      ; Y = 2: 16x16 tiles
$03:C448 98           TYA                             ; \
$03:C449 22 B3 B7 01  JSL.L FinishOAMWrite            ; / A = 2 (three tiles); finish OAM write
$03:C44D 60           RTS                             ; Return

$03:C44E BD A0 15     LDA.W RAM_OffscreenHorz,X       ; \
$03:C451 1D 6C 18     ORA.W RAM_OffscreenVert,X       ; } Return if the sprite is off-screen horizontally or vertically
$03:C454 D0 0A        BNE $C460                       ; /
$03:C456 A0 07        LDY.B #$07                      ; \
$03:C458 B9 0B 17     LDA.W RAM_ExSpriteNum,Y         ; |
$03:C45B F0 04        BEQ $C461                       ; |
$03:C45D 88           DEY                             ; |
$03:C45E 10 F8        BPL $C458                       ; } Find a free extended sprite slot (Y = 7..0); return if none
$03:C460 6B           RTL                             ; /

$03:C461 A9 06        LDA.B #$06                      ; \
$03:C463 99 0B 17     STA.W RAM_ExSpriteNum,Y         ; / Extended sprite = Bone ($06)
$03:C466 B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$03:C468 38           SEC                             ; |
$03:C469 E9 10        SBC.B #$10                      ; } Bone Y low = sprite Y - $10
$03:C46B 99 15 17     STA.W RAM_ExSpriteYLo,Y         ; /
$03:C46E BD D4 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; \
$03:C471 E9 00        SBC.B #$00                      ; } Bone Y high (with borrow)
$03:C473 99 29 17     STA.W RAM_ExSpriteYHi,Y         ; /
$03:C476 B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; \
$03:C478 99 1F 17     STA.W RAM_ExSpriteXLo,Y         ; / Bone X low = sprite X low
$03:C47B BD E0 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; \
$03:C47E 99 33 17     STA.W RAM_ExSpriteXHi,Y         ; / Bone X high = sprite X high
$03:C481 BD 7C 15     LDA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; \
$03:C484 4A           LSR                             ; / Carry = sprite direction
$03:C485 A9 18        LDA.B #$18                      ; Bone X speed = $18 (right)
$03:C487 90 02        BCC $C48B                       ; \
$03:C489 A9 E8        LDA.B #$E8                      ; / Facing left: X speed = $E8
$03:C48B 99 47 17     STA.W RAM_ExSprSpeedX,Y         ; Store the bone X speed
$03:C48E 6B           RTL                             ; Return long


}

;;; $C48F..C491: Table: dark room beam sweep data ;;;
{
;; $03C48F: beam end X step (+1, -1). $03C491: right end value at which the sweep reverses ($FF, $90).
$03:C48F              .db $01,$FF                     ; Spotlight sweep step per frame: +1, -1

$03:C491              .db $FF,$90                     ; Bottom edge value that reverses the sweep: $FF, $90

;;; $C493: Disco ball tiles and drawing (DiscoBallTiles) ;;;
{
;; Tile and property tables, then $C4A5: draws the disco ball as one 16x16 sprite at screen position
;;     ($78,$28).
;; It spins (8 frames) while the room light is on (state bit 0), otherwise shows the static tile $C2.
;; Parameters: X: sprite index.
$03:C493              .db $80,$82,$84,$86,$88,$8C,$C0,$C2 ; Disco ball tiles, animated (8 frames) then static tile $C2
$03:C49B              .db $C2                         ; Static tile

$03:C49C              .db $31,$33,$35,$37,$31,$33,$35,$37 ; Disco ball tile properties (palette/priority), animated
$03:C4A4              .db $39                         ; Static properties

$03:C4A5 BC EA 15     LDY.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X         ; Y = OAM index of this sprite
$03:C4A8 A9 78        LDA.B #$78                      ; \
$03:C4AA 99 00 03     STA.W OAM_DispX,Y               ; / OAM X = $78
$03:C4AD A9 28        LDA.B #$28                      ; \
$03:C4AF 99 01 03     STA.W OAM_DispY,Y               ; / OAM Y = $28
$03:C4B2 DA           PHX                             ; Save sprite index
$03:C4B3 B5 C2        LDA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; A = state (lit flag)
$03:C4B5 A2 08        LDX.B #$08                      ; X = 8: default frame (static ball)
$03:C4B7 29 01        AND.B #$01                      ; \
$03:C4B9 F0 06        BEQ $C4C1                       ; / Light off: keep the static ball
$03:C4BB A5 13        LDA RAM_FrameCounter            ; \
$03:C4BD 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:C4BE 29 07        AND.B #$07                      ; } Light on: X = ([frame counter] >> 1) & 7, spinning ball
$03:C4C0 AA           TAX                             ; /
$03:C4C1 BD 93 C4     LDA.W DiscoBallTiles,X          ; \
$03:C4C4 99 02 03     STA.W OAM_Tile,Y                ; / OAM tile = DiscoBallTiles[X]
$03:C4C7 BD 9C C4     LDA.W $C49C,X                   ; \
$03:C4CA 99 03 03     STA.W OAM_Prop,Y                ; / OAM properties = $C49C[X]
$03:C4CD 98           TYA                             ; \
$03:C4CE 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:C4CF 4A           LSR                             ; } Y = OAM index / 4
$03:C4D0 A8           TAY                             ; /
$03:C4D1 A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; \
$03:C4D3 99 60 04     STA.W OAM_TileSize,Y            ; / Tile size = 16x16
$03:C4D6 FA           PLX                             ; Restore sprite index
$03:C4D7 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $C4D8..C4DA: Table: dark room backdrop colors ;;;
{
;; Backdrop color ($0701/$0702) for light off / on: $4210 and $318C (low bytes at $03C4D8, high bytes at
;;     $03C4DA).
$03:C4D8              .db $10,$8C                     ; Backdrop color low bytes: $10 (light off), $8C (light on)

$03:C4DA              .db $42,$31                     ; Backdrop color high bytes: $42, $31 (colors $4210 and $318C, dark grays)

}

;;; $C4DC: Dark room with spotlight main (DarkRoomWithLight) ;;;
{
;; Sprite $C6. Keeps only one instance alive, draws the disco ball, sets color math to darken everything
;;     outside window 1 and builds the window shape.
;; The window is a beam widening from ($78..$87) at scanline 48 to ([$1476]..[$1478]) at scanline 223, with
;;     the far end sweeping back and forth.
;; Edges are computed per scanline with a DDA (steps $CF) into the HDMA table at $04A0 (left, right per line);
;;     the table is rebuilt every 4th frame.
;; State 0 (light off) fills the whole table with empty windows (left 1, right 0). Quirk: also sets the
;;     backdrop color from the state.
;; Called by:
;;     $03:A145: Bank 3 sprite main dispatch (Bnk3CallSprMain)
$03:C4DC BD 34 15     LDA.W $1534,X                   ; \
$03:C4DF D0 1F        BNE $C500                       ; / Already initialized? Then skip the duplicate check
$03:C4E1 A0 09        LDY.B #$09                      ; Y = 9: scan sprite slots 9..0
$03:C4E3 CC E9 15     CPY.W $15E9                     ; \
$03:C4E6 F0 12        BEQ $C4FA                       ; / Skip this sprite's own slot
$03:C4E8 B9 C8 14     LDA.W $14C8,Y                   ; \
$03:C4EB C9 08        CMP.B #$08                      ; } Skip slots whose status is not 8 (normal)
$03:C4ED D0 0B        BNE $C4FA                       ; /
$03:C4EF B9 9E 00     LDA.W RAM_SpriteNum,Y           ; \
$03:C4F2 C9 C6        CMP.B #$C6                      ; } Skip slots that are not sprite $C6
$03:C4F4 D0 04        BNE $C4FA                       ; /
$03:C4F6 9E C8 14     STZ.W $14C8,X                   ; Another dark room sprite exists: erase this one
$03:C4F9 60           RTS                             ; Return

$03:C4FA 88           DEY                             ; \
$03:C4FB 10 E6        BPL $C4E3                       ; / Next slot
$03:C4FD FE 34 15     INC.W $1534,X                   ; Mark as initialized
$03:C500 20 A5 C4     JSR.W $C4A5                     ; Draw the disco ball
$03:C503 A9 FF        LDA.B #$FF                      ; \
$03:C505 85 40        STA $40                         ; / [$40] (CGADSUB mirror) = $FF: subtract all layers, half (darken)
$03:C507 A9 20        LDA.B #$20                      ; \
$03:C509 85 44        STA $44                         ; / [$44] (CGWSEL mirror) = $20: color math only outside the window
$03:C50B A9 20        LDA.B #$20                      ; \
$03:C50D 85 43        STA $43                         ; / [$43] (WOBJSEL mirror) = $20: color window uses window 1
$03:C50F A9 80        LDA.B #$80                      ; \
$03:C511 8D 9F 0D     STA.W $0D9F                     ; / Enable HDMA channel 7 (window 1 left/right edges per scanline)
$03:C514 B5 C2        LDA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; \
$03:C516 29 01        AND.B #$01                      ; } Y = state & 1
$03:C518 A8           TAY                             ; /
$03:C519 B9 D8 C4     LDA.W $C4D8,Y                   ; \
$03:C51C 8D 01 07     STA.W $0701                     ; / Backdrop color low = $C4D8[Y]
$03:C51F B9 DA C4     LDA.W $C4DA,Y                   ; \
$03:C522 8D 02 07     STA.W $0702                     ; / Backdrop color high = $C4DA[Y]
$03:C525 A5 9D        LDA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; \
$03:C527 D0 D0        BNE $C4F9                       ; / Return if sprites are locked
$03:C529 AD 82 14     LDA.W $1482                     ; \
$03:C52C D0 1F        BNE $C54D                       ; / Beam already set up? Then skip the set-up
$03:C52E A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; \
$03:C530 8D 76 14     STA.W $1476                     ; / Beam end left X [$1476] = 0
$03:C533 A9 90        LDA.B #$90                      ; \
$03:C535 8D 78 14     STA.W $1478                     ; / Beam end right X [$1478] = $90
$03:C538 A9 78        LDA.B #$78                      ; \
$03:C53A 8D 72 14     STA.W $1472                     ; / Beam start left X [$1472] = $78
$03:C53D A9 87        LDA.B #$87                      ; \
$03:C53F 8D 74 14     STA.W $1474                     ; / Beam start right X [$1474] = $87
$03:C542 A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; \
$03:C544 8D 86 14     STA.W $1486                     ; / [$1486] = 1 (probably unused)
$03:C547 9C 83 14     STZ.W $1483                     ; Sweep direction [$1483] = 0
$03:C54A EE 82 14     INC.W $1482                     ; Set-up done
$03:C54D AC 83 14     LDY.W $1483                     ; Y = sweep direction
$03:C550 AD 76 14     LDA.W $1476                     ; \
$03:C553 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:C554 79 8F C4     ADC.W $C48F,Y                   ; } Beam end left X += $C48F[Y] (+1 or -1)
$03:C557 8D 76 14     STA.W $1476                     ; /
$03:C55A AD 78 14     LDA.W $1478                     ; \
$03:C55D 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:C55E 79 8F C4     ADC.W $C48F,Y                   ; } Beam end right X += $C48F[Y]
$03:C561 8D 78 14     STA.W $1478                     ; /
$03:C564 D9 91 C4     CMP.W $C491,Y                   ; \
$03:C567 D0 09        BNE $C572                       ; / Right end reached the turning value?
$03:C569 AD 83 14     LDA.W $1483                     ; \
$03:C56C 1A           INC A                           ; |
$03:C56D 29 01        AND.B #$01                      ; } Yes: toggle the sweep direction
$03:C56F 8D 83 14     STA.W $1483                     ; /
$03:C572 A5 13        LDA RAM_FrameCounter            ; \
$03:C574 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; } Rebuild the window table only every 4th frame
$03:C576 D0 81        BNE $C4F9                       ; /
$03:C578 A0 00        LDY.B #$00                      ; Y = 0 (left side sign)
$03:C57A AD 72 14     LDA.W $1472                     ; \
$03:C57D 8D 7A 14     STA.W $147A                     ; / [$147A] = left edge, starts at [$1472]
$03:C580 38           SEC                             ; \
$03:C581 ED 76 14     SBC.W $1476                     ; } A = [$1472] - [$1476]; carry set if the edge moves left or stays
$03:C584 B0 04        BCS $C58A                       ; /
$03:C586 C8           INY                             ; \
$03:C587 49 FF        EOR.B #$FF                      ; } Otherwise negate it and set the sign Y = 1
$03:C589 1A           INC A                           ; /
$03:C58A 8D 80 14     STA.W $1480                     ; [$1480] = |left edge change| (DDA step)
$03:C58D 8C 84 14     STY.W $1484                     ; [$1484] = left edge sign (0 = moves left, 1 = moves right)
$03:C590 9C 7E 14     STZ.W $147E                     ; [$147E] = 0 (left DDA accumulator)
$03:C593 A0 00        LDY.B #$00                      ; Y = 0 (right side sign)
$03:C595 AD 74 14     LDA.W $1474                     ; \
$03:C598 8D 7C 14     STA.W $147C                     ; / [$147C] = right edge, starts at [$1474]
$03:C59B 38           SEC                             ; \
$03:C59C ED 78 14     SBC.W $1478                     ; } A = [$1474] - [$1478]
$03:C59F B0 04        BCS $C5A5                       ; /
$03:C5A1 C8           INY                             ; \
$03:C5A2 49 FF        EOR.B #$FF                      ; } Negate it and set the sign Y = 1 if negative
$03:C5A4 1A           INC A                           ; /
$03:C5A5 8D 81 14     STA.W $1481                     ; [$1481] = |right edge change| (DDA step)
$03:C5A8 8C 85 14     STY.W $1485                     ; [$1485] = right edge sign
$03:C5AB 9C 7F 14     STZ.W $147F                     ; [$147F] = 0 (right DDA accumulator)
$03:C5AE B5 C2        LDA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; \
$03:C5B0 85 0F        STA $0F                         ; / [$0F] = state (0 = light off)
$03:C5B2 DA           PHX                             ; Save sprite index
$03:C5B3 C2 10        REP #$10                        ; X, Y 16-bit
$03:C5B5 A2 00 00     LDX.W #$0000                    ; X = 0: byte offset into the table at $04A0 (2 bytes per scanline)
$03:C5B8 E0 5F 00     CPX.W #$005F                    ; \
$03:C5BB 90 4A        BCC $C607                       ; / First 48 scanlines (above the beam): window left = 1, right = 0
$03:C5BD AD 7E 14     LDA.W $147E                     ; \
$03:C5C0 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:C5C1 6D 80 14     ADC.W $1480                     ; } Left DDA: [$147E] += [$1480]
$03:C5C4 8D 7E 14     STA.W $147E                     ; /
$03:C5C7 B0 04        BCS $C5CD                       ; \
$03:C5C9 C9 CF        CMP.B #$CF                      ; } Skip if no carry and below $CF
$03:C5CB 90 13        BCC $C5E0                       ; /
$03:C5CD E9 CF        SBC.B #$CF                      ; \
$03:C5CF 8D 7E 14     STA.W $147E                     ; / Overflow: subtract $CF
$03:C5D2 EE 7A 14     INC.W $147A                     ; Left edge [$147A] += 1
$03:C5D5 AD 84 14     LDA.W $1484                     ; \
$03:C5D8 D0 06        BNE $C5E0                       ; / Edge moves right: done
$03:C5DA CE 7A 14     DEC.W $147A                     ; \
$03:C5DD CE 7A 14     DEC.W $147A                     ; / Edge moves left: net -1
$03:C5E0 AD 7F 14     LDA.W $147F                     ; \
$03:C5E3 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:C5E4 6D 81 14     ADC.W $1481                     ; } Right DDA: [$147F] += [$1481]
$03:C5E7 8D 7F 14     STA.W $147F                     ; /
$03:C5EA B0 04        BCS $C5F0                       ; \
$03:C5EC C9 CF        CMP.B #$CF                      ; } Skip if no carry and below $CF
$03:C5EE 90 13        BCC $C603                       ; /
$03:C5F0 E9 CF        SBC.B #$CF                      ; \
$03:C5F2 8D 7F 14     STA.W $147F                     ; / Overflow: subtract $CF
$03:C5F5 EE 7C 14     INC.W $147C                     ; Right edge [$147C] += 1
$03:C5F8 AD 85 14     LDA.W $1485                     ; \
$03:C5FB D0 06        BNE $C603                       ; / Edge moves right: done
$03:C5FD CE 7C 14     DEC.W $147C                     ; \
$03:C600 CE 7C 14     DEC.W $147C                     ; / Edge moves left: net -1
$03:C603 A5 0F        LDA $0F                         ; \
$03:C605 D0 08        BNE $C60F                       ; / Light on: store the computed edges
$03:C607 A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; \
$03:C609 9D A0 04     STA.W $04A0,X                   ; / Window left = 1 (empty window: no light on this line)
$03:C60C 3A           DEC A                           ; \
$03:C60D 80 09        BRA $C618                       ; / Window right = 0

$03:C60F AD 7A 14     LDA.W $147A                     ; \
$03:C612 9D A0 04     STA.W $04A0,X                   ; / Window left = [$147A]
$03:C615 AD 7C 14     LDA.W $147C                     ; Window right = [$147C]
$03:C618 9D A1 04     STA.W $04A1,X                   ; Store window right
$03:C61B E8           INX                             ; \
$03:C61C E8           INX                             ; / Next scanline (X += 2)
$03:C61D E0 C0 01     CPX.W #$01C0                    ; \
$03:C620 D0 96        BNE $C5B8                       ; / Loop for all 224 scanlines
$03:C622 E2 10        SEP #$10                        ; X, Y 8-bit
$03:C624 FA           PLX                             ; Restore sprite index
$03:C625 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $C786: Firework burst sounds; Peach fireworks controller (FireworkSfx4) ;;;
{
;; Tables: burst sound ($1DFC), backdrop flash colors indexed by [$156D] & 3 and the launch delay per rocket.
;; $03C796: last Peach ending state (pointer 7 in PeachPtrs). Launches four Firework sprites ($7A) from below
;;     the screen, one at a time (each waits for [$1FEB]),
;; flashes the backdrop color while a burst is active, then waits $70 frames, advances cutscene [$13C6] and
;;     sets the end timer [$1493] = $FF.
;; Parameters: X: Peach sprite index.
$03:C786              .db $00,$2C,$00,$00             ; Burst sound for $1DFC per rocket

$03:C78A              .db $00,$AA,$FF,$AA             ; Flash backdrop color low byte, indexed by [$156D] & 3

$03:C78E              .db $00,$7E,$27,$7E             ; Flash backdrop color high byte ($7EAA, $27FF flashes)

$03:C792              .db $C0,$C0,$FF,$C0             ; Value for [$1FEB] after launching each rocket (delay before the next one)

$03:C796 BD 64 15     LDA.W $1564,X                   ; \
$03:C799 F0 0C        BEQ $C7A7                       ; / Rockets finished? Run the timer if [$1564] is set
$03:C79B 3A           DEC A                           ; \
$03:C79C D0 08        BNE $C7A6                       ; / Timer not at 1 yet: return
$03:C79E EE C6 13     INC.W $13C6                     ; Next cutscene state [$13C6]++
$03:C7A1 A9 FF        LDA.B #$FF                      ; \
$03:C7A3 8D 93 14     STA.W $1493                     ; / End-of-level timer [$1493] = $FF
$03:C7A6 60           RTS                             ; Return

$03:C7A7 AD 6D 15     LDA.W $156D                     ; \
$03:C7AA 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; } Y = [$156D] & 3: backdrop flash step
$03:C7AC A8           TAY                             ; /
$03:C7AD B9 8A C7     LDA.W $C78A,Y                   ; \
$03:C7B0 8D 01 07     STA.W $0701                     ; / Backdrop color low = $C78A[Y]
$03:C7B3 B9 8E C7     LDA.W $C78E,Y                   ; \
$03:C7B6 8D 02 07     STA.W $0702                     ; / Backdrop color high = $C78E[Y]
$03:C7B9 AD EB 1F     LDA.W $1FEB                     ; \
$03:C7BC D0 51        BNE $C80F                       ; / Return while launch delay [$1FEB] is non-zero
$03:C7BE BD 34 15     LDA.W $1534,X                   ; \
$03:C7C1 C9 04        CMP.B #$04                      ; } Four rockets launched? Go start the end timer
$03:C7C3 F0 4B        BEQ $C810                       ; /
$03:C7C5 A0 01        LDY.B #$01                      ; Y = 1: look for a free sprite slot among 1..0
$03:C7C7 B9 C8 14     LDA.W $14C8,Y                   ; \
$03:C7CA F0 04        BEQ $C7D0                       ; / Free slot found
$03:C7CC 88           DEY                             ; \
$03:C7CD 10 F8        BPL $C7C7                       ; / Next slot
$03:C7CF 60           RTS                             ; No free slot: return

$03:C7D0 A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; \
$03:C7D2 99 C8 14     STA.W $14C8,Y                   ; / Sprite status = normal
$03:C7D5 A9 7A        LDA.B #$7A                      ; \
$03:C7D7 99 9E 00     STA.W RAM_SpriteNum,Y           ; / Sprite number = $7A (firework)
$03:C7DA A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; \
$03:C7DC 99 E0 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,Y           ; / X high = 0
$03:C7DF A9 A8        LDA.B #$A8                      ; \
$03:C7E1 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:C7E2 65 1C        ADC RAM_ScreenBndryYLo          ; } Y low = screen Y + $A8 (below the screen bottom)
$03:C7E4 99 D8 00     STA.W RAM_SpriteYLo,Y           ; /
$03:C7E7 A5 1D        LDA RAM_ScreenBndryYHi          ; \
$03:C7E9 69 00        ADC.B #$00                      ; } Y high = screen Y high (with carry)
$03:C7EB 99 D4 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,Y           ; /
$03:C7EE DA           PHX                             ; Save sprite index
$03:C7EF BB           TYX                             ; X = new slot
$03:C7F0 22 D2 F7 07  JSL.L InitSpriteTables          ; Initialize the new sprite's tables
$03:C7F4 FA           PLX                             ; Restore Peach's index
$03:C7F5 DA           PHX                             ; Save it again
$03:C7F6 BD 34 15     LDA.W $1534,X                   ; \
$03:C7F9 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; } New sprite [$1534] = rocket number & 3
$03:C7FB 99 34 15     STA.W $1534,Y                   ; /
$03:C7FE AA           TAX                             ; X = rocket number
$03:C7FF BD 92 C7     LDA.W $C792,X                   ; \
$03:C802 8D EB 1F     STA.W $1FEB                     ; / [$1FEB] = launch delay for this rocket
$03:C805 BD 76 C7     LDA.W $C776,X                   ; \
$03:C808 99 E4 00     STA.W RAM_SpriteXLo,Y           ; / New sprite X low = $C776[X]
$03:C80B FA           PLX                             ; Restore Peach's index
$03:C80C FE 34 15     INC.W $1534,X                   ; Rockets launched [$1534]++
$03:C80F 60           RTS                             ; Return

$03:C810 A9 70        LDA.B #$70                      ; \
$03:C812 9D 64 15     STA.W $1564,X                   ; / All launched: timer [$1564] = $70 frames before the scene ends
$03:C815 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $C816: Firework sprite main (state dispatch) (Firework) ;;;
{
;; Sprite $7A. Runs the routine for state [$C2] from FireworkPtrs; [$1534] = rocket number 0-3.
;; Called by:
;;     $03:A14E: Bank 3 sprite main dispatch (Bnk3CallSprMain)
$03:C816 B5 C2        LDA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; A = state
$03:C818 22 DF 86 00  JSL.L ExecutePtr                ; Run the routine for this state

}

;;; $C81C: Pointer table: firework states (FireworkPtrs) ;;;
{
;; 0 launch, 1 rise, 2 burst, 3 fade out.
$03:C81C 28 C8        .dw $C828                       ; State 0: launch
$03:C81E 45 C8        .dw $C845                       ; State 1: rise
$03:C820 8D C8        .dw $C88D                       ; State 2: burst
$03:C822 41 C9        .dw $C941                       ; State 3: fade out

}

;;; $C824: Table: firework launch speed; state 0 (FireworkSpeedY) ;;;
{
;; State 0: sets the launch Y speed from the rocket number, plays the launch sound, timer = $10, goes to state
;;     1.
$03:C824              .db $E4,$E6,$E4,$E2             ; Launch Y speed per rocket

$03:C828 BC 34 15     LDY.W $1534,X                   ; \
$03:C82B B9 24 C8     LDA.W FireworkSpeedY,Y          ; } Y speed = FireworkSpeedY[rocket number [$1534]]
$03:C82E 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; /
$03:C830 A9 25        LDA.B #$25                      ; \
$03:C832 8D FC 1D     STA.W $1DFC                     ; / Play rocket launch sound effect
$03:C835 A9 10        LDA.B #$10                      ; \
$03:C837 9D 64 15     STA.W $1564,X                   ; / Timer [$1564] = $10
$03:C83A F6 C2        INC RAM_SpriteState,X           ; State++
$03:C83C 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $C83D..C841: Table: firework burst start values ;;;
