$03:C83D              .db $14,$0C,$10,$15             ; Initial burst expansion rate [$151C] per rocket

$03:C841              .db $08,$10,$0C,$05             ; Burst delay [$15AC] per rocket

}

;;; $C845: Firework state 1: rise and slow down ;;;
{
;; Rises with Y speed increasing by 1 every 4th frame. At speed $FC it enters state 2 with the burst
;;     parameters set and flashes the backdrop ([$156D] = 8). Draws the rocket spark.
$03:C845 BD 64 15     LDA.W $1564,X                   ; \
$03:C848 C9 01        CMP.B #$01                      ; } Skip the sounds unless the timer [$1564] is at 1
$03:C84A D0 0F        BNE $C85B                       ; /
$03:C84C BC 34 15     LDY.W $1534,X                   ; Y = rocket number
$03:C84F B9 7A C7     LDA.W FireworkSfx1,Y            ; \
$03:C852 8D F9 1D     STA.W $1DF9                     ; / Sound $1DF9 = FireworkSfx1[Y]
$03:C855 B9 7E C7     LDA.W FireworkSfx2,Y            ; \
$03:C858 8D FC 1D     STA.W $1DFC                     ; / Sound $1DFC = FireworkSfx2[Y]
$03:C85B 22 1A 80 01  JSL.L UpdateYPosNoGrvty         ; Move up by the Y speed (no gravity)
$03:C85F F6 B6        INC RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; X speed [$B6] used as a frame counter
$03:C861 B5 B6        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; \
$03:C863 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; } Every 4th frame...
$03:C865 D0 02        BNE $C869                       ; /
$03:C867 F6 AA        INC RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; ...slow the rise: Y speed++
$03:C869 B5 AA        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; \
$03:C86B C9 FC        CMP.B #$FC                      ; } Rise slowed to $FC? Not yet: just draw
$03:C86D D0 16        BNE $C885                       ; /
$03:C86F F6 C2        INC RAM_SpriteState,X           ; State++ (burst)
$03:C871 BC 34 15     LDY.W $1534,X                   ; \
$03:C874 B9 3D C8     LDA.W $C83D,Y                   ; } Burst expansion rate [$151C] = $C83D[rocket]
$03:C877 9D 1C 15     STA.W $151C,X                   ; /
$03:C87A B9 41 C8     LDA.W $C841,Y                   ; \
$03:C87D 9D AC 15     STA.W $15AC,X                   ; / Burst delay [$15AC] = $C841[rocket]
$03:C880 A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; \
$03:C882 8D 6D 15     STA.W $156D                     ; / Backdrop flash timer [$156D] = 8
$03:C885 20 6D C9     JSR.W $C96D                     ; Draw the rocket spark
$03:C888 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $C889..C889: Table: firework maximum burst size ;;;
{
$03:C889              .db $FF,$80,$C0,$FF             ; Maximum burst size [$1570] per rocket

}

;;; $C88D: Firework state 2: burst expansion ;;;
{
;; Plays the burst sound when the delay ends, expands the burst size [$1570] (twice per frame at first,
;;     expansion rate slowing),
;; ends at the maximum size and goes to state 3, then draws the particles ($C9E9).
$03:C88D BD AC 15     LDA.W $15AC,X                   ; \
$03:C890 3A           DEC A                           ; } Burst delay [$15AC] - 1 = 0 (reached 1)?
$03:C891 D0 0F        BNE $C8A2                       ; /
$03:C893 BC 34 15     LDY.W $1534,X                   ; \
$03:C896 B9 82 C7     LDA.W FireworkSfx3,Y            ; } Sound $1DF9 = FireworkSfx3[rocket]
$03:C899 8D F9 1D     STA.W $1DF9                     ; /
$03:C89C B9 86 C7     LDA.W FireworkSfx4,Y            ; \
$03:C89F 8D FC 1D     STA.W $1DFC                     ; / Sound $1DFC = FireworkSfx4[rocket]
$03:C8A2 20 B1 C8     JSR.W $C8B1                     ; Expand the burst
$03:C8A5 B5 C2        LDA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; \
$03:C8A7 C9 02        CMP.B #$02                      ; } State still 2?
$03:C8A9 D0 03        BNE $C8AE                       ; /
$03:C8AB 20 B1 C8     JSR.W $C8B1                     ; Expand twice per frame while in this state
$03:C8AE 4C E9 C9     JMP.W $C9E9                     ; Draw the burst particles ($C9E9)

$03:C8B1 BC 34 15     LDY.W $1534,X                   ; Y = rocket number
$03:C8B4 BD 70 15     LDA.W $1570,X                   ; \
$03:C8B7 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:C8B8 7D 1C 15     ADC.W $151C,X                   ; } Burst size [$1570] += expansion rate [$151C]
$03:C8BB 9D 70 15     STA.W $1570,X                   ; /
$03:C8BE B0 1B        BCS $C8DB                       ; Overflowed: force the end
$03:C8C0 D9 89 C8     CMP.W $C889,Y                   ; \
$03:C8C3 B0 1B        BCS $C8E0                       ; / Reached the maximum size for this rocket: end
$03:C8C5 BD 1C 15     LDA.W $151C,X                   ; \
$03:C8C8 C9 02        CMP.B #$02                      ; } Rate below 2: keep it at 1
$03:C8CA 90 08        BCC $C8D4                       ; /
$03:C8CC 38           SEC                             ; \
$03:C8CD E9 01        SBC.B #$01                      ; |
$03:C8CF 9D 1C 15     STA.W $151C,X                   ; } Rate -= 1 (expansion slows down)
$03:C8D2 B0 10        BCS $C8E4                       ; /
$03:C8D4 A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; \
$03:C8D6 9D 1C 15     STA.W $151C,X                   ; / Rate = 1
$03:C8D9 80 09        BRA $C8E4                       ; Continue

$03:C8DB A9 FF        LDA.B #$FF                      ; \
$03:C8DD 9D 70 15     STA.W $1570,X                   ; / Size = $FF
$03:C8E0 F6 C2        INC RAM_SpriteState,X           ; State++ (fade out)
$03:C8E2 74 AA        STZ RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; Y speed = 0
$03:C8E4 BD 1C 15     LDA.W $151C,X                   ; \
$03:C8E7 29 FF        AND.B #$FF                      ; } Y = expansion rate
$03:C8E9 A8           TAY                             ; /
$03:C8EA B9 F1 C8     LDA.W $C8F1,Y                   ; \
$03:C8ED 9D 02 16     STA.W $1602,X                   ; / Animation frame [$1602] = $C8F1[Y]
$03:C8F0 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $C8F1..C939: Table: firework burst frame by rate ;;;
{
$03:C8F1              .db $06,$05,$04,$03,$03,$03,$03,$02 ; Burst frame by expansion rate: fast = frame 0, slower rates give up to frame 6
$03:C8F9              .db $02,$02,$02,$02,$02,$02,$01,$01
$03:C901              .db $01,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00
$03:C909              .db $00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00
$03:C911              .db $00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00
$03:C919              .db $00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00
$03:C921              .db $03,$03,$03,$03,$03,$03,$03,$03 ; Probably unused (the rate never exceeds $15)
$03:C929              .db $03,$03,$02,$02,$02,$02,$02,$02
$03:C931              .db $02,$02,$02,$02,$02,$02,$02,$02
$03:C939              .db $02,$02,$02,$02,$02,$02,$02,$02

}

;;; $C941: Firework state 3: fade out and erase ;;;
{
;; Y speed grows every 8 frames; frame 7, 8, 9 as it speeds up; the sprite is erased at Y speed 8. Draws the
;;     particles.
$03:C941 A5 13        LDA RAM_FrameCounter            ; \
$03:C943 29 07        AND.B #$07                      ; } Every 8th frame...
$03:C945 D0 02        BNE $C949                       ; /
$03:C947 F6 AA        INC RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; ...Y speed++ (falling faster)
$03:C949 22 1A 80 01  JSL.L UpdateYPosNoGrvty         ; Move vertically
$03:C94D A9 07        LDA.B #$07                      ; A = 7: frame for the fade
$03:C94F B4 AA        LDY RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; \
$03:C951 C0 08        CPY.B #$08                      ; } Y speed reached 8?
$03:C953 D0 03        BNE $C958                       ; /
$03:C955 9E C8 14     STZ.W $14C8,X                   ; Yes: erase the sprite
$03:C958 C0 03        CPY.B #$03                      ; \
$03:C95A 90 06        BCC $C962                       ; / Y speed >= 3: next frame
$03:C95C 1A           INC A                           ; Frame 8
$03:C95D C0 05        CPY.B #$05                      ; \
$03:C95F 90 01        BCC $C962                       ; / Y speed >= 5: next frame
$03:C961 1A           INC A                           ; Frame 9
$03:C962 9D 02 16     STA.W $1602,X                   ; Animation frame [$1602] = A
$03:C965 20 E9 C9     JSR.W $C9E9                     ; Draw the burst particles
$03:C968 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $C969..C969: Table: firework rocket spark tiles ;;;
{
$03:C969              .db $EC,$8E,$EC,$EC             ; Rocket spark tile per rocket ($8E for rocket 1)

}

;;; $C96D: Draw firework rocket spark ;;;
{
;; Draws a flickering 8x8 spark at the sprite position in OAM slot 0 on every 4th frame (staggered by sprite
;;     index).
;; Parameters: X: sprite index.
;; Called by:
;;     $03:C885: Firework state 1: rise and slow down
$03:C96D 8A           TXA                             ; \
$03:C96E 45 13        EOR RAM_FrameCounter            ; |
$03:C970 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; } Draw only on every 4th frame (staggered by sprite index)
$03:C972 D0 44        BNE $C9B8                       ; /
$03:C974 20 60 B7     JSR.W GetDrawInfoBnk3           ; Get on-screen position
$03:C977 A0 00        LDY.B #$00                      ; Y = 0: uses the first OAM slots
$03:C979 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$03:C97B 99 00 03     STA.W OAM_DispX,Y               ; } OAM X of slots 0 and 1 = sprite X
$03:C97E 99 04 03     STA.W OAM_Tile2DispX,Y          ; /
$03:C981 A5 01        LDA $01                         ; \
$03:C983 99 01 03     STA.W OAM_DispY,Y               ; / OAM Y of slot 0 = sprite Y
$03:C986 DA           PHX                             ; Save sprite index
$03:C987 BD 34 15     LDA.W $1534,X                   ; \
$03:C98A AA           TAX                             ; / X = rocket number
$03:C98B A5 13        LDA RAM_FrameCounter            ; \
$03:C98D 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:C98E 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:C98F 29 02        AND.B #$02                      ; } A = 0 or 1, toggles every 8 frames
$03:C991 4A           LSR                             ; /
$03:C992 7D 69 C9     ADC.W $C969,X                   ; \
$03:C995 99 02 03     STA.W OAM_Tile,Y                ; / OAM tile = $C969[X] + A
$03:C998 FA           PLX                             ; Restore sprite index
$03:C999 A5 13        LDA RAM_FrameCounter            ; \
$03:C99B 0A           ASL                             ; |
$03:C99C 29 0E        AND.B #$0E                      ; } [$02] = ([frame counter] * 2) & $0E: cycling palette
$03:C99E 85 02        STA $02                         ; /
$03:C9A0 A5 13        LDA RAM_FrameCounter            ; \
$03:C9A2 0A           ASL                             ; |
$03:C9A3 0A           ASL                             ; |
$03:C9A4 0A           ASL                             ; |
$03:C9A5 0A           ASL                             ; } A = X flip bit toggling with the frame counter
$03:C9A6 29 40        AND.B #$40                      ; /
$03:C9A8 05 02        ORA $02                         ; \
$03:C9AA 09 31        ORA.B #$31                      ; } OAM properties = flip | palette | $31
$03:C9AC 99 03 03     STA.W OAM_Prop,Y                ; /
$03:C9AF 98           TYA                             ; \
$03:C9B0 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:C9B1 4A           LSR                             ; } Y = OAM index / 4
$03:C9B2 A8           TAY                             ; /
$03:C9B3 A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; \
$03:C9B5 99 60 04     STA.W OAM_TileSize,Y            ; / Tile size = 8x8
$03:C9B8 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $C9B9..C9D9: Table: firework burst particle tiles ;;;
{
$03:C9B9              .db $36,$35,$C7,$34,$34,$34,$34,$24 ; Burst particle tiles: 10 frames for each of 4 animation phases
$03:C9C1              .db $03,$03,$36,$35,$C7,$34,$34,$24
$03:C9C9              .db $24,$24,$24,$03,$36,$35,$C7,$34
$03:C9D1              .db $34,$34,$24,$24,$03,$24,$36,$35
$03:C9D9              .db $C7,$34,$24,$24,$24,$24,$24,$03
}

;;; $C9E1..C9E1: Table: firework burst jitter offsets ;;;
{
$03:C9E1              .db $00,$01,$01,$00,$00,$FF,$FF,$00 ; Burst particle jitter offsets: 0, 1, 1, 0, 0, -1, -1, 0

}

;;; $C9E9: Draw firework burst particles ;;;
{
;; Draws one firework burst: 64 particles in the $0200 OAM area, then 20 more in the $0300 area (84 in all).
;; Each particle position comes from a pattern table (type [$1534] 0-2 or 3+), scaled by the radius [$1570]
;;     with the hardware
;; multiplier, so the burst expands. From animation frame 6 on, a small jitter makes the particles sparkle.
;; Parameters: X = sprite slot; [$1570] radius, [$1602] animation frame, [$1534] firework type. Always 8x8
;;     tiles, priority 3.
;; Called by:
;;     $03:C8AE: Firework state 2: burst expansion
;;     $03:C965: Firework state 3: fade out and erase
$03:C9E9 8A           TXA                             ; \
$03:C9EA 45 13        EOR RAM_FrameCounter            ; } $05 = sprite slot XOR frame counter (seed that varies tile and palette)
$03:C9EC 85 05        STA $05                         ; /
$03:C9EE BD 70 15     LDA.W $1570,X                   ; \
$03:C9F1 85 06        STA $06                         ; / $06 = [$1570]: burst radius scale
$03:C9F3 BD 02 16     LDA.W $1602,X                   ; \
$03:C9F6 85 07        STA $07                         ; / $07 = [$1602]: animation frame
$03:C9F8 B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; \
$03:C9FA 85 08        STA $08                         ; / $08 = burst center X low
$03:C9FC B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$03:C9FE 38           SEC                             ; |
$03:C9FF E5 1C        SBC RAM_ScreenBndryYLo          ; } $09 = burst center Y relative to the screen
$03:CA01 85 09        STA $09                         ; /
$03:CA03 BD 34 15     LDA.W $1534,X                   ; \
$03:CA06 85 0A        STA $0A                         ; / $0A = [$1534]: firework type
$03:CA08 DA           PHX                             ; Save sprite index
$03:CA09 A2 3F        LDX.B #$3F                      ; X = $3F: first pass draws 64 particles (index counts down to 0)
$03:CA0B A0 00        LDY.B #$00                      ; Y = 0: OAM buffer offset ($0200 area)
$03:CA0D 86 04        STX $04                         ; $04 = particle index
$03:CA0F A5 0A        LDA $0A                         ; \
$03:CA11 C9 03        CMP.B #$03                      ; |
$03:CA13 BD 26 C6     LDA.W $C626,X                   ; } A = particle X from pattern table (type 0-2: $C626, type 3+: $C6CE)
$03:CA16 90 03        BCC $CA1B                       ; |
$03:CA18 BD CE C6     LDA.W $C6CE,X                   ; /
$03:CA1B 38           SEC                             ; \
$03:CA1C E9 40        SBC.B #$40                      ; } $00 = X offset from burst center (table value - $40)
$03:CA1E 85 00        STA $00                         ; /
$03:CA20 5A           PHY                             ; Save OAM index
$03:CA21 A5 0A        LDA $0A                         ; \
$03:CA23 C9 03        CMP.B #$03                      ; |
$03:CA25 BD 7A C6     LDA.W $C67A,X                   ; } A = particle Y from pattern table (type 0-2: $C67A, type 3+: $C722)
$03:CA28 90 03        BCC $CA2D                       ; |
$03:CA2A BD 22 C7     LDA.W $C722,X                   ; /
$03:CA2D 38           SEC                             ; \
$03:CA2E E9 50        SBC.B #$50                      ; } $01 = Y offset from burst center (table value - $50)
$03:CA30 85 01        STA $01                         ; /
$03:CA32 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$03:CA34 10 03        BPL $CA39                       ; |
$03:CA36 49 FF        EOR.B #$FF                      ; } A = |X offset|
$03:CA38 1A           INC A                           ; /
$03:CA39 8D 02 42     STA.W $4202                     ; \
$03:CA3C A5 06        LDA $06                         ; |
$03:CA3E 8D 03 42     STA.W $4203                     ; |
$03:CA41 EA           NOP                             ; } Hardware multiply: |X offset| * radius scale [$06], result in $4216/$4217
$03:CA42 EA           NOP                             ; |
$03:CA43 EA           NOP                             ; |
$03:CA44 EA           NOP                             ; /
$03:CA45 AD 17 42     LDA.W $4217                     ; \
$03:CA48 A4 00        LDY $00                         ; |
$03:CA4A 10 03        BPL $CA4F                       ; |
$03:CA4C 49 FF        EOR.B #$FF                      ; |
$03:CA4E 1A           INC A                           ; } $02 = high byte of the product (X offset * scale / 256), sign restored from [$00]
$03:CA4F 85 02        STA $02                         ; /
$03:CA51 A5 01        LDA $01                         ; \
$03:CA53 10 03        BPL $CA58                       ; |
$03:CA55 49 FF        EOR.B #$FF                      ; } A = |Y offset|
$03:CA57 1A           INC A                           ; /
$03:CA58 8D 02 42     STA.W $4202                     ; \
$03:CA5B A5 06        LDA $06                         ; |
$03:CA5D 8D 03 42     STA.W $4203                     ; |
$03:CA60 EA           NOP                             ; } Hardware multiply: |Y offset| * radius scale [$06]
$03:CA61 EA           NOP                             ; |
$03:CA62 EA           NOP                             ; |
$03:CA63 EA           NOP                             ; /
$03:CA64 AD 17 42     LDA.W $4217                     ; \
$03:CA67 A4 01        LDY $01                         ; |
$03:CA69 10 03        BPL $CA6E                       ; |
$03:CA6B 49 FF        EOR.B #$FF                      ; |
$03:CA6D 1A           INC A                           ; } $03 = scaled Y offset, sign restored from [$01]
$03:CA6E 85 03        STA $03                         ; /
$03:CA70 A0 00        LDY.B #$00                      ; Y = 0: no sparkle jitter
$03:CA72 A5 07        LDA $07                         ; \
$03:CA74 C9 06        CMP.B #$06                      ; } Frames 0-5: skip the jitter
$03:CA76 90 0A        BCC $CA82                       ; /
$03:CA78 A5 05        LDA $05                         ; \
$03:CA7A 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:CA7B 65 04        ADC $04                         ; |
$03:CA7D 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:CA7E 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:CA7F 29 07        AND.B #$07                      ; } Frame >= 6: Y = (([$05] + particle index) >> 2) & 7, index into the jitter table
$03:CA81 A8           TAY                             ; /
$03:CA82 B9 E1 C9     LDA.W $C9E1,Y                   ; A = sparkle jitter X (0,1,1,0,0,-1,-1,0)
$03:CA85 7A           PLY                             ; Restore OAM index
$03:CA86 18           CLC                             ; \
$03:CA87 65 02        ADC $02                         ; |
$03:CA89 18           CLC                             ; } OAM X = center X + scaled X offset + jitter
$03:CA8A 65 08        ADC $08                         ; |
$03:CA8C 99 00 02     STA.W OAM_ExtendedDispX,Y       ; /
$03:CA8F A5 03        LDA $03                         ; \
$03:CA91 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:CA92 65 09        ADC $09                         ; } OAM Y = center Y + scaled Y offset
$03:CA94 99 01 02     STA.W OAM_ExtendedDispY,Y       ; /
$03:CA97 DA           PHX                             ; Save particle index
$03:CA98 A5 05        LDA $05                         ; \
$03:CA9A 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; |
$03:CA9C 85 0F        STA $0F                         ; |
$03:CA9E 0A           ASL                             ; |
$03:CA9F 0A           ASL                             ; |
$03:CAA0 0A           ASL                             ; } X = ([$05] & 3) * 10 + frame [$07]: row of 10 animation tiles
$03:CAA1 65 0F        ADC $0F                         ; |
$03:CAA3 65 0F        ADC $0F                         ; |
$03:CAA5 65 07        ADC $07                         ; |
$03:CAA7 AA           TAX                             ; /
$03:CAA8 BD B9 C9     LDA.W $C9B9,X                   ; \
$03:CAAB 99 02 02     STA.W OAM_ExtendedTile,Y        ; / Tile = $C9B9[X] (sparkle animation)
$03:CAAE FA           PLX                             ; Restore particle index
$03:CAAF A5 05        LDA $05                         ; \
$03:CAB1 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:CAB2 EA           NOP                             ; |
$03:CAB3 EA           NOP                             ; |
$03:CAB4 DA           PHX                             ; } A = [$05] / 2, XOR particle index unless type = 3: varies the palette per particle
$03:CAB5 A6 0A        LDX $0A                         ; |
$03:CAB7 E0 03        CPX.B #$03                      ; |
$03:CAB9 F0 02        BEQ $CABD                       ; |
$03:CABB 45 04        EOR $04                         ; /
$03:CABD 29 0E        AND.B #$0E                      ; \
$03:CABF 09 31        ORA.B #$31                      ; } Properties = palette (bits 1-3) | priority 3 | page 1 ($31)
$03:CAC1 99 03 02     STA.W OAM_ExtendedProp,Y        ; /
$03:CAC4 FA           PLX                             ; Restore particle index
$03:CAC5 5A           PHY                             ; \
$03:CAC6 98           TYA                             ; |
$03:CAC7 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:CAC8 4A           LSR                             ; } Size bit [$0420 + slot] = 0: 8x8 sprite
$03:CAC9 A8           TAY                             ; |
$03:CACA A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; |
$03:CACC 99 20 04     STA.W $0420,Y                   ; /
$03:CACF 7A           PLY                             ; Restore OAM index
$03:CAD0 C8           INY                             ; \
$03:CAD1 C8           INY                             ; |
$03:CAD2 C8           INY                             ; } Y += 4: next OAM slot
$03:CAD3 C8           INY                             ; /
$03:CAD4 CA           DEX                             ; \
$03:CAD5 30 03        BMI $CADA                       ; / Next particle, done when X < 0
$03:CAD7 4C 0D CA     JMP.W $CA0D                     ; Loop

$03:CADA A2 53        LDX.B #$53                      ; X = $53: second pass draws 20 particles ($53 down to $40); Y has wrapped to 0 ($0300 area)
$03:CADC 86 04        STX $04                         ; $04 = particle index
$03:CADE A5 0A        LDA $0A                         ; \
$03:CAE0 C9 03        CMP.B #$03                      ; |
$03:CAE2 BD 26 C6     LDA.W $C626,X                   ; } A = particle X from pattern table (type 0-2: $C626, type 3+: $C6CE)
$03:CAE5 90 03        BCC $CAEA                       ; |
$03:CAE7 BD CE C6     LDA.W $C6CE,X                   ; /
$03:CAEA 38           SEC                             ; \
$03:CAEB E9 40        SBC.B #$40                      ; } $00 = X offset from burst center (table value - $40)
$03:CAED 85 00        STA $00                         ; /
$03:CAEF A5 0A        LDA $0A                         ; \
$03:CAF1 C9 03        CMP.B #$03                      ; |
$03:CAF3 BD 7A C6     LDA.W $C67A,X                   ; } A = particle Y from pattern table (type 0-2: $C67A, type 3+: $C722)
$03:CAF6 90 03        BCC $CAFB                       ; |
$03:CAF8 BD 22 C7     LDA.W $C722,X                   ; /
$03:CAFB 38           SEC                             ; \
$03:CAFC E9 50        SBC.B #$50                      ; } $01 = Y offset from burst center (table value - $50)
$03:CAFE 85 01        STA $01                         ; /
$03:CB00 5A           PHY                             ; Save OAM index
$03:CB01 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$03:CB03 10 03        BPL $CB08                       ; |
$03:CB05 49 FF        EOR.B #$FF                      ; } A = |X offset|
$03:CB07 1A           INC A                           ; /
$03:CB08 8D 02 42     STA.W $4202                     ; \
$03:CB0B A5 06        LDA $06                         ; |
$03:CB0D 8D 03 42     STA.W $4203                     ; |
$03:CB10 EA           NOP                             ; } Hardware multiply: |X offset| * radius scale [$06]
$03:CB11 EA           NOP                             ; |
$03:CB12 EA           NOP                             ; |
$03:CB13 EA           NOP                             ; /
$03:CB14 AD 17 42     LDA.W $4217                     ; \
$03:CB17 A4 00        LDY $00                         ; |
$03:CB19 10 03        BPL $CB1E                       ; |
$03:CB1B 49 FF        EOR.B #$FF                      ; |
$03:CB1D 1A           INC A                           ; } $02 = high byte of the product, sign restored from [$00]
$03:CB1E 85 02        STA $02                         ; /
$03:CB20 A5 01        LDA $01                         ; \
$03:CB22 10 03        BPL $CB27                       ; |
$03:CB24 49 FF        EOR.B #$FF                      ; } A = |Y offset|
$03:CB26 1A           INC A                           ; /
$03:CB27 8D 02 42     STA.W $4202                     ; \
$03:CB2A A5 06        LDA $06                         ; |
$03:CB2C 8D 03 42     STA.W $4203                     ; |
$03:CB2F EA           NOP                             ; } Hardware multiply: |Y offset| * radius scale [$06]
$03:CB30 EA           NOP                             ; |
$03:CB31 EA           NOP                             ; |
$03:CB32 EA           NOP                             ; /
$03:CB33 AD 17 42     LDA.W $4217                     ; \
$03:CB36 A4 01        LDY $01                         ; |
$03:CB38 10 03        BPL $CB3D                       ; |
$03:CB3A 49 FF        EOR.B #$FF                      ; |
$03:CB3C 1A           INC A                           ; } $03 = scaled Y offset, sign restored from [$01]
$03:CB3D 85 03        STA $03                         ; /
$03:CB3F A0 00        LDY.B #$00                      ; Y = 0: no sparkle jitter
$03:CB41 A5 07        LDA $07                         ; \
$03:CB43 C9 06        CMP.B #$06                      ; } Frames 0-5: skip the jitter
$03:CB45 90 0A        BCC $CB51                       ; /
$03:CB47 A5 05        LDA $05                         ; \
$03:CB49 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:CB4A 65 04        ADC $04                         ; |
$03:CB4C 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:CB4D 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:CB4E 29 07        AND.B #$07                      ; } Frame >= 6: Y = (([$05] + particle index) >> 2) & 7, index into the jitter table
$03:CB50 A8           TAY                             ; /
$03:CB51 B9 E1 C9     LDA.W $C9E1,Y                   ; A = sparkle jitter X (0,1,1,0,0,-1,-1,0)
$03:CB54 7A           PLY                             ; Restore OAM index
$03:CB55 18           CLC                             ; \
$03:CB56 65 02        ADC $02                         ; |
$03:CB58 18           CLC                             ; } OAM X = center X + scaled X offset + jitter
$03:CB59 65 08        ADC $08                         ; |
$03:CB5B 99 00 03     STA.W OAM_DispX,Y               ; /
$03:CB5E A5 03        LDA $03                         ; \
$03:CB60 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:CB61 65 09        ADC $09                         ; } OAM Y = center Y + scaled Y offset
$03:CB63 99 01 03     STA.W OAM_DispY,Y               ; /
$03:CB66 DA           PHX                             ; Save particle index
$03:CB67 A5 05        LDA $05                         ; \
$03:CB69 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; |
$03:CB6B 85 0F        STA $0F                         ; |
$03:CB6D 0A           ASL                             ; |
$03:CB6E 0A           ASL                             ; |
$03:CB6F 0A           ASL                             ; } X = ([$05] & 3) * 10 + frame [$07]: row of 10 animation tiles
$03:CB70 65 0F        ADC $0F                         ; |
$03:CB72 65 0F        ADC $0F                         ; |
$03:CB74 65 07        ADC $07                         ; |
$03:CB76 AA           TAX                             ; /
$03:CB77 BD B9 C9     LDA.W $C9B9,X                   ; \
$03:CB7A 99 02 03     STA.W OAM_Tile,Y                ; / Tile = $C9B9[X] (sparkle animation)
$03:CB7D FA           PLX                             ; Restore particle index
$03:CB7E A5 05        LDA $05                         ; \
$03:CB80 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:CB81 EA           NOP                             ; |
$03:CB82 EA           NOP                             ; |
$03:CB83 DA           PHX                             ; } A = [$05] / 2, XOR particle index unless type = 3: varies the palette per particle
$03:CB84 A6 0A        LDX $0A                         ; |
$03:CB86 E0 03        CPX.B #$03                      ; |
$03:CB88 F0 02        BEQ $CB8C                       ; |
$03:CB8A 45 04        EOR $04                         ; /
$03:CB8C 29 0E        AND.B #$0E                      ; \
$03:CB8E 09 31        ORA.B #$31                      ; } Properties = palette (bits 1-3) | priority 3 | page 1 ($31)
$03:CB90 99 03 03     STA.W OAM_Prop,Y                ; /
$03:CB93 FA           PLX                             ; Restore particle index
$03:CB94 5A           PHY                             ; \
$03:CB95 98           TYA                             ; |
$03:CB96 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:CB97 4A           LSR                             ; } Size bit [$0460 + slot] = 0: 8x8 sprite
$03:CB98 A8           TAY                             ; |
$03:CB99 A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; |
$03:CB9B 99 60 04     STA.W OAM_TileSize,Y            ; /
$03:CB9E 7A           PLY                             ; Restore OAM index
$03:CB9F C8           INY                             ; \
$03:CBA0 C8           INY                             ; |
$03:CBA1 C8           INY                             ; } Y += 4: next OAM slot
$03:CBA2 C8           INY                             ; /
$03:CBA3 CA           DEX                             ; \
$03:CBA4 E0 3F        CPX.B #$3F                      ; / Next particle
$03:CBA6 F0 03        BEQ $CBAB                       ; Done when X = $3F (20 particles drawn)
$03:CBA8 4C DC CA     JMP.W $CADC                     ; Loop

$03:CBAB FA           PLX                             ; Restore sprite index
$03:CBAC 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $CBAD: Table: football spawn X offset (ChuckSprGenDispX) ;;;
{
$03:CBAD              .db $14,$EC                     ; X offset from Chuck: $14 facing right, $EC facing left

}

;;; $CBAF: Table: football spawn X high offset (ChuckSprGenSpeedHi) ;;;
{
$03:CBAF              .db $00,$FF                     ; X offset high byte: $00 / $FF

}

;;; $CBB1: Football spawn and Koopa Kid main (ChuckSprGenSpeedLo) ;;;
{
;; $03CBB1: football X speed table. $03CBB3: Chuck throws a football (called from bank 02): spawns sprite $1B
;;     ahead of the Chuck,
;; moving horizontally at $18/$E8 and upward at $E0. Returns without spawning if there is no free slot.
;; $03CC09: long-call wrapper for the Pipe Koopa Kid sprite main routine (set from bank 01). $03CC14 draws the
;;     sprite and, when
;; status = 8 and sprites are not locked, runs the state routine for [$151C].
$03:CBB1              .db $18,$E8                     ; Football X speed: $18 right, $E8 left

$03:CBB3 22 E4 A9 02  JSL.L FindFreeSprSlot           ; \
$03:CBB7 30 4F        BMI $CC08                       ; / Find a free sprite slot (Y); return if none
$03:CBB9 A9 1B        LDA.B #$1B                      ; \
$03:CBBB 99 9E 00     STA.W RAM_SpriteNum,Y           ; / Sprite number = $1B (Football)
$03:CBBE DA           PHX                             ; \
$03:CBBF BB           TYX                             ; |
$03:CBC0 22 D2 F7 07  JSL.L InitSpriteTables          ; } Initialize the new sprite's tables (X = new slot meanwhile)
$03:CBC4 FA           PLX                             ; /
$03:CBC5 A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; \
$03:CBC7 99 C8 14     STA.W $14C8,Y                   ; / Sprite status = 8 (normal)
$03:CBCA B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$03:CBCC 99 D8 00     STA.W RAM_SpriteYLo,Y           ; / New sprite Y low = spawner Y low
$03:CBCF BD D4 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; \
$03:CBD2 99 D4 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,Y           ; / New sprite Y high = spawner Y high
$03:CBD5 B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; \
$03:CBD7 85 01        STA $01                         ; / $01 = spawner X low
$03:CBD9 BD E0 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; \
$03:CBDC 85 00        STA $00                         ; / $00 = spawner X high
$03:CBDE DA           PHX                             ; \
$03:CBDF BD 7C 15     LDA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; } X = spawner facing direction (0 right, 1 left)
$03:CBE2 AA           TAX                             ; /
$03:CBE3 A5 01        LDA $01                         ; \
$03:CBE5 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:CBE6 7F AD CB 03  ADC.L ChuckSprGenDispX,X        ; } New X low = spawner X low + offset by direction
$03:CBEA 99 E4 00     STA.W RAM_SpriteXLo,Y           ; /
$03:CBED A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$03:CBEF 7F AF CB 03  ADC.L ChuckSprGenSpeedHi,X      ; } New X high = spawner X high + $00/$FF (carry)
$03:CBF3 99 E0 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,Y           ; /
$03:CBF6 BF B1 CB 03  LDA.L ChuckSprGenSpeedLo,X      ; \
$03:CBFA 99 B6 00     STA.W RAM_SpriteSpeedX,Y        ; / New X speed = $18 / $E8 by direction
$03:CBFD A9 E0        LDA.B #$E0                      ; \
$03:CBFF 99 AA 00     STA.W RAM_SpriteSpeedY,Y        ; / New Y speed = $E0 (thrown upward)
$03:CC02 A9 10        LDA.B #$10                      ; \
$03:CC04 99 40 15     STA.W $1540,Y                   ; / New [$1540] = $10 (sprite timer)
$03:CC07 FA           PLX                             ; Restore spawner index
$03:CC08 6B           RTL                             ; Return

$03:CC09 8B           PHB                             ; \
$03:CC0A 4B           PHK                             ; } Data bank = program bank (old bank saved)
$03:CC0B AB           PLB                             ; /
$03:CC0C 9E 62 16     STZ.W RAM_Tweaker1662,X         ; Clear sprite tweaker byte [$1662]
$03:CC0F 20 14 CC     JSR.W $CC14                     ; Draw and run the sprite ($CC14)
$03:CC12 AB           PLB                             ; Restore the data bank
$03:CC13 6B           RTL                             ; Return long

$03:CC14 20 84 D4     JSR.W $D484                     ; Draw the sprite ($D484)
$03:CC17 BD C8 14     LDA.W $14C8,X                   ; \
$03:CC1A C9 08        CMP.B #$08                      ; } Return unless sprite status = 8 (normal)
$03:CC1C D0 19        BNE $CC37                       ; /
$03:CC1E A5 9D        LDA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; \
$03:CC20 D0 15        BNE $CC37                       ; / Return if sprites are locked
$03:CC22 BD 1C 15     LDA.W $151C,X                   ; \
$03:CC25 22 DF 86 00  JSL.L ExecutePtr                ; / Run the state routine for [$151C]

}

;;; $CC29: Pointer table: Pipe Koopa Kid states (PipeKoopaPtrs) ;;;
{
;; Indexed by [$151C]: 0 pick pipe and timing, 1 rise, 2 peek out (can be stomped), 3 sink, 4 stomped, 5 fall,
;;     6 landed (ends the
;; level). Hedge: the sprite looks like a Koopa Kid (number $29) peeking from pipes; Mario stomps it three
;;     times.
$03:CC29 8A CC        .dw $CC8A                       ; State $00 - 0 - Pick pipe and timing, spawn helpers
$03:CC2B 21 CD        .dw $CD21                       ; State $01 - 1 - Rise out of the pipe
$03:CC2D C7 CD        .dw $CDC7                       ; State $02 - 2 - Peek out, can be stomped
$03:CC2F EF CD        .dw $CDEF                       ; State $03 - 3 - Sink back into the pipe
$03:CC31 0E CE        .dw $CE0E                       ; State $04 - 4 - Stomped, recoil
$03:CC33 5A CE        .dw $CE5A                       ; State $05 - 5 - Fall (after third stomp)
$03:CC35 89 CE        .dw $CE89                       ; State $06 - 6 - Landed, end the level

$03:CC37 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $CC38..CC50: Data: pipe positions and rise timers ;;;
{
$03:CC38              .db $18,$38,$58,$78,$98,$B8,$D8,$78 ; Pipe X positions (index 0-6; seventh entry $78 for the extra index 7)
$03:CC40              .db $40,$50,$50,$40,$30,$40,$50,$40 ; Pipe Y positions (index 0-6)
$03:CC48              .db $50,$4A,$50,$4A,$4A,$40,$4A,$48 ; Rise timer by [$1528] (0-8)
$03:CC50              .db $4A                         ; Rise timer for [$1528] = 8 (continued)

}

;;; $CC51..CC59: Data: initial animation frames ;;;
{
$03:CC51              .db $02,$04,$06,$08,$0B,$0C,$0E,$10 ; Initial animation frame by [$1528] (0-7)
$03:CC59              .db $13                         ; Initial animation frame for [$1528] = 8

}

;;; $CC5A..CC82: Table: pipe number by random value ;;;
{
;; Indexed by [$160E] (random 0-15) | [$1570] (0, $10 or $20): gives the pipe number 0-6 for each of the three
;;     Koopa Kid sprites.
$03:CC5A              .db $00,$01,$02,$03,$04,$05,$06,$00 ; Pipe number 0-6 by ([$160E] | part offset): entries 0-7
$03:CC62              .db $01,$02,$03,$04,$05,$06,$00,$01 ; Pipe number 0-6 by ([$160E] | part offset): entries 8-15
$03:CC6A              .db $02,$03,$04,$05,$06,$00,$01,$02 ; Pipe number 0-6 by ([$160E] | part offset): entries 16-23
$03:CC72              .db $03,$04,$05,$06,$00,$01,$02,$03 ; Pipe number 0-6 by ([$160E] | part offset): entries 24-31
$03:CC7A              .db $04,$05,$06,$00,$01,$02,$03,$04 ; Pipe number 0-6 by ([$160E] | part offset): entries 32-39
$03:CC82              .db $05,$06,$00,$01,$02,$03,$04,$05 ; Pipe number 0-6 by ([$160E] | part offset): entries 40-47

}

;;; $CC8A: Koopa Kid state 0: choose pipe ;;;
{
;; Waits for [$1540]. Picks (main sprite) a random seed, puts the sprite on its pipe, spawns the two helper
;;     sprites, chooses a
;; rise timer and initial frame, and moves on to state 1.
$03:CC8A BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; \
$03:CC8D D0 50        BNE $CCDF                       ; / Wait while the timer [$1540] runs; then return
$03:CC8F BD 70 15     LDA.W $1570,X                   ; \
$03:CC92 D0 09        BNE $CC9D                       ; / Skip the random pick for helper sprites ([$1570] != 0)
$03:CC94 22 F9 AC 01  JSL.L GetRand                   ; \
$03:CC98 29 0F        AND.B #$0F                      ; } [$160E] = random 0-15 (shared pipe-order seed)
$03:CC9A 9D 0E 16     STA.W $160E,X                   ; /
$03:CC9D BD 0E 16     LDA.W $160E,X                   ; \
$03:CCA0 1D 70 15     ORA.W $1570,X                   ; |
$03:CCA3 A8           TAY                             ; } Y = pipe number 0-6 from $CC5A[[$160E] | [$1570]]
$03:CCA4 B9 5A CC     LDA.W $CC5A,Y                   ; /
$03:CCA7 A8           TAY                             ; Y = pipe number
$03:CCA8 B9 38 CC     LDA.W $CC38,Y                   ; \
$03:CCAB 95 E4        STA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; / X position = $CC38[pipe number]
$03:CCAD B5 C2        LDA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; \
$03:CCAF C9 06        CMP.B #$06                      ; } A = $CC40[pipe number]: pipe Y position
$03:CCB1 B9 40 CC     LDA.W $CC40,Y                   ; /
$03:CCB4 90 02        BCC $CCB8                       ; [$C2] < 6: keep the table value
$03:CCB6 A9 50        LDA.B #$50                      ; Otherwise Y = $50
$03:CCB8 95 D8        STA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; Set Y position
$03:CCBA A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; A = 8: [$1528] value for helper sprites
$03:CCBC BC 70 15     LDY.W $1570,X                   ; \
$03:CCBF D0 0B        BNE $CCCC                       ; / Helper sprites ([$1570] != 0) keep A = 8
$03:CCC1 20 E2 CC     JSR.W $CCE2                     ; Spawn the two helper Koopa Kid sprites ($CCE2)
$03:CCC4 22 F9 AC 01  JSL.L GetRand                   ; \
$03:CCC8 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:CCC9 4A           LSR                             ; } A = random 0-7
$03:CCCA 29 07        AND.B #$07                      ; /
$03:CCCC 9D 28 15     STA.W $1528,X                   ; [$1528] = table index (0-8)
$03:CCCF A8           TAY                             ; \
$03:CCD0 B9 48 CC     LDA.W $CC48,Y                   ; } [$1540] = $CC48[index]: time to rise
$03:CCD3 9D 40 15     STA.W $1540,X                   ; /
$03:CCD6 FE 1C 15     INC.W $151C,X                   ; State + 1 (rise out of the pipe)
$03:CCD9 B9 51 CC     LDA.W $CC51,Y                   ; \
$03:CCDC 9D 02 16     STA.W $1602,X                   ; / [$1602] = $CC51[index]: initial animation frame
$03:CCDF 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $CCE0..CCE0: Data: helper part offsets ;;;
{
$03:CCE0              .db $10,$20                     ; [$1570] part offsets for the two helper sprites: $10, $20

}

;;; $CCE2: Spawn helper Koopa Kids; state 1 rise ;;;
{
;; $03CCE2: spawns two extra sprites ($29) at the same position, with [$1570] = $10 and $20 (copies [$C2],
;;     [$160E] and position).
;; $03CD21 (state 1): rises with Y speed $F8; when [$1540] expires sets it to $40 and goes to state 2.
;; Called by:
;;     $03:CCC1: Koopa Kid state 0: choose pipe
$03:CCE2 A0 01        LDY.B #$01                      ; Y = 1: first helper
$03:CCE4 20 E8 CC     JSR.W $CCE8                     ; Spawn helper Y = 1; then falls into the next copy with Y = 0
$03:CCE7 88           DEY                             ; Y = 0: second helper
$03:CCE8 A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; \
$03:CCEA 99 C8 14     STA.W $14C8,Y                   ; / Sprite status = 8 (normal)
$03:CCED A9 29        LDA.B #$29                      ; \
$03:CCEF 99 9E 00     STA.W RAM_SpriteNum,Y           ; / Sprite number = $29 (Koopa Kid)
$03:CCF2 DA           PHX                             ; \
$03:CCF3 BB           TYX                             ; |
$03:CCF4 22 D2 F7 07  JSL.L InitSpriteTables          ; } Initialize the new sprite's tables
$03:CCF8 FA           PLX                             ; /
$03:CCF9 B9 E0 CC     LDA.W $CCE0,Y                   ; \
$03:CCFC 99 70 15     STA.W $1570,Y                   ; / [$1570,Y] = $CCE0[Y]: part offset ($10 or $20)
$03:CCFF B5 C2        LDA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; \
$03:CD01 99 C2 00     STA.W RAM_SpriteState,Y         ; / Copy [$C2] (state value used for Y position) from the main sprite
$03:CD04 BD 0E 16     LDA.W $160E,X                   ; \
$03:CD07 99 0E 16     STA.W $160E,Y                   ; / Copy [$160E] (pipe seed) from the main sprite
$03:CD0A B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; \
$03:CD0C 99 E4 00     STA.W RAM_SpriteXLo,Y           ; / Copy X low
$03:CD0F BD E0 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; \
$03:CD12 99 E0 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,Y           ; / Copy X high
$03:CD15 B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$03:CD17 99 D8 00     STA.W RAM_SpriteYLo,Y           ; / Copy Y low
$03:CD1A BD D4 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; \
$03:CD1D 99 D4 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,Y           ; / Copy Y high
$03:CD20 60           RTS                             ; Return

$03:CD21 BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; \
$03:CD24 D0 08        BNE $CD2E                       ; / Timer [$1540] running: keep rising
$03:CD26 A9 40        LDA.B #$40                      ; \
$03:CD28 9D 40 15     STA.W $1540,X                   ; } Timer expired: [$1540] = $40, state + 1
$03:CD2B FE 1C 15     INC.W $151C,X                   ; /
$03:CD2E A9 F8        LDA.B #$F8                      ; \
$03:CD30 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; / Y speed = $F8 (rise out of the pipe)
$03:CD32 22 1A 80 01  JSL.L UpdateYPosNoGrvty         ; Apply Y speed (no gravity)
$03:CD36 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $CD37..CDBF: Table: Koopa Kid peek animation frames ;;;
{
;; Indexed by [$1528] * 16 + [$1540] / 4; gives the animation frame [$1602] while peeking out of the pipe.
$03:CD37              .db $02,$02,$02,$02,$03,$03,$03,$03 ; [$1528] = 0, [$1540]/4 = 0-7
$03:CD3F              .db $03,$03,$03,$03,$02,$02,$02,$02 ; [$1528] = 0, [$1540]/4 = 8-15
$03:CD47              .db $04,$04,$04,$04,$05,$05,$04,$05 ; [$1528] = 1, [$1540]/4 = 0-7
$03:CD4F              .db $05,$04,$05,$05,$04,$04,$04,$04 ; [$1528] = 1, [$1540]/4 = 8-15
$03:CD57              .db $06,$06,$06,$06,$07,$07,$07,$07 ; [$1528] = 2, [$1540]/4 = 0-7
$03:CD5F              .db $07,$07,$07,$07,$06,$06,$06,$06 ; [$1528] = 2, [$1540]/4 = 8-15
$03:CD67              .db $08,$08,$08,$08,$08,$09,$09,$08 ; [$1528] = 3, [$1540]/4 = 0-7
$03:CD6F              .db $08,$09,$09,$08,$08,$08,$08,$08 ; [$1528] = 3, [$1540]/4 = 8-15
$03:CD77              .db $0B,$0B,$0B,$0B,$0B,$0A,$0B,$0A ; [$1528] = 4, [$1540]/4 = 0-7
$03:CD7F              .db $0B,$0A,$0B,$0A,$0B,$0B,$0B,$0B ; [$1528] = 4, [$1540]/4 = 8-15
$03:CD87              .db $0C,$0C,$0C,$0C,$0D,$0C,$0D,$0C ; [$1528] = 5, [$1540]/4 = 0-7
$03:CD8F              .db $0D,$0C,$0D,$0C,$0D,$0D,$0D,$0D ; [$1528] = 5, [$1540]/4 = 8-15
$03:CD97              .db $0E,$0E,$0E,$0E,$0E,$0F,$0E,$0F ; [$1528] = 6, [$1540]/4 = 0-7
$03:CD9F              .db $0E,$0F,$0E,$0F,$0E,$0E,$0E,$0E ; [$1528] = 6, [$1540]/4 = 8-15
$03:CDA7              .db $10,$10,$10,$10,$11,$12,$11,$10 ; [$1528] = 7, [$1540]/4 = 0-7
$03:CDAF              .db $11,$12,$11,$10,$11,$11,$11,$11 ; [$1528] = 7, [$1540]/4 = 8-15
$03:CDB7              .db $13,$13,$13,$13,$13,$13,$13,$13 ; [$1528] = 8, [$1540]/4 = 0-7
$03:CDBF              .db $13,$13,$13,$13,$13,$13,$13,$13 ; [$1528] = 8, [$1540]/4 = 8-15

}

;;; $CDC7: Koopa Kid states 2-4: peek, sink, stomped ;;;
{
;; State 2: checks Mario contact and animates from $CD37; when the timer ends goes to state 3.
;; State 3: sinks at Y speed $10; helpers erase themselves, the main sprite returns to state 0.
;; State 4 (after a stomp): flickers or plays the recoil frames; after the third stomp ([$1534] = 3) goes to
;;     state 5, otherwise sinks.
$03:CDC7 20 A7 CE     JSR.W $CEA7                     ; Handle Mario contact ($CEA7)
$03:CDCA BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; \
$03:CDCD D0 0B        BNE $CDDA                       ; / Timer [$1540] still running: animate
$03:CDCF A9 24        LDA.B #$24                      ; \
$03:CDD1 9D 40 15     STA.W $1540,X                   ; / Timer = $24
$03:CDD4 A9 03        LDA.B #$03                      ; \
$03:CDD6 9D 1C 15     STA.W $151C,X                   ; / State = 3 (sink back)
$03:CDD9 60           RTS                             ; Return

$03:CDDA 4A           LSR                             ; \
$03:CDDB 4A           LSR                             ; } $00 = [$1540] / 4
$03:CDDC 85 00        STA $00                         ; /
$03:CDDE BD 28 15     LDA.W $1528,X                   ; \
$03:CDE1 0A           ASL                             ; |
$03:CDE2 0A           ASL                             ; |
$03:CDE3 0A           ASL                             ; |
$03:CDE4 0A           ASL                             ; } A = [$1528] * 16 | [$00]
$03:CDE5 05 00        ORA $00                         ; /
$03:CDE7 A8           TAY                             ; Y = index into $CD37
$03:CDE8 B9 37 CD     LDA.W $CD37,Y                   ; \
$03:CDEB 9D 02 16     STA.W $1602,X                   ; / [$1602] = $CD37[Y]: animation frame
$03:CDEE 60           RTS                             ; Return

$03:CDEF BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; \
$03:CDF2 D0 11        BNE $CE05                       ; / Timer [$1540] running: keep sinking
$03:CDF4 BD 70 15     LDA.W $1570,X                   ; \
$03:CDF7 F0 04        BEQ $CDFD                       ; / Main sprite: go to CDFD
$03:CDF9 9E C8 14     STZ.W $14C8,X                   ; Helper sprite: erase it (status 0)
$03:CDFC 60           RTS                             ; Return

$03:CDFD 9E 1C 15     STZ.W $151C,X                   ; State = 0 (main sprite picks a new pipe)
$03:CE00 A9 30        LDA.B #$30                      ; \
$03:CE02 9D 40 15     STA.W $1540,X                   ; / Timer = $30 (wait before reappearing)
$03:CE05 A9 10        LDA.B #$10                      ; \
$03:CE07 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; / Y speed = $10 (sink into the pipe)
$03:CE09 22 1A 80 01  JSL.L UpdateYPosNoGrvty         ; Apply Y speed (no gravity)
$03:CE0D 60           RTS                             ; Return

$03:CE0E BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; \
$03:CE11 D0 17        BNE $CE2A                       ; / Timer [$1540] running: animate
$03:CE13 FE 34 15     INC.W $1534,X                   ; Stomp count [$1534] + 1
$03:CE16 BD 34 15     LDA.W $1534,X                   ; \
$03:CE19 C9 03        CMP.B #$03                      ; } Not the third stomp: go back to state 3 via $CDCF
$03:CE1B D0 B2        BNE $CDCF                       ; /
$03:CE1D A9 05        LDA.B #$05                      ; \
$03:CE1F 9D 1C 15     STA.W $151C,X                   ; / Third stomp: state = 5 (fall)
$03:CE22 74 AA        STZ RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; Y speed = 0
$03:CE24 A9 23        LDA.B #$23                      ; \
$03:CE26 8D F9 1D     STA.W $1DF9                     ; / Play sound effect $23
$03:CE29 60           RTS                             ; Return

$03:CE2A BC 70 15     LDY.W $1570,X                   ; \
$03:CE2D D0 13        BNE $CE42                       ; / Y = [$1570]; helper sprites branch to CE42
$03:CE2F C9 24        CMP.B #$24                      ; \
$03:CE31 D0 05        BNE $CE38                       ; / Main sprite: timer = $24?
$03:CE33 A0 29        LDY.B #$29                      ; \
$03:CE35 8C FC 1D     STY.W $1DFC                     ; / Play sound effect $29 (once)
$03:CE38 A5 14        LDA RAM_FrameCounterB           ; \
$03:CE3A 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:CE3B 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:CE3C 29 01        AND.B #$01                      ; } [$1602] = ([$14] / 4) & 1: flicker between two frames
$03:CE3E 9D 02 16     STA.W $1602,X                   ; /
$03:CE41 60           RTS                             ; Return

$03:CE42 C9 10        CMP.B #$10                      ; \
$03:CE44 D0 05        BNE $CE4B                       ; / Helper: timer = $10?
$03:CE46 A0 2A        LDY.B #$2A                      ; \
$03:CE48 8C FC 1D     STY.W $1DFC                     ; / Play sound effect $2A (once)
$03:CE4B 4A           LSR                             ; \
$03:CE4C 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:CE4D 4A           LSR                             ; } Y = timer / 8
$03:CE4E A8           TAY                             ; /
$03:CE4F B9 56 CE     LDA.W $CE56,Y                   ; \
$03:CE52 9D 02 16     STA.W $1602,X                   ; / [$1602] = $CE56[Y]: recoil animation frame
$03:CE55 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $CE5A: Koopa Kid states 5-6 and Mario contact ;;;
{
;; State 5: falls (Y speed + 3 up to $40); on reaching Y >= $85 in the lower screen goes to state 6 with a $80
;;     timer and impact effect.
;; State 6: sinks at Y speed 4; when the timer ends erases the sprite, increments [$13C6], sets end-of-level
;;     timer [$1493] = $FF and music $0B.
;; $03CEA7: Mario contact: falling stomps score points, bounce Mario and put the sprite in state 4; the second
;;     stomp of the main sprite
;; kills the other sprites; otherwise Mario is hurt.
$03:CE5A 22 1A 80 01  JSL.L UpdateYPosNoGrvty         ; Apply Y speed (no gravity)
$03:CE5E B5 AA        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; \
$03:CE60 C9 40        CMP.B #$40                      ; } Y speed < $40: accelerate
$03:CE62 10 05        BPL $CE69                       ; /
$03:CE64 18           CLC                             ; \
$03:CE65 69 03        ADC.B #$03                      ; } Y speed += 3 (fall)
$03:CE67 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; /
$03:CE69 BD D4 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; \
$03:CE6C F0 19        BEQ $CE87                       ; / Y high = 0: still above the lower screen, skip
$03:CE6E B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$03:CE70 C9 85        CMP.B #$85                      ; } Y low < $85: not landed yet, skip
$03:CE72 90 13        BCC $CE87                       ; /
$03:CE74 A9 06        LDA.B #$06                      ; \
$03:CE76 9D 1C 15     STA.W $151C,X                   ; / State = 6 (landed)
$03:CE79 A9 80        LDA.B #$80                      ; \
$03:CE7B 9D 40 15     STA.W $1540,X                   ; / Timer = $80
$03:CE7E A9 20        LDA.B #$20                      ; \
$03:CE80 8D FC 1D     STA.W $1DFC                     ; / Play sound effect $20 (impact)
$03:CE83 22 28 85 02  JSL.L $8528                     ; Spawn impact effect ($8528)
$03:CE87 80 A6        BRA $CE2F                       ; Join the flicker animation ($CE2F)

$03:CE89 BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; \
$03:CE8C D0 10        BNE $CE9E                       ; / Wait while the timer [$1540] runs
$03:CE8E 9E C8 14     STZ.W $14C8,X                   ; Erase the sprite (status 0)
$03:CE91 EE C6 13     INC.W $13C6                     ; [$13C6]++ (boss defeated/level goal flag)
$03:CE94 A9 FF        LDA.B #$FF                      ; \
$03:CE96 8D 93 14     STA.W $1493                     ; / [$1493] = $FF (end-of-level timer)
$03:CE99 A9 0B        LDA.B #$0B                      ; \
$03:CE9B 8D FB 1D     STA.W $1DFB                     ; / Change music to $0B
$03:CE9E A9 04        LDA.B #$04                      ; \
$03:CEA0 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; / Y speed = 4
$03:CEA2 22 1A 80 01  JSL.L UpdateYPosNoGrvty         ; Apply Y speed (no gravity)
$03:CEA6 60           RTS                             ; Return

$03:CEA7 22 DC A7 01  JSL.L MarioSprInteract          ; Check Mario/sprite contact (carry set if touching)
$03:CEAB 90 44        BCC $CEF1                       ; No contact: return
$03:CEAD A5 7D        LDA RAM_MarioSpeedY             ; \
$03:CEAF C9 10        CMP.B #$10                      ; } Mario Y speed < $10 (signed): not stomping, Mario is hurt
$03:CEB1 30 3A        BMI $CEED                       ; /
$03:CEB3 22 99 AB 01  JSL.L DisplayContactGfx         ; Show contact stars
$03:CEB7 A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; \
$03:CEB9 22 E5 AC 02  JSL.L GivePoints                ; / Give points (score index 2)
$03:CEBD 22 33 AA 01  JSL.L BoostMarioSpeed           ; Bounce Mario upward
$03:CEC1 A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; \
$03:CEC3 8D F9 1D     STA.W $1DF9                     ; / Play sound effect $02
$03:CEC6 BD 70 15     LDA.W $1570,X                   ; \
$03:CEC9 D0 10        BNE $CEDB                       ; / Helper sprite: skip the main-sprite effects
$03:CECB A9 28        LDA.B #$28                      ; \
$03:CECD 8D FC 1D     STA.W $1DFC                     ; / Play sound effect $28
$03:CED0 BD 34 15     LDA.W $1534,X                   ; \
$03:CED3 C9 02        CMP.B #$02                      ; } If [$1534] = 2 (second stomp), kill the other sprites below
$03:CED5 D0 04        BNE $CEDB                       ; /
$03:CED7 22 C8 A6 03  JSL.L KillMostSprites           ; Kill most sprites on screen
$03:CEDB A9 04        LDA.B #$04                      ; \
$03:CEDD 9D 1C 15     STA.W $151C,X                   ; / State = 4 (stomped)
$03:CEE0 A9 50        LDA.B #$50                      ; \
$03:CEE2 BC 70 15     LDY.W $1570,X                   ; |
$03:CEE5 F0 02        BEQ $CEE9                       ; |
$03:CEE7 A9 1F        LDA.B #$1F                      ; } Timer = $50 for the main sprite, $1F for helpers
$03:CEE9 9D 40 15     STA.W $1540,X                   ; /
$03:CEEC 60           RTS                             ; Return

$03:CEED 22 B7 F5 00  JSL.L HurtMario                 ; Hurt Mario
$03:CEF1 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

$03:D48F 7D 02 16     ADC.W $1602,X                   ; |

$03:D494 B5 C2        LDA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; \
$03:D496 C9 06        CMP.B #$06                      ; |

$03:D4D6 C8           INY                             ; |
$03:D4D7 C8           INY                             ; |

;;; $D674: Draw Peach message letters ;;;
{
;; Draws the letters of Princess Peach's message revealed so far: [$1921] letters from the table at
;;     $D524 as 8x8 sprites, written to OAM from $0200 up.
;; The letter count is advanced by the Peach sprite code ($AEAF) with timers from $AE5B.
;; Parameters: X: sprite index (preserved).
;; Called by:
;;     $03:AEAF: Peach state 5: ending picture steps
;;     $03:AF30: Peach state 6: fade ending color
$03:D674 DA           PHX                             ; Save sprite index
$03:D675 C2 30        REP #$30                        ; A, X and Y 16-bit
$03:D677 AE 21 19     LDX.W $1921                     ; \
$03:D67A F0 2C        BEQ $D6A8                       ; / X = number of letters revealed so far ([$1921]); none: nothing to draw
$03:D67C CA           DEX                             ; X = index of the last letter
$03:D67D A0 00 00     LDY.W #$0000                    ; Y = 0: offset into the OAM buffer at $0200
$03:D680 DA           PHX                             ; Save letter index
$03:D681 8A           TXA                             ; \
$03:D682 0A           ASL                             ; |
$03:D683 0A           ASL                             ; |
$03:D684 AA           TAX                             ; / X = letter index * 4 (4 bytes per letter in the table)
$03:D685 BD 24 D5     LDA.W $D524,X                   ; \
$03:D688 99 00 02     STA.W OAM_ExtendedDispX,Y       ; / OAM Y and X of this letter (one 16-bit write: X, Y from the table)
$03:D68B BD 26 D5     LDA.W $D526,X                   ; \
$03:D68E 99 02 02     STA.W OAM_ExtendedTile,Y        ; / OAM tile and properties of this letter (16-bit write)
$03:D691 5A           PHY                             ; Save OAM offset
$03:D692 98           TYA                             ; \
$03:D693 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:D694 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:D695 A8           TAY                             ; / Y = OAM offset / 4: index into the OAM size table
$03:D696 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$03:D698 A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; \
$03:D69A 99 20 04     STA.W $0420,Y                   ; / OAM size entry ($0420 table) = 0: 8x8 sprite, X < 256
$03:D69D C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$03:D69F 7A           PLY                             ; Restore OAM offset
$03:D6A0 FA           PLX                             ; Restore letter index
$03:D6A1 C8           INY                             ; \
$03:D6A2 C8           INY                             ; |
$03:D6A3 C8           INY                             ; |
$03:D6A4 C8           INY                             ; / Next OAM slot: Y += 4
$03:D6A5 CA           DEX                             ; \
$03:D6A6 10 D8        BPL $D680                       ; / Loop for all revealed letters
$03:D6A8 E2 30        SEP #$30                        ; A, X and Y 8-bit
$03:D6AA FA           PLX                             ; Restore sprite index
$03:D6AB 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $D6AC..D6FC: Padding: FF fill ;;;
{
$03:D6AC              .db $FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF
$03:D6B4              .db $FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF
$03:D6BC              .db $FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF
$03:D6C4              .db $FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF
$03:D6CC              .db $FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF
$03:D6D4              .db $FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF
$03:D6DC              .db $FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF
$03:D6E4              .db $FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF
$03:D6EC              .db $FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF
$03:D6F4              .db $FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF
$03:D6FC              .db $FF,$FF,$FF,$FF

}

;;; $D700..D708: Table: bridge segment X positions ;;;
{
;; X pixel position of each of the 12 bridge segments broken by BreakBridge: $B0 down to $00 in steps of $10.
$03:D700              .db $B0,$A0,$90,$80,$70,$60,$50,$40 ; Bridge segment X positions: $B0 down to $40 (16 px apart)
$03:D708              .db $30,$20,$10,$00             ; Bridge segment X positions: $30 down to $00

}

;;; $D70C: Reznor bridge: wait for two dead Reznors ;;;
{
;; Called from the Reznor sprite code ($03989F) every frame for the sprite in slot 7. Sums the four Reznor-
;;     dead flags ([$1520]-[$1523]); with fewer than 2 dead it returns, otherwise it falls into BreakBridge.
;; Called by:
;;     $03:989F: Reznor: unlocked, slot 7 setup (ReznorNotLocked)
$03:D70C DA           PHX                             ; Save sprite index
$03:D70D AD 20 15     LDA.W RAM_Reznor1Dead           ; \
$03:D710 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:D711 6D 21 15     ADC.W RAM_Reznor2Dead           ; |
$03:D714 6D 22 15     ADC.W RAM_Reznor3Dead           ; |
$03:D717 6D 23 15     ADC.W RAM_Reznor4Dead           ; / A = number of dead Reznors (flags [$1520]-[$1523])
$03:D71A C9 02        CMP.B #$02                      ; \
$03:D71C 90 39        BCC $D757                       ; / Fewer than 2 Reznors dead: leave the bridge alone ($03D757)
}

;;; $D71E: Break bridge one segment at a time (BreakBridge) ;;;
{
;; Once 2 Reznors are dead, destroys the bridge from the outside in, a segment pair (left and mirrored right)
;;     every $40 frames: spawns smoke puffs and plays sound $07 at the start,
;; then $04 frames later replaces both blocks with Map16 tile $25 and queues a stripe image that blanks 3 BG
;;     tiles on the two rows of each block.
;; [$1B9F] = number of segments broken (0-12); [$14A7] = segment timer, [$98]/[$9A] = block position scratch.
;; Sub-entries: $03D759 mirrors the block X ($0170 - X), $03D766 smoke puffs, $03D77F erases one block and
;;     queues the tilemap update.
$03:D71E AE 9F 1B     LDX.W $1B9F                     ; X = [$1B9F]: number of bridge segments already broken
$03:D721 E0 0C        CPX.B #$0C                      ; \
$03:D723 B0 32        BCS $D757                       ; / All 12 segments gone: return ($03D757)
$03:D725 BF 00 D7 03  LDA.L $D700,X                   ; \
$03:D729 85 9A        STA RAM_BlockXLo                ; |
$03:D72B 64 9B        STZ RAM_BlockXHi                ; / Block X = $D700[X]: X position of this bridge segment (left side)
$03:D72D A9 B0        LDA.B #$B0                      ; \
$03:D72F 85 98        STA RAM_BlockYLo                ; |
$03:D731 64 99        STZ RAM_BlockYHi                ; / Block Y = $00B0: row of the bridge
$03:D733 AD A7 14     LDA.W $14A7                     ; \
$03:D736 F0 12        BEQ $D74A                       ; / Segment timer [$14A7] = 0: start breaking this segment ($03D74A)
$03:D738 C9 3C        CMP.B #$3C                      ; \
$03:D73A D0 1B        BNE $D757                       ; / Timer != $3C: nothing to do this frame
$03:D73C 20 7F D7     JSR.W $D77F                     ; Replace the left block with an empty tile
$03:D73F 20 59 D7     JSR.W $D759                     ; Mirror the block X position to the right side
$03:D742 20 7F D7     JSR.W $D77F                     ; Replace the right block too
$03:D745 EE 9F 1B     INC.W $1B9F                     ; Next segment: [$1B9F]++
$03:D748 80 0D        BRA $D757                       ; Done ($03D757)

$03:D74A 20 66 D7     JSR.W $D766                     ; Smoke puffs at both blocks
$03:D74D A9 40        LDA.B #$40                      ; \
$03:D74F 8D A7 14     STA.W $14A7                     ; / Segment timer [$14A7] = $40
$03:D752 A9 07        LDA.B #$07                      ; \
$03:D754 8D FC 1D     STA.W $1DFC                     ; / Play sound effect $07 ([$1DFC])
$03:D757 FA           PLX                             ; Restore sprite index
$03:D758 6B           RTL                             ; Return

$03:D759 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$03:D75B A9 70 01     LDA.W #$0170                    ; \
$03:D75E 38           SEC                             ; |
$03:D75F E5 9A        SBC RAM_BlockXLo                ; |
$03:D761 85 9A        STA RAM_BlockXLo                ; / Block X = $0170 - Block X: mirror about the bridge center (X = $00B8)
$03:D763 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$03:D765 60           RTS                             ; Return

$03:D766 20 6C D7     JSR.W $D76C                     ; Smoke puff at the left block
$03:D769 20 59 D7     JSR.W $D759                     ; Mirror X, then fall into the puff code for the right block
$03:D76C C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$03:D76E A5 9A        LDA RAM_BlockXLo                ; \
$03:D770 38           SEC                             ; |
$03:D771 E5 1A        SBC RAM_ScreenBndryXLo          ; |
$03:D773 C9 00 01     CMP.W #$0100                    ; / Carry set if the block is off-screen horizontally (X - [$1A] >= $0100)
$03:D776 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$03:D778 B0 04        BCS $D77E                       ; Off-screen: no smoke
$03:D77A 22 44 8A 02  JSL.L $8A44                     ; Spawn a smoke puff at the block position ($8A44)
$03:D77E 60           RTS                             ; Return

$03:D77F A5 9A        LDA RAM_BlockXLo                ; \
$03:D781 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:D782 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:D783 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:D784 85 01        STA $01                         ; / $01 = block X / 8 (tile column)
$03:D786 4A           LSR                             ; \
$03:D787 05 98        ORA RAM_BlockYLo                ; / A = block row ([$98]) | block column (X / 16): Map16 index within a screen
$03:D789 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$03:D78B 29 FF 00     AND.W #$00FF                    ; Keep the low byte only
$03:D78E A6 9B        LDX RAM_BlockXHi                ; \
$03:D790 F0 06        BEQ $D798                       ; |
$03:D792 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:D793 69 B0 01     ADC.W #$01B0                    ; |
$03:D796 A2 04        LDX.B #$04                      ; / Block X high byte set: Map16 index += $01B0 (second screen), X = 4 (tilemap page 2)
$03:D798 86 00        STX $00                         ; $00 = tilemap page offset (0 or 4)
$03:D79A C2 10        REP #$10                        ; Index 16-bit
$03:D79C AA           TAX                             ; X = Map16 index
$03:D79D E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$03:D79F A9 25        LDA.B #$25                      ; \
$03:D7A1 9F 00 C8 7E  STA.L $7EC800,X                 ; / Map16 tile low byte = $25 (empty tile)
$03:D7A5 A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; \
$03:D7A7 9F 00 C8 7F  STA.L $7FC800,X                 ; / Map16 tile high byte = 0
$03:D7AB C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$03:D7AD AF 7B 83 7F  LDA.L $7F837B                   ; \
$03:D7B1 AA           TAX                             ; / X = current write index of the stripe image buffer
$03:D7B2 A9 5A C0     LDA.W #$C05A                    ; \
$03:D7B5 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:D7B6 65 00        ADC $00                         ; |
$03:D7B8 9F 7D 83 7F  STA.L $7F837D,X                 ; / Stripe record 1: VRAM address $5AC0 + [$01] (tile column), +$0400 if page 2
$03:D7BC 09 00 20     ORA.W #$2000                    ; \
$03:D7BF 9F 83 83 7F  STA.L $7F8383,X                 ; / Stripe record 2: VRAM address = record 1 + $20 (next tilemap row)
$03:D7C3 A9 40 02     LDA.W #$0240                    ; \
$03:D7C6 9F 7F 83 7F  STA.L $7F837F,X                 ; |
$03:D7CA 9F 85 83 7F  STA.L $7F8385,X                 ; / Both records: header $0240 = RLE, count - 1 = 2 (three tiles)
$03:D7CE A9 FC 38     LDA.W #$38FC                    ; \
$03:D7D1 9F 81 83 7F  STA.L $7F8381,X                 ; |
$03:D7D5 9F 87 83 7F  STA.L $7F8387,X                 ; / Both records: data = tile $FC (blank), attributes $38
$03:D7D9 A9 FF 00     LDA.W #$00FF                    ; \
$03:D7DC 9F 89 83 7F  STA.L $7F8389,X                 ; / End of stripe image marker $FF
$03:D7E0 8A           TXA                             ; \
$03:D7E1 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:D7E2 69 0C 00     ADC.W #$000C                    ; |
$03:D7E5 8F 7B 83 7F  STA.L $7F837B                   ; / Stripe buffer index += $0C (two 6-byte records)
$03:D7E9 E2 30        SEP #$30                        ; A, X and Y 8-bit
$03:D7EB 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $D7EC: Mode 7 room: clear map, draw Iggy platform (IggyPlatform) ;;;
{
;; Data: IggyPlatform = 16x16 block numbers of the tilting platform ($00 = empty); $D8EC = 4 tile
;;     numbers per block (2x2 tiles, column order).
;; Code ($03D958, called from game mode code at $0097D8): clears the whole Mode 7 tilemap to tile $FF, then,
;;     for Iggy/Larry rooms only ([$0D9B] bit 6 clear),
;; draws the platform at tilemap row 16, column 16 and keeps a copy of the block layout at $0AF6-$0BF5.
;; Quirk: the second tile row of each block row is written by repeating the same blocks with [$03] = 1.
$03:D7EC              .db $00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00 ; Platform layout row 0, blocks 0-7 (block numbers)
$03:D7F4              .db $00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00 ; Platform layout row 0, blocks 8-15 (block numbers)
$03:D7FC              .db $00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00 ; Platform layout row 1, blocks 0-7 (block numbers)
$03:D804              .db $00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00 ; Platform layout row 1, blocks 8-15 (block numbers)
$03:D80C              .db $00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00 ; Platform layout row 2, blocks 0-7 (block numbers)
$03:D814              .db $00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00 ; Platform layout row 2, blocks 8-15 (block numbers)
$03:D81C              .db $00,$00,$15,$16,$17,$18,$17,$18 ; Platform layout row 3, blocks 0-7 (block numbers)
$03:D824              .db $17,$18,$17,$18,$19,$1A,$00,$00 ; Platform layout row 3, blocks 8-15 (block numbers)
$03:D82C              .db $00,$00,$01,$02,$03,$04,$03,$04 ; Platform layout row 4, blocks 0-7 (block numbers)
$03:D834              .db $03,$04,$03,$04,$05,$12,$00,$00 ; Platform layout row 4, blocks 8-15 (block numbers)
$03:D83C              .db $00,$00,$00,$07,$04,$03,$04,$03 ; Platform layout row 5, blocks 0-7 (block numbers)
$03:D844              .db $04,$03,$04,$03,$08,$00,$00,$00 ; Platform layout row 5, blocks 8-15 (block numbers)
$03:D84C              .db $00,$00,$00,$09,$0A,$04,$03,$04 ; Platform layout row 6, blocks 0-7 (block numbers)
$03:D854              .db $03,$04,$03,$0B,$0C,$00,$00,$00 ; Platform layout row 6, blocks 8-15 (block numbers)
$03:D85C              .db $00,$00,$00,$00,$0D,$0E,$04,$03 ; Platform layout row 7, blocks 0-7 (block numbers)
$03:D864              .db $04,$03,$0F,$10,$00,$00,$00,$00 ; Platform layout row 7, blocks 8-15 (block numbers)
$03:D86C              .db $00,$00,$00,$00,$11,$02,$03,$04 ; Platform layout row 8, blocks 0-7 (block numbers)
$03:D874              .db $03,$04,$05,$12,$00,$00,$00,$00 ; Platform layout row 8, blocks 8-15 (block numbers)
$03:D87C              .db $00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$07,$04,$03 ; Platform layout row 9, blocks 0-7 (block numbers)
$03:D884              .db $04,$03,$08,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00 ; Platform layout row 9, blocks 8-15 (block numbers)
$03:D88C              .db $00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$09,$0A,$04 ; Platform layout row 10, blocks 0-7 (block numbers)
$03:D894              .db $03,$0B,$0C,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00 ; Platform layout row 10, blocks 8-15 (block numbers)
$03:D89C              .db $00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$13,$03 ; Platform layout row 11, blocks 0-7 (block numbers)
$03:D8A4              .db $04,$14,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00 ; Platform layout row 11, blocks 8-15 (block numbers)
$03:D8AC              .db $00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$13 ; Platform layout row 12, blocks 0-7 (block numbers)
$03:D8B4              .db $14,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00 ; Platform layout row 12, blocks 8-15 (block numbers)
$03:D8BC              .db $00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00 ; Platform layout row 13, blocks 0-7 (block numbers)
$03:D8C4              .db $00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00 ; Platform layout row 13, blocks 8-15 (block numbers)
$03:D8CC              .db $00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00 ; Platform layout row 14, blocks 0-7 (block numbers)
$03:D8D4              .db $00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00 ; Platform layout row 14, blocks 8-15 (block numbers)
$03:D8DC              .db $00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00 ; Platform layout row 15, blocks 0-7 (block numbers)
$03:D8E4              .db $00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00 ; Platform layout row 15, blocks 8-15 (block numbers)
$03:D8EC              .db $FF,$FF                     ; Block tile table, blocks 0-0 (4 tile numbers per block)

$03:D8EE              .db $FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$24,$34,$25,$0B ; Block tile table, blocks 0-2 (4 tile numbers per block)
$03:D8F6              .db $26,$36,$0E,$1B,$0C,$1C,$0D,$1D ; Block tile table, blocks 2-4 (4 tile numbers per block)
$03:D8FE              .db $0E,$1E,$29,$39,$2A,$3A,$2B,$3B ; Block tile table, blocks 4-6 (4 tile numbers per block)
$03:D906              .db $26,$38,$20,$30,$21,$31,$27,$37 ; Block tile table, blocks 6-8 (4 tile numbers per block)
$03:D90E              .db $28,$38,$FF,$FF,$22,$32,$0E,$33 ; Block tile table, blocks 8-10 (4 tile numbers per block)
$03:D916              .db $0C,$1C,$0D,$1D,$0E,$3C,$2D,$3D ; Block tile table, blocks 10-12 (4 tile numbers per block)
$03:D91E              .db $FF,$FF,$07,$17,$0E,$23,$0E,$04 ; Block tile table, blocks 12-14 (4 tile numbers per block)
$03:D926              .db $0C,$1C,$0D,$1D,$0E,$09,$0E,$2C ; Block tile table, blocks 14-16 (4 tile numbers per block)
$03:D92E              .db $0A,$1A,$FF,$FF,$24,$34,$2B,$3B ; Block tile table, blocks 16-18 (4 tile numbers per block)
$03:D936              .db $FF,$FF,$07,$17,$0E,$18,$0E,$19 ; Block tile table, blocks 18-20 (4 tile numbers per block)
$03:D93E              .db $0A,$1A,$02,$12,$03,$13,$03,$08 ; Block tile table, blocks 20-22 (4 tile numbers per block)
$03:D946              .db $03,$05,$03,$05,$03,$14,$03,$15 ; Block tile table, blocks 22-24 (4 tile numbers per block)
$03:D94E              .db $03,$05,$03,$05,$03,$08,$03,$06 ; Block tile table, blocks 24-26 (4 tile numbers per block)
$03:D956              .db $0F,$1F                     ; Block tile table, blocks 26-26 (4 tile numbers per block)

$03:D958 C2 10        REP #$10                        ; Index 16-bit
$03:D95A 9C 15 21     STZ.W $2115                     ; VMAIN = 0: VRAM address increments after each $2118 write
$03:D95D 9C 16 21     STZ.W $2116                     ; \
$03:D960 9C 17 21     STZ.W $2117                     ; / VRAM address = $0000: start of the Mode 7 tilemap
$03:D963 A2 00 40     LDX.W #$4000                    ; X = $4000: size of the 128 x 128 tilemap
$03:D966 A9 FF        LDA.B #$FF                      ; A = tile $FF (blank)
$03:D968 8D 18 21     STA.W $2118                     ; \
$03:D96B CA           DEX                             ; |
$03:D96C D0 FA        BNE $D968                       ; / Fill the whole Mode 7 tilemap with tile $FF
$03:D96E E2 10        SEP #$10                        ; Index 8-bit
$03:D970 2C 9B 0D     BIT.W $0D9B                     ; \
$03:D973 70 1B        BVS $D990                       ; / Bit 6 of [$0D9B] set (not Iggy/Larry): no platform, return
$03:D975 8B           PHB                             ; \
$03:D976 4B           PHK                             ; |
$03:D977 AB           PLB                             ; / Data bank = $03 (old bank saved)
$03:D978 A9 EC        LDA.B #$EC                      ; \
$03:D97A 85 05        STA $05                         ; |
$03:D97C A9 D7        LDA.B #$D7                      ; |
$03:D97E 85 06        STA $06                         ; |
$03:D980 A9 03        LDA.B #$03                      ; |
$03:D982 85 07        STA $07                         ; / [$05] = $03D7EC: pointer to the platform block layout (IggyPlatform)
$03:D984 A9 10        LDA.B #$10                      ; \
$03:D986 85 00        STA $00                         ; |
$03:D988 A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; |
$03:D98A 85 01        STA $01                         ; / [$00] = $0810: VRAM address of the platform (tilemap row 16, column 16)
$03:D98C 20 91 D9     JSR.W $D991                     ; Draw the platform into the tilemap
$03:D98F AB           PLB                             ; Restore data bank
$03:D990 6B           RTL                             ; Return

$03:D991 9C 15 21     STZ.W $2115                     ; VMAIN = 0 again
$03:D994 A0 00        LDY.B #$00                      ; Y = 0: index into the platform layout
$03:D996 84 02        STY $02                         ; $02 = index of the first block of this row
$03:D998 A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; A = 0
$03:D99A 85 03        STA $03                         ; $03 = 0: first of the two tile rows of this block row
$03:D99C A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$03:D99E 8D 16 21     STA.W $2116                     ; |
$03:D9A1 A5 01        LDA $01                         ; |
$03:D9A3 8D 17 21     STA.W $2117                     ; / VRAM address = [$00]/[$01]
$03:D9A6 A4 02        LDY $02                         ; Y = first block of this row
$03:D9A8 A9 10        LDA.B #$10                      ; \
$03:D9AA 85 04        STA $04                         ; / $04 = 16 blocks per row
$03:D9AC B7 05        LDA [$05],Y                     ; A = block number from the layout
$03:D9AE 99 F6 0A     STA.W $0AF6,Y                   ; Keep a copy of the layout at $0AF6 + Y
$03:D9B1 0A           ASL                             ; \
$03:D9B2 0A           ASL                             ; |
$03:D9B3 05 03        ORA $03                         ; |
$03:D9B5 AA           TAX                             ; / X = block * 4 + [$03]: index into the block tile table
$03:D9B6 BF EC D8 03  LDA.L $D8EC,X                   ; \
$03:D9BA 8D 18 21     STA.W $2118                     ; / Write the first tile of this block row ($D8EC)
$03:D9BD BF EE D8 03  LDA.L $D8EE,X                   ; \
$03:D9C1 8D 18 21     STA.W $2118                     ; / Write the second tile ($D8EE = table + 2)
$03:D9C4 C8           INY                             ; Next block
$03:D9C5 C6 04        DEC $04                         ; \
$03:D9C7 D0 E3        BNE $D9AC                       ; / Repeat for 16 blocks
$03:D9C9 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$03:D9CB 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:D9CC 69 80        ADC.B #$80                      ; |
$03:D9CE 85 00        STA $00                         ; |
$03:D9D0 90 02        BCC $D9D4                       ; |
$03:D9D2 E6 01        INC $01                         ; / [$00]/[$01] += $0080: next Mode 7 tilemap row
$03:D9D4 A5 03        LDA $03                         ; \
$03:D9D6 49 01        EOR.B #$01                      ; |
$03:D9D8 D0 C0        BNE $D99A                       ; / Toggle [$03]: if it was 0, redo the blocks for the second tile row ($03D99A)
$03:D9DA 98           TYA                             ; \
$03:D9DB D0 B9        BNE $D996                       ; / Y = 0 after the last block (wrapped past 256)? Else next block row
$03:D9DD 60           RTS                             ; Return

;;; $DD6E: Pointer table: boss palettes, low bytes (KoopaPalPtrLo) ;;;
{
