$03:DD6E              .db $BC,$A4,$98,$78,$6C         ; Boss palette pointers, low bytes (bank 0): $B2BC, $B2A4, $B298, $B378, $B36C

}

;;; $DD73: Mode 7 boss graphics and palette setup (KoopaPalPtrHi) ;;;
{
;; High bytes of the palette pointers, ExGFX file numbers per boss ($DD78), then the setup routine
;;     ($03DD7D, called from Reznor and Koopa kid init code):
;; stores the boss number in [$13FC], copies the boss palette (6 colors) to $0707, decompresses the ExGFX file
;;     and converts its 128 3bpp tiles to Mode 7 8bpp tile pairs (normal + mirrored) in VRAM,
;; and blanks the 96-byte tilemap buffer at $7E:C680. Boss 4 also draws an 8x8 tile block and sets Mode 7
;;     values [$2C], [$38], [$39].
;; Parameters: X: sprite index (preserved). Sub-routine $03DDE5 converts one tile with the help of
;;     $03DE39/$03DE3C.
$03:DD73              .db $B2,$B2,$B2,$B3,$B3         ; Boss palette pointers, high bytes

$03:DD78              .db $0B,$0B,$0B,$21,$00         ; ExGFX file per boss (0-4): $0B, $0B, $0B, $21, none

$03:DD7D DA           PHX                             ; Save sprite index
$03:DD7E 8B           PHB                             ; \
$03:DD7F 4B           PHK                             ; |
$03:DD80 AB           PLB                             ; / Data bank = $03 (old bank saved)
$03:DD81 B4 C2        LDY RAM_SpriteState,X           ; \
$03:DD83 8C FC 13     STY.W $13FC                     ; / [$13FC] = boss number (the sprite state)
$03:DD86 C0 04        CPY.B #$04                      ; \
$03:DD88 D0 0D        BNE $DD97                       ; / Boss 4 only: extra setup; others go to $03DD97
$03:DD8A 20 8E DE     JSR.W $DE8E                     ; Draw the 8x8 tile block into the Mode 7 tilemap
$03:DD8D A9 48        LDA.B #$48                      ; \
$03:DD8F 85 2C        STA $2C                         ; / Mode 7 center Y low byte [$2C] = $48
$03:DD91 A9 14        LDA.B #$14                      ; \
$03:DD93 85 38        STA $38                         ; |
$03:DD95 85 39        STA $39                         ; / Mode 7 matrix values [$38] = [$39] = $14 (probably the zoom)
$03:DD97 A9 FF        LDA.B #$FF                      ; \
$03:DD99 85 5D        STA RAM_ScreensInLvl            ; / [$5D] (screens in level) = $FF
$03:DD9B 1A           INC A                           ; A = 0
$03:DD9C 85 5E        STA $5E                         ; [$5E] = 0
$03:DD9E AC FC 13     LDY.W $13FC                     ; Y = boss number
$03:DDA1 BE 78 DD     LDX.W $DD78,Y                   ; X = ExGFX file for this boss ($DD78), 0 = none
$03:DDA4 B9 6E DD     LDA.W KoopaPalPtrLo,Y           ; \
$03:DDA7 85 00        STA $00                         ; |
$03:DDA9 B9 73 DD     LDA.W KoopaPalPtrHi,Y           ; |
$03:DDAC 85 01        STA $01                         ; |
$03:DDAE 64 02        STZ $02                         ; / [$00] = $00:xxxx: pointer to the boss palette in bank 0
$03:DDB0 A0 0B        LDY.B #$0B                      ; \
$03:DDB2 B7 00        LDA [$00],Y                     ; |
$03:DDB4 99 07 07     STA.W $0707,Y                   ; |
$03:DDB7 88           DEY                             ; |
$03:DDB8 10 F8        BPL $DDB2                       ; / Copy 12 bytes (6 colors) of the palette to the CGRAM mirror at $0707
$03:DDBA A9 80        LDA.B #$80                      ; \
$03:DDBC 8D 15 21     STA.W $2115                     ; / VMAIN = $80: VRAM address increments after $2119 writes
$03:DDBF 9C 16 21     STZ.W $2116                     ; \
$03:DDC2 9C 17 21     STZ.W $2117                     ; / VRAM address = $0000
$03:DDC5 9B           TXY                             ; Y = ExGFX file number
$03:DDC6 F0 0F        BEQ $DDD7                       ; None: skip the graphics upload
$03:DDC8 22 28 BA 00  JSL.L $BA28                     ; Decompress ExGFX file Y to $7E:AD00 and point [$00] at it
$03:DDCC A9 80        LDA.B #$80                      ; \
$03:DDCE 85 03        STA $03                         ; / $03 = $80: number of 3bpp tiles to convert
$03:DDD0 20 E5 DD     JSR.W $DDE5                     ; Convert one tile (normal and mirrored copy) and upload it
$03:DDD3 C6 03        DEC $03                         ; \
$03:DDD5 D0 F9        BNE $DDD0                       ; / Repeat for all 128 tiles (256 Mode 7 tiles)
$03:DDD7 A2 5F        LDX.B #$5F                      ; \
$03:DDD9 A9 FF        LDA.B #$FF                      ; |
$03:DDDB 9F 80 C6 7E  STA.L $7EC680,X                 ; |
$03:DDDF CA           DEX                             ; |
$03:DDE0 10 F7        BPL $DDD9                       ; / Fill the 96-byte Mode 7 tilemap buffer at $7E:C680 with tile $FF (blank)
$03:DDE2 AB           PLB                             ; Restore data bank
$03:DDE3 FA           PLX                             ; Restore sprite index
$03:DDE4 6B           RTL                             ; Return

$03:DDE5 A2 00        LDX.B #$00                      ; \
$03:DDE7 9B           TXY                             ; / X = Y = 0: pixel buffer index and source byte index
$03:DDE8 A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; \
$03:DDEA 85 05        STA $05                         ; / $05 = 8 rows per tile
$03:DDEC 20 39 DE     JSR.W $DE39                     ; Read bitplanes 0 and 1 of this row into the pixel buffer
$03:DDEF 5A           PHY                             ; \
$03:DDF0 98           TYA                             ; |
$03:DDF1 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:DDF2 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:DDF3 69 0F        ADC.B #$0F                      ; |
$03:DDF5 A8           TAY                             ; / Y = Y / 2 + $0F: offset of bitplane 2 of this row
$03:DDF6 20 3C DE     JSR.W $DE3C                     ; Read bitplane 2 of this row (pixel index X unchanged)
$03:DDF9 A0 08        LDY.B #$08                      ; Y = 8 pixels per row
$03:DDFB BD A3 1B     LDA.W $1BA3,X                   ; \
$03:DDFE 0A           ASL                             ; |
$03:DDFF 2A           ROL                             ; |
$03:DE00 2A           ROL                             ; |
$03:DE01 2A           ROL                             ; |
$03:DE02 29 07        AND.B #$07                      ; |
$03:DE04 9D A3 1B     STA.W $1BA3,X                   ; / A = 3-bit color of this pixel: rotate the three collected plane bits down
$03:DE07 8D 19 21     STA.W $2119                     ; Write the pixel to the Mode 7 tile data (VRAM high byte)
$03:DE0A E8           INX                             ; \
$03:DE0B 88           DEY                             ; |
$03:DE0C D0 ED        BNE $DDFB                       ; / Next pixel; repeat for the 8 pixels of the row
$03:DE0E 7A           PLY                             ; Restore source byte index
$03:DE0F C6 05        DEC $05                         ; \
$03:DE11 D0 D9        BNE $DDEC                       ; / Repeat for 8 rows
$03:DE13 A9 07        LDA.B #$07                      ; A = 7: index of the last pixel in row 0
$03:DE15 AA           TAX                             ; X = A
$03:DE16 A0 08        LDY.B #$08                      ; \
$03:DE18 84 05        STY $05                         ; / $05 = 8 pixels per row
$03:DE1A BC A3 1B     LDY.W $1BA3,X                   ; \
$03:DE1D 8C 19 21     STY.W $2119                     ; |
$03:DE20 CA           DEX                             ; |
$03:DE21 C6 05        DEC $05                         ; |
$03:DE23 D0 F5        BNE $DE1A                       ; / Write this row backwards (mirrored tile)
$03:DE25 18           CLC                             ; \
$03:DE26 69 08        ADC.B #$08                      ; |
$03:DE28 C9 40        CMP.B #$40                      ; |
$03:DE2A 90 E9        BCC $DE15                       ; / Next row: A += 8, until all 8 rows are done
$03:DE2C C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$03:DE2E A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$03:DE30 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:DE31 69 18 00     ADC.W #$0018                    ; |
$03:DE34 85 00        STA $00                         ; / [$00] += $18: next 3bpp tile (24 bytes)
$03:DE36 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$03:DE38 60           RTS                             ; Return

$03:DE39 20 3C DE     JSR.W $DE3C                     ; Read two bitplane bytes (calls the routine below twice)
$03:DE3C DA           PHX                             ; Save pixel index
$03:DE3D B7 00        LDA [$00],Y                     ; A = next bitplane byte of the row
$03:DE3F 5A           PHY                             ; Save source index
$03:DE40 A0 08        LDY.B #$08                      ; Y = 8 bits
$03:DE42 0A           ASL                             ; \
$03:DE43 7E A3 1B     ROR.W $1BA3,X                   ; |
$03:DE46 E8           INX                             ; |
$03:DE47 88           DEY                             ; |
$03:DE48 D0 F8        BNE $DE42                       ; / Shift each bit of A into bit 7 of the pixel buffer bytes $1BA3 + X ...
$03:DE4A 7A           PLY                             ; Restore source index
$03:DE4B C8           INY                             ; Y = next source byte
$03:DE4C FA           PLX                             ; Restore pixel index
$03:DE4D 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $DE4E..DE86: Table: 8x8 Mode 7 tile block ;;;
{
;; Tile numbers (8 rows of 8) drawn by $DE8E; the last entry $3F is probably the corner.
$03:DE4E              .db $40,$41,$42,$43,$44,$45,$46,$47 ; Tile row 0 of the 8x8 tile block
$03:DE56              .db $50,$51,$52,$53,$54,$55,$56,$57 ; Tile row 1 of the 8x8 tile block
$03:DE5E              .db $60,$61,$62,$63,$64,$65,$66,$67 ; Tile row 2 of the 8x8 tile block
$03:DE66              .db $70,$71,$72,$73,$74,$75,$76,$77 ; Tile row 3 of the 8x8 tile block
$03:DE6E              .db $48,$49,$4A,$4B,$4C,$4D,$4E,$4F ; Tile row 4 of the 8x8 tile block
$03:DE76              .db $58,$59,$5A,$5B,$5C,$5D,$5E,$5F ; Tile row 5 of the 8x8 tile block
$03:DE7E              .db $68,$69,$6A,$6B,$6C,$6D,$6E,$6F ; Tile row 6 of the 8x8 tile block
$03:DE86              .db $78,$79,$7A,$7B,$7C,$7D,$7E,$3F ; Tile row 7 of the 8x8 tile block

}

;;; $DE8E: Draw 8x8 tile block into Mode 7 map ;;;
{
;; Writes the 64 tile numbers of $DE4E as 8 rows of 8 tiles into the Mode 7 tilemap at VRAM word address
;;     $0A9C (row 21, column 28), one row per $80 words.
;; Only used for boss 4 by the setup routine.
;; Called by:
;;     $03:DD8A: Mode 7 boss graphics and palette setup (KoopaPalPtrHi)
$03:DE8E 9C 15 21     STZ.W $2115                     ; VMAIN = 0: VRAM address increments after $2118 writes
$03:DE91 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$03:DE93 A9 1C 0A     LDA.W #$0A1C                    ; \
$03:DE96 85 00        STA $00                         ; / [$00] = $0A1C: VRAM address of the block minus one tilemap row ($80)
$03:DE98 A2 00        LDX.B #$00                      ; X = 0: index into $DE4E
$03:DE9A C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$03:DE9C A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$03:DE9E 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:DE9F 69 80 00     ADC.W #$0080                    ; |
$03:DEA2 85 00        STA $00                         ; |
$03:DEA4 8D 16 21     STA.W $2116                     ; / [$00] += $80 (next tilemap row) and set it as the VRAM address
$03:DEA7 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$03:DEA9 A0 08        LDY.B #$08                      ; Y = 8 tiles per row
$03:DEAB BF 4E DE 03  LDA.L $DE4E,X                   ; \
$03:DEAF 8D 18 21     STA.W $2118                     ; / Write the tile number to the Mode 7 tilemap
$03:DEB2 E8           INX                             ; \
$03:DEB3 88           DEY                             ; |
$03:DEB4 D0 F5        BNE $DEAB                       ; / Repeat for 8 tiles
$03:DEB6 E0 40        CPX.B #$40                      ; \
$03:DEB8 90 E0        BCC $DE9A                       ; / Repeat for 8 rows (64 tiles)
$03:DEBA 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $DEBB..DED7: Tables: Mode 7 scroll offsets and animation ;;;
{
;; $DEBB: scroll offsets ($0100, $0110). $DEBF/03DEC7/03DECF: animated top strip tiles.
;;     $DED7: source offsets of animated rows.
$03:DEBB              .db $00,$01,$10,$01             ; Mode 7 scroll offsets: X = $0100, Y = $0110 (16-bit words)

$03:DEBF              .db $6E,$70,$FF,$50,$FE,$FE,$FF,$57 ; Top strip tiles 1-2 for animation frames 0-3
$03:DEC7              .db $72,$74,$52,$54,$3C,$3E,$55,$53 ; Top strip tiles 3-4 for animation frames 0-3
$03:DECF              .db $76,$56,$56,$FF,$FF,$FF,$51,$FF ; Top strip tiles 5-6 for animation frames 0-3
$03:DED7              .db $20,$03,$30,$03,$40,$03,$50,$03 ; Animated row offsets: $0320, $0330, $0340, $0350

}

;;; $DEDF: Position Mode 7 picture, build tilemap ;;;
{
;; Called each frame by the boss and Reznor code. Sets the Mode 7 scroll [$3A]/[$3C] so the picture sits at
;;     the sprite position in X/Y,
;; then builds the tilemap in the buffer at $7E:C680: either a 4x4 picture frame ([$0D9B] bit 0 clear) or a
;;     12-row, 8-wide picture with animated rows ([$0D9B] bit 0 set).
;; [$1BA2]: bits 0-6 = frame number, bit 7 = flip horizontally (reads rows backwards and swaps tile numbers
;;     with their mirror, bit 0).
;; [$1BA1]: only its sign (bit 15 of the word) is used. $03DFAE: computes one scroll value (Y = 0: horizontal,
;;     Y = 2: vertical).
;; Parameters: X: sprite index (preserved). A is lost.
;; Called by:
;;     $01:CDD8: Morton, Roy and Ludwig main routine (WallKoopaKids)
;;     $01:D036: Ludwig sub-states: walk and jump; hit and death states
;;     $03:98BE: Reznor ring: sign and level end (ReznorSignCode)
;;     $03:A2A1: Bowser main logic
$03:DEDF 8B           PHB                             ; \
$03:DEE0 4B           PHK                             ; |
$03:DEE1 AB           PLB                             ; / Data bank = $03 (old bank saved)
$03:DEE2 BD E0 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; \
$03:DEE5 EB           XBA                             ; |
$03:DEE6 B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; / A = sprite X position (16 bit)
$03:DEE8 A0 00        LDY.B #$00                      ; \
$03:DEEA 20 AE DF     JSR.W $DFAE                     ; / Mode 7 H-scroll [$3A] = [$1A] + $0100 - sprite X
$03:DEED BD D4 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; \
$03:DEF0 EB           XBA                             ; |
$03:DEF1 B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; / A = sprite Y position (16 bit)
$03:DEF3 A0 02        LDY.B #$02                      ; \
$03:DEF5 20 AE DF     JSR.W $DFAE                     ; / Mode 7 V-scroll [$3C] = [$1C] + $0110 - sprite Y
$03:DEF8 DA           PHX                             ; Save sprite index
$03:DEF9 C2 30        REP #$30                        ; A, X and Y 16-bit
$03:DEFB 64 06        STZ $06                         ; $06 = 0: write index into the tilemap buffer $7E:C680
$03:DEFD A0 03 00     LDY.W #$0003                    ; Y = 3: row width - 1 (4 tiles)
$03:DF00 AD 9B 0D     LDA.W $0D9B                     ; \
$03:DF03 4A           LSR                             ; |
$03:DF04 90 3E        BCC $DF44                       ; / [$0D9B] bit 0 clear: 4x4 tile picture, go to $03DF44
$03:DF06 AD 28 14     LDA.W $1428                     ; \
$03:DF09 29 03 00     AND.W #$0003                    ; |
$03:DF0C 0A           ASL                             ; |
$03:DF0D AA           TAX                             ; / X = ([$1428] & 3) * 2: top strip animation frame
$03:DF0E BF BF DE 03  LDA.L $DEBF,X                   ; \
$03:DF12 8F 81 C6 7E  STA.L $7EC681                   ; / Top strip tiles 1-2 = $DEBF[X]
$03:DF16 BF C7 DE 03  LDA.L $DEC7,X                   ; \
$03:DF1A 8F 83 C6 7E  STA.L $7EC683                   ; / Top strip tiles 3-4 = $DEC7[X]
$03:DF1E BF CF DE 03  LDA.L $DECF,X                   ; \
$03:DF22 8F 85 C6 7E  STA.L $7EC685                   ; / Top strip tiles 5-6 = $DECF[X]
$03:DF26 A9 08 00     LDA.W #$0008                    ; \
$03:DF29 85 06        STA $06                         ; / $06 = 8: the rows below start after the 8-tile top strip
$03:DF2B A2 80 03     LDX.W #$0380                    ; X = $0380: table offset of the second row
$03:DF2E AD A2 1B     LDA.W $1BA2                     ; \
$03:DF31 29 7F 00     AND.W #$007F                    ; |
$03:DF34 C9 2C 00     CMP.W #$002C                    ; |
$03:DF37 90 03        BCC $DF3C                       ; |
$03:DF39 A2 88 03     LDX.W #$0388                    ; / If frame ([$1BA2] & $7F) >= $2C use offset $0388 instead
$03:DF3C 8A           TXA                             ; A = table offset of the second row
$03:DF3D A2 0A 00     LDX.W #$000A                    ; X = $0A: pass counter (11 rows to copy)
$03:DF40 A0 07 00     LDY.W #$0007                    ; Y = 7: row width - 1 (8 tiles)
$03:DF43 38           SEC                             ; Carry set: skip the frame offset calculation
$03:DF44 84 00        STY $00                         ; $00 = row width - 1
$03:DF46 B0 0D        BCS $DF55                       ; Carry set (8-wide picture): start copying
$03:DF48 AD A2 1B     LDA.W $1BA2                     ; \
$03:DF4B 29 7F 00     AND.W #$007F                    ; |
$03:DF4E 0A           ASL                             ; |
$03:DF4F 0A           ASL                             ; |
$03:DF50 0A           ASL                             ; |
$03:DF51 0A           ASL                             ; / A = ([$1BA2] & $7F) * 16: offset of the frame in $D9DE
$03:DF52 A2 03 00     LDX.W #$0003                    ; X = 3: four rows per frame
$03:DF55 86 02        STX $02                         ; $02 = number of passes left
$03:DF57 48           PHA                             ; Save the table offset
$03:DF58 AC A1 1B     LDY.W $1BA1                     ; \
$03:DF5B 10 03        BPL $DF60                       ; |
$03:DF5D 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:DF5E 65 00        ADC $00                         ; / If [$1BA2] bit 7 is set (flipped): start at the end of the row
$03:DF60 A8           TAY                             ; Y = table offset
$03:DF61 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$03:DF63 A6 06        LDX $06                         ; X = write index into the tilemap buffer
$03:DF65 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$03:DF67 85 04        STA $04                         ; / $04 = row width - 1: tile counter
$03:DF69 B9 DE D9     LDA.W $D9DE,Y                   ; A = tile number from the picture table
$03:DF6C C8           INY                             ; Next table byte
$03:DF6D 2C A2 1B     BIT.W $1BA2                     ; \
$03:DF70 10 04        BPL $DF76                       ; / Not flipped: keep the tile
$03:DF72 49 01        EOR.B #$01                      ; \
$03:DF74 88           DEY                             ; |
$03:DF75 88           DEY                             ; / Flipped: use the mirrored tile (toggle bit 0) and walk backwards
$03:DF76 9F 80 C6 7E  STA.L $7EC680,X                 ; Store the tile in the tilemap buffer
$03:DF7A E8           INX                             ; Next buffer byte
$03:DF7B C6 04        DEC $04                         ; \
$03:DF7D 10 EA        BPL $DF69                       ; / Repeat for the whole row
$03:DF7F 86 06        STX $06                         ; Save the buffer write index
$03:DF81 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$03:DF83 68           PLA                             ; \
$03:DF84 38           SEC                             ; |
$03:DF85 65 00        ADC $00                         ; / A = saved table offset + row width: next row
$03:DF87 A6 02        LDX $02                         ; X = passes left
$03:DF89 E0 04 00     CPX.W #$0004                    ; \
$03:DF8C F0 BA        BEQ $DF48                       ; / Pass 4: switch to the frame dependent rows ($03DF48)
$03:DF8E E0 08 00     CPX.W #$0008                    ; \
$03:DF91 D0 03        BNE $DF96                       ; |
$03:DF93 A9 60 03     LDA.W #$0360                    ; / Pass 8: next source = $0360 (static rows)
$03:DF96 E0 0A 00     CPX.W #$000A                    ; \
$03:DF99 D0 0B        BNE $DFA6                       ; |
$03:DF9B AD 27 14     LDA.W $1427                     ; |
$03:DF9E 29 03 00     AND.W #$0003                    ; |
$03:DFA1 0A           ASL                             ; |
$03:DFA2 A8           TAY                             ; |
$03:DFA3 B9 D7 DE     LDA.W $DED7,Y                   ; / Pass 10: next source = $DED7[([$1427] & 3) * 2] (animated rows)
$03:DFA6 CA           DEX                             ; \
$03:DFA7 10 AC        BPL $DF55                       ; / Next pass; repeat until X < 0
$03:DFA9 E2 30        SEP #$30                        ; A, X and Y 8-bit
$03:DFAB FA           PLX                             ; Restore sprite index
$03:DFAC AB           PLB                             ; Restore data bank
$03:DFAD 6B           RTL                             ; Return

$03:DFAE DA           PHX                             ; Save X
$03:DFAF BB           TYX                             ; X = Y (0 = horizontal, 2 = vertical)
$03:DFB0 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$03:DFB2 49 FF FF     EOR.W #$FFFF                    ; \
$03:DFB5 1A           INC A                           ; |
$03:DFB6 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:DFB7 7F BB DE 03  ADC.L $DEBB,X                   ; |
$03:DFBB 18           CLC                             ; |
$03:DFBC 75 1A        ADC RAM_ScreenBndryXLo,X        ; |
$03:DFBE 95 3A        STA $3A,X                       ; / Scroll [$3A+X] = -A + $DEBB[X] + screen boundary ([$1A] or [$1C])
$03:DFC0 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$03:DFC2 FA           PLX                             ; Restore X
$03:DFC3 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $DFC4..DFC4: Table: palette set offsets ;;;
{
;; 8 offsets in steps of $0E into $B69E, indexed by [$1429] at $03E039; probably lightning flash palette
;;     sets.
$03:DFC4              .db $00,$0E,$1C,$2A,$38,$46,$54,$62 ; Offsets (14 apart) into $B69E, probably palette sets

}

;;; $DFCC: Bowser room palette and lightning flash ;;;
{
;; Called from Bowser's INIT/main (JSL at BowserFight). Appends an 8-color CGRAM upload record (start color 0)
;;     to the palette buffer at [$0681].
;; Color 0 (backdrop) flashes with thunder: a random delay in [$1FFC] counts down, then [$1FFB] steps through
;;     $B5DE colors and sound $18 plays.
;; Colors 1-7 come from a 14-byte row of $B69E selected by [$1429]; [$190D] non-zero (hedged: no
;;     lightning) keeps the backdrop color [$0701].
;; Called by:
;;     $03:A259: Bowser fight sprite main (BowserFight)
$03:DFCC DA           PHX                             ; Save X
$03:DFCD AE 81 06     LDX.W $0681                     ; X = palette buffer write index [$0681]
$03:DFD0 A9 10        LDA.B #$10                      ; \
$03:DFD2 9D 82 06     STA.W $0682,X                   ; / Record header: byte count = $10 (8 colors)
$03:DFD5 9E 83 06     STZ.W $0683,X                   ; CGRAM start address = 0 (backdrop color)
$03:DFD8 9E 84 06     STZ.W $0684,X                   ; \
$03:DFDB 9E 85 06     STZ.W $0685,X                   ; / Default color 0 = $0000 (replaced below)
$03:DFDE 9B           TXY                             ; Y = write index (X is reused)
$03:DFDF AE FB 1F     LDX.W $1FFB                     ; X = [$1FFB] (lightning flash step, 0 = no flash running)
$03:DFE2 D0 37        BNE $E01B                       ; Flash running: continue it at $03E01B
$03:DFE4 AD 0D 19     LDA.W $190D                     ; \
$03:DFE7 F0 07        BEQ $DFF0                       ; / [$190D] (probably disables lightning) = 0: go check for a new flash
$03:DFE9 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$03:DFEB AD 01 07     LDA.W $0701                     ; A = [$0701] (current backdrop color)
$03:DFEE 80 41        BRA $E031                       ; Use it unchanged as color 0

$03:DFF0 A5 14        LDA RAM_FrameCounterB           ; A = [RAM_FrameCounterB]
$03:DFF2 4A           LSR                             ; \
$03:DFF3 90 41        BCC $E036                       ; / Only act on odd frames
$03:DFF5 CE FC 1F     DEC.W $1FFC                     ; \
$03:DFF8 D0 3C        BNE $E036                       ; / Count down [$1FFC] (delay to next flash); not zero: no new flash
$03:DFFA AA           TAX                             ; X = frame counter / 2 (random-looking index)
$03:DFFB BF 08 F7 04  LDA.L $F708,X                   ; Read a byte from ROM $04F708 as a pseudo-random number
$03:DFFF 29 07        AND.B #$07                      ; \
$03:E001 AA           TAX                             ; / X = random 0-7
$03:E002 BF F8 F6 04  LDA.L $F6F8,X                   ; \
$03:E006 8D FC 1F     STA.W $1FFC                     ; / [$1FFC] = $F6F8[X] (frames until the next flash)
$03:E009 BF 00 F7 04  LDA.L $F700,X                   ; \
$03:E00D 8D FB 1F     STA.W $1FFB                     ; / [$1FFB] = $F700[X] (flash length in steps)
$03:E010 AA           TAX                             ; X = [$1FFB]
$03:E011 A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; \
$03:E013 8D FD 1F     STA.W $1FFD                     ; / [$1FFD] = 8 (frames for the first step)
$03:E016 A9 18        LDA.B #$18                      ; \
$03:E018 8D FC 1D     STA.W $1DFC                     ; / Play sound effect $18 (thunder)
$03:E01B CE FD 1F     DEC.W $1FFD                     ; Step timer [$1FFD]--
$03:E01E 10 08        BPL $E028                       ; Still >= 0: keep the same step
$03:E020 CE FB 1F     DEC.W $1FFB                     ; Next step: [$1FFB]--
$03:E023 A9 04        LDA.B #$04                      ; \
$03:E025 8D FD 1F     STA.W $1FFD                     ; / [$1FFD] = 4 (frames per later step)
$03:E028 8A           TXA                             ; \
$03:E029 0A           ASL                             ; |
$03:E02A AA           TAX                             ; } X = [$1FFB] * 2: word index into the flash color table
$03:E02B C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$03:E02D BF DE B5 00  LDA.L $B5DE,X                   ; A = flash color $B5DE[X]
$03:E031 99 84 06     STA.W $0684,Y                   ; Color 0 (backdrop) in the buffer = A
$03:E034 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$03:E036 AE 29 14     LDX.W $1429                     ; X = [$1429] (probably Bowser's phase / palette row)
$03:E039 BF C4 DF 03  LDA.L $DFC4,X                   ; \
$03:E03D AA           TAX                             ; / X = row offset (row * $0E) into the palette table
$03:E03E A9 0E        LDA.B #$0E                      ; \
$03:E040 85 00        STA $00                         ; / Byte counter = $0E (colors 1-7)
$03:E042 BF 9E B6 00  LDA.L $B69E,X                   ; Copy a palette byte from $B69E[X]...
$03:E046 99 86 06     STA.W $0686,Y                   ; ...into the buffer (colors 1-7 of the record)
$03:E049 E8           INX                             ; Next source byte
$03:E04A C8           INY                             ; Next buffer byte
$03:E04B C6 00        DEC $00                         ; \
$03:E04D D0 F3        BNE $E042                       ; / Loop for all 14 bytes
$03:E04F BB           TYX                             ; X = end of record
$03:E050 9E 86 06     STZ.W $0686,X                   ; Write terminator 0 after the record
$03:E053 E8           INX                             ; \
$03:E054 E8           INX                             ; |
$03:E055 E8           INX                             ; |
$03:E056 E8           INX                             ; } Buffer index += 4 (so [$0681] = old index + 18)
$03:E057 8E 81 06     STX.W $0681                     ; Store the new palette buffer index
$03:E05A FA           PLX                             ; Restore X
$03:E05B 6B           RTL                             ; Return


}
